            '  Future<V2TimMessageListResult?> getHistoryMessageListThroughIm06({\r\n'

            '      conversationId: group.isNotEmpty ? group : peer,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (scope == null) {\r\n'
            '      _lastHistoryErrorByConversation[conversationID] = <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'errorType\': \'invalid_scope\',\r\n'
            '        \'errorCode\': null,\r\n'
            '        \'description\': \'IM history scope cannot be created\',\r\n'
            '      };\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'history_im06_unavailable\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'reason\': \'invalid_scope\',\r\n'
            '          \'requestedSource\': getType.name,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final requestedSource = switch (getType) {\r\n'
            '      HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_LOCAL_OLDER_MSG ||\r\n'
            '      HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_LOCAL_NEWER_MSG =>\r\n'
            '        ImHistorySource.local,\r\n'
            '      _ => ImHistorySource.cloud,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    final cursorId = (lastMsgID ?? lastMsg?.msgID)?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final cursorSeq =\r\n'
            '        conversationType == ImConversationType.group && lastMsgSeq > 0\r\n'
            '            ? lastMsgSeq\r\n'
            '            : null;\r\n'
            '    final hasPinnedGroupSeqs = conversationType == ImConversationType.group &&\r\n'
            '        messageSeqList?.isNotEmpty == true;\r\n'
            '    final hasPaginationCursor = cursorId.isNotEmpty || cursorSeq != null;\r\n'
            '    // An exact group-Seq lookup is still a directional history request even\r\n'
            '    // though it deliberately has no pagination cursor. Treating it as the\r\n'
            '    // latest window rewrites CLOUD_NEWER to CLOUD_OLDER in the typed adapter.\r\n'
            '    final hasDirectionalAnchor = hasPaginationCursor || hasPinnedGroupSeqs;\r\n'
            '    final direction = !hasDirectionalAnchor\r\n'
            '        ? ImHistoryDirection.latest\r\n'
            '        : switch (getType) {\r\n'
            '            HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_LOCAL_NEWER_MSG ||\r\n'
            '            HistoryMsgGetTypeEnum.V2TIM_GET_CLOUD_NEWER_MSG =>\r\n'
            '              ImHistoryDirection.newer,\r\n'
            '            _ => ImHistoryDirection.older,\r\n'
            '          };\r\n'
            '    final requestGeneration = ++_im06HistoryRequestSequence;\r\n'
            '    final coordinator = _im06HistorySearchCoordinator ??=\r\n'
            '        Im06HistorySearchCoordinator.production(\r\n'
            '      messageService: _messageService,\r\n'
            '      platform: _im06Platform,\r\n'
            '      ownerUserId: writerScope.normalizedOwnerUserID,\r\n'
            '      accountGeneration: writerScope.accountGeneration,\r\n'
            '      domainGeneration: writerScope.domainGeneration,\r\n'
            '      coverageStore: appIm06HistoryCoverageStore,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final result = await coordinator.readHistory(\r\n'
            '      Im06HistoryRequest(\r\n'
            '        scope: scope,\r\n'
            '        platform: _im06Platform,\r\n'
            '        requestedSource: requestedSource,\r\n'
            '        direction: direction,\r\n'
            '        requestId: \'uikit-history-$requestGeneration\',\r\n'
            '        requestGeneration: requestGeneration,\r\n'
            '        accountGeneration: writerScope.accountGeneration,\r\n'
            '        domainGeneration: writerScope.domainGeneration,\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(scope.conversationId),\r\n'
            '        count: count,\r\n'
            '        lastMessage: lastMsg,\r\n'
            '        cursor: hasPaginationCursor\r\n'
            '            ? Im06HistoryCursor(\r\n'
            '                messageId: cursorId.isEmpty ? null : cursorId,\r\n'
            '                sequence: cursorSeq,\r\n'
            '              )\r\n'
            '            : const Im06HistoryCursor.latest(),\r\n'
            '        messageTypeList: messageTypeList,\r\n'
            '        messageSeqList: messageSeqList,\r\n'
            '        timeBegin: timeBegin,\r\n'
            '        timePeriod: timePeriod,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (_messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != writerScope ||\r\n'
            '        !result.isSuccess ||\r\n'
            '        result.page == null) {\r\n'
            '      _lastHistoryErrorByConversation[conversationID] = <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'errorType\': _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != writerScope\r\n'
            '            ? \'scope_changed\'\r\n'
            '            : result.error?.name ?? \'unknown\',\r\n'
            '        \'errorCode\': result.errorCode,\r\n'
            '        \'description\': result.errorDescription ?? \'history request failed\',\r\n'
            '      };\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'history_im06_failure\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'reason\': _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != writerScope\r\n'
            '              ? \'scope_changed\'\r\n'
            '              : result.error?.name ?? \'unknown\',\r\n'
            '          \'error\': result.error?.name,\r\n'
            '          \'errorCode\': result.errorCode,\r\n'
            '          \'description\': result.errorDescription,\r\n'
            '          \'route\': result.route.name,\r\n'
            '          \'requestedSource\': requestedSource.name,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _lastHistoryErrorByConversation.remove(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    return V2TimMessageListResult(\r\n'
            '      isFinished: result.page!.isCompleted,\r\n'
            '      messageList: result.page!.messages.whereType<V2TimMessage>().toList(),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  ImPlatform get _im06Platform {\r\n'

            '      localID: message.id,\r\n'
            '      outgoingStableID: readOutgoingStableId(message) ??\r\n'

            '  Iterable<MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>> _reconciliationRecords(\r\n'

            '      (message.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '              ((message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\').isEmpty ||\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _seedMessageWriterFromProjection(\r\n'
            '    String key,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> current, {\r\n'
            '    required int clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final trackSeqGaps = _isGroupConversation(key, messages: current);\r\n'
            '    if (_messageReconciliationWriter.ownsAuthoritativeWindow(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '      expectedAuthority: _writerProjectionAuthorities[key],\r\n'
            '      values: current,\r\n'
            '      matchesRecord: (record, value) =>\r\n'
            '          record.msgID == value.msgID &&\r\n'
            '          record.localID == value.id &&\r\n'
            '          record.seq == value.seq &&\r\n'
            '          record.outgoingStableID == _outgoingRecordStableIdentity(value),\r\n'
            '      trackSeqGaps: trackSeqGaps,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'

            '    ChatMainThreadPerf.increment(\'message_writer_seed_performed\');\r\n'
            '    _messageReconciliationWriter.seedAuthoritative(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '      records: _reconciliationRecords(current),\r\n'
            '      trackSeqGaps: trackSeqGaps,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'

            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.authorityFor(key);\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  int messageDeltaGenerationFor(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) return 0;\r\n'
            '    return _messageReconciliationWriter.coordinator\r\n'
            '        .stateFor(key)\r\n'
            '        .requestGeneration;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int messageDeltaClearEpochFor(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    return _messageHistoryCoverageByConv[key]?.clearEpoch ?? 0;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 窗口库中已记录的最高清空 epoch；null 表示本次未能读取，而非版本 0。\r\n'
            '  Future<int?> _persistedHistoryWindowClearEpoch(String canonicalKey) async {\r\n'
            '    final repository = HistoryWindowRepositoryProvider.repository;\r\n'
            '    final owner =\r\n'
            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope?.normalizedOwnerUserID ??\r\n'
            '            \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (repository == null || owner.isEmpty || canonicalKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      return await repository.persistedClearEpoch(\r\n'
            '        ownerUserID: owner,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: canonicalKey,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 内存 clearEpoch 落后于窗口库时采纳窗口库的值。\r\n'
            '  /// 否则 `_checkScope` 会把每次分页读都判成 stale，上拉永远静默失败。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> syncHistoryClearEpochFromWindowStore(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    final key = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    if (_historyWindowClearEpochSyncedKeys.contains(key)) return;\r\n'
            '    final sessionGeneration = _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final persisted = await _persistedHistoryWindowClearEpoch(key);\r\n'
            '    if (persisted == null ||\r\n'
            '        sessionGeneration != _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration) return;\r\n'
            '    final current = messageDeltaClearEpochFor(key);\r\n'
            '    if (persisted <= current) {\r\n'
            '      _historyWindowClearEpochSyncedKeys.add(key);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    await ensureMessageHistoryCoverageLoaded(key, clearEpoch: persisted);\r\n'
            '    if (sessionGeneration != _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration) return;\r\n'
            '    final coverage = messageHistoryCoverageFor(key);\r\n'
            '    // A failed/obsolete read, or a concurrent coverage load that did not adopt\r\n'
            '    // the floor yet, must leave the next foreground pagination free to retry.\r\n'
            '    if (coverage == null || coverage.clearEpoch < persisted) return;\r\n'
            '    _historyWindowClearEpochSyncedKeys.add(key);\r\n'
            '    unawaited(persistMessageHistoryCoverage(coverage));\r\n'
            '    ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '      \'history_clear_epoch_synced_from_window_store\',\r\n'
            '      conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'memoryEpoch\': current,\r\n'
            '        \'persistedEpoch\': persisted,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'

            '          .recordsFor(\r\n'
            '            canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID),\r\n'
            '          )\r\n'
            '          .length;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// DIAG: 当前 IM06 scope 状态读取接口（仅用于 trace，不参与业务逻辑）。\r\n'
            '  String? get im06WriterOwnerUserID =>\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope?.ownerUserID;\r\n'
            '  int? get im06WriterAccountGeneration =>\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope?.accountGeneration;\r\n'
            '  int? get im06WriterDomainGeneration =>\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope?.domainGeneration;\r\n'
            '  bool get im06WriterScopeConfigured =>\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != null;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Supplies the account and SDK-session scope captured by app ingress.\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// The UIKit model does not infer the logged-in account. The host app must\r\n'
            '  /// call this at login/session ownership time so late events can be rejected\r\n'
            '  /// by the single Writer.\r\n'
            '  void configureMessageWriterScope({\r\n'
            '    required String ownerUserID,\r\n'

            '    required int domainGeneration,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void releaseMessageDeltaTombstones(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<String> msgIDs,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) return;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void restoreMessageDeltaAfterDeleteFailure(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final restored = messages.toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    if (restored.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    final ids = restored\r\n'
            '        .map((message) => message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\')\r\n'
            '        .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    releaseMessageDeltaTombstones(conversationID, ids);\r\n'
            '    commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: conversationID,\r\n'
            '        eventID:\r\n'
            '            \'delete_rollback:${ids.join(\',\')}:${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.optimisticAdoption,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.userAction,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(conversationID),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(conversationID),\r\n'
            '        upserts: _reconciliationRecords(restored),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Authoritative boundary for realtime, optimistic, edit, revoke and delete.\r\n'
            '  /// `setMessageList` remains the final UI projection writer, but no caller in\r\n'
            '  /// these mutation paths decides merge/removal semantics independently.\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// [forcePublishForRevoke] bypasses the active history request barrier for\r\n'
            '  /// revoke deltas only; this lets the user-visible revoke UX refresh\r\n'
            '  /// immediately instead of waiting for the in-flight history transaction.\r\n'
            '  /// Other kinds, scope mismatches, generation mismatches and eventID dupes\r\n'
            '  /// are still rejected.\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult? commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '    MessageDelta<V2TimMessage> delta, {\r\n'
            '    bool applyMemoryWindow = true,\r\n'
            '    bool memoryWindowPreferLatest = false,\r\n'
            '    bool forcePublishForRevoke = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(delta.conversationKey);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? delta.conversationKey.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty || delta.isSynthetic) return null;\r\n'
            '    if (!_messageReconciliationWriter.hasActiveRequest(key)) {\r\n'
            '      final current = _mergedAliasMessageList(key);\r\n'
            '      _seedMessageWriterFromProjection(\r\n'
            '        key,\r\n'
            '        current,\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: delta.clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final normalized = MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '      conversationKey: key,\r\n'
            '      eventID: delta.eventID,\r\n'
            '      kind: delta.kind,\r\n'
            '      source: delta.source,\r\n'
            '      generation: delta.generation,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: delta.clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      ownerUserID: delta.ownerUserID,\r\n'
            '      accountGeneration: delta.accountGeneration,\r\n'
            '      domainGeneration: delta.domainGeneration,\r\n'
            '      replace: delta.replace,\r\n'
            '      upserts: delta.upserts,\r\n'
            '      localDeletes: delta.localDeletes,\r\n'
            '      explicitDeletes: delta.explicitDeletes,\r\n'
            '      tombstones: delta.tombstones,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // A history request is a read-side transaction. It must never hold back\r\n'
            '    // realtime rows (including group rows) or the send/ack projection for the\r\n'
            '    // same conversation. The Writer still retains each delta for the final\r\n'
            '    // history merge, so publishing here cannot lose ordering or dedupe.\r\n'
            '    final publishDuringHistory =\r\n'
            '        normalized.kind == MessageDeltaKind.realtimeUpsert ||\r\n'
            '            normalized.kind == MessageDeltaKind.delete ||\r\n'
            '            normalized.source == MessageDeltaSource.sendPipeline;\r\n'
            '    final writerCommit =\r\n'
            '        forcePublishForRevoke && delta.kind == MessageDeltaKind.revoke\r\n'
            '            ? _messageReconciliationWriter.applyRevokeDelta(normalized)\r\n'
            '            : _messageReconciliationWriter.applyDelta(\r\n'
            '                normalized,\r\n'
            '                publishDuringHistory: publishDuringHistory,\r\n'
            '              );\r\n'
            '    if (writerCommit == null) return null;\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.kind == MessageDeltaKind.realtimeUpsert &&\r\n'
            '        normalized.source == MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime) {\r\n'
            '      final appended = _commitRealtimeWriterAppend(key, writerCommit);\r\n'
            '      if (appended != null) return appended;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.source == MessageDeltaSource.sendPipeline &&\r\n'
            '        (normalized.kind == MessageDeltaKind.edit ||\r\n'
            '            normalized.kind == MessageDeltaKind.optimisticAdoption)) {\r\n'
            '      final rowCommit = _commitOutgoingMediaRows(key, writerCommit);\r\n'
            '      if (rowCommit != null) return rowCommit;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return setMessageList(\r\n'
            '      key,\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.valuesFor(key),\r\n'
            '      needResetNewMessageCount: false,\r\n'
            '      replace: true,\r\n'
            '      isDeleteMsg: delta.kind == MessageDeltaKind.delete,\r\n'
            '      applyMemoryWindow: applyMemoryWindow,\r\n'
            '      memoryWindowPreferLatest: memoryWindowPreferLatest,\r\n'
            '      writerCommit: writerCommit,\r\n'
            '      historyCommitSource:\r\n'
            '          \'message_delta:${delta.kind.name}:r${writerCommit.revision}\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Publishes a Writer-approved newest-prefix append without running the\r\n'
            '  /// full history reconciliation, sort and gap scan again. The surrounding\r\n'
            '  /// inbound pipeline owns the one list-revision bump and presentation\r\n'
            '  /// pacing for this batch.\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult? _commitRealtimeWriterAppend(\r\n'
            '    String storageKey,\r\n'
            '    MessageReconciliationWriterCommit<V2TimMessage> writerCommit,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (writerCommit.missingSeqRanges.isNotEmpty ||\r\n'
            '        writerCommit.seqIdentityConflicts.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final previous = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    final authoritative = _messageReconciliationWriter.valuesFor(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    if (authoritative.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '        authoritative.length > ChatMessageWindowPolicy.softMax) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final appendedCount = previous.isEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? authoritative.length\r\n'
            '        : _canonicalRealtimeAppendCount(previous, authoritative);\r\n'
            '    if (appendedCount <= 0) return null;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final next = _messageReconciliationWriter.valuesFor(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    _messageListMap[storageKey] = next;\r\n'
            '    _collapseHistoryAliasesToCanonical(storageKey, canonical: storageKey);\r\n'
            '    _invalidateMessageListDisplayCache(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    _messageListContentSignatureByConv[storageKey] =\r\n'
            '        _messageListContentSignature(next);\r\n'
            '    ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.seedEstimatesForMessages(\r\n'
            '      next.take(appendedCount).toList(growable: false),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    ChatMainThreadPerf.increment(\'message_realtime_writer_append\');\r\n'
            '    ChatMainThreadPerf.increment(\'message_realtime_canonical_reused\');\r\n'
            '    return _messageCommitSnapshot(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      storageKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      list: next,\r\n'
            '      structureChanged: true,\r\n'
            '      contentChanged: true,\r\n'
            '      recordCommit: true,\r\n'
            '      writerCommit: writerCommit,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Same-position media adoption must not reset the history viewport.\r\n'
            '  /// Publish the accepted Writer snapshot, then notify only changed rows.\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult? _commitOutgoingMediaRows(\r\n'
            '    String storageKey,\r\n'
            '    MessageReconciliationWriterCommit<V2TimMessage> writerCommit,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final previous = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    final next = _messageReconciliationWriter.valuesFor(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    if (previous.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '        previous.length != next.length ||\r\n'
            '        !isNewestFirstStorageOrderValid(next)) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final changed = <MapEntry<V2TimMessage, V2TimMessage>>[];\r\n'
            '    for (var index = 0; index < previous.length; index++) {\r\n'
            '      final before = previous[index];\r\n'
            '      final after = next[index];\r\n'
            '      if (identical(before, after)) continue;\r\n'
            '      if (_commitSnapshotIdentity(before) == _commitSnapshotIdentity(after) &&\r\n'
            '          _messageListContentSignature([before]) ==\r\n'
            '              _messageListContentSignature([after])) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final stableId = readOutgoingStableId(before)?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (stableId.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '          stableId != readOutgoingStableId(after) ||\r\n'
            '          !_isRowLocalOutgoingMediaReceipt(before, after)) {\r\n'
            '        return null;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      changed.add(MapEntry(before, after));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _messageListMap[storageKey] = next;\r\n'
            '    _collapseHistoryAliasesToCanonical(storageKey, canonical: storageKey);\r\n'
            '    _invalidateMessageListDisplayCache(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    _messageListContentSignatureByConv[storageKey] =\r\n'
            '        _messageListContentSignature(next);\r\n'
            '    for (final change in changed) {\r\n'
            '      ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.rememberAliasesBetween(\r\n'
            '        change.key,\r\n'
            '        change.value,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _markMessageRowChanged(storageKey, change.value, extraKey: change.key.id);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _messageCommitSnapshot(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      storageKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      list: next,\r\n'
            '      structureChanged: false,\r\n'
            '      contentChanged: changed.isNotEmpty,\r\n'
            '      recordCommit: true,\r\n'
            '      writerCommit: writerCommit,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Starts one history transaction against the current authoritative window.\r\n'
            '  /// Realtime callbacks are queued by the same writer until this generation\r\n'
            '  /// either commits or fails, so an old history response cannot overwrite them.\r\n'
            '  MessageReconciliationRequest beginHistoryReconciliation({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationSource requestedSource,\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationNetworkState networkState,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final authoritative = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    _seedMessageWriterFromProjection(\r\n'
            '      storageKey,\r\n'
            '      authoritative,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return _messageReconciliationWriter.beginInitialHistory(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      requestedSource: requestedSource,\r\n'
            '      networkState: networkState,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool hasActiveHistoryReconciliation(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    return key.isNotEmpty && _messageReconciliationWriter.hasActiveRequest(key);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Releases a history writer owned by a chat page that has been disposed.\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// Native SDK history reads cannot be cancelled. Dropping the writer state\r\n'
            '  /// here prevents a late completion from retaining the conversation\'s shared\r\n'
            '  /// mutation lane and lets incoming/send deltas publish normally after the\r\n'
            '  /// route has changed. The runner\'s generation/clear guards still reject the\r\n'
            '  /// late response when its Future eventually completes.\r\n'
            '  void cancelHistoryReconciliation(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _messageReconciliationWriter.reset(key);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  MessageReconciliationState messageReconciliationStateFor(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    return _messageReconciliationWriter.coordinator.stateFor(\r\n'
            '      storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID : storageKey,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  MessageHistoryCommitMetadata? messageHistoryCommitMetadataFor(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    return _lastHistoryCommitMetadataByConv[\r\n'
            '        storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey];\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult? completeHistoryReconciliation({\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationRequest request,\r\n'
            '    required Iterable<V2TimMessage> history,\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationSource actualSource,\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationNetworkState networkState,\r\n'
            '    bool applyMemoryWindow = true,\r\n'
            '    bool memoryWindowPreferLatest = false,\r\n'
            '    String historyCommitSource = \'reconciliation\',\r\n'
            '    bool cloudHasMoreNewer = false,\r\n'
            '    MessageHistoryBatchKind batchKind = MessageHistoryBatchKind.olderPage,\r\n'
            '    bool? historyIsFinished,\r\n'
            '    int? clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '    MessageHistoryCursor? requestedCursor,\r\n'
            '    MessageHistoryBounds? returnedBounds,\r\n'
            '    MessageHistoryProofKind? proofKind,\r\n'
            '    bool? cloudResponseProven,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<String> explicitDeletes = const <String>[],\r\n'
            '    Iterable<String> tombstones = const <String>[],\r\n'
            '    bool skipEquivalentHistoryWindow = false,\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    /// Already canonical window captured by the pagination caller. Reusing it\r\n'
            '    /// avoids a second alias merge/dedupe while committing an older page.\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage>? currentWindowOverride,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    // Include direct row-local/self-send commits made while the request was in\r\n'
            '    // flight. Inbound callbacks are already held in pendingRealtime.\r\n'
            '    final historyList = history.toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    final effectiveClearEpoch =\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch ?? messageDeltaClearEpochFor(request.conversationKey);\r\n'
            '    final current = currentWindowOverride ??\r\n'
            '        _mergedAliasMessageList(request.conversationKey);\r\n'
            '    final authoritativeBase =\r\n'
            '        batchKind == MessageHistoryBatchKind.latestWindow &&\r\n'
            '                actualSource == MessageReconciliationSource.cloud\r\n'
            '            ? _authoritativeBaseForCloudLatestWindow(\r\n'
            '                conversationID: request.conversationKey,\r\n'
            '                current: current,\r\n'
            '                cloudWindow: historyList,\r\n'
            '              )\r\n'
            '            : current;\r\n'
            '    final resolvedProofKind = proofKind ??\r\n'
            '        (cloudResponseProven != null\r\n'
            '            ? (cloudResponseProven\r\n'
            '                ? MessageHistoryProofKind.transportObserved\r\n'
            '                : MessageHistoryProofKind.none)\r\n'
            '            : actualSource == MessageReconciliationSource.cloud &&\r\n'
            '                    networkState == MessageReconciliationNetworkState.online\r\n'
            '                ? MessageHistoryProofKind.transportObserved\r\n'
            '                : MessageHistoryProofKind.none);\r\n'
            '    final commit = _messageReconciliationWriter.completeHistory(\r\n'
            '      request: request,\r\n'
            '      history: _reconciliationRecords(historyList),\r\n'
            '      authoritativeBase: _reconciliationRecords(authoritativeBase),\r\n'
            '      actualSource: actualSource,\r\n'
            '      networkState: networkState,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: effectiveClearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      cloudHasMoreNewer: cloudHasMoreNewer,\r\n'
            '      batchKind: batchKind,\r\n'
            '      proofKind: resolvedProofKind,\r\n'
            '      historyIsFinished: historyIsFinished,\r\n'
            '      explicitDeletes: explicitDeletes,\r\n'
            '      tombstones: tombstones,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit == null) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final result = setMessageList(\r\n'
            '      commit.conversationKey,\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.valuesFor(commit.conversationKey),\r\n'
            '      needResetNewMessageCount: false,\r\n'
            '      replace: true,\r\n'
            '      applyMemoryWindow: applyMemoryWindow,\r\n'
            '      memoryWindowPreferLatest: memoryWindowPreferLatest,\r\n'
            '      skipEquivalentHistoryWindow: true,\r\n'
            '      writerCommit: commit,\r\n'
            '      historyCommitSource: skipEquivalentHistoryWindow\r\n'
            '          ? historyCommitSource\r\n'
            '          : \'$historyCommitSource:r${commit.revision}\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final resolvedMetadataKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(\r\n'
            '      commit.conversationKey,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final metadataKey = resolvedMetadataKey.isEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? commit.conversationKey.trim()\r\n'
            '        : resolvedMetadataKey;\r\n'
            '    _lastHistoryCommitMetadataByConv[metadataKey] =\r\n'
            '        MessageHistoryCommitMetadata(\r\n'
            '      conversationKey: metadataKey,\r\n'
            '      source: actualSource,\r\n'
            '      batchKind: batchKind,\r\n'
            '      generation: request.generation,\r\n'
            '      revision: commit.revision,\r\n'
            '      resultCount: result.rawCount,\r\n'
            '      proofKind: resolvedProofKind,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: effectiveClearEpoch,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _recordMessageHistoryCoverageAfterCommit(\r\n'
            '      request: request,\r\n'
            '      batchKind: batchKind,\r\n'
            '      actualSource: actualSource,\r\n'
            '      networkState: networkState,\r\n'
            '      history: historyList,\r\n'
            '      historyIsFinished: historyIsFinished,\r\n'
            '      cloudHasMoreNewer: cloudHasMoreNewer,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: effectiveClearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      requestedCursor: requestedCursor,\r\n'
            '      returnedBounds: returnedBounds,\r\n'
            '      proofKind: resolvedProofKind,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    unawaited(\r\n'
            '      ImOutgoingSendCoordinator.instance\r\n'
            '          .adoptProviderHistory(historyList)\r\n'
            '          .catchError((Object error) {\r\n'
            '        debugPrint(\r\n'
            '          \'OUTBOX_HISTORY_ADOPTION_FAILURE \'\r\n'
            '          \'errorType=${error.runtimeType}\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return 0;\r\n'
            '      }),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Commits a typed history envelope after validating its request generation\r\n'
            '  /// and clear epoch. Transport provenance and continuity proof remain\r\n'
            '  /// separate; an online response is not promoted to complete history.\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult? completeHistoryBatch({\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationRequest request,\r\n'
            '    required MessageHistoryBatch<V2TimMessage> batch,\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationNetworkState networkState,\r\n'
            '    required int clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '    bool applyMemoryWindow = true,\r\n'
            '    bool memoryWindowPreferLatest = false,\r\n'
            '    String historyCommitSource = \'reconciliation_batch\',\r\n'
            '    bool skipEquivalentHistoryWindow = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final batchKey = batch.conversationKey.trim();\r\n'
            '    final requestKey = request.conversationKey.trim();\r\n'
            '    final sameConversation = isSameConversationIdForHistory(\r\n'
            '      batchKey,\r\n'
            '      requestKey,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final stale = batch.isStale(\r\n'
            '      generation: request.generation,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!sameConversation || stale) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'history_batch_rejected\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: requestKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'reason\': !sameConversation ? \'conversation_mismatch\' : \'stale\',\r\n'
            '          \'batchKind\': batch.batchKind.name,\r\n'
            '          \'requestGeneration\': request.generation,\r\n'
            '          \'batchGeneration\': batch.generation,\r\n'
            '          \'clearEpoch\': clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '          \'batchClearEpoch\': batch.clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (batchKey != requestKey) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'history_batch_alias_accepted\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: requestKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'batchKind\': batch.batchKind.name,\r\n'
            '          \'requestGeneration\': request.generation,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return completeHistoryReconciliation(\r\n'
            '      request: request,\r\n'
            '      history: batch.messages,\r\n'
            '      actualSource: batch.actualSource,\r\n'
            '      networkState: networkState,\r\n'
            '      applyMemoryWindow: applyMemoryWindow,\r\n'
            '      memoryWindowPreferLatest: memoryWindowPreferLatest,\r\n'
            '      historyCommitSource: historyCommitSource,\r\n'
            '      skipEquivalentHistoryWindow: skipEquivalentHistoryWindow,\r\n'
            '      cloudHasMoreNewer: batch.cloudHasMoreNewer,\r\n'
            '      batchKind: batch.batchKind,\r\n'
            '      historyIsFinished: batch.isFinished,\r\n'
            '      clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      requestedCursor: batch.requestedCursor,\r\n'
            '      returnedBounds: batch.returnedBounds,\r\n'
            '      proofKind: batch.proofKind,\r\n'
            '      explicitDeletes: batch.explicitDeletes,\r\n'
            '      tombstones: batch.tombstones,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage> _authoritativeBaseForCloudLatestWindow({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> current,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> cloudWindow,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    // A latest-window response proves only the bounded window it returned.\r\n'
            '    // Absence from that page is not a delete/revoke proof, especially when the\r\n'
            '    // SDK cloud request can fall back to local data. Keep every existing row;\r\n'
            '    // explicit tombstones/revoke callbacks are the only removal authority.\r\n'
            '    return current;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _groupWindowsOverlapOrTouch(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> first,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> second,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    int? firstMin;\r\n'
            '    int? firstMax;\r\n'
            '    int? secondMin;\r\n'
            '    int? secondMax;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in first) {\r\n'
            '      final seq = int.tryParse(message.seq?.trim() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '      if (seq == null || seq <= 0) continue;\r\n'
            '      firstMin = firstMin == null || seq < firstMin ? seq : firstMin;\r\n'
            '      firstMax = firstMax == null || seq > firstMax ? seq : firstMax;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final message in second) {\r\n'
            '      final seq = int.tryParse(message.seq?.trim() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '      if (seq == null || seq <= 0) continue;\r\n'
            '      secondMin = secondMin == null || seq < secondMin ? seq : secondMin;\r\n'
            '      secondMax = secondMax == null || seq > secondMax ? seq : secondMax;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (firstMin == null ||\r\n'
            '        firstMax == null ||\r\n'
            '        secondMin == null ||\r\n'
            '        secondMax == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return firstMin <= secondMax + 1 && secondMin <= firstMax + 1;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _recordMessageHistoryCoverageAfterCommit({\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationRequest request,\r\n'
            '    required MessageHistoryBatchKind batchKind,\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationSource actualSource,\r\n'
            '    required MessageReconciliationNetworkState networkState,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> history,\r\n'
            '    required bool? historyIsFinished,\r\n'
            '    required bool cloudHasMoreNewer,\r\n'
            '    required int clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '    MessageHistoryCursor? requestedCursor,\r\n'
            '    MessageHistoryBounds? returnedBounds,\r\n'
            '    required MessageHistoryProofKind proofKind,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(request.conversationKey);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? request.conversationKey : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    final coverageSessionGeneration = _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final reconciliationState =\r\n'
            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.coordinator.stateFor(key);\r\n'
            '    final missingSeqRanges = List<MessageSeqRange>.unmodifiable(\r\n'
            '      reconciliationState.missingSeqRanges,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final historySnapshot = List<V2TimMessage>.unmodifiable(history);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    void applyLoadedCoverage() {\r\n'
            '      if (coverageSessionGeneration !=\r\n'
            '          _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final current = _messageHistoryCoverageByConv[key];\r\n'
            '      if (current == null || current.clearEpoch != clearEpoch) return;\r\n'
            '      final previousGeneration =\r\n'
            '          _messageHistoryCoverageRequestGenerationByConv[key] ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      if (request.generation <= previousGeneration) return;\r\n'
            '      _messageHistoryCoverageRequestGenerationByConv[key] = request.generation;\r\n'
            '      _applyMessageHistoryCoverageCommit(\r\n'
            '        current: current,\r\n'
            '        request: request,\r\n'
            '        batchKind: batchKind,\r\n'
            '        actualSource: actualSource,\r\n'
            '        networkState: networkState,\r\n'
            '        history: historySnapshot,\r\n'
            '        historyIsFinished: historyIsFinished,\r\n'
            '        cloudHasMoreNewer: cloudHasMoreNewer,\r\n'
            '        missingSeqRanges: missingSeqRanges,\r\n'
            '        requestedCursor: requestedCursor,\r\n'
            '        returnedBounds: returnedBounds,\r\n'
            '        proofKind: proofKind,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (_messageHistoryCoverageLoadedConvs.contains(key) &&\r\n'
            '        !_messageHistoryCoverageUpdateTailByConv.containsKey(key)) {\r\n'
            '      applyLoadedCoverage();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    unawaited(\r\n'
            '      _enqueueMessageHistoryCoverageUpdate(key, () async {\r\n'
            '        await ensureMessageHistoryCoverageLoaded(key, clearEpoch: clearEpoch);\r\n'
            '        applyLoadedCoverage();\r\n'
            '      }),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _enqueueMessageHistoryCoverageUpdate(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    Future<void> Function() update,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final previous = _messageHistoryCoverageUpdateTailByConv[conversationID];\r\n'
            '    late final Future<void> task;\r\n'
            '    task = () async {\r\n'
            '      if (previous != null) {\r\n'
            '        try {\r\n'
            '          await previous;\r\n'

            '    if (until > _previousPageImageDecodeDeferUntilMs) {\r\n'
            '      _previousPageImageDecodeDeferUntilMs = until;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool get isPreviousPageImageDecodeDeferActive {\r\n'
            '    if (_previousPageImageDecodeDeferUntilMs <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    if (now >= _previousPageImageDecodeDeferUntilMs) {\r\n'
            '      _previousPageImageDecodeDeferUntilMs = 0;\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 用户正在滑，或刚松手后的短窗口（用于跳过进场动画等）。\r\n'
            '  bool get shouldSkipHeavyChatListPresentation {\r\n'
            '    if (isPreviousPageImageDecodeDeferActive) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (isChatOpenImageDecodeDeferActive) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (isChatListUserScrolling) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_lastChatListUserScrollEndAtMs <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return _shouldDeferHeavyBubbleDecodeForAndroidHistory();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final elapsed =\r\n'
            '        DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - _lastChatListUserScrollEndAtMs;\r\n'
            '    if (elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < postScrollSkipEnterAnimationMs) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _shouldDeferHeavyBubbleDecodeForAndroidHistory();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldDeferHeavyBubbleDecodeForAndroidHistory() {\r\n'
            '    if (kIsWeb || !Platform.isAndroid) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convId = currentSelectedConv.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (isReadingHistory(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 不在底部时推迟离屏图片解码，避免浏览历史/未读时主线程尖刺。\r\n'
            '    return !_isActiveChatNearBottom(convId);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int deferredIncomingBufferedCount(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return _inboundUnreadStateFor(\r\n'
            '      conversationID,\r\n'
            '      create: false,\r\n'
            '    ).bufferedMessages.length;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 后台期间缓冲、尚未合并进可见列表的新消息（含 deferred 闸门）。\r\n'
            '  bool hasDeferredIncomingForResume(String? conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _safeConversationId(conversationID ?? currentSelectedConv);\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final key in _historyFlagKeys(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      final normalized = _inboundStateKey(key);\r\n'
            '      if (_deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.contains(normalized)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (deferredIncomingBufferedCount(key) > 0) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 回前台：贴底合并并清计数；最新窗离底灌列表保留计数；缺口窗保留 buffer。\r\n'
            '  void reconcileActiveChatAfterForegroundResume({int attempt = 0}) {\r\n'
            '    final convId = currentSelectedConv.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty || !_chatAppForeground) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!hasDeferredIncomingForResume(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final normalizedConvId = _inboundStateKey(convId);\r\n'
            '    final wasAtBottomBeforeBackground =\r\n'
            '        _wasAtBottomBeforeBackgroundByConv[normalizedConvId];\r\n'
            '    final followingLatest = isFollowingLatest(convId);\r\n'
            '    final controller = _activeChatScrollControllerMap[convId];\r\n'
            '    final scrollReady = controller != null &&\r\n'
            '        controller.hasClients &&\r\n'
            '        controller.positions.isNotEmpty;\r\n'
            '    if (wasAtBottomBeforeBackground == null && !scrollReady && attempt < 3) {\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '        reconcileActiveChatAfterForegroundResume(attempt: attempt + 1);\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final isHistoryGap = hasDurableHistoryDeferred(convId) ||\r\n'
            '        memoryWindowMissingNewer(convId) ||\r\n'
            '        isSearchJumpPending(convId);\r\n'
            '    final wasReadingAway = wasAtBottomBeforeBackground == false ||\r\n'
            '        (wasAtBottomBeforeBackground == null && !followingLatest);\r\n'
            '    if (isHistoryGap && wasReadingAway) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '        action: \'resume_reconcile_keep_buffer\',\r\n'
            '        conv: convId,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'buffered\': deferredIncomingBufferedCount(convId),\r\n'
            '          \'attempt\': attempt,\r\n'
            '          \'wasAtBottomBeforeBackground\': wasAtBottomBeforeBackground,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (wasAtBottomBeforeBackground == true ||\r\n'
            '        (wasAtBottomBeforeBackground == null && followingLatest)) {\r\n'
            '      _mergeDeferredIncomingAfterBackgroundResume(convId);\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      _mergeDeferredIncomingPreserveViewport(convId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _wasAtBottomBeforeBackgroundByConv.remove(normalizedConvId);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _mergeDeferredIncomingAfterBackgroundResume(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _safeConversationId(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (hasDurableHistoryDeferred(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      _storeHistoryMessagePosition(\r\n'
            '          convId, HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest);\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final key in _historyFlagKeys(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      _deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.remove(_inboundStateKey(key));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _storeHistoryMessagePosition(convId, HistoryMessagePosition.bottom);\r\n'
            '    flushDeferredIncomingMessages(convId, notify: false, userInitiated: true);\r\n'
            '    unlockEntryUnreadForTongue(conversationID: convId, notify: false);\r\n'
            '    clearReceivedUnreadState(conversationID: convId, notify: false);\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '      action: \'resume_reconcile_merged\',\r\n'
            '      conv: convId,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'listLen\':\r\n'
            '            _messageListMap[_resolveMessageListStorageKey(convId)]?.length,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _mergeDeferredIncomingPreserveViewport(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _safeConversationId(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (hasDurableHistoryDeferred(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      _storeHistoryMessagePosition(\r\n'
            '          convId, HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest);\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final key in _historyFlagKeys(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      _deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.remove(_inboundStateKey(key));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    flushDeferredIncomingMessages(convId, notify: false, userInitiated: true);\r\n'
            '    _syncHistoryPositionFromActiveScroll(convId);\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '      action: \'resume_reconcile_merged_preserve_viewport\',\r\n'
            '      conv: convId,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'listLen\':\r\n'
            '            _messageListMap[_resolveMessageListStorageKey(convId)]?.length,\r\n'
            '        \'received\': receivedNewMessageCountFor(convId),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _pruneInboundFloodWindow([int? nowMs]) {\r\n'
            '    final now = nowMs ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    _inboundFloodArrivalMs.removeWhere((t) => now - t > _inboundFloodWindowMs);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _noteInboundFloodArrivals(int count) {\r\n'
            '    if (count <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {\r\n'
            '      _inboundFloodArrivalMs.add(now);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_inboundFloodArrivalMs.length > 96) {\r\n'
            '      _inboundFloodArrivalMs.removeRange(0, _inboundFloodArrivalMs.length - 96);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _pruneInboundFloodWindow(now);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 消息洪峰：短时高频入站，动画与分片揭示应让路给吞吐。\r\n'
            '  bool get isInboundFloodActive {\r\n'
            '    _pruneInboundFloodWindow();\r\n'
            '    return _inboundFloodArrivalMs.length >= _inboundFloodCountThreshold;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Bind the open history list\'s page UI notifiers as SSOT for scroll flags.\r\n'
            '  void attachOpenChatPageUi({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationId,\r\n'
            '    required ValueNotifier<HistoryMessagePosition> historyPosition,\r\n'
            '    required ValueNotifier<bool> userScrolling,\r\n'

            '    final convId = _safeConversationId(conversationId);\r\n'
            '    _openPageConvId = convId;\r\n'

            '    _openPageHistoryPosition = historyPosition;\r\n'
            '    _openPageUserScrolling?.removeListener(_updateMediaScrollGate);\r\n'
            '    _openPageUserScrolling = userScrolling;\r\n'
            '    userScrolling.addListener(_updateMediaScrollGate);\r\n'
            '    final seeded =\r\n'
            '        _historyMessagePositionMap[convId] ?? HistoryMessagePosition.bottom;\r\n'
            '    if (historyPosition.value != seeded) {\r\n'
            '      historyPosition.value = seeded;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    userScrolling.value = false;\r\n'
            '    _isChatListUserScrolling = false;\r\n'

            '    required ValueNotifier<bool> userScrolling,\r\n'

            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convId = _openPageConvId;\r\n'
            '    if (convId != null && convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _historyMessagePositionMap[convId] = historyPosition.value;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _openPageHistoryPosition = null;\r\n'
            '    _openPageUserScrolling?.removeListener(_updateMediaScrollGate);\r\n'
            '    _openPageUserScrolling = null;\r\n'
            '    BackgroundMediaGate.instance.setBusy(this, false);\r\n'
            '    _openPageConvId = null;\r\n'
            '    _updateSearchJumpWorkGate();\r\n'
            '    _isChatListUserScrolling = false;\r\n'
            '    if (convId != null && convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      clearOpenChatBottomCapsuleLock(convId);\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _storeHistoryMessagePosition(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    HistoryMessagePosition position,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _safeConversationId(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (position == HistoryMessagePosition.bottom &&\r\n'
            '        (isSearchJumpPending(convId) ||\r\n'
            '            (memoryWindowMissingNewer(convId) &&\r\n'
            '                !isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(convId)))) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _historyMessagePositionMap[convId] = position;\r\n'
            '    final page = _openPageHistoryPosition;\r\n'
            '    final pageConv = _openPageConvId;\r\n'
            '    if (page != null &&\r\n'
            '        pageConv != null &&\r\n'
            '        _isSameConversationID(convId, pageConv) &&\r\n'
            '        page.value != position) {\r\n'
            '      page.value = position;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (position == HistoryMessagePosition.bottom) {\r\n'
            '      final state = _messageReconciliationWriter.coordinator.stateFor(convId);\r\n'
            '      if (state.cloudHasMoreNewer) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool get shouldAnimateInboundPresentation =>\r\n'
            '      _chatAppForeground &&\r\n'
            '      DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch >=\r\n'
            '          _suppressInboundAnimationUntilMs &&\r\n'
            '      !isInboundFloodActive;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void setChatAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {\r\n'
            '    final wasForeground = _chatAppForeground;\r\n'
            '    final foreground = state == AppLifecycleState.resumed;\r\n'
            '    final convId = currentSelectedConv.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (wasForeground && !foreground && convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _syncHistoryPositionFromActiveScroll(convId);\r\n'
            '      final normalizedConvId = _inboundStateKey(convId);\r\n'
            '      final logicalPosition = getMessageListPosition(convId);\r\n'
            '      _wasAtBottomBeforeBackgroundByConv[normalizedConvId] =\r\n'
            '          _isActiveChatNearBottom(convId) ||\r\n'
            '              logicalPosition == HistoryMessagePosition.bottom;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _chatAppForeground = foreground;\r\n'
            '    if (foreground && !wasForeground) {\r\n'
            '      // Resume recovery may merge a large server-side backlog over several\r\n'
            '      // asynchronous callbacks. Treat that window as synchronization, not as\r\n'
            '      // a sequence of newly arriving foreground messages.\r\n'
            '      _suppressInboundAnimationUntilMs =\r\n'
            '          DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch + 5000;\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '        reconcileActiveChatAfterForegroundResume();\r\n'
            '        if (convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          unawaited(\r\n'
            '            reconcileConversationCloud(convId, reason: \'app_foreground\'),\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'

            '    if (convId.isNotEmpty && !foreground) {\r\n'

            '      // transitioning to background, otherwise it will be replayed on resume.\r\n'

            '    _messageEnterAnimationKeys.clear();\r\n'
            '    // paused/hidden 阶段不重建仍在树上的长消息列表；resumed 会统一通知。\r\n'
            '    if (foreground) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool isBulkMessageSyncActive([String? conversationID]) {\r\n'
            '    if (conversationID != null) {\r\n'
            '      final convId = _safeConversationId(conversationID);\r\n'
            '      return (_bulkMessageSyncDepthByConv[convId] ?? 0) > 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _bulkMessageSyncDepthByConv.values.any((depth) => depth > 0);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _beginBulkMessageSync(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convId = _safeConversationId(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (convId.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _bulkMessageSyncDepthByConv[convId] =\r\n'

            '  void _endBulkMessageSync(String conversationID) {\r\n'

            '    final next = (_bulkMessageSyncDepthByConv[convId] ?? 0) - 1;\r\n'
            '    if (next <= 0) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  @Deprecated(\'Use isChunkedRevealActive\')\r\n'

            '  int get inboundScrollFollowSeq => _inboundScrollFollowSeq;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Bumped when paced reveal cancels an in-flight push so only the newest\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool get inboundScrollFollowSessionEnding =>\r\n'

            '  List<V2TimMessage> get lastInboundScrollFollowChunk =>\r\n'
