            '\r\n'
            '  int messageListRevisionFor(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final key = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    return _messageListRevisionByConv[key.isNotEmpty ? key : conversationID] ??\r\n'
            '        0;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int messageProjectionRevisionFor(String conversationID) =>\r\n'
            '      _messageProjectionRevisionByConv[_inboundStateKey(conversationID)] ?? 0;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Privacy-safe counts for diagnosing authority -> projection -> render\r\n'
            '  /// discontinuities. Message content is intentionally excluded.\r\n'
            '  Map<String, Object?> historyProjectionDiagnostics(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final authoritative = _collectAuthoritativeMessages(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final hidden = _inboundHiddenKeysByConv[convKey] ?? const <String>{};\r\n'
            '    final unreadState = _inboundUnreadStateFor(convKey, create: false);\r\n'
            '    final displayKey = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final display = _messageListDisplayCache[\r\n'
            '        displayKey.isNotEmpty ? displayKey : conversationID];\r\n'
            '    return <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '      \'authorityCount\': authoritative.length,\r\n'
            '      \'hiddenCount\': hidden.length,\r\n'
            '      \'projectedCount\': authoritative\r\n'
            '          .where((message) => !hidden.contains(messageDedupKey(message)))\r\n'
            '          .length,\r\n'
            '      \'displayCount\':\r\n'
            '          display?.where((message) => message.elemType != 11).length,\r\n'
            '      \'displayDividerCount\':\r\n'
            '          display?.where((message) => message.elemType == 11).length,\r\n'
            '      \'displayCacheHit\': display != null,\r\n'
            '      \'bufferedCount\': unreadState.bufferedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '      \'tongueUnread\': unreadState.unreadCount,\r\n'
            '      \'lockedEntryUnread\': unreadState.lockedEntryUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      \'pendingReveal\': pendingInboundProjectionCount(convKey),\r\n'
            '      \'revealWaiting\': isInboundProjectionRevealWaiting(convKey),\r\n'
            '      \'listRevision\': messageListRevisionFor(conversationID),\r\n'
            '      \'projectionRevision\': messageProjectionRevisionFor(convKey),\r\n'
            '      \'position\': getMessageListPosition(conversationID).name,\r\n'
            '      \'deferredUntilBottom\': _deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.contains(\r\n'
            '        convKey,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _authoritativeDeferredKey(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final normalized = _normalizeConversationID(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final convKey = normalized.isEmpty ? conversationID : normalized;\r\n'
            '    return \'$convKey|${messageDedupKey(message)}\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _revealDeferredProjectionAcrossAliases(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final snapshot = List<V2TimMessage>.from(messages);\r\n'
            '    if (snapshot.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _revealInboundProjectionChunk(conversationID, snapshot);\r\n'
            '    final pendingKeys = snapshot.map(messageDedupKey).toSet();\r\n'
            '    for (final alias in List<String>.from(_inboundHiddenKeysByConv.keys)) {\r\n'
            '      if (alias == conversationID) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final hidden = _inboundHiddenKeysByConv[alias];\r\n'
            '      if (hidden == null || !hidden.any(pendingKeys.contains)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _revealInboundProjectionChunk(alias, snapshot);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _hideInboundProjection(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final hidden = _inboundHiddenKeysByConv.putIfAbsent(\r\n'
            '      convKey,\r\n'
            '      () => <String>{},\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      hidden.add(messageDedupKey(message));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _revealInboundProjectionChunk(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final hidden = _inboundHiddenKeysByConv[convKey];\r\n'
            '    if (hidden == null || hidden.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var changed = false;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      final removed = hidden.remove(messageDedupKey(message));\r\n'
            '      changed = removed || changed;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (hidden.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _inboundHiddenKeysByConv.remove(convKey);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (changed) {\r\n'
            '      _bumpMessageProjectionRevisionFor(convKey);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return changed;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _revealAllInboundProjection(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final hidden = _inboundHiddenKeysByConv.remove(convKey);\r\n'
            '    _authoritativeDeferredIncomingKeys.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key) => key.startsWith(\'$convKey|\'),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (hidden == null || hidden.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _bumpMessageProjectionRevisionFor(convKey);\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _revealAllDeferredProjectionAcrossAliases(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    var changed = false;\r\n'
            '    final aliases = List<String>.from(_inboundHiddenKeysByConv.keys);\r\n'
            '    for (final alias in aliases) {\r\n'
            '      if (_isSameConversationID(alias, conversationID)) {\r\n'
            '        changed = _revealAllInboundProjection(alias) || changed;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Also clears authoritative deferred keys when no projection alias remains.\r\n'
            '    changed = _revealAllInboundProjection(conversationID) || changed;\r\n'
            '    return changed;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _bumpMessageProjectionRevisionFor(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    // Visibility changes independently of message IDs (hidden -> revealed).\r\n'
            '    // Callers invoke this only after mutating projection state.\r\n'
            '    _messageProjectionRevisionByConv[convKey] =\r\n'
            '        (_messageProjectionRevisionByConv[convKey] ?? 0) + 1;\r\n'
            '    _messageListDisplayCache.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key, _) => _isSameConversationID(key, convKey),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _invalidateMessageListDisplayCache(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    _messageListDisplayCache.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key, _) => _isSameConversationID(key, conversationID),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _bumpMessageListRevisionFor(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    String reason = \'\',\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final canonical = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final revisionKey = canonical.isNotEmpty ? canonical : conversationID;\r\n'
            '    final next = (_messageListRevisionByConv[revisionKey] ?? 0) + 1;\r\n'
            '    _messageListRevisionByConv[revisionKey] = next;\r\n'
            '    // 与投影 revision 一致：按等价会话 ID 清展示缓存，避免群 ID 别名打空洞。\r\n'
            '    _messageListDisplayCache.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key, _) => _isSameConversationID(key, conversationID),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // 仅「绕过 setMessageList 的原地改表」清签名，迫使下次 setMessageList 再比对。\r\n'
            '    // setMessageList 自己 bump 时绝不能清：否则刚写入的签名立刻失效，\r\n'
            '    // 进页 hydrate / loadLatest 原样回写会每次都 signatureChanged→再 bump→整表抖。\r\n'
            '    final fromSetMessageList = reason == \'setMessageList_signature\' ||\r\n'
            '        reason == \'setMessageList_delete\';\r\n'
            '    if (!fromSetMessageList) {\r\n'
            '      _messageListContentSignatureByConv.remove(revisionKey);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '      \'message_list_revision_bump\',\r\n'
            '      conv: conversationID,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'rev\': next,\r\n'
            '        \'reason\': reason.isEmpty ? \'unspecified\' : reason,\r\n'
            '        \'stack\': ChatJitterDiag.compactStack(),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleNotifyListeners() {\r\n'
            '    if (_notifyScheduled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _notifyScheduled = true;\r\n'
            '    // 洪峰时并到下一帧，避免同帧多次 microtask → 整表 setState 连打。\r\n'
            '    void flush() {\r\n'
            '      _notifyScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '      if (!_notifyPending) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 相册是不透明路由。覆盖期间继续通知会让底层长消息列表在不可见时\r\n'
            '      // 反复 rebuild，并与 PhotoKit 缩略图解码争抢 raster/主线程。\r\n'
            '      // 保留 pending，关闭相册后由 endMediaPickerOverlay 一次性刷新。\r\n'
            '      if (isMediaPickerOverlayOpen) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _notifyPending = false;\r\n'
            '      notifyListeners();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (isInboundFloodActive) {\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => flush());\r\n'
            '      // Buffered arrivals do not otherwise dirty the list. Schedule the frame\r\n'
            '      // so the unread capsule still updates while the reader is stationary.\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.ensureVisualUpdate();\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      scheduleMicrotask(flush);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _markNeedsNotify({String? conversationID}) {\r\n'
            '    if (conversationID != null &&\r\n'
            '        currentSelectedConv.trim().isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !_isSameConversationID(conversationID, currentSelectedConv)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _notifyPending = true;\r\n'
            '    if (isMediaPickerOverlayOpen) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _scheduleNotifyListeners();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleInactiveInboundPresentationCommit(String convID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(convID);\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _inactiveInboundDirtyConvs.add(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    _inactiveInboundNotifyTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '    final delay = isInboundFloodActive\r\n'
            '        ? _inactiveInboundNotifyDelayFlood\r\n'
            '        : _inactiveInboundNotifyDelayIdle;\r\n'
            '    _inactiveInboundNotifyTimer = Timer(delay, () {\r\n'
            '      _inactiveInboundNotifyTimer = null;\r\n'
            '      _flushInactiveInboundPresentationCommits();\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _flushInactiveInboundPresentationCommits() {\r\n'
            '    _inactiveInboundNotifyTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '    _inactiveInboundNotifyTimer = null;\r\n'
            '    if (_inactiveInboundDirtyConvs.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convs = List<String>.from(_inactiveInboundDirtyConvs);\r\n'
            '    _inactiveInboundDirtyConvs.clear();\r\n'
            '    for (final convId in convs) {\r\n'
            '      _bumpMessageListRevisionFor(\r\n'
            '        convId,\r\n'
            '        reason: \'inbound_batch_inactive_coalesced\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final activeConvId = currentSelectedConv.trim();\r\n'
            '    final touchesActiveConversation = activeConvId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        convs.any((convId) => _isSameConversationID(convId, activeConvId));\r\n'
            '    // 当前聊天打开时，其他会话的消息只更新各自 revision；不要广播全局\r\n'
            '    // notify 掀翻正在显示的长消息列表。切入该会话时会直接读取最新 map。\r\n'
            '    if (activeConvId.isEmpty || touchesActiveConversation) {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void flushInactiveInboundPresentationForConversation(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_inactiveInboundDirtyConvs.remove(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_inactiveInboundDirtyConvs.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _inactiveInboundNotifyTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '      _inactiveInboundNotifyTimer = null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _bumpMessageListRevisionFor(\r\n'
            '      storageKey,\r\n'
            '      reason: \'inbound_batch_inactive_open\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 回前台合并缓冲后再跑 history refresh，避免与 deferred merge 抢写列表。\r\n'
            '  Future<void> prepareForegroundChatRecovery() async {\r\n'

            '  int _normalizedOutgoingStatus(V2TimMessage item, int? fallback) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  V2TimMessage? _messageInConversation(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    String? clientId,\r\n'
            '    String? msgID,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final list = rawMessageList(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (list == null || list.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final index = _identityLookupFor(list);\r\n'
            '    if (index != null) {\r\n'
            '      final byClient = clientId == null ? null : index.clientIDs[clientId];\r\n'
            '      final byServer = msgID == null ? null : index.serverIDs[msgID];\r\n'
            '      final position = byClient == null\r\n'
            '          ? byServer\r\n'
            '          : byServer == null\r\n'
            '              ? byClient\r\n'
            '              : min(byClient, byServer);\r\n'
            '      return position == null ? null : list[position];\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final item in list) {\r\n'
            '      if (clientId != null &&\r\n'
            '          clientId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '          item.id != null &&\r\n'
            '          item.id == clientId) {\r\n'
            '        return item;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (msgID != null &&\r\n'
            '          msgID.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '          item.msgID != null &&\r\n'
            '          item.msgID == msgID) {\r\n'
            '        return item;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int _receiptTimestamp(int value) {\r\n'
            '    if (value > 1000000000000) {\r\n'
            '      return value ~/ 1000;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return value;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  V2TimMessage? messageInConversationByKey(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    String messageKey,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final key = messageKey.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final list = _messageListMap[storageKey];\r\n'
            '    if (list == null || list.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final resolvedKey = _rowLocalAliasByConversation[storageKey]?[key] ?? key;\r\n'
            '    final index = _identityLookupFor(list);\r\n'
            '    if (index != null) {\r\n'
            '      var position = index.rowKeys[resolvedKey];\r\n'
            '      // Anonymous timestamp/sender keys have no SDK identity epoch. Keep\r\n'
            '      // their small compatibility lane live rather than caching mutable data.\r\n'
            '      for (final anonymous in index.anonymousIndices) {\r\n'
            '        if ((position == null || anonymous < position) &&\r\n'
            '            ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(list[anonymous]) == resolvedKey) {\r\n'
            '          position = anonymous;\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return position == null ? null : list[position];\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final item in list) {\r\n'
            '      if (item.msgID == resolvedKey || item.id == resolvedKey) {\r\n'
            '        return item;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final seq = item.seq?.trim();\r\n'
            '      if (seq != null && seq.isNotEmpty && \'seq_$seq\' == resolvedKey) {\r\n'
            '        return item;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(item) == resolvedKey) {\r\n'
            '        return item;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _messageMatchesRowIdentity(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '    Set<String> identities,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (identities.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final values = <String>{\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(message).trim(),\r\n'
            '      message.id?.trim() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '      message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '      readOutgoingStableId(message)?.trim() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '      if (message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE)\r\n'
            '        message.imageElem?.path?.trim() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '    }..remove(\'\');\r\n'
            '    return values.any(identities.contains);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _rememberRowLocalAliases(\r\n'
            '    String storageKey,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<String?> aliases,\r\n'
            '    String targetKey,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final target = targetKey.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (target.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final map = _rowLocalAliasByConversation.putIfAbsent(\r\n'
            '      storageKey,\r\n'
            '      () => <String, String>{},\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final normalizedAliases = aliases\r\n'
            '        .map((value) => value?.trim() ?? \'\')\r\n'
            '        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)\r\n'
            '        .toSet();\r\n'
            '    final chainedSources = map.entries\r\n'
            '        .where((entry) => normalizedAliases.contains(entry.value))\r\n'
            '        .map((entry) => entry.key)\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    for (final source in chainedSources) {\r\n'
            '      map[source] = target;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final value in normalizedAliases) {\r\n'
            '      if (value.isNotEmpty && value != target) {\r\n'
            '        map[value] = target;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    while (map.length > 512) {\r\n'
            '      map.remove(map.keys.first);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Resolves exactly one row through the outgoing stable identity chain.\r\n'
            '  /// Missing/ambiguous identities, semantic changes and reordering are never\r\n'
            '  /// guessed: callers must keep their full-list fallback for those results.\r\n'
            '  RowLocalMessageReplacementResult replaceMessageRowByStableIdentity({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    required String stableIdentity,\r\n'
            '    required V2TimMessage replacement,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<String?> aliases = const <String?>[],\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final primary = stableIdentity.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (primary.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.notFound;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final current = _messageListMap[storageKey];\r\n'
            '    if (current == null || current.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.notFound;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final identities = <String>{primary};\r\n'
            '    for (final alias in aliases) {\r\n'
            '      final value = alias?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (value.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        identities.add(value);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final matches = <int>[];\r\n'
            '    for (var index = 0; index < current.length; index++) {\r\n'
            '      if (_messageMatchesRowIdentity(current[index], identities)) {\r\n'
            '        matches.add(index);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (matches.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.notFound;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (matches.length != 1) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.ambiguous;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final index = matches.single;\r\n'
            '    final expected = current[index];\r\n'
            '    if (expected.elemType != replacement.elemType ||\r\n'
            '        expected.isSelf != replacement.isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.semanticChange;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final next = List<V2TimMessage>.from(current)..[index] = replacement;\r\n'
            '    if (!isNewestFirstStorageOrderValid(next)) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.reordered;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final resolvedStableIdentity = readOutgoingStableId(expected) ??\r\n'
            '        readOutgoingStableId(replacement) ??\r\n'
            '        expected.id ??\r\n'
            '        expected.msgID ??\r\n'
            '        primary;\r\n'
            '    final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID:\r\n'
            '            \'row_replace:$resolvedStableIdentity:${replacement.msgID ?? \'\'}\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.edit,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sendPipeline,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        upserts: <MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>>[\r\n'
            '          MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '            value: replacement,\r\n'
            '            msgID: replacement.msgID,\r\n'
            '            localID: replacement.id,\r\n'
            '            outgoingStableID: resolvedStableIdentity,\r\n'
            '            seq: replacement.seq,\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        ],\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit == null) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.stale;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final replacementKey = ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(replacement);\r\n'
            '    final allAliases = <String?>{\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(expected),\r\n'
            '      expected.id,\r\n'
            '      expected.msgID,\r\n'
            '      readOutgoingStableId(expected),\r\n'
            '      replacement.id,\r\n'
            '      replacement.msgID,\r\n'
            '      readOutgoingStableId(replacement),\r\n'
            '      ...aliases,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    _rememberRowLocalAliases(storageKey, allAliases, replacementKey);\r\n'
            '    for (final alias in allAliases) {\r\n'
            '      final value = alias?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (value.isNotEmpty && value != replacementKey) {\r\n'
            '        _chatUiStateStore.bindMessageAlias(storageKey, value, replacementKey);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowChanged(storageKey, replacement);\r\n'
            '    return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.replaced;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Replaces one authoritative row without invalidating the whole message\r\n'
            '  /// window. The caller must already have proved that membership and ordering\r\n'
            '  /// are unchanged; otherwise use [setMessageList].\r\n'
            '  RowLocalMessageReplacementResult replaceMessageRowLocal({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    required int index,\r\n'
            '    required V2TimMessage expected,\r\n'
            '    required V2TimMessage replacement,\r\n'
            '    Iterable<String?> aliases = const <String?>[],\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final current = _messageListMap[storageKey];\r\n'
            '    if (current == null ||\r\n'
            '        index < 0 ||\r\n'
            '        index >= current.length ||\r\n'
            '        !identical(current[index], expected)) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.stale;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final next = List<V2TimMessage>.from(current);\r\n'
            '    next[index] = replacement;\r\n'
            '    if (!isNewestFirstStorageOrderValid(next)) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.reordered;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final stableIdentity = readOutgoingStableId(expected) ??\r\n'
            '        readOutgoingStableId(replacement) ??\r\n'
            '        expected.id ??\r\n'
            '        expected.msgID ??\r\n'
            '        replacement.id ??\r\n'
            '        replacement.msgID;\r\n'
            '    if (stableIdentity == null || stableIdentity.trim().isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.notFound;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID: \'row_local_replace:$stableIdentity:${replacement.msgID ?? \'\'}\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.edit,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sendPipeline,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        upserts: <MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>>[\r\n'
            '          MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '            value: replacement,\r\n'
            '            msgID: replacement.msgID,\r\n'
            '            localID: replacement.id,\r\n'
            '            outgoingStableID: stableIdentity,\r\n'
            '            seq: replacement.seq,\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        ],\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit == null) {\r\n'
            '      return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.stale;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final replacementKey = ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(replacement);\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String?>{\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(expected),\r\n'
            '      expected.id,\r\n'
            '      expected.msgID,\r\n'
            '      replacement.id,\r\n'
            '      replacement.msgID,\r\n'
            '      ...aliases,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    _rememberRowLocalAliases(storageKey, keys, replacementKey);\r\n'
            '    for (final alias in keys) {\r\n'
            '      final value = alias?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (value.isNotEmpty && value != replacementKey) {\r\n'
            '        _chatUiStateStore.bindMessageAlias(storageKey, value, replacementKey);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowChanged(storageKey, replacement);\r\n'
            '    return RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.replaced;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _markMessageRowChanged(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message, {\r\n'
            '    String? extraKey,\r\n'
            '    MessageMutationType mutationType = MessageMutationType.contentOrMedia,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>{ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(message)};\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(msgID);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(id);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seq = message.seq?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (seq != null && seq.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(\'seq_$seq\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final key = extraKey?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key != null && key.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(key);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _messageCommitCoordinator.stage(\r\n'
            '      MessageMutation(\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '        type: mutationType,\r\n'
            '        generation: _messageCommitGenerationByConv[conversationID] ?? 0,\r\n'
            '        source: \'row_local\',\r\n'
            '        stableIdentity: _commitSnapshotIdentity(message),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      requiresListRevision: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _chatUiStateStore.markMessagesChanged(conversationID, keys);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _markMessageRowChangedByIds(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    String? msgID,\r\n'
            '    String? clientId,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    final mid = msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (mid != null && mid.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(mid);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final cid = clientId?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (cid != null && cid.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(cid);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final message = _messageInConversation(\r\n'
            '      conversationID,\r\n'
            '      clientId: cid,\r\n'
            '      msgID: mid,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (message != null) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(message));\r\n'
            '      final messageId = message.id?.trim();\r\n'
            '      if (messageId != null && messageId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(messageId);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final messageMsgID = message.msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '      if (messageMsgID != null && messageMsgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(messageMsgID);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (keys.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _messageCommitCoordinator.stage(\r\n'
            '        MessageMutation(\r\n'
            '          conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '          type: MessageMutationType.statusOrProgress,\r\n'
            '          generation: _messageCommitGenerationByConv[conversationID] ?? 0,\r\n'
            '          source: \'status_progress\',\r\n'
            '          stableIdentity: mid?.isNotEmpty == true ? mid : cid,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '        requiresListRevision: false,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _chatUiStateStore.markMessagesChanged(conversationID, keys);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _markMessageRowsChangedByMsgID(String msgID) {\r\n'
            '    final key = msgID.trim();\r\n'

            '  void markMessageRowsChangedByMsgIDs(Iterable<String?> msgIDs) {\r\n'

            '        .toSet();\r\n'
            '    if (keys.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  int messageStatusInConversation(\r\n'

            '\r\n'

            '    String? msgID,\r\n'

            '          clientId: clientId,\r\n'
            '          msgID: dataMsgID,\r\n'
            '          sendFailCode: sendMsgRes.code,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'sdk_send_failed\',\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  TUIChatGlobalModel() {\r\n'
            '    _inboundBatchCoalescer = MessageInboundBatchCoalescer(\r\n'
            '      maxBatchSize: _inboundBatchMaxSize,\r\n'
            '      maxDelay: _inboundBatchMaxDelay,\r\n'
            '      onFlush: _flushInboundMessageBatch,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _inboundChunkReveal = MessageInboundChunkedReveal(\r\n'
            '      interval: Duration(milliseconds: chatConfig.inboundChunkRevealIntervalMs),\r\n'
            '      maxChunkSize: chatConfig.inboundChunkRevealMaxChunk,\r\n'
            '      alignToFrame: true,\r\n'
            '      burstBoostChunk: 0,\r\n'
            '      // Ordinary live bursts share one measured insertion. Reserve fast-forward\r\n'
            '      // for genuine backlogs, instead of snapping all but the latest message.\r\n'
            '      maxAnimatedBacklog: 24,\r\n'
            '      coalescePendingMessages: true,\r\n'
            '      // Paced reveal is presentation-only. Keeping it outside bulk-sync allows\r\n'
            '      // each released row to run its extent animation while chunk-active guards\r\n'
            '      // still suppress competing list-push and pin paths.\r\n'
            '      onSessionBegin: (_) {},\r\n'
            '      onSessionEnd: (convId) {\r\n'
            '        _inboundScrollFollowSessionEnding = true;\r\n'
            '        _lastInboundScrollFollowChunk = const [];\r\n'
            '        _inboundScrollFollowSeq++;\r\n'
            '        _flushDeferredPinToBottom(convId);\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      onRevealChunk: (convId, chunk) {\r\n'
            '        _lastInboundScrollFollowChunk = chunk;\r\n'
            '        _inboundScrollFollowSessionEnding = false;\r\n'
            '        _revealInboundProjectionChunk(convId, chunk);\r\n'
            '        if (chunk.length == 1) {\r\n'
            '          final message = chunk.first;\r\n'
            '          if (message.isSelf != true &&\r\n'
            '              _inboundChunkReveal.pendingCountFor(convId) == 0) {\r\n'
            '            _markIncomingMessageEnterAnimation(message);\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _inboundScrollFollowSeq++;\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      onDrainRemaining: _drainChunkRevealToBuffer,\r\n'
            '      onSupersede: (convId) {\r\n'
            '        _inboundPresentationSupersedeSeq++;\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      onFastForward: (convId, messages) {\r\n'
            '        for (final message in messages) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldDeferIncomingToVisibleList(\r\n'
            '    String convID, {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isHistoryGapDeferral(String convID) {\r\n'
            '    final state = _inboundUnreadStateFor(convID, create: false);\r\n'
            '    // Loading the entry unread baseline is bookkeeping, not a missing page.\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _bufferIncomingWhileReadingAway(\r\n'
            '    String convID,\r\n'

            '    if (!_chatAppForeground) {\r\n'

            '      _deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.add(normalizedConvId);\r\n'

            '        normalizedConvId,\r\n'
            '        HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'

            '    if (_isHistoryGapDeferral(convID)) {\r\n'
            '      state.pendingLegacyMessages[messageKey] = mountedMessage;\r\n'

            '      state.revealedUnreadMessageIDs.add(id);\r\n'

            '    state.receivedCount++;\r\n'
            '    state.bufferedMessages.add(mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '    _recordBufferedLiveIncoming(state, mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logReadingHistoryIncoming(\r\n'
            '      action: \'route_buffer\',\r\n'
            '      conv: convID,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'route\': route,\r\n'
            '        \'position\': position.name,\r\n'
            '        \'nearBottom\': isActuallyNearBottom,\r\n'
            '        \'tongueUnread\': state.unreadCount,\r\n'

            '        \'msgId\': mountedMessage.msgID,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 将看历史期间缓冲的新消息合并进可见列表（回到底部 / 点未读条时调用）。\r\n'
            '  bool flushDeferredIncomingMessages(\r\n'
            '    String convID, {\r\n'
            '    bool notify = true,\r\n'
            '    bool userInitiated = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (hasDurableHistoryDeferred(convID)) return false;\r\n'
            '    final normalizedConvId = _inboundStateKey(convID);\r\n'
            '    // The viewport\'s bottom may only be the end of a search/history page.\r\n'
            '    // Revealing the live tail here creates a gap and corrupts the next SDK cursor.\r\n'
            '    if (!userInitiated &&\r\n'
            '        (!isFollowingLatest(convID) ||\r\n'
            '            isHistoryReadingWindowActive(convID) ||\r\n'
            '            memoryWindowMissingNewer(convID) ||\r\n'
            '            isSearchJumpPending(convID) ||\r\n'
            '            getMessageListPosition(convID) ==\r\n'
            '                HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.contains(normalizedConvId) &&\r\n'
            '        !userInitiated) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (userInitiated) {\r\n'
            '      if (_inboundChunkReveal.isActiveFor(convID)) {\r\n'
            '        _inboundChunkReveal.cancelToBuffer(convID);\r\n'
            '      } else if (_inboundChunkReveal.isActiveFor(normalizedConvId)) {\r\n'
            '        _inboundChunkReveal.cancelToBuffer(normalizedConvId);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.remove(normalizedConvId);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final projectionRevealed = userInitiated\r\n'
            '        ? _revealAllDeferredProjectionAcrossAliases(convID)\r\n'
            '        : false;\r\n'
            '    final state = _inboundUnreadStateFor(normalizedConvId, create: false);\r\n'
            '    if (state.bufferedMessages.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      if (projectionRevealed && notify) {\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return projectionRevealed;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final pending = List<V2TimMessage>.from(state.bufferedMessages);\r\n'
            '    state.bufferedMessages.clear();\r\n'
            '    state.bufferedMessageKeys.clear();\r\n'
            '    state.pendingLegacyMessages.clear();\r\n'
            '    final alreadyAuthoritative = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    final needsUpsert = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    for (final message in pending) {\r\n'
            '      final key = _authoritativeDeferredKey(convID, message);\r\n'
            '      if (_authoritativeDeferredIncomingKeys.remove(key)) {\r\n'
            '        alreadyAuthoritative.add(message);\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        needsUpsert.add(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _revealDeferredProjectionAcrossAliases(convID, alreadyAuthoritative);\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(convID);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 松手后大缓冲：走分片揭示，避免一次 revision + 整表 layout。\r\n'
            '    if (!userInitiated &&\r\n'
            '        pending.length >= postScrollFlushChunkThreshold &&\r\n'
            '        chatConfig.inboundChunkRevealEnabled &&\r\n'
            '        !isChatListUserScrolling &&\r\n'
            '        needsUpsert.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '        action: \'flush_deferred_paced\',\r\n'
            '        conv: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'count\': pending.length,\r\n'
            '          \'upsert\': needsUpsert.length,\r\n'
            '          \'authoritative\': alreadyAuthoritative.length,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _stageInboundChunkReveal(storageKey, needsUpsert);\r\n'
            '      if (notify) {\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final result = _upsertIncomingMessageBatch(storageKey, needsUpsert);\r\n'
            '    // Returning to the latest edge can flush rows while a history reading\r\n'
            '    // cursor is still frozen. Admit the drained tail to that same window\r\n'
            '    // before notifying the list; otherwise the raw rows exist but remain\r\n'
            '    // hidden behind its old newest cursor.\r\n'
            '    _freezeHistoryReadingWindowByConversation[_inboundStateKey(convID)]\r\n'
            '        ?.didAppend?.call(pending);\r\n'
            '    if (result.inserted) {\r\n'
            '      _bumpMessageListRevisionFor(storageKey, reason: \'flush_deferred_batch\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logReadingHistoryIncoming(\r\n'
            '      action: \'flush_deferred\',\r\n'
            '      conv: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'count\': pending.length,\r\n'
            '        \'listLen\': _messageListMap[storageKey]?.length,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '      action: \'flush_deferred\',\r\n'
            '      conv: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      throttleKey: \'flush_deferred\',\r\n'
            '      minIntervalMs: 100,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'count\': pending.length,\r\n'
            '        \'listLen\': _messageListMap[storageKey]?.length,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (notify) {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Flushes messages that are either waiting in the SDK batch coalescer or\r\n'
            '  /// buffered while the user was away from the latest message. This is the\r\n'
            '  /// final inbound drain used by an explicit return-to-bottom transaction.\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// The coalescer is deliberately drained first: otherwise a message already\r\n'
            '  /// delivered by the SDK can arrive in the 50ms coalescing gap after the UI\'s\r\n'
            '  /// first deferred flush and be mistaken for a post-transaction message.\r\n'
            '  bool flushPendingIncomingMessagesForUserBottom(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>{\r\n'
            '      conversationID.trim(),\r\n'
            '      storageKey,\r\n'
            '      _inboundStateKey(conversationID),\r\n'
            '      _inboundStateKey(storageKey),\r\n'
            '    }..removeWhere((key) => key.isEmpty);\r\n'
            '    var hadCoalescedMessages = false;\r\n'
            '    for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '      hadCoalescedMessages = _inboundBatchCoalescer.pendingCountFor(key) > 0 ||\r\n'
            '          hadCoalescedMessages;\r\n'
            '      _inboundBatchCoalescer.flushConversation(key);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final beforeDeferred = deferredIncomingBufferedCount(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final flushedDeferred = flushDeferredIncomingMessages(\r\n'
            '      storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID : storageKey,\r\n'
            '      notify: true,\r\n'
            '      userInitiated: true,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return hadCoalescedMessages || beforeDeferred > 0 || flushedDeferred;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimGroupApplication> get groupApplicationList =>\r\n'
            '      _groupApplicationList ?? [];\r\n'

            '      _groupSystemNoticeList;\r\n'

            '  Widget Function(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Map<String, V2TimMessageReceipt> get messageReadReceiptMap =>\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  String get currentSelectedConv => _currentConversationList.isNotEmpty\r\n'

            '          .conversationID\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  ConvType? get currentSelectedConvType => _currentConversationList.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '      ? _currentConversationList[_currentConversationList.length - 1]\r\n'
            '          .conversationType\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  String _normalizeConversationID(String? value) {\r\n'
            '    return normalizeConversationIdForHistory(value);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 历史桶写入主键：C2C 固定 `c2c_<uid>`，群去掉 `group_` 前缀并保留短码大小写。\r\n'
            '  static String canonicalHistoryStorageKey(String? conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final normalized = normalizeConversationIdForHistory(trimmed);\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return trimmed;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_historyIdKind(trimmed) == _HistoryConversationKind.group) {\r\n'
            '      return normalized;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return \'c2c_${normalized.toLowerCase()}\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<String> _historyAliasKeys(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    final canonical = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(trimmed);\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>{\r\n'
            '      if (trimmed.isNotEmpty) trimmed,\r\n'
            '      if (canonical.isNotEmpty) canonical,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    keys.addAll(\r\n'
            '      _messageListMap.keys.where(\r\n'
            '        (mapKey) => isSameConversationIdForHistory(mapKey, trimmed),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return keys.toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage> _mergedAliasMessageList(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final windows = <List<V2TimMessage>>[];\r\n'
            '    final seen = Set<List<V2TimMessage>>.identity();\r\n'
            '    for (final key in _historyAliasKeys(conversationID)) {\r\n'
            '      final list = _messageListMap[key];\r\n'
            '      if (list != null && list.isNotEmpty && seen.add(list)) windows.add(list);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (windows.isEmpty) return const <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    if (windows.length == 1) {\r\n'
            '      ChatMainThreadPerf.increment(\'message_single_window_reused\');\r\n'
            '      return windows.single;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Defensive migration for a genuinely distinct legacy alias window.\r\n'
            '    return List<V2TimMessage>.unmodifiable(sortMessagesNewestFirst(\r\n'
            '        dedupeMessages([for (final window in windows) ...window])));\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 别名合并后的内存窗（`c2c_` / 裸 id 等同会话），供分页 baseline 与提交守卫使用。\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage> mergedAliasMessageList(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return _mergedAliasMessageList(conversationID);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Returns the canonical window already maintained by the reconciliation\r\n'
            '  /// writer. Pending realtime deltas remain owned by the writer and are merged\r\n'
            '  /// by completeHistory; they must not force this read back through full dedupe.\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage> canonicalMessageWindow(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return _mergedAliasMessageList(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final window = _messageReconciliationWriter.valuesFor(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    return window.isEmpty ? _mergedAliasMessageList(conversationID) : window;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 用户正在读历史（一屏外 / 非最新），此期间禁止 latest 向 replace 抢写列表。\r\n'
            '  bool isReadingHistory(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final position = getMessageListPosition(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    return position == HistoryMessagePosition.awayTwoScreen ||\r\n'
            '        position == HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _collapseHistoryAliasesToCanonical(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    required String canonical,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (canonical.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final key in _historyAliasKeys(conversationID)) {\r\n'
            '      if (key == canonical) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _messageListMap.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _messageListContentSignatureByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      final position = _historyMessagePositionMap.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      if (position != null &&\r\n'
            '          !_historyMessagePositionMap.containsKey(canonical)) {\r\n'
            '        _storeHistoryMessagePosition(canonical, position);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 去掉 `c2c_` / `group_` 等前缀，供历史桶 / 进页匹配共用。\r\n'
            '  static String normalizeConversationIdForHistory(String? value) {\r\n'
            '    var id = value?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (id.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final lower = id.toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '    if (lower.startsWith(\'c2c_\')) {\r\n'
            '      id = id.substring(4);\r\n'
            '    } else if (lower.startsWith(\'group_\')) {\r\n'
            '      id = id.substring(6);\r\n'
            '    } else if (id.startsWith(\'C2C\')) {\r\n'
            '      id = id.substring(3);\r\n'
            '    } else if (id.startsWith(\'GROUP\')) {\r\n'
            '      id = id.substring(5);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return id;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isSameConversationID(String? left, String? right) {\r\n'
            '    return isSameConversationIdForHistory(left, right);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isGroupConversation(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    Iterable<V2TimMessage> messages = const <V2TimMessage>[],\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final selectedType = currentSelectedConvType;\r\n'

            '        _isSameConversationID(conversationID, currentSelectedConv)) {\r\n'
            '      return selectedType == ConvType.group;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 包内外统一的会话 ID 等价判断（前缀、社群短码）。\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// 聊天页空拉兜底、hydrate 别名探测等禁止再写字面 `==` / 手拼 `group_`。\r\n'
            '  /// `c2c_` 与群短码即使忽略大小写相同，也不得判为同一会话。\r\n'
            '  static bool isSameConversationIdForHistory(String? left, String? right) {\r\n'
            '    final a = normalizeConversationIdForHistory(left);\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'

            '      final groupBody = aKind == _HistoryConversationKind.group ? a : b;\r\n'

            '        return _communityIdsEquivalent(a, b);\r\n'

            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (a == b) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (aKind == _HistoryConversationKind.group) {\r\n'
            '      return _communityIdsEquivalent(a, b);\r\n'

            '    return a.toLowerCase() == b.toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 与 app [ChatIdFormat.isCommunityShortToken] 对齐：字母数字下划线且含大写。\r\n'
            '  static final RegExp _communityShortAlnumReg = RegExp(r\'^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$\');\r\n'
            '  static final RegExp _hasUpperCaseReg = RegExp(r\'[A-Z]\');\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _looksLikeCommunityShortToken(String token) {\r\n'
            '    final t = token.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (t.isEmpty || t.toUpperCase().contains(\'TGS#\')) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_communityShortAlnumReg.hasMatch(t)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _hasUpperCaseReg.hasMatch(t);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _rawHasC2cPrefix(String trimmed) {\r\n'
            '    final lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '    return lower.startsWith(\'c2c_\') || trimmed.startsWith(\'C2C\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _rawHasGroupPrefix(String trimmed) {\r\n'
            '    final lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '    return lower.startsWith(\'group_\') || trimmed.startsWith(\'GROUP\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static _HistoryConversationKind _historyIdKind(String? conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return _HistoryConversationKind.c2c;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_rawHasC2cPrefix(trimmed)) {\r\n'
            '      return _HistoryConversationKind.c2c;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_rawHasGroupPrefix(trimmed)) {\r\n'
            '      return _HistoryConversationKind.group;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final body = normalizeConversationIdForHistory(trimmed);\r\n'
            '    if (body.contains(\'TGS#\') ||\r\n'
            '        body.startsWith(\'@\') ||\r\n'
            '        _looksLikeCommunityShortToken(body)) {\r\n'
            '      return _HistoryConversationKind.group;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _HistoryConversationKind.c2c;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _communityIdsEquivalent(String left, String right) {\r\n'
            '    String shortOf(String raw) {\r\n'
            '      var id = raw.trim();\r\n'
            '      if (id.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return \'\';\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final upper = id.toUpperCase();\r\n'
            '      // 默认分配社群：`@TGS#_@TGS#{short}`\r\n'
            '      const fullPrefix = \'@TGS#_@TGS#\';\r\n'
            '      if (upper.startsWith(fullPrefix)) {\r\n'
            '        return id.substring(fullPrefix.length);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 控制台自定义社群：`@TGS#_mc…` → `mc…`（勿把 `_mc…` 当 token）\r\n'
            '      if (upper.startsWith(\'@TGS#_\')) {\r\n'
            '        return id.substring(\'@TGS#_\'.length);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final hash = id.indexOf(\'#\');\r\n'
            '      if (hash >= 0 && hash + 1 < id.length && upper.contains(\'TGS#\')) {\r\n'
            '        var token = id.substring(hash + 1);\r\n'
            '        if (token.startsWith(\'_\')) {\r\n'
            '          token = token.substring(1);\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return token;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (id.startsWith(\'@\')) {\r\n'
            '        return id.substring(1);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return id;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<MessageHistoryCoverage> ensureMessageHistoryCoverageLoaded(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    int clearEpoch = 0,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return MessageHistoryCoverage.empty(\'\', isGroup: false);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final cached = _messageHistoryCoverageByConv[key];\r\n'
            '    if (_messageHistoryCoverageLoadedConvs.contains(key) && cached != null) {\r\n'
            '      if (clearEpoch <= cached.clearEpoch) return cached;\r\n'
            '      final cleared = MessageHistoryCoverage.empty(\r\n'
            '        key,\r\n'

            '        clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _storeMessageHistoryCoverage(cleared);\r\n'
            '      return cleared;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final existingTask = _messageHistoryCoverageLoadInFlight[key];\r\n'
            '    if (existingTask != null) {\r\n'
            '      final loaded = await existingTask;\r\n'
            '      return loaded ??\r\n'
            '          MessageHistoryCoverage.empty(\r\n'

            '            isGroup: _looksLikeGroupConversationKey(key),\r\n'
            '            clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    late final Future<MessageHistoryCoverage?> task;\r\n'
            '    final coverageSessionGeneration = _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration;\r\n'
            '    task = () async {\r\n'
            '      final loaded = await loadMessageHistoryCoverage(key);\r\n'
            '      // 窗口库的清空屏障是地板：coverage 行丢失时不能退回 0。\r\n'
            '      final persisted = await _persistedHistoryWindowClearEpoch(\r\n'
            '        canonicalHistoryStorageKey(key),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'

            '          ? MessageHistoryCoverage.empty(\r\n'
            '              key,\r\n'

            '          _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration) {\r\n'

            '      }\r\n'
            '      _messageHistoryCoverageByConv[key] = normalized;\r\n'
            '      _messageHistoryCoverageLoadedConvs.add(key);\r\n'

            '        .whenComplete(() {\r\n'
            '      if (identical(_messageHistoryCoverageLoadInFlight[key], task)) {\r\n'
            '        _messageHistoryCoverageLoadInFlight.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    _messageHistoryCoverageLoadInFlight[key] = task;\r\n'
            '    return await task ??\r\n'
            '        MessageHistoryCoverage.empty(\r\n'
            '          key,\r\n'
            '          isGroup: _looksLikeGroupConversationKey(key),\r\n'
            '          clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Records a closed missing group-seq interval produced when an older page\r\n'
            '  /// was rejected for not abutting the contiguous spine. Does not change the\r\n'
            '  /// message list.\r\n'
            '  void noteRejectedOlderPageGap({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    required int missingLowerSeq,\r\n'
            '    required int missingUpperSeq,\r\n'
            '    bool isGroup = true,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!isGroup ||\r\n'
            '        missingLowerSeq <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '        missingUpperSeq <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '        missingLowerSeq > missingUpperSeq) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final key = storageKey.isEmpty ? conversationID.trim() : storageKey;\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) {\r\n'

            '    final current = _messageHistoryCoverageByConv[key] ??\r\n'
            '        MessageHistoryCoverage.empty(\r\n'
            '          key,\r\n'

            '          clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(key),\r\n'

            '    final holeKey = \'seq:$missingLowerSeq-$missingUpperSeq\';\r\n'
            '    final nextHoles = <MessageHistoryHole>[\r\n'
            '      for (final hole in current.holes)\r\n'
            '        if (hole.key != holeKey) hole,\r\n'
            '      MessageHistoryHole(\r\n'
            '        key: holeKey,\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageHistoryHoleKind.groupSeq,\r\n'
            '        status: MessageHistoryHoleStatus.open,\r\n'
            '        startSeq: missingLowerSeq,\r\n'
            '        endSeq: missingUpperSeq,\r\n'
            '        generation:\r\n'
            '            _messageHistoryCoverageRequestGenerationByConv[key] ?? 0,\r\n'
            '        updatedAtMs: now,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    ];\r\n'
            '    _storeMessageHistoryCoverage(\r\n'
            '      current.copyWith(\r\n'
            '        isGroup: true,\r\n'
            '        coverageRevision: current.coverageRevision + 1,\r\n'
            '        status: MessageHistoryCoverageStatus.partial,\r\n'
            '        holes: nextHoles,\r\n'
            '        updatedAtMs: now,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'

            '  /// Activates the InboundReorderBuffer for group conversations after\r\n'

            '  /// Triggers a CLOUD_NEWER pull when a group seq gap times out.\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  V2TimMessage? _cloudCatchUpNewestAnchor(List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  String _cloudCatchUpAnchorKey(V2TimMessage? anchor) {\r\n'
            '    if (anchor == null) {\r\n'

            '    if (msgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Include the visible content signature in the in-memory key. A server\r\n'
            '    // edit to the same message therefore invalidates the stalled decision.\r\n'
            '    return \'$msgID|${_messageListContentSignature(<V2TimMessage>[anchor])}\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _shouldHoldStalledCloudContinuation(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    final current = _mergedAliasMessageList(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final anchor = _cloudCatchUpNewestAnchor(current);\r\n'
            '    final anchorID = anchor?.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (anchorID.isEmpty) {\r\n'

            '    final inMemory = _cloudCatchUpStalledAnchorByConv[conversationID];\r\n'
            '    if (inMemory != null) {\r\n'
            '      // A changed anchor or content is a fresh observation. Do not fall back\r\n'
            '      // to the durable ID-only record, otherwise an edited tip would remain\r\n'
            '      // blocked until another lifecycle event.\r\n'
            '      if (inMemory == _cloudCatchUpAnchorKey(anchor)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _markCloudCatchUpUnblocked(String conversationID) async {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _recordCloudCatchUpStalled(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Runs one bounded cloud reconciliation for open/reconnect/foreground and\r\n'
            '  /// gap-repair triggers. All fetched rows are committed through the same\r\n'
            '  /// reconciliation writer as initial history and realtime callbacks.\r\n'
            '  Future<MessageCloudCatchUpResult> reconcileConversationCloud(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    required String reason,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return const MessageCloudCatchUpResult(\r\n'
            '        disposition: MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.offline,\r\n'
            '        attempts: 0,\r\n'

            '          \'position\': getMessageListPosition(storageKey).name,\r\n'
            '          \'memorySuppressed\': isMemoryWindowSuppressed(storageKey),\r\n'
            '          \'missingNewer\': memoryWindowMissingNewer(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return const MessageCloudCatchUpResult(\r\n'
            '        disposition: MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.settled,\r\n'
            '        attempts: 0,\r\n'
            '        timedOut: false,\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (reason == \'cloud_continuation\') {\r\n'
            '      if (await _shouldHoldStalledCloudContinuation(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '        ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '          \'cloud_catch_up_stalled_hold\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\'reason\': reason},\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return const MessageCloudCatchUpResult(\r\n'
            '          disposition: MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.stalled,\r\n'
            '          attempts: 0,\r\n'
            '          timedOut: false,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'

            '      // A fresh lifecycle/open/bottom trigger is the explicit escape hatch\r\n'
            '      // from a stalled same-anchor continuation.\r\n'
            '      await _markCloudCatchUpUnblocked(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (reason != \'cloud_continuation\') {\r\n'
            '      _cancelCloudContinuation(storageKey, clearBudget: false);\r\n'
            '      _cloudContinuationRoundsByConv[storageKey] = 0;\r\n'

            '    final result = await _boundedCloudCatchUp.run(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'

            '          _runCloudCatchUpAttempt(storageKey, reason: reason, attempt: attempt),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    await _markUnresolvedGroupCoverageAfterCatchUp(storageKey, result);\r\n'
            '    if (result.disposition == MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.stalled) {\r\n'
            '      await _recordCloudCatchUpStalled(\r\n'
            '        storageKey,\r\n'
            '        _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (result.settled) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'cloud_catch_up_settled\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'reason\': reason,\r\n'
            '          \'attempts\': result.attempts,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (result.completed || result.settled) {\r\n'
            '      _cancelCloudContinuation(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    } else if (result.needsContinuation) {\r\n'
            '      _scheduleCloudContinuation(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _markUnresolvedGroupCoverageAfterCatchUp(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    MessageCloudCatchUpResult result,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    if (result.completed || result.settled || result.needsContinuation) return;\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    await _enqueueMessageHistoryCoverageUpdate(storageKey, () async {\r\n'
            '      final current = await ensureMessageHistoryCoverageLoaded(storageKey);\r\n'
            '      final unresolved = current.holes\r\n'
            '          .where(\r\n'
            '            (hole) =>\r\n'
            '                hole.kind == MessageHistoryHoleKind.groupSeq &&\r\n'
            '                hole.status != MessageHistoryHoleStatus.resolved,\r\n'
            '          )\r\n'
            '          .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '      if (!current.isGroup || unresolved.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '      final nextHoleStatus =\r\n'
            '          result.disposition == MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.offline\r\n'
            '              ? MessageHistoryHoleStatus.cloudUnavailable\r\n'
            '              : MessageHistoryHoleStatus.retryable;\r\n'
            '      if (unresolved.every((hole) => hole.status == nextHoleStatus)) return;\r\n'
            '      final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '      final holes = current.holes.map((hole) {\r\n'
            '        if (hole.kind != MessageHistoryHoleKind.groupSeq ||\r\n'
            '            hole.status == MessageHistoryHoleStatus.resolved) {\r\n'
            '          return hole;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return MessageHistoryHole(\r\n'
            '          key: hole.key,\r\n'
            '          kind: hole.kind,\r\n'
            '          status: nextHoleStatus,\r\n'
            '          startSeq: hole.startSeq,\r\n'
            '          endSeq: hole.endSeq,\r\n'
            '          olderMsgID: hole.olderMsgID,\r\n'
            '          newerMsgID: hole.newerMsgID,\r\n'
            '          generation: hole.generation,\r\n'
            '          updatedAtMs: now,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }).toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '      _storeMessageHistoryCoverage(\r\n'
            '        current.copyWith(\r\n'
            '          coverageRevision: current.coverageRevision + 1,\r\n'
            '          status: result.disposition == MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.offline\r\n'
            '              ? MessageHistoryCoverageStatus.offlineLocalOnly\r\n'
            '              : MessageHistoryCoverageStatus.partial,\r\n'
            '          holes: holes,\r\n'
            '          updatedAtMs: now,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleCloudContinuation(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final current = storageKey.isEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? const <V2TimMessage>[]\r\n'
            '        : _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'

            '        isChatListUserScrolling) {\r\n'

            '    final position = getMessageListPosition(storageKey);\r\n'

            '        if (!_chatAppForeground ||\r\n'

            '            isChatListUserScrolling ||\r\n'
            '            _messageReconciliationWriter.hasActiveRequest(storageKey)) {\r\n'

            '        final currentRounds = _cloudContinuationRoundsByConv[storageKey] ?? 0;\r\n'

            '        );\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _cancelCloudContinuation(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition> _runCloudCatchUpAttempt(\r\n'
            '    String storageKey, {\r\n'
            '    required String reason,\r\n'
            '    required MessageCloudCatchUpAttempt attempt,\r\n'

            '      return MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.settled;\r\n'

            '          \'cloud_gap_exact_request\',\r\n'

            '      }\r\n'

            '          await applyHistoryWindowMutations(storageKey, response.messageList);\r\n'
            '      if (!attempt.isCurrent ||\r\n'
            '          _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != writerScope ||\r\n'
            '          messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey) != clearEpoch ||\r\n'
