            '        networkState: provenance.networkState,\r\n'
            '        historyCommitSource: \'cloud_catch_up:$reason:a${attempt.number}\',\r\n'
            '        cloudHasMoreNewer: missingSeqs.isEmpty && !response.isFinished,\r\n'
            '        batchKind: missingSeqs.isEmpty\r\n'
            '            ? MessageHistoryBatchKind.newerCatchUp\r\n'
            '            : MessageHistoryBatchKind.gapFill,\r\n'
            '        historyIsFinished: response.isFinished,\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageHistoryCoverageFor(storageKey)?.clearEpoch ?? 0,\r\n'
            '        requestedCursor: catchUpCursor,\r\n'
            '        returnedBounds: MessageHistoryBounds(\r\n'
            '          oldestMsgID: returnedOldest?.msgID,\r\n'
            '          newestMsgID: returnedNewest?.msgID,\r\n'
            '          oldestSeq: _messageNumericSeq(returnedOldest),\r\n'
            '          newestSeq: _messageNumericSeq(returnedNewest),\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '        cloudResponseProven: provenance.cloudResponseProven,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (commit == null) {\r\n'
            '        return MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.retry;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!provenance.cloudResponseProven) {\r\n'
            '        return MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.offline;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final state = _messageReconciliationWriter.coordinator.stateFor(\r\n'
            '        storageKey,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final needsAnotherPage = missingSeqs.isEmpty && !response.isFinished;\r\n'
            '      if (state.missingSeqRanges.isNotEmpty || needsAnotherPage) {\r\n'
            '        return needsAnotherPage\r\n'
            '            ? MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.continuation\r\n'
            '            : MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.retry;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // A successful finished transport response ends this bounded pass, but\r\n'
            '      // does not upgrade durable coverage to verified. A later open/reconnect\r\n'
            '      // can validate again without three identical immediate retries.\r\n'
            '      if (provenance.proofKind != MessageHistoryProofKind.serverContinuity) {\r\n'
            '        return MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.settled;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.complete;\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt.isCurrent) {\r\n'
            '        failHistoryReconciliation(\r\n'
            '          request: request,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'cloud_catch_up_exception\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return MessageCloudCatchUpDisposition.retry;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _c2cCatchUpHasNewMessage(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> current,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> fetched,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final known = <String, String>{};\r\n'
            '    for (final message in current) {\r\n'
            '      final id = (message.msgID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '          ? message.msgID!.trim()\r\n'
            '          : (message.id?.trim() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '      if (id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        known[id] = _messageListContentSignature(<V2TimMessage>[message]);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final message in fetched) {\r\n'
            '      final id = (message.msgID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '          ? message.msgID!.trim()\r\n'
            '          : (message.id?.trim() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '      if (id.isEmpty || !known.containsKey(id)) return true;\r\n'
            '      if (known[id] != _messageListContentSignature(<V2TimMessage>[message])) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<int> _boundedMissingGroupSeqs(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> newestFirst, {\r\n'
            '    required int maxCount,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final gaps = GapDetector.detectGaps(\r\n'
            '      newestFirst: newestFirst,\r\n'
            '      isGroup: true,\r\n'
            '      fullScan: true,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (gaps.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return const <int>[];\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqs = <int>[];\r\n'
            '    for (final gap in gaps) {\r\n'
            '      final lower = gap.lowerSeq;\r\n'
            '      final upper = gap.upperSeq;\r\n'
            '      if (lower == null || upper == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      for (var seq = lower + 1; seq < upper && seqs.length < maxCount; seq++) {\r\n'
            '        seqs.add(seq);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (seqs.length >= maxCount) {\r\n'
            '        break;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return List<int>.unmodifiable(seqs);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldFallbackFromExactGroupSeqRequest(\r\n'
            '    Map<String, Object?>? error,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (error == null) return false;\r\n'
            '    final code = int.tryParse(error[\'errorCode\']?.toString() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '    final description =\r\n'
            '        error[\'description\']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    return code == 10004 ||\r\n'
            '        description.contains(\'msgseqlist\') ||\r\n'
            '        description.contains(\'message seq list\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int _groupGapRangeFallbackCount(List<int> missingSeqs) {\r\n'
            '    if (missingSeqs.isEmpty) return 20;\r\n'
            '    var contiguousCount = 1;\r\n'
            '    for (var index = 1; index < missingSeqs.length; index++) {\r\n'
            '      if (missingSeqs[index] != missingSeqs[index - 1] + 1) break;\r\n'
            '      contiguousCount++;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Include enough messages to cross the first missing range while keeping\r\n'
            '    // the fallback bounded. A minimum page avoids another one-row edge case.\r\n'
            '    return (contiguousCount + 2).clamp(20, 100);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _requestDetectedGroupGapCatchUp(String conversationID, GapInfo gap) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final lower = gap.lowerSeq ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final upper = gap.upperSeq ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty || lower <= 0 || upper <= lower + 1) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_shouldDeferCloudCatchUpWhileReadingHistory(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'seq_gap_catch_up_deferred_reading_history\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'lowerSeq\': lower,\r\n'
            '          \'upperSeq\': upper,\r\n'
            '          \'position\': getMessageListPosition(storageKey).name,\r\n'
            '          \'memorySuppressed\': isMemoryWindowSuppressed(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final rangeKey = \'$storageKey:$lower-$upper\';\r\n'
            '    final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    final previous = _groupGapAutoAttemptAtMs[rangeKey] ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (now - previous < _groupGapAutoCooldownMs) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _groupGapAutoAttemptAtMs[rangeKey] = now;\r\n'
            '    unawaited(\r\n'
            '      reconcileConversationCloud(storageKey, reason: \'seq_gap_${lower}_$upper\'),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldDeferCloudCatchUpWhileReadingHistory(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return isMemoryWindowSuppressed(conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '        isReadingHistory(conversationID);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _clearResolvedGroupGapAttempts(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    List<GapInfo> gaps,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final active = <String>{\r\n'
            '      for (final gap in gaps)\r\n'
            '        \'$storageKey:${gap.lowerSeq ?? 0}-${gap.upperSeq ?? 0}\',\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    _groupGapAutoAttemptAtMs.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key, _) => key.startsWith(\'$storageKey:\') && !active.contains(key),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 保留当前消息窗口，只撤销“首屏已验证”资格。\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// LOCAL-only 预热刷新了旧暖窗时使用；不清消息、分页提示、搜索或位置状态。\r\n'
            '  void clearInitialHistoryLoaded(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _initialHistoryLoadedConvs.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key) => _isSameConversationID(key, trimmed),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void markInitialHistoryMayHaveOlder(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    required bool mayHaveOlder,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final keys = _historyFlagKeys(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (keys.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (mayHaveOlder) {\r\n'
            '      for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '        _mayHaveOlderHistoryByConv[key] = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '        _mayHaveOlderHistoryByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool mayHaveOlderHistory(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_mayHaveOlderHistoryByConv[trimmed] == true) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final normalized = _normalizeConversationID(trimmed);\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _mayHaveOlderHistoryByConv[normalized] == true) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in _mayHaveOlderHistoryByConv.entries) {\r\n'
            '      if (entry.value && _isSameConversationID(entry.key, trimmed)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Raw in-memory window for warm/open short-circuit (alias-aware).\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// 若本 key 上是空 list、但等价别名仍有消息，优先返回非空别名窗——\r\n'
            '  /// 否则 tip-strip / hydrate_keep_empty 写过的空占位会永远挡住真实暖窗（灰屏）。\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage>? rawMessageList(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage>? emptyPlaceholder;\r\n'
            '    final direct = _messageListMap[trimmed];\r\n'
            '    if (direct != null) {\r\n'
            '      if (direct.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return direct;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      emptyPlaceholder = direct;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final normalized = _normalizeConversationID(trimmed);\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final byNorm = _messageListMap[normalized];\r\n'
            '      if (byNorm != null && byNorm.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return byNorm;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      emptyPlaceholder ??= byNorm;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in _messageListMap.entries) {\r\n'
            '      if (!_isSameConversationID(entry.key, trimmed)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final aliasList = entry.value;\r\n'
            '      if (aliasList == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (aliasList.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return aliasList;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      emptyPlaceholder ??= aliasList;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return emptyPlaceholder;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 是否仍有进页 hydrate / 冷开并行 peek 在飞（别名感知）。\r\n'
            '  bool hasOpenHydrateInFlight(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return _findOpenHydrateInFlight(conversationID) != null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Last terminal result for the app-owned first-window bootstrap. This is\r\n'
            '  /// separate from the in-flight map so a caller arriving just after\r\n'
            '  /// completion can consume the same result without issuing LOCAL/CLOUD again.\r\n'
            '  OpenHydrateResult? openHydrateResultFor(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return null;\r\n'
            '    final direct = _openHydrateResultByConv[trimmed];\r\n'
            '    if (direct != null) return direct;\r\n'
            '    final normalized = _normalizeConversationID(trimmed);\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final byNorm = _openHydrateResultByConv[normalized];\r\n'
            '      if (byNorm != null) return byNorm;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in _openHydrateResultByConv.entries) {\r\n'
            '      if (_isSameConversationID(entry.key, trimmed)) return entry.value;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  OpenHydrateResult? takeOpenHydrateResult(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final result = openHydrateResultFor(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (result != null) {\r\n'
            '      clearOpenHydrateResult(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void publishOpenHydrateResult(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    OpenHydrateResult result,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final key = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    for (final alias in _historyFlagKeys(key)) {\r\n'
            '      _openHydrateResultByConv[alias] = result;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void clearOpenHydrateResult(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final key = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    _openHydrateResultByConv.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (alias, _) => _isSameConversationID(alias, key),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<OpenHydrateResult>? _findOpenHydrateInFlight(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final direct = _openHydrateInFlightByConv[trimmed];\r\n'
            '    if (direct != null) {\r\n'
            '      return direct;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final normalized = _normalizeConversationID(trimmed);\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final byNorm = _openHydrateInFlightByConv[normalized];\r\n'
            '      if (byNorm != null) {\r\n'
            '        return byNorm;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in _openHydrateInFlightByConv.entries) {\r\n'
            '      if (_isSameConversationID(entry.key, trimmed)) {\r\n'
            '        return entry.value;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// The route, page and UIKit share one task and its terminal result.\r\n'
            '  /// A caller timing out does not remove the underlying task.\r\n'
            '  Future<OpenHydrateResult> ensureOpenHydrate(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    required String requestSignature,\r\n'
            '    required Future<bool> Function() load,\r\n'
            '    required bool Function() canPublish,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final key = conversationID.trim();\n'
            '    final existing = _findOpenHydrateInFlight(key);\n'
            '    if (existing != null && (_openHydrateCanPublish[existing]?.call() ?? true)) {\n'
            '      final joinTrace = ChatOpenPerfLog.captureCurrent(conversationKey: key);\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.markHydrateJoined(\r\n'
            '        ChatOpenPerfLog.lastPrepareRequestId,\r\n'
            '        trace: joinTrace,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '        \'app_hydrate_join\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'requestId\': joinTrace.requestId,\r\n'
            '          \'prepareId\': joinTrace.requestId,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '        trace: joinTrace,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (_isSameConversationID(_openBottomCapsuleLockConvId, key)) {\r\n'
            '        _openBottomCapsuleHydrateSettled = false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return existing;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final previous = openHydrateResultFor(key);\r\n'
            '    if (previous != null &&\r\n'
            '        previous.requestSignature == requestSignature &&\r\n'
            '        previous.shouldSuppressOrdinaryLoad &&\r\n'
            '        hasInitialHistoryLoaded(key)) {\r\n'
            '      final reuseTrace = ChatOpenPerfLog.captureCurrent(conversationKey: key);\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '        \'app_hydrate_reuse\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'requestId\': reuseTrace.requestId,\r\n'
            '          \'prepareId\': reuseTrace.requestId,\r\n'
            '          \'hydrateKind\': previous.kind.name,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '        trace: reuseTrace,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      markOpenChatHydrateSettled(key);\r\n'
            '      return Future.value(previous);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    clearOpenHydrateResult(key);\r\n'
            '    final generation = _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final clearEpoch = messageDeltaClearEpochFor(key);\r\n'
            '    final ownerTrace = ChatOpenPerfLog.captureCurrent(conversationKey: key);\r\n'
            '    final ownerRequestId = ownerTrace.requestId;\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.markHydrateOwner(ownerRequestId, trace: ownerTrace);\r\n'
            '    ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '      \'app_hydrate_registered\',\r\n'
            '      conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'requestId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '        \'prepareId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      trace: ownerTrace,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    late final Future<OpenHydrateResult> task;\r\n'
            '    task = Future<OpenHydrateResult>.microtask(() async {\r\n'
            '      var kind = OpenHydrateResultKind.aborted;\r\n'
            '      ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '        \'app_hydrate_started\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'requestId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '          \'prepareId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '        trace: ownerTrace,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        if (canPublish() && await load()) {\r\n'
            '          kind = rawMessageCount(key) > 0\r\n'
            '              ? OpenHydrateResultKind.committedMessages\r\n'
            '              : OpenHydrateResultKind.committedEmpty;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        kind = OpenHydrateResultKind.failed;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final current = generation == _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration &&\r\n'
            '          clearEpoch == messageDeltaClearEpochFor(key) &&\r\n'
            '          identical(_findOpenHydrateInFlight(key), task) &&\r\n'
            '          canPublish();\r\n'
            '      if (!current) kind = OpenHydrateResultKind.aborted;\r\n'
            '      final result = OpenHydrateResult(\r\n'
            '        kind: kind,\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: key,\r\n'
            '        resultCount: current ? rawMessageCount(key) : 0,\r\n'
            '        firstWindowCommitted: current &&\r\n'
            '            (kind == OpenHydrateResultKind.committedMessages ||\r\n'
            '                kind == OpenHydrateResultKind.committedEmpty),\r\n'
            '        generation: generation,\r\n'
            '        completedAtMs: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,\r\n'
            '        requestSignature: requestSignature,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (current) {\r\n'
            '        publishOpenHydrateResult(key, result);\r\n'
            '        ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '          \'app_hydrate_commit\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'requestId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '            \'prepareId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '            \'hydrateKind\': kind.name,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '          trace: ownerTrace,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        ChatOpenPerfLog.mark(\r\n'
            '          \'app_hydrate_aborted\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'requestId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '            \'prepareId\': ownerRequestId,\r\n'
            '            \'hydrateKind\': kind.name,\r\n'
            '            \'staleReason\': \'hydrateAborted\',\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '          trace: ownerTrace,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return result;\r\n'
            '    }).whenComplete(() {\n'
            '      final stillOwner = identical(_findOpenHydrateInFlight(key), task);\n'
            '      _openHydrateInFlightByConv\n'
            '          .removeWhere((_, value) => identical(value, task));\n'
            '      if (stillOwner) markOpenChatHydrateSettled(key);\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    _openHydrateCanPublish[task] = canPublish;\n'
            '    for (final alias in _historyFlagKeys(key)) {\r\n'
            '      _openHydrateInFlightByConv[alias] = task;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isSameConversationID(_openBottomCapsuleLockConvId, key)) {\r\n'
            '      _openBottomCapsuleHydrateSettled = false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return task;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> awaitOpenHydrateInFlight(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    Duration timeout = const Duration(milliseconds: 450),\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final inFlight = _findOpenHydrateInFlight(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (inFlight == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      await inFlight.timeout(timeout);\r\n'
            '    } on TimeoutException {\r\n'
            '      // hydrate 自行兜底。\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int rawMessageCount(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return rawMessageList(conversationID)?.length ?? 0;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool memoryWindowMissingNewer(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in _memoryWindowMissingNewerByConv.entries) {\r\n'
            '      if (entry.value && _isSameConversationID(entry.key, conversationID)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// True when the in-memory window was trimmed and must be reconciled with\r\n'
            '  /// SDK history before it can be considered a complete open window.\r\n'
            '  /// This is deliberately separate from the SDK\'s own "has more" flags.\r\n'
            '  bool memoryWindowNeedsReconciliation(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return memoryWindowMissingNewer(conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '        _memoryWindowMissingOlderByConv.entries.any(\r\n'
            '          (entry) =>\r\n'
            '              entry.value && _isSameConversationID(entry.key, conversationID),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool memoryWindowReconciliationCovered(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage>? messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (!memoryWindowNeedsReconciliation(conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '        messages == null ||\r\n'
            '        messages.isEmpty) return false;\r\n'
            '    final boundary = _memoryWindowBoundaryTimestampByConv.entries\r\n'
            '        .where((e) => _isSameConversationID(e.key, conversationID))\r\n'
            '        .map((e) => e.value)\r\n'
            '        .fold<int>(0, (a, b) => a > b ? a : b);\r\n'
            '    final newer = memoryWindowMissingNewer(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final older = _memoryWindowMissingOlderByConv.entries.any(\r\n'
            '      (e) => e.value && _isSameConversationID(e.key, conversationID),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (boundary <= 0) return messages.isNotEmpty;\r\n'
            '    final timestamps =\r\n'
            '        messages.map((m) => m.timestamp ?? 0).where((v) => v > 0);\r\n'
            '    if (timestamps.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final minTs = timestamps.reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b);\r\n'
            '      final maxTs = timestamps.reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);\r\n'
            '      if (newer && maxTs > boundary) return true;\r\n'
            '      if (older && minTs < boundary) return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqs = messages\r\n'
            '        .map((m) => int.tryParse(m.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') ?? 0)\r\n'
            '        .where((v) => v > 0);\r\n'
            '    final boundarySeq = int.tryParse(\r\n'
            '          _memoryWindowBoundarySeqByConv.entries\r\n'
            '              .firstWhere(\r\n'
            '                (e) => _isSameConversationID(e.key, conversationID),\r\n'
            '                orElse: () => const MapEntry(\'\', \'\'),\r\n'
            '              )\r\n'
            '              .value,\r\n'
            '        ) ??\r\n'
            '        0;\r\n'
            '    if (boundarySeq > 0 && seqs.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final minSeq = seqs.reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b);\r\n'
            '      final maxSeq = seqs.reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);\r\n'
            '      return (newer && maxSeq > boundarySeq) || (older && minSeq < boundarySeq);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void markMemoryWindowMissingNewer(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final key = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _memoryWindowMissingNewerByConv[key] = true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void markMemoryWindowMissingOlder(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final key = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isNotEmpty) _memoryWindowMissingOlderByConv[key] = true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void clearMemoryWindowMissingNewer(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final keys = _memoryWindowMissingNewerByConv.keys\r\n'
            '        .where((k) => _isSameConversationID(k, conversationID))\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '      _memoryWindowMissingNewerByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void clearMemoryWindowReconciliation(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    clearMemoryWindowMissingNewer(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final keys = _memoryWindowMissingOlderByConv.keys\r\n'
            '        .where((k) => _isSameConversationID(k, conversationID))\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '      _memoryWindowMissingOlderByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _memoryWindowBoundaryTimestampByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _memoryWindowBoundarySeqByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void setMemoryWindowSuppressed(String conversationID, bool suppressed) {\r\n'
            '    final key = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final wasSuppressed = isMemoryWindowSuppressed(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (suppressed) {\r\n'
            '      _memoryWindowSuppressedConvs.add(key);\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      _memoryWindowSuppressedConvs.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '        (k) => _isSameConversationID(k, conversationID),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (wasSuppressed != suppressed) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '        \'memory_window\',\r\n'
            '        conv: conversationID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'action\': suppressed ? \'suppress_on\' : \'suppress_off\',\r\n'
            '          \'rawCount\': rawMessageCount(conversationID),\r\n'
            '          \'position\': getMessageListPosition(conversationID).name,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool isMemoryWindowSuppressed(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return _memoryWindowSuppressedConvs.any(\r\n'
            '      (k) => _isSameConversationID(k, conversationID),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// IM `onSyncServerFinish`：90 天漫游入库后通知打开中的聊天页重拉连续窗。\r\n'
            '  void addRoamingSyncListener(VoidCallback listener) {\r\n'
            '    if (_roamingSyncListeners.contains(listener)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _roamingSyncListeners.add(listener);\r\n'

            '  void removeRoamingSyncListener(VoidCallback listener) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void notifyRoamingSyncFinished() {\r\n'

            '    for (final listener in listeners) {\r\n'
            '      listener();\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 上翻分页前挂上视口锚，供 [setMessageList] 做双向窗口裁剪。\r\n'
            '  void setMemoryWindowAnchor(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    String? msgID,\r\n'
            '    String? seq,\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void clearMemoryWindowAnchor([String? conversationID]) {\r\n'
            '    if (conversationID != null &&\r\n'
            '        conversationID.trim().isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _memoryWindowAnchorConvID != null &&\r\n'
            '        !_isSameConversationID(_memoryWindowAnchorConvID!, conversationID)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '    _memoryWindowAnchorMsgID = null;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 对当前内存列表再跑一遍窗口闸门（搜索抑制解除后收束超长窗）。\r\n'
            '  void applyMessageMemoryWindowNow(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    String? memoryWindowAnchorMsgID,\r\n'
            '    String? memoryWindowAnchorSeq,\r\n'
            '    bool memoryWindowPreferLatest = false,\r\n'
            '    bool forceWhileReadingHistory = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final list = rawMessageList(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (list == null || list.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (list.length <= ChatMessageWindowPolicy.softMax) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    setMessageList(\r\n'
            '      conversationID,\r\n'
            '      List<V2TimMessage>.of(list),\r\n'
            '      needResetNewMessageCount: false,\r\n'
            '      replace: true,\r\n'
            '      memoryWindowPreferLatest: memoryWindowPreferLatest,\r\n'
            '      memoryWindowAnchorMsgID: memoryWindowAnchorMsgID,\r\n'
            '      memoryWindowAnchorSeq: memoryWindowAnchorSeq,\r\n'
            '      forceMemoryWindowTrimWhileReading: forceWhileReadingHistory,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool isMessageInMemoryWindow(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    String? msgID,\r\n'
            '    String? seq,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final list = rawMessageList(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (list == null || list.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final s = seq?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    for (final message in list) {\r\n'
            '      if (id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        final mid = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        final lid = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        if (mid == id || lid == id) {\r\n'
            '          return true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (s.isNotEmpty && (message.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') == s) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Leave-chat warm trim: keep newest-first [keepCount] rows (tips included).\r\n'
            '  /// Does not delete DB/SDK storage. No-op when already within budget or empty.\r\n'
            '  bool trimMessageListToNewestWarmWindow(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID, {\r\n'
            '    int keepCount = HistoryMessageDartConstant.initialOpenFetchCount,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmedId = conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (trimmedId.isEmpty || keepCount <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final list = rawMessageList(trimmedId);\r\n'
            '    if (list == null || list.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final beforeCount = list.length;\r\n'
            '    if (beforeCount <= keepCount) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final kept = List<V2TimMessage>.from(list.sublist(0, keepCount));\r\n'
            '    clearMemoryWindowMissingNewer(trimmedId);\r\n'
            '    clearMemoryWindowAnchor(trimmedId);\r\n'
            '    setMemoryWindowSuppressed(trimmedId, false);\r\n'
            '    setMessageList(\r\n'
            '      trimmedId,\r\n'
            '      kept,\r\n'
            '      needResetNewMessageCount: false,\r\n'
            '      replace: true,\r\n'
            '      applyMemoryWindow: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    markInitialHistoryLoaded(trimmedId);\r\n'
            '    markInitialHistoryMayHaveOlder(trimmedId, mayHaveOlder: true);\r\n'
            '    ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '      \'history_leave_trim_to_warm\',\r\n'
            '      conversationID: trimmedId,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'beforeCount\': beforeCount,\r\n'
            '        \'afterCount\': kept.length,\r\n'
            '        \'keepCount\': keepCount,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void removeMessageList(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    clearOpenHydrateResult(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    _openHydrateInFlightByConv.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key, _) => _isSameConversationID(key, conversationID),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final normalized = _normalizeConversationID(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '        OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(normalized) ||\r\n'
            '        OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(OutgoingVisibleProbe.lastConvID)) {\r\n'
            '      OutgoingVisibleProbe.log(\r\n'
            '        \'remove_message_list\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'normalized\': normalized,\r\n'
            '          ...OutgoingVisibleProbe.trackedInList(rawMessageList(conversationID)),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>{\r\n'
            '      if (conversationID.trim().isNotEmpty) conversationID.trim(),\r\n'
            '      if (normalized.isNotEmpty) normalized,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    keys.addAll(\r\n'
            '      _messageListMap.keys\r\n'
            '          .where(\r\n'
            '            (mapKey) => keys.any((key) => _isSameConversationID(mapKey, key)),\r\n'
            '          )\r\n'
            '          .toList(growable: false),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // Reuse the warm-cache eviction boundary for every retained authority.\r\n'
            '    // An in-flight Writer still owns its pending deltas and request generation.\r\n'
            '    final writerKey = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (!_isSameConversationID(conversationID, currentSelectedConv) &&\r\n'
            '        !_messageReconciliationWriter.hasActiveRequest(writerKey) &&\r\n'
            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.pendingDeltaCount(writerKey) == 0) {\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.reset(writerKey);\r\n'
            '      _writerProjectionAuthorities.remove(writerKey);\r\n'
            '      final session = _boundedHistory.sessions.remove(writerKey);\r\n'
            '      if (session != null) _closeBoundedHistorySession(session);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Drop every loaded/mayHaveOlder alias first — leftover flags after a wipe\r\n'
            '    // make open path think the window is warm while map is empty (灰屏).\r\n'
            '    _clearHistoryFlagsForConversation(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    clearMemoryWindowMissingNewer(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    clearMemoryWindowAnchor(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    setMemoryWindowSuppressed(conversationID, false);\r\n'
            '    for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '      _messageListMap.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _rowLocalAliasByConversation.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _messageListContentSignatureByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _historyMessagePositionMap.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _searchJumpStatusMap.remove(_searchJumpStateKey(key));\r\n'
            '      _updateSearchJumpWorkGate();\r\n'
            '      _messageListDisplayCache.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '        (cacheKey, _) => _isSameConversationID(cacheKey, key),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (keys.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 清空聊天记录后的内存态：空列表 + 已加载完成。\r\n'
            '  /// 必须保留 initialLoaded，否则消息列表会一直显示 bootstrapping 转圈。\r\n'
            '  void clearLocalHistoryAsEmptyLoaded(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    clearOpenHydrateResult(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    _openHydrateInFlightByConv.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (key, _) => _isSameConversationID(key, conversationID),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final normalized = _normalizeConversationID(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>{\r\n'
            '      if (conversationID.trim().isNotEmpty) conversationID.trim(),\r\n'
            '      if (normalized.isNotEmpty) normalized,\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    // hydrate / 预载会把同一份列表写在等价别名 key（如 group_ 前缀）下；\r\n'
            '    // 只清字面 key 会留下旧窗口，再进页时被别名读回（清空后仍闪旧记录）。\r\n'
            '    keys.addAll(\r\n'
            '      _messageListMap.keys\r\n'
            '          .where(\r\n'
            '            (mapKey) => keys.any((key) => _isSameConversationID(mapKey, key)),\r\n'
            '          )\r\n'
            '          .toList(growable: false),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '      // Clearing the visible window is also a formal replacement. Reset any\r\n'
            '      // in-flight writer transaction first, then publish the empty snapshot\r\n'
            '      // through the compatibility admission so stale history cannot restore\r\n'
            '      // rows after the clear.\r\n'
            '      _messageReconciliationWriter.reset(key);\r\n'
            '      setMessageList(\r\n'
            '        key,\r\n'
            '        const <V2TimMessage>[],\r\n'
            '        needResetNewMessageCount: false,\r\n'
            '        isDeleteMsg: true,\r\n'
            '        replace: true,\r\n'
            '        applyMemoryWindow: false,\r\n'
            '        historyCommitSource: \'clear_local_history\',\r\n'

            '      _messageListContentSignatureByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _initialHistoryLoadedConvs.add(key);\r\n'
            '      _mayHaveOlderHistoryByConv.remove(key);\r\n'
            '      _storeHistoryMessagePosition(key, HistoryMessagePosition.bottom);\r\n'
            '      _searchJumpStatusMap.remove(_searchJumpStateKey(key));\r\n'
            '      _updateSearchJumpWorkGate();\r\n'
            '      // 展示层缓存必须同步失效：否则清空后再进页，getMessageList 仍会\r\n'
            '      // 命中旧缓存，把已清空的消息整窗闪现一帧再塌掉（进页「抖两次」）。\r\n'
            '      _messageListDisplayCache.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '        (cacheKey, _) => _isSameConversationID(cacheKey, key),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (keys.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool isSearchJumpPending(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final status = getSearchJumpStatus(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    return status == SearchJumpStatus.loading ||\r\n'
            '        status == SearchJumpStatus.positioning;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  // Route IDs (c2c_peer/group_id) and SDK IDs (peer/id) address one jump.\r\n'
            '  // Request ownership and UI status must use the same stable bucket as history.\r\n'
            '  String _searchJumpStateKey(String conversationID) =>\r\n'
            '      canonicalHistoryStorageKey(_safeConversationId(conversationID));\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  SearchJumpStatus getSearchJumpStatus(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    return _searchJumpStatusMap[_searchJumpStateKey(conversationID)] ??\r\n'
            '        SearchJumpStatus.idle;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  final Map<String, int> _searchJumpRequestMap = {};\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int searchJumpRequestFor(String conversationID) =>\r\n'
            '      _searchJumpRequestMap[_searchJumpStateKey(conversationID)] ?? 0;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool isCurrentSearchJumpRequest(String conversationID, int requestID) =>\r\n'
            '      searchJumpRequestFor(conversationID) == requestID;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Reset synchronously, before a new route can inspect the previous window.\r\n'
            '  int beginSearchJump(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final key = _searchJumpStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final requestID = searchJumpRequestFor(key) + 1;\r\n'
            '    _searchJumpRequestMap[key] = requestID;\r\n'
            '    setSearchJumpStatus(key, SearchJumpStatus.loading, notify: false);\r\n'
            '    // Explicit navigation owns the viewport now. A menu-close restore must\r\n'

            '    final conv = _normalizeC2CKey(conversationID).toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '    final peer = _normalizeC2CKey(peerID).toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '    if (conv.isEmpty || peer.isEmpty) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  int _c2cPeerReadTimestampFor(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _normalizeC2CKey(conversationID).toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '    if (convKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var timestamp = 0;\r\n'
            '    _c2cPeerReadTimestampMap.forEach((peerID, readAt) {\r\n'
            '      if (_normalizeC2CKey(peerID).toLowerCase() == convKey &&\r\n'
            '          readAt > timestamp) {\r\n'
            '        timestamp = readAt;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'

            '  bool isOutgoingC2CMessagePeerRead({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    required V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final current = _messageInConversation(\r\n'
            '      conversationID,\r\n'
            '      clientId: message.id,\r\n'
            '      msgID: message.msgID,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (current?.isPeerRead == true || message.isPeerRead == true) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final msgID = current?.msgID ?? message.msgID;\r\n'
            '    if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final receipt = _messageReadReceiptMap[msgID];\r\n'
            '      if (receipt?.isPeerRead == true) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final readAt = _c2cPeerReadTimestampFor(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (readAt <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final sentAt = current?.timestamp ?? message.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    return sentAt > 0 && sentAt <= readAt;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '        messageDeltaClearEpochFor(conversationID) == clearEpoch &&\r\n'
            '        (windowScope == null || isHistoryWindowScopeCurrent(windowScope));\r\n'

            '        _pendingGroupApplicationRefreshTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '        _pendingGroupApplicationRefreshTimer = Timer(\r\n'
            '          const Duration(milliseconds: 300),\r\n'
            '          () => refreshGroupApplicationList(force: true),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final now = DateTime.now();\r\n'
            '    final last = _lastGroupApplicationRefreshAt;\r\n'
            '    if (!force && last != null) {\r\n'
            '      final elapsed = now.difference(last);\r\n'
            '      if (elapsed < _groupApplicationRefreshInterval) {\r\n'
            '        _pendingGroupApplicationRefreshTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '        _pendingGroupApplicationRefreshTimer = Timer(\r\n'
            '          _groupApplicationRefreshInterval - elapsed,\r\n'
            '          () => refreshGroupApplicationList(force: true),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _lastGroupApplicationRefreshAt = now;\r\n'
            '    final task = _loadGroupApplicationList();\r\n'
            '    _groupApplicationRefreshTask = task.whenComplete(() {\r\n'
            '      if (identical(_groupApplicationRefreshTask, task)) {\r\n'
            '        _groupApplicationRefreshTask = null;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '            ?.whereType<V2TimGroupApplication>()\r\n'
            '            .toList() ??\r\n'
            '        [];\r\n'
            '    if (_isSameGroupApplicationList(\r\n'
            '      _groupApplicationList ?? const [],\r\n'
            '      nextList,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isSameGroupApplicationList(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimGroupApplication> oldList,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimGroupApplication> nextList,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (oldList.length != nextList.length) return false;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < oldList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final oldItem = oldList[i];\r\n'
            '      final nextItem = nextList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (oldItem.groupID != nextItem.groupID ||\r\n'
            '          oldItem.fromUser != nextItem.fromUser ||\r\n'
            '          oldItem.toUser != nextItem.toUser ||\r\n'
            '          oldItem.addTime != nextItem.addTime ||\r\n'
            '          oldItem.type != nextItem.type ||\r\n'
            '          oldItem.handleStatus != nextItem.handleStatus ||\r\n'
            '          oldItem.handleResult != nextItem.handleResult) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  static const String _outgoingLocalSeqKey = \'__outgoingLocalSeq\';\r\n'
            '  static const String _outgoingLocalSentAtKey = \'__outgoingLocalSentAt\';\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int? _outgoingRandomValue(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final random = message.random;\r\n'
            '    if (random == null || random == 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'

            '    return random;\r\n'
