            '\r\n'
            '  static int? _readOutgoingLocalSeq(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return _readOutgoingLocalInt(message, _outgoingLocalSeqKey);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int? _readOutgoingLocalSentAt(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return _readOutgoingLocalInt(message, _outgoingLocalSentAtKey);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int? _readOutgoingLocalInt(V2TimMessage message, String key) {\r\n'
            '    final raw = message.localCustomData?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\r\n'
            '      if (decoded is! Map) {\r\n'
            '        return null;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final value = decoded[key];\r\n'
            '      if (value is int) {\r\n'
            '        return value;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (value is num) {\r\n'
            '        return value.toInt();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static void _writeOutgoingLocalSeq(V2TimMessage message, int seq) {\r\n'
            '    final data = <String, dynamic>{};\r\n'
            '    final raw = message.localCustomData?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\r\n'
            '        if (decoded is Map) {\r\n'
            '          data.addAll(Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded));\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    data[_outgoingLocalSeqKey] = seq;\r\n'
            '    data[_outgoingLocalSentAtKey] ??=\r\n'
            '        DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000;\r\n'
            '    message.localCustomData = jsonEncode(data);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static void _preserveOutgoingLocalOrderData(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage previous,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage merged,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final previousRaw = previous.localCustomData?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (previousRaw == null || previousRaw.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final data = <String, dynamic>{};\r\n'
            '    final mergedRaw = merged.localCustomData?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (mergedRaw != null && mergedRaw.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final decoded = jsonDecode(mergedRaw);\r\n'
            '        if (decoded is Map) {\r\n'
            '          data.addAll(Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded));\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final previousDecoded = jsonDecode(previousRaw);\r\n'
            '      if (previousDecoded is Map) {\r\n'
            '        for (final key in const [\r\n'
            '          _outgoingLocalSeqKey,\r\n'
            '          _outgoingLocalSentAtKey,\r\n'
            '          kChatOutgoingStableIdKey,\r\n'
            '          kChatMediaBatchIdKey,\r\n'
            '          kChatMediaBatchIndexKey,\r\n'
            '        ]) {\r\n'
            '          if (previousDecoded.containsKey(key)) {\r\n'
            '            data[key] = previousDecoded[key];\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    if (data.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      merged.localCustomData = jsonEncode(data);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void assignOutgoingLocalSeq(String conversationID, V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final convID = _safeConversationId(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (convID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final next = (_outgoingLocalSeqByConv[convID] ?? 0) + 1;\r\n'
            '    _outgoingLocalSeqByConv[convID] = next;\r\n'
            '    _writeOutgoingLocalSeq(message, next);\r\n'
            '    _logOutgoingSendOrder(\r\n'
            '      event: \'tap\',\r\n'
            '      convID: convID,\r\n'
            '      message: message,\r\n'
            '      clientId: message.id,\r\n'
            '      mergePath: \'assign_local_seq\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _logOutgoingSendOrder({\r\n'
            '    required String event,\r\n'
            '    required String convID,\r\n'
            '    required V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '    String? clientId,\r\n'
            '    String? mergePath,\r\n'
            '    int? existingIndex,\r\n'
            '    bool? reordered,\r\n'
            '    String? warn,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatJitterDiag.enabled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final list = _messageListMap[convID] ?? const <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final idValue = clientId?.trim().isNotEmpty == true\r\n'
            '        ? clientId!.trim()\r\n'
            '        : (message.id?.trim() ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '    var finalIndex = -1;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final item = list[i];\r\n'
            '      if (msgID.isNotEmpty && item.msgID == msgID) {\r\n'
            '        finalIndex = i;\r\n'
            '        break;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (idValue.isNotEmpty && item.id == idValue) {\r\n'
            '        finalIndex = i;\r\n'
            '        break;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final localSeq = _readOutgoingLocalSeq(message);\r\n'
            '    final existing = existingIndex ?? -1;\r\n'
            '    final reorderFlag = reordered == true;\r\n'
            '    final warnSuffix = warn == null || warn.isEmpty ? \'\' : \' warn=$warn\';\r\n'
            '    debugPrint(\r\n'
            '      \'[IM_SEND_ORDER] event=$event conv=$convID clientId=$idValue msgID=$msgID \'\r\n'
            '      \'tapOrder=$localSeq localSeq=$localSeq serverSeq=${message.seq ?? \'\'} \'\r\n'
            '      \'timestamp=${message.timestamp ?? \'\'} finalIndex=$finalIndex listLen=${list.length} \'\r\n'
            '      \'existingIndex=$existing path=${mergePath ?? \'\'} reordered=$reorderFlag \'\r\n'
            '      \'isSelf=${message.isSelf} random=${message.random}$warnSuffix\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    outputLogger.i(\r\n'
            '      \'[IM_SEND_ORDER] event=$event conv=$convID clientId=$idValue msgID=$msgID \'\r\n'
            '      \'localSeq=$localSeq serverSeq=${message.seq ?? \'\'} ts=${message.timestamp ?? \'\'} \'\r\n'
            '      \'path=${mergePath ?? \'\'} reordered=$reorderFlag warn=${warn ?? \'\'}\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static String? _outgoingCorrelationKey(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Stable id bridges optimistic clientId → SDK create id across swaps.\r\n'
            '    // Prefer it over random/id so dedupe collapses 一图两气泡 pairs.\r\n'
            '    final stableId = readOutgoingStableId(message)?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (stableId != null && stableId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'stable:$stableId:t${message.elemType}\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final random = _outgoingRandomValue(message);\r\n'
            '    if (random != null) {\r\n'
            '      // 带上 elemType，避免不同消息偶发同 random 时文字/图片被并成一条。\r\n'
            '      return \'rand:$random:t${message.elemType}\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'id:$id:t${message.elemType}\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _isClientPlaceholderMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (message.status != MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id;\r\n'
            '    return id != null && id.isNotEmpty;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _isResolvedOutgoingMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // C2C 镜像 dup（对方内容却标 isSelf）不是真实 outgoing ack。\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(message) &&\r\n'
            '        _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(message) < 3) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (msgID == null || msgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty && id == msgID) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return message.status != MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _outgoingMessagesCorrelate(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (a.isSelf != true || b.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 同 random/id 也必须同类型：否则文字占位与图片回执可能被误并。\r\n'
            '    if (a.elemType != b.elemType) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final keyA = _outgoingCorrelationKey(a);\r\n'
            '    final keyB = _outgoingCorrelationKey(b);\r\n'
            '    if (keyA != null && keyB != null && keyA == keyB) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqA = _readOutgoingLocalSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final seqB = _readOutgoingLocalSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    if (seqA != null && seqB != null && seqA == seqB) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Optimistic image keeps a local path; adopt copies it onto the SDK\r\n'
            '    // message. Path equality is a safe bridge when one side is still a\r\n'
            '    // placeholder and random/id have not converged yet.\r\n'
            '    if (a.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE &&\r\n'
            '        (_isClientPlaceholderMessage(a) || _isClientPlaceholderMessage(b))) {\r\n'
            '      final pathA = a.imageElem?.path?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final pathB = b.imageElem?.path?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (pathA.isNotEmpty && pathA == pathB) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_outgoingRandomValue(a) != null || _outgoingRandomValue(b) != null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final placeholder = _isClientPlaceholderMessage(a) ||\r\n'
            '        _isClientPlaceholderMessage(b) ||\r\n'
            '        _isResolvedOutgoingMessage(a) ||\r\n'
            '        _isResolvedOutgoingMessage(b);\r\n'
            '    if (!placeholder) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Never correlate by timestamp alone: same-second sends share timestamp\r\n'
            '    // and would merge acks into the wrong placeholder.\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 存储序列为 newest-first：任一相邻对 chronologically 逆序则需重排。\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static bool isNewestFirstStorageOrderValid(List<V2TimMessage> list) {\r\n'
            '    if (list.length < 2) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < list.length - 1; i++) {\r\n'
            '      if (compareMessagesChronological(list[i], list[i + 1]) < 0) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 秒级 epoch；字段误存毫秒时归一化（Web/归档混源常见）。\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static int normalizeMessageEpochSeconds(int? raw) {\r\n'
            '    if (raw == null || raw <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (raw >= 1000000000000) {\r\n'
            '      return raw ~/ 1000;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return raw;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int messageEpochSecondsForDisplay(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return normalizeMessageEpochSeconds(_messageSortTimestamp(message));\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int _findOutgoingPlaceholderIndex(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> list,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage incoming,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final candidates = <int>[];\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final element = list[i];\r\n'
            '      if (!_isClientPlaceholderMessage(element)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (element.elemType != incoming.elemType) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      candidates.add(i);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (candidates.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return -1;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final incomingStable = readOutgoingStableId(incoming)?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (incomingStable != null && incomingStable.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      for (final i in candidates) {\r\n'
            '        if (readOutgoingStableId(list[i]) == incomingStable) {\r\n'
            '          return i;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (candidates.length == 1) {\r\n'
            '      return candidates.first;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final incomingRandom = _outgoingRandomValue(incoming);\r\n'
            '    if (incomingRandom != null) {\r\n'
            '      for (final i in candidates) {\r\n'
            '        if (list[i].random == incomingRandom) {\r\n'
            '          return i;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final incomingId = incoming.id?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (incomingId != null && incomingId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      for (final i in candidates) {\r\n'
            '        if (list[i].id == incomingId) {\r\n'
            '          return i;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final incomingMsgID = incoming.msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (incomingMsgID != null && incomingMsgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      for (final i in candidates) {\r\n'
            '        if (list[i].msgID?.trim() == incomingMsgID) {\r\n'
            '          return i;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final incomingLocalSeq = _readOutgoingLocalSeq(incoming);\r\n'
            '    if (incomingLocalSeq != null) {\r\n'
            '      for (final i in candidates) {\r\n'
            '        if (_readOutgoingLocalSeq(list[i]) == incomingLocalSeq) {\r\n'
            '          return i;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (incoming.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE) {\r\n'
            '      final path = incoming.imageElem?.path?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (path.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        final pathMatches = <int>[];\r\n'
            '        for (final i in candidates) {\r\n'
            '          if (list[i].imageElem?.path?.trim() == path) {\r\n'
            '            pathMatches.add(i);\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (pathMatches.length == 1) {\r\n'
            '          return pathMatches.first;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (incoming.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND) {\r\n'
            '      final newDuration = incoming.soundElem?.duration;\r\n'
            '      for (final i in candidates) {\r\n'
            '        if (list[i].soundElem?.duration == newDuration) {\r\n'
            '          return i;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Ambiguous when multiple placeholders share type without random/id/msgID.\r\n'
            '    // Orphan-insert + chronological sort is safer than guessing FIFO.\r\n'
            '    return -1;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Binds SDK-assigned [msgID] to a sending placeholder before send completes.\r\n'
            '  void bindOutgoingSyncMsgId(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    String clientId,\r\n'
            '    String msgID,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final id = clientId.trim();\r\n'
            '    final serverMsgID = msgID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (id.isEmpty || serverMsgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final current = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    final index = current.indexWhere(\r\n'
            '      (item) =>\r\n'
            '          item.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '          item.id == id &&\r\n'
            '          (item.msgID == null || item.msgID!.isEmpty || item.msgID == id),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (index < 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final previous = current[index];\r\n'
            '    final updated = _cloneMessage(previous);\r\n'
            '    updated.msgID = serverMsgID;\r\n'
            '    final stableIdentity = readOutgoingStableId(previous) ?? id;\r\n'
            '    final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID: \'send_bind:$id:$serverMsgID\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.optimisticAdoption,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sendPipeline,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        upserts: <MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>>[\r\n'
            '          MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '            value: updated,\r\n'
            '            msgID: updated.msgID,\r\n'
            '            localID: updated.id,\r\n'
            '            outgoingStableID: stableIdentity,\r\n'
            '            seq: updated.seq,\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        ],\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit == null) {\r\n'
            '      // Rejected/stale/active-history binds must not mutate the formal list.\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _chatUiStateStore.bindMessageAlias(\r\n'
            '      storageKey,\r\n'
            '      id,\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(updated),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.rememberAlias(id, serverMsgID);\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowChanged(storageKey, updated, extraKey: id);\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static int findOutgoingPlaceholderIndexForTesting(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> list,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage incoming,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    return _findOutgoingPlaceholderIndex(list, incoming);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static void preserveOutgoingLocalOrderDataForTesting(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage previous,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage merged,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    _preserveOutgoingLocalOrderData(previous, merged);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static int? readOutgoingLocalSeqForTesting(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return _readOutgoingLocalSeq(message);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int findReplaceableOutgoingIndex(\r\n'
            '    String convID,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message, {\r\n'
            '    String? priorTempId,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage>? listOverride,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final list = listOverride ?? _messageListMap[convID] ?? [];\r\n'
            '    if (priorTempId != null && priorTempId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final byTemp = list.indexWhere(\r\n'
            '        (item) => item.id == priorTempId || item.msgID == priorTempId,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (byTemp != -1) {\r\n'
            '        return byTemp;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id;\r\n'
            '    if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final byId = list.indexWhere((item) => item.id == id);\r\n'
            '      if (byId != -1) {\r\n'
            '        return byId;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID;\r\n'
            '    if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final byMsgID = list.indexWhere((item) => item.msgID == msgID);\r\n'
            '      if (byMsgID != -1) {\r\n'
            '        return byMsgID;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _findOutgoingPlaceholderIndex(list, message);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _preserveSoundLocalPath(V2TimMessage? previous, V2TimMessage resolved) {\r\n'
            '    if (previous == null ||\r\n'
            '        previous.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND ||\r\n'
            '        resolved.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prevSound = previous.soundElem;\r\n'
            '    final nextSound = resolved.soundElem;\r\n'
            '    if (prevSound == null || nextSound == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final localPath = prevSound.path ?? prevSound.localUrl;\r\n'
            '    if (localPath == null || localPath.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    nextSound.path = localPath;\r\n'
            '    nextSound.localUrl = prevSound.localUrl ?? localPath;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _preserveImageLocalPath(V2TimMessage? previous, V2TimMessage resolved) {\r\n'
            '    if (previous == null ||\r\n'
            '        previous.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE ||\r\n'
            '        resolved.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prevPath = previous.imageElem?.path;\r\n'
            '    if (prevPath == null || prevPath.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    resolved.imageElem ??= previous.imageElem;\r\n'
            '    resolved.imageElem!.path = prevPath;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _preserveImageDisplaySize(V2TimMessage resolved, String clientId) {\r\n'
            '    if (resolved.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    Size? size = _fileMessageSizeMap[clientId];\r\n'
            '    final msgID = resolved.msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if ((size == null || size.width <= 0 || size.height <= 0) &&\r\n'
            '        msgID != null &&\r\n'
            '        msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      size = _fileMessageSizeMap[msgID];\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (size == null || size.width <= 0 || size.height <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final imageList = resolved.imageElem?.imageList;\r\n'
            '    if (imageList == null || imageList.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final width = size.width.round();\r\n'
            '    final height = size.height.round();\r\n'
            '    for (final image in imageList) {\r\n'
            '      if (image == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      image.width = width;\r\n'
            '      image.height = height;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _migrateFileMessageMetadata(String clientId, String? msgID) {\r\n'
            '    if (clientId.isEmpty || msgID == null || msgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final location = _fileListLocationMap[clientId];\r\n'
            '    if (location != null && location.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _fileListLocationMap.putIfAbsent(msgID, () => location);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final size = _fileMessageSizeMap[clientId];\r\n'
            '    if (size != null) {\r\n'
            '      _fileMessageSizeMap.putIfAbsent(msgID, () => size);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _registerSoundLocalPath(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final localPath = message.soundElem?.path ?? message.soundElem?.localUrl;\r\n'
            '    if (localPath == null || localPath.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID;\r\n'
            '    if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      setFileMessageLocation(msgID, localPath);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final clientId = message.id;\r\n'
            '    if (clientId != null && clientId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      setFileMessageLocation(clientId, localPath);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _messageCorrelatesWithStored(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage stored,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage incoming,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (messagesCorrelateForDedup(stored, incoming)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (incoming.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '        _outgoingMessagesCorrelate(stored, incoming)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  V2TimMessage _mergeMessageAtIndex(\r\n'
            '    String convID,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> list,\r\n'
            '    int index,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage newMsg, {\r\n'
            '    bool replacingPlaceholder = false,\r\n'
            '    bool forceSuccess = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final previous = list[index];\r\n'
            '    final merged = _cloneMessage(newMsg);\r\n'
            '    final isSelf =\r\n'
            '        _isC2cConversationMessage(previous) && _isC2cConversationMessage(newMsg)\r\n'
            '            ? _resolveMergedIsSelf(previous, newMsg)\r\n'
            '            : (previous.isSelf == true || newMsg.isSelf == true);\r\n'
            '    merged.isSelf = isSelf;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      final clientId = previous.id;\r\n'
            '      if (clientId != null && clientId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        merged.id = clientId;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _preserveOutgoingLocalOrderData(previous, merged);\r\n'
            '      if (previous.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND &&\r\n'
            '          merged.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND) {\r\n'
            '        _preserveSoundLocalPath(previous, merged);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (previous.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE &&\r\n'
            '          merged.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE) {\r\n'
            '        _preserveImageLocalPath(previous, merged);\r\n'
            '        final clientId = previous.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        if (clientId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          _preserveImageDisplaySize(merged, clientId);\r\n'
            '          _migrateFileMessageMetadata(clientId, merged.msgID);\r\n'
            '          final layoutSize = readPersistedImageLayoutSize(previous) ??\r\n'
            '              _fileMessageSizeMap[clientId] ??\r\n'
            '              ((merged.msgID?.isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '                  ? _fileMessageSizeMap[merged.msgID!]\r\n'
            '                  : null);\r\n'
            '          if (layoutSize != null) {\r\n'
            '            applyImageLayoutToMessage(merged, layoutSize);\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Echo/history never pass fromFinalSendSuccess. Final send results\r\n'
            '      // write through updateMessage / applyOutgoingSendResult instead.\r\n'
            '      final resolvedStatus = OutgoingSendStatus.mergeSelf(\r\n'
            '        previous: previous.status,\r\n'
            '        incoming: merged.status,\r\n'
            '        fromFinalSendSuccess: false,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      merged.status = resolvedStatus;\r\n'
            '      if (resolvedStatus == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SEND_FAIL) {\r\n'
            '        if (ErrorMessageConverter.getSendFailCode(merged) == null) {\r\n'
            '          final previousCode = ErrorMessageConverter.getSendFailCode(previous);\r\n'
            '          if (previousCode != null) {\r\n'
            '            ErrorMessageConverter.attachSendFailCode(merged, previousCode);\r\n'
            '          } else if ((previous.localCustomData ?? \'\').isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '            merged.localCustomData = previous.localCustomData;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } else if (resolvedStatus == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SEND_SUCC) {\r\n'
            '        ErrorMessageConverter.clearSendFailCode(merged);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else if (merged.status == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING) {\r\n'
            '      merged.status = MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SEND_SUCC;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      _logOutgoingSendOrder(\r\n'
            '        event: \'merge_self\',\r\n'
            '        convID: convID,\r\n'
            '        message: merged,\r\n'
            '        clientId: merged.id,\r\n'
            '        mergePath: replacingPlaceholder ? \'placeholder_merge\' : \'inplace_merge\',\r\n'
            '        existingIndex: index,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return merged;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _applyMergedMessagePresentationSideEffects(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? previous,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    _registerSoundLocalPath(message);\r\n'
            '    if (previous == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final previousKey = ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(previous);\r\n'
            '    _chatUiStateStore.bindMessageAlias(\r\n'
            '      conversationID,\r\n'
            '      previousKey,\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(message),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'

            '\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _sameMessageIdentityList(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Applies a burst without sorting the full conversation once per message.\r\n'

            '          \'${messages.map(messageDedupKey).join(\',\')}\';\r\n'

            '          source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '          generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(convID),\r\n'
            '          clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(convID),\r\n'
            '          upserts: _reconciliationRecords(messages),\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'

            '        return (\r\n'

            '          lastInserted: null,\r\n'

            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'

            '          : const <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'

            '        lastInserted: insertedMessages.isEmpty ? null : insertedMessages.last,\r\n'
            '        insertedMessages: insertedMessages,\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(convID);\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    final before = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    final known = List<V2TimMessage>.of(before);\r\n'
            '    final records = <MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>>[];\r\n'
            '    final previousRecords = <V2TimMessage?>[];\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'

            '      );\r\n'

            '              known,\r\n'
            '              index,\r\n'
            '              message,\r\n'
            '              replacingPlaceholder: replacingPlaceholder,\r\n'
            '              forceSuccess: message.isSelf != true,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'

            '        MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '          value: value,\r\n'
            '          msgID: value.msgID,\r\n'
            '          localID: value.id,\r\n'
            '          outgoingStableID: stableIdentity,\r\n'
            '          seq: value.seq,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'

            '      if (previous == null) {\r\n'
            '        insertedMessages.add(value);\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID: \'realtime:batch:${++_nextRealtimeReconciliationEvent}:\'\r\n'

            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.realtimeUpsert,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'

            '        upserts: records,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit != null) {\r\n'
            '      for (var index = 0; index < records.length; index++) {\r\n'

            '        );\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _stageInboundChunkReveal(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _flushInboundMessageBatch(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldChunkRevealInbound(String convID, List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _drainChunkRevealToBuffer(String convID, List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'

            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _applyInboundMessageBatch(String convID, List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'
            '    if (messages.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final isActiveConversation = _isSameConversationID(\r\n'
            '      convID,\r\n'

            '\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    _syncHistoryPositionFromActiveScroll(convID);\r\n'

            '    final wasAtBottomBeforeKeyboardViewportChange =\r\n'
            '        _wasAtBottomBeforeKeyboardViewportChange(convID);\r\n'
            '    final isActuallyNearBottom = _isActiveChatNearBottom(convID) ||\r\n'
            '        wasAtBottomBeforeKeyboardViewportChange;\r\n'
            '    if (wasAtBottomBeforeKeyboardViewportChange) {\r\n'
            '      _storeHistoryMessagePosition(convID, HistoryMessagePosition.bottom);\r\n'
            '      position = HistoryMessagePosition.bottom;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final isReturningToBottom = isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(convID);\r\n'
            '    final isFollowing = isFollowingLatest(convID) ||\r\n'
            '        wasAtBottomBeforeKeyboardViewportChange;\r\n'
            '    var clearedUnreadState = false;\r\n'
            '    final messagesToUpsert = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      if (message.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '        if (!isFollowing) {\r\n'
            '          final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(convID);\r\n'
            '          final existing = _messageListMap[storageKey];\r\n'
            '          final key = messageDedupKey(message);\r\n'
            '          final alreadyVisible =\r\n'
            '              existing?.any((row) => messageDedupKey(row) == key) == true;\r\n'
            '          if (!alreadyVisible) {\r\n'
            '            continue;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _syncSelfSentMessage(convID, message, forceSuccess: false);\r\n'
            '        listDirty = true;\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      if (!_chatAppForeground) {\r\n'
            '        _bufferIncomingWhileReadingAway(\r\n'
            '          convID,\r\n'
            '          message,\r\n'
            '          route: \'app_background\',\r\n'
            '          position: HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest,\r\n'
            '          isActuallyNearBottom: false,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      if (_shouldDeferIncomingToVisibleList(\r\n'
            '            convID,\r\n'
            '            position: position,\r\n'
            '            isActuallyNearBottom: isActuallyNearBottom,\r\n'
            '          )) {\r\n'
            '        _bufferIncomingWhileReadingAway(\r\n'
            '          convID,\r\n'
            '          message,\r\n'
            '          route: position == HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest\r\n'
            '              ? \'notShowLatest\'\r\n'
            '              : \'awayFromBottom\',\r\n'
            '          position: position,\r\n'
            '          isActuallyNearBottom: isActuallyNearBottom,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      if (isFollowing) {\r\n'
            '        _storeHistoryMessagePosition(convID, HistoryMessagePosition.bottom);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (isFollowing && !clearedUnreadState && lockedEntryUnreadCountFor(convID) == 0) {\r\n'
            '        flushDeferredIncomingMessages(convID, notify: false);\r\n'
            '        clearReceivedUnreadState(conversationID: convID, notify: false);\r\n'
            '        clearedUnreadState = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      messagesToUpsert.add(message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final upsertResult = _upsertIncomingMessageBatch(convID, messagesToUpsert);\r\n'
            '    if (upsertResult.insertedMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _freezeHistoryReadingWindowByConversation[_inboundStateKey(convID)]\r\n'
            '          ?.didAppend?.call(upsertResult.insertedMessages);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!isFollowing) {\r\n'
            '      _recordVisibleLiveIncoming(convID, upsertResult.insertedMessages);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (upsertResult.inserted) {\r\n'
            '      listDirty = true;\r\n'
            '      enterAnimationCandidate = upsertResult.lastInserted;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (listDirty) {\r\n'
            '      _bumpMessageListRevisionFor(convID, reason: \'inbound_batch_active\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (isFollowing && enterAnimationCandidate != null) {\r\n'
            '      _markIncomingMessageEnterAnimation(enterAnimationCandidate);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final isBulk = messages.length >= _bulkMessageSyncThreshold;\r\n'
            '    if (listDirty &&\r\n'
            '        isFollowing &&\r\n'
            '        !_shouldDeferIncomingToVisibleList(\r\n'
            '          convID,\r\n'
            '          position: position,\r\n'
            '          isActuallyNearBottom: isActuallyNearBottom,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      final scrollFollowActive = chatConfig.inboundScrollFollowEnabled &&\r\n'
            '          isChunkedRevealActive(convID);\r\n'
            '      if (isBulk ||\r\n'
            '          isBulkMessageSyncActive(convID) ||\r\n'
            '          isChunkedRevealActive(convID)) {\r\n'
            '        if (!scrollFollowActive) {\r\n'
            '          _pendingPinAfterBulkByConv[convID] = true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        requestPinToBottom(convID);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '      action: \'batch_applied\',\r\n'
            '      conv: convID,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'count\': messages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'upserted\': messagesToUpsert.length,\r\n'
            '        \'listDirty\': listDirty,\r\n'
            '        \'bulk\': isBulk,\r\n'
            '        \'nearBottom\': isActuallyNearBottom,\r\n'
            '        \'bottomLocked\': isInboundPresentationBottomLocked(convID),\r\n'
            '        \'returningToBottom\': isReturningToBottom,\r\n'
            '        \'logicalPosition\': position.name,\r\n'
            '        \'tongueUnread\': unreadCountForTongue,\r\n'
            '        \'buffered\': _inboundUnreadStateFor(\r\n'
            '          convID,\r\n'
            '          create: false,\r\n'
            '        ).bufferedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'queue\': pendingInboundProjectionCount(convID),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '      action: \'inbound_batch\',\r\n'
            '      conv: convID,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'isFollowing\': isFollowing,\r\n'
            '        \'keyboardBottom\': wasAtBottomBeforeKeyboardViewportChange,\r\n'
            '        \'willPin\': listDirty &&\r\n'
            '            isFollowing &&\r\n'
            '            !_shouldDeferIncomingToVisibleList(\r\n'
            '              convID,\r\n'
            '              position: position,\r\n'
            '              isActuallyNearBottom: isActuallyNearBottom,\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '        ...stickToLatestDiagSnapshot(convID),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _recordVisibleLiveIncoming(String convID, List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'
            '    final state = _inboundUnreadStateFor(convID);\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      final id = liveIncomingIdentity(message);\r\n'
            '      // Publication is not a read. Retry and history replay do not create\r\n'
            '      // another reminder; measured visible coverage consumes this ledger.\r\n'
            '      if (message.isSelf == true || id.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '          state.seenLiveIncomingIds.contains(id) ||\r\n'
            '          !state.revealedUnreadMessageIDs.add(id)) continue;\r\n'
            '      state.unreadCount++;\r\n'
            '      state.receivedCount++;\r\n'
            '      _recordBufferedLiveIncoming(state, message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _syncSelfSentMessage(\r\n'
            '    String convID,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage newMsg, {\r\n'
            '    bool forceSuccess = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (newMsg.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (forceSuccess &&\r\n'
            '        (isOutgoingMediaCancelled(newMsg.id) ||\r\n'
            '            isOutgoingMediaCancelled(newMsg.msgID))) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // _upsertIncomingMessage constructs and submits the authoritative delta.\r\n'
            '    // Its null/rejected result is terminal for this callback; there is no\r\n'
            '    // direct-list fallback after a Writer decision.\r\n'
            '    return _upsertIncomingMessage(convID, newMsg, forceSuccess: forceSuccess);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _syncGroupMemberFromMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final groupID = TencentUtils.checkString(message.groupID);\r\n'
            '    final userID = TencentUtils.checkString(message.sender) ??\r\n'
            '        TencentUtils.checkString(message.userID);\r\n'
            '    if (groupID == null || userID == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final nameCard = TencentUtils.checkString(message.nameCard);\r\n'
            '    final nickName = TencentUtils.checkString(message.nickName);\r\n'
            '    final friendRemark = TencentUtils.checkString(message.friendRemark);\r\n'
            '    final faceUrl = TencentUtils.checkString(message.faceUrl);\r\n'
            '    if (nameCard == null &&\r\n'
            '        nickName == null &&\r\n'
            '        friendRemark == null &&\r\n'
            '        faceUrl == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final current = GroupMemberStore.instance.memberOf(groupID, userID);\r\n'
            '    if (current == null) {\r\n'
            '      GroupMemberStore.instance.putMember(\r\n'
            '        groupID,\r\n'
            '        V2TimGroupMemberFullInfo(\r\n'
            '          userID: userID,\r\n'
            '          nameCard: nameCard,\r\n'
            '          nickName: nickName,\r\n'
            '          friendRemark: friendRemark,\r\n'
            '          faceUrl: faceUrl,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    var changed = false;\r\n'
            '    if (nameCard != null && current.nameCard != nameCard) {\r\n'
            '      current.nameCard = nameCard;\r\n'
            '      changed = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (nickName != null && current.nickName != nickName) {\r\n'
            '      current.nickName = nickName;\r\n'
            '      changed = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (friendRemark != null && current.friendRemark != friendRemark) {\r\n'
            '      current.friendRemark = friendRemark;\r\n'
            '      changed = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (faceUrl != null && current.faceUrl != faceUrl) {\r\n'
            '      current.faceUrl = faceUrl;\r\n'
            '      changed = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (changed) {\r\n'
            '      GroupMemberStore.instance.putMember(groupID, current);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _onReceiveNewMsg(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage msgComing, {\r\n'
            '    String? ingressEventID,\r\n'
            '    int? ingressSequence,\r\n'
            '    bool projectMessageList = true,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final lifecycleGeneration = _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final writerScope = _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope;\r\n'
            '    final initialConvID = _messageConversationID(msgComing);\r\n'
            '    if (initialConvID == null || initialConvID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final capturedClearEpoch = messageDeltaClearEpochFor(initialConvID);\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? mountedMessage = msgComing;\r\n'
            '    if (_lifeCycle?.newMessageWillMount != null) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        mountedMessage = await _lifeCycle!.newMessageWillMount(msgComing);\r\n'
            '      } catch (e) {\r\n'
            '        outputLogger.i(\'newMessageWillMount error: $e\');\r\n'
            '        mountedMessage = msgComing;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_isMessageLifecycleCurrent(lifecycleGeneration) ||\r\n'
            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != writerScope ||\r\n'
            '        messageDeltaClearEpochFor(initialConvID) != capturedClearEpoch) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '        \'message_inbound_drop_stale_lifecycle\',\r\n'
            '        conv: initialConvID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'generation\': lifecycleGeneration,\r\n'
            '          \'currentGeneration\': _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (mountedMessage == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    mountedMessage = _normalizeInboundC2cDirection(mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final rawConvID = _messageConversationID(mountedMessage) ?? initialConvID;\r\n'
            '    final convID = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(rawConvID);\r\n'
            '    _syncGroupMemberFromMessage(mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '    final senderId = TencentUtils.checkString(mountedMessage.sender) ??\r\n'
            '        TencentUtils.checkString(mountedMessage.userID);\r\n'
            '    if (mountedMessage.isSelf != true && senderId != null) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(\r\n'
            '        UserProfileLocalBridge.upsertPublicProfileFromSnapshot(\r\n'
            '          userId: senderId,\r\n'
            '          nickName: mountedMessage.nickName,\r\n'
            '          faceUrl: mountedMessage.faceUrl,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // Typing/status custom messages should update typing state only. They must not\r\n'
            '    // enter the visible message list, but they also must not stop normal message\r\n'
            '    // events in other conversations.\r\n'
            '    final bool isEditMessage = _editStatusCheck(mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '    if (isEditMessage) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (!projectMessageList) {\r\n'
            '      if (HistoryWindowRepositoryProvider.repository != null) {\r\n'
            '        await _admitBoundedHistoryIncoming(\r\n'
            '          mountedMessage,\r\n'
            '          eventID: ingressEventID,\r\n'
            '          ingressSequence: ingressSequence,\r\n'
            '          allowLatestReveal: false,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (!_isSameConversationID(convID, currentSelectedConv) &&\r\n'
            '        !_messageListMap.containsKey(convID)) {\r\n'
            '      // Notifications and business signaling run outside this display model.\r\n'
            '      // Opening this conversation will read the SDK\'s persisted recent page.\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (HistoryWindowRepositoryProvider.repository != null &&\r\n'
            '        await _admitBoundedHistoryIncoming(mountedMessage,\r\n'
            '            eventID: ingressEventID, ingressSequence: ingressSequence)) return;\r\n'
            '    if (!_isMessageLifecycleCurrent(lifecycleGeneration) ||\r\n'
            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != writerScope) return;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _checkFromUserisActive(mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '    final convType = TencentUtils.checkString(mountedMessage.groupID) != null\r\n'
            '        ? ConvType.group\r\n'
            '        : ConvType.c2c;\r\n'
            '    final isActiveConversation = _isSameConversationID(\r\n'
            '      convID,\r\n'
            '      currentSelectedConv,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (isActiveConversation &&\r\n'
            '        chatConfig.isAutoReportRead &&\r\n'
            '        lockedEntryUnreadCountFor(convID) == 0) {\r\n'
            '      _scheduleActiveReadReport(convID: convID, convType: convType);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // Self-sent sync on the active chat must stay immediate for send UX.\r\n'
            '    if (isActiveConversation && mountedMessage.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '      _syncSelfSentMessage(convID, mountedMessage, forceSuccess: false);\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // Group seq gap detection: if the reorder buffer is active for this\r\n'
            '    // conversation, route through it so out-of-order messages are buffered\r\n'
            '    // and missing messages trigger a cloud catch-up. C2C seq has no global\r\n'
            '    // continuity so the buffer is never active for C2C.\r\n'
            '    final buffer = _reorderBuffersByConv[convID];\r\n'
            '    if (buffer != null && buffer.isActivated && convType == ConvType.group) {\r\n'
            '      final result = buffer.accept(mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '      if (result == null) {\r\n'
            '        // Buffered: out-of-order or gap detected, will be flushed later.\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (result.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        // Duplicate (seq <= expected), silently dropped.\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Contiguous: upsert immediately (may include drained buffer messages).\r\n'
            '      for (final msg in result) {\r\n'
            '        _inboundBatchCoalescer.enqueue(convID, msg);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _inboundBatchCoalescer.enqueue(convID, mountedMessage);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _revokedCloudCustomData(String? raw, bool isAdmin) {\r\n'
            '    final data = <String, dynamic>{};\r\n'
            '    final source = raw?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (source != null && source.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final decoded = jsonDecode(source);\r\n'
            '        if (decoded is Map) {\r\n'
            '          data.addAll(Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded));\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        // Keep the original message render stable even when old custom data is invalid.\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    data[\'isRevoke\'] = true;\r\n'
            '    data[\'revokeByAdmin\'] = isAdmin;\r\n'
            '    return jsonEncode(data);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _addRevokeLookupKey(List<String> keys, String? key) {\r\n'
            '    final value = key?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (value == null || value.isEmpty || keys.contains(value)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    keys.add(value);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (value.startsWith(\'c2c_\')) {\r\n'
            '      final pure = value.substring(4);\r\n'
            '      if (pure.isNotEmpty && !keys.contains(pure)) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(pure);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else if (value.startsWith(\'C2C\')) {\r\n'
            '      final pure = value.substring(3);\r\n'
            '      if (pure.isNotEmpty && !keys.contains(pure)) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(pure);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else if (!value.startsWith(\'group_\') && !value.startsWith(\'GROUP\')) {\r\n'
            '      final c2cKey = \'c2c_$value\';\r\n'
            '      if (!keys.contains(c2cKey)) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(c2cKey);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (value.startsWith(\'group_\')) {\r\n'
            '      final pure = value.substring(6);\r\n'
            '      if (pure.isNotEmpty && !keys.contains(pure)) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(pure);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else if (value.startsWith(\'GROUP\')) {\r\n'
            '      final pure = value.substring(5);\r\n'
            '      if (pure.isNotEmpty && !keys.contains(pure)) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(pure);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _clearRevokedInboundPresentation(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    String msgID, {\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? revokedMessage,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final target = msgID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (target.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final stateKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final state = _inboundUnreadStateFor(stateKey, create: false);\r\n'
            '    final dedupKeys = <String>{\r\n'
            '      \'msg:$target\',\r\n'
            '      if (revokedMessage != null) messageDedupKey(revokedMessage),\r\n'
            '    };\r\n'
            '    state.bufferedMessages.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (message) =>\r\n'
            '          message.msgID == target ||\r\n'
            '          dedupKeys.contains(messageDedupKey(message)),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    bool matchesTarget(String value) {\r\n'
            '      return dedupKeys.contains(value) ||\r\n'
            '          value == target ||\r\n'
            '          value.endsWith(\':$target\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    state.bufferedMessageKeys.removeWhere(matchesTarget);\r\n'
            '    _inboundFastForwardMessageKeys.removeWhere(matchesTarget);\r\n'
            '    final deferredPrefix = \'$stateKey|\';\r\n'
            '    _authoritativeDeferredIncomingKeys.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '      (value) =>\r\n'
            '          value.startsWith(deferredPrefix) &&\r\n'
            '          matchesTarget(value.substring(deferredPrefix.length)),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (revokedMessage != null) {\r\n'
            '      _revealDeferredProjectionAcrossAliases(conversationID, <V2TimMessage>[\r\n'
            '        revokedMessage,\r\n'
            '      ]);\r\n'
            '      _chatUiStateStore.markMessageChanged(\r\n'
            '        conversationID,\r\n'
            '        ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(revokedMessage),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool markMessageRevokedNow(\r\n'
            '    String msgID, {\r\n'
            '    String? convID,\r\n'
            '    bool isAdmin = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final targetMsgID = msgID.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (targetMsgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>[];\r\n'
            '    _addRevokeLookupKey(keys, convID);\r\n'
            '    _addRevokeLookupKey(keys, currentSelectedConv);\r\n'
            '    for (final key in _messageListMap.keys) {\r\n'
            '      _addRevokeLookupKey(keys, key);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    var didUpdate = false;\r\n'
            '    final visitedStorageKeys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    for (final key in keys) {\r\n'
            '      final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(key);\r\n'
            '      if (storageKey.isEmpty || !visitedStorageKeys.add(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final activeMessageList = _messageListMap[storageKey];\r\n'
            '      if (activeMessageList == null || activeMessageList.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        // Keep the revoke authority even when the row is outside the current\r\n'
            '        // memory window. A later older-page response must not resurrect it.\r\n'
            '        final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '          MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '            conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '            eventID: \'revoke_tombstone:$targetMsgID:$storageKey\',\r\n'
            '            kind: MessageDeltaKind.revoke,\r\n'
            '            source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '            generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '            clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '            tombstones: <String>{targetMsgID},\r\n'

            '          didUpdate = true;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '      final target = activeMessageList.cast<V2TimMessage?>().firstWhere(\r\n'
            '            (item) => item?.msgID == targetMsgID,\r\n'
            '            orElse: () => null,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '      if (target != null) {\r\n'
            '        final revoked = _cloneMessage(target);\r\n'
            '        revoked.status = MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_LOCAL_REVOKED;\r\n'
            '        revoked.cloudCustomData = _revokedCloudCustomData(\r\n'
            '          revoked.cloudCustomData,\r\n'
            '          isAdmin,\r\n'

            '        revoked.id ??= revoked.msgID;\r\n'
            '        final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '          MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'

            '            kind: MessageDeltaKind.revoke,\r\n'
            '            source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '            generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '            clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '            upserts: [messageDeltaRecord(revoked)],\r\n'

            '          forcePublishForRevoke: true,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (commit != null) {\r\n'
            '          _clearRevokedInboundPresentation(\r\n'
            '            storageKey,\r\n'
            '            targetMsgID,\r\n'

            '          );\r\n'

            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      // A row may be outside this memory window or may already have been\r\n'
            '      // projected away. The tombstone is still authoritative and is the only\r\n'
            '      // accepted fallback; never mutate the formal list directly here.\r\n'
            '      final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '        MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '          conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '          eventID:\r\n'
            '              \'revoke_tombstone:$targetMsgID:$storageKey:${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}\',\r\n'
            '          kind: MessageDeltaKind.revoke,\r\n'
            '          source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '          generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '          clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '          tombstones: <String>{targetMsgID},\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '        forcePublishForRevoke: true,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (commit != null) {\r\n'
            '        _clearRevokedInboundPresentation(storageKey, targetMsgID);\r\n'
            '        didUpdate = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // The recalled row may already be outside the in-memory chat window while\r\n'
            '    // still present in the short gallery cache. Invalidate by server identity\r\n'
            '    // even when no visible row was updated, and across alias conversation keys.\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    if (didUpdate) {\r\n'
            '      // Revoke is a user-visible command. Refresh immediately like WeChat instead\r\n'
            '      // of waiting for the next route switch/history reload.\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> onMessageRevoked(String msgID, [String? convID]) async {\r\n'

            '  void markMessageChangedByMessage(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Commits media metadata that arrived after a history row was mounted.\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// URL resolution usually mutates the SDK message object in place. A cloud\r\n'
            '  /// reconciliation can instead have cloned that row, so update the\r\n'
            '  /// authoritative row when identity matches and then use the existing\r\n'
            '  /// row-level revision channel. This keeps late media enrichment from\r\n'
            '  /// rebuilding or resorting the whole message window.\r\n'
            '  void mergeMessageMediaMetadata(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage resolved, {\r\n'
            '    String? conversationID,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final msgID = resolved.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final clientID = resolved.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.isEmpty && clientID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final explicitConversation = conversationID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    String inferredConversation = explicitConversation;\r\n'
            '    if (inferredConversation.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      inferredConversation = resolved.userID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (inferredConversation.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      inferredConversation = resolved.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (inferredConversation.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final dynamic nativeMessage = resolved;\r\n'
            '        inferredConversation =\r\n'
            '            nativeMessage.messageConvID?.toString().trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // Explicit context is authoritative. Without it, userID/groupID is only\r\n'
            '    // a preference because self-sent C2C rows may carry the login user ID.\r\n'
            '    final allEntries = _messageListMap.entries.toList(growable: true);\r\n'
            '    final entries = explicitConversation.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? allEntries\r\n'
            '            .where(\r\n'
            '              (entry) => _isSameConversationID(entry.key, explicitConversation),\r\n'
            '            )\r\n'
            '            .toList(growable: true)\r\n'
            '        : allEntries.toList(growable: true);\r\n'
            '    if (explicitConversation.isEmpty && inferredConversation.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      entries.sort((left, right) {\r\n'
            '        final leftMatches = _isSameConversationID(\r\n'
            '          left.key,\r\n'
            '          inferredConversation,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        final rightMatches = _isSameConversationID(\r\n'
            '          right.key,\r\n'
            '          inferredConversation,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (leftMatches == rightMatches) {\r\n'
            '          return 0;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return leftMatches ? -1 : 1;\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final visitedStorageKeys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    var changed = false;\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in entries) {\r\n'
            '      final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(entry.key);\r\n'
            '      if (!visitedStorageKeys.add(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final current = _messageListMap[storageKey];\r\n'
            '      if (current == null || current.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final index = current.indexWhere(\r\n'
            '        (candidate) =>\r\n'
            '            (msgID.isNotEmpty && candidate.msgID == msgID) ||\r\n'
            '            (clientID.isNotEmpty && candidate.id == clientID),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (index < 0) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final existing = current[index];\r\n'
            '      if (identical(existing, resolved)) {\r\n'
            '        _messageListDisplayCache.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '          (key, _) => _isSameConversationID(key, storageKey),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        _markMessageRowChanged(\r\n'
            '          storageKey,\r\n'
            '          existing,\r\n'
            '          extraKey: msgID.isNotEmpty ? msgID : clientID,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        changed = true;\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final replacement = _cloneMessage(existing);\r\n'
            '      if (resolved.imageElem != null) {\r\n'
            '        replacement.imageElem = resolved.imageElem;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (resolved.videoElem != null) {\r\n'
            '        replacement.videoElem = resolved.videoElem;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (replacement.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_NONE &&\r\n'
            '          resolved.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_NONE) {\r\n'
            '        replacement.elemType = resolved.elemType;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final result = replaceMessageRowLocal(\r\n'
            '        conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        index: index,\r\n'
            '        expected: existing,\r\n'
            '        replacement: replacement,\r\n'
            '        aliases: <String?>[msgID, clientID],\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (result == RowLocalMessageReplacementResult.replaced) {\r\n'
            '        _messageListDisplayCache.removeWhere(\r\n'
            '          (key, _) => _isSameConversationID(key, storageKey),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        changed = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // A metadata response may finish before the matching history window is\r\n'
            '    // committed. The row-level invalidation is harmless and lets a later\r\n'
            '    // alias-aware lookup rebuild the row as soon as it exists.\r\n'
            '    if (!changed && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      markMessageRowsChangedByMsgIDs(<String?>[msgID]);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> onMessageModified(V2TimMessage modifiedMessage,\r\n'
            '      [String? convID]) async {\r\n'
            '    if (HistoryWindowRepositoryProvider.repository != null) {\r\n'
            '      await recordHistoryWindowMutation(\r\n'
            '          conversationID: convID ?? _messageConversationID(modifiedMessage),\r\n'
            '          msgID: modifiedMessage.msgID ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '          kind: HistoryWindowMutationKind.edit,\r\n'
            '          message: modifiedMessage);\r\n'
