            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _applyMessageModifiedNow(V2TimMessage modifiedMessage,\r\n'
            '      [String? convID]) async {\r\n'
            '    final lifecycleGeneration = _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final writerScope = _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope;\r\n'
            '    final String? exactId = TencentUtils.checkString(modifiedMessage.userID) ??\r\n'
            '        TencentUtils.checkString(modifiedMessage.groupID);\r\n'
            '    final rawConvID = convID ?? exactId;\r\n'
            '    if (rawConvID == null || rawConvID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final resolvedConvID = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(rawConvID);\r\n'
            '    if (resolvedConvID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final capturedClearEpoch = messageDeltaClearEpochFor(resolvedConvID);\r\n'
            '    if (modifiedMessage.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '      if (!_shouldProjectHistoryWindowEdit(resolvedConvID, modifiedMessage))\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      final applied = _syncSelfSentMessage(\r\n'
            '        resolvedConvID,\r\n'
            '        modifiedMessage,\r\n'
            '        forceSuccess: false,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (applied) {\r\n'
            '        _chatUiStateStore.markMessageChangedByMessage(\r\n'
            '          resolvedConvID,\r\n'
            '          modifiedMessage,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final V2TimMessage newMsg =\r\n'
            '        await _lifeCycle?.modifiedMessageWillMount(modifiedMessage) ??\r\n'
            '            modifiedMessage;\r\n'
            '    if (!_isMessageLifecycleCurrent(lifecycleGeneration) ||\r\n'
            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.configuredScope != writerScope ||\r\n'
            '        messageDeltaClearEpochFor(resolvedConvID) != capturedClearEpoch) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '        \'message_modified_drop_stale_lifecycle\',\r\n'
            '        conv: resolvedConvID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'generation\': lifecycleGeneration,\r\n'
            '          \'currentGeneration\': _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_shouldProjectHistoryWindowEdit(resolvedConvID, newMsg)) return;\r\n'
            '    if (newMsg.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      final msgID = newMsg.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final clientId = newMsg.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final editCommit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '        MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '          conversationKey: resolvedConvID,\r\n'
            '          eventID: \'edit:${msgID.isNotEmpty ? msgID : clientId}:\'\r\n'
            '              \'${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}\',\r\n'
            '          kind: MessageDeltaKind.edit,\r\n'
            '          source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '          generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(resolvedConvID),\r\n'
            '          clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(resolvedConvID),\r\n'
            '          upserts: [messageDeltaRecord(newMsg)],\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      // The row may be outside the current memory window. The delta still\r\n'
            '      // needs to be remembered as an authoritative overlay so an older page\r\n'
            '      // cannot resurrect stale content. While history is in flight the delta\r\n'
            '      // is queued and must not be applied through the legacy direct writer.\r\n'
            '      if (editCommit != null ||\r\n'
            '          _messageReconciliationWriter.hasActiveRequest(resolvedConvID)) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // A null commit means the writer rejected a stale/duplicate/tombstoned\r\n'
            '      // edit. Never fall back to a direct list mutation in that case, or a\r\n'
            '      // deleted row could be reintroduced outside the authoritative state.\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (newMsg.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '      // A lifecycle hook may turn an inbound model into a self message. It\r\n'
            '      // still follows the same send/adoption Writer boundary as the normal\r\n'
            '      // self branch above.\r\n'
            '      final applied = _syncSelfSentMessage(\r\n'
            '        resolvedConvID,\r\n'
            '        newMsg,\r\n'
            '        forceSuccess: false,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (applied) {\r\n'
            '        _chatUiStateStore.markMessageChangedByMessage(resolvedConvID, newMsg);\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  _onReceiveC2CReadReceipt(List<V2TimMessageReceipt> receiptList) {\r\n'
            '    var changed = false;\r\n'
            '    final peerReadConvIds = <String, int>{};\r\n'
            '    // Scan a peer\'s window once for the entire SDK watermark batch.\r\n'
            '    final latestByPeer = <String, V2TimMessageReceipt>{};\r\n'
            '    final wildcardPeers = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    for (final receipt in receiptList) {\r\n'
            '      final peerKey = _normalizeC2CKey(receipt.userID).toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '      if (peerKey.isEmpty) continue;\r\n'
            '      final readAt = _receiptTimestamp(receipt.timestamp);\r\n'
            '      if (readAt <= 0) wildcardPeers.add(peerKey);\r\n'
            '      final previous = latestByPeer[peerKey];\r\n'
            '      if (previous == null || readAt > _receiptTimestamp(previous.timestamp)) {\r\n'
            '        latestByPeer[peerKey] = receipt;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final receipt in latestByPeer.values) {\r\n'
            '      final peerID = receipt.userID.trim();\r\n'
            '      if (peerID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final readAt = _receiptTimestamp(receipt.timestamp);\r\n'
            '      final peerKey = _normalizeC2CKey(peerID).toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '      if (readAt > (_c2cPeerReadTimestampMap[peerKey] ?? 0)) {\r\n'
            '        _c2cPeerReadTimestampMap[peerKey] = readAt;\r\n'
            '        changed = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final normalizedPeer = _normalizeC2CKey(peerID);\r\n'
            '      if (normalizedPeer.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        peerReadConvIds[\'c2c_$normalizedPeer\'] = readAt;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final visitedConversationKeys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '      for (final entry in _messageListMap.entries.toList()) {\r\n'
            '        if (!_isC2CConversationForPeer(entry.key, peerID)) {\r\n'
            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(entry.key);\r\n'
            '        if (storageKey.isEmpty || !visitedConversationKeys.add(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        peerReadConvIds[storageKey] = readAt;\r\n'
            '        final list = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'
            '        if (list.isEmpty) continue;\r\n'
            '        var convChanged = false;\r\n'
            '        final changedKeys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '        final updated = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '        for (final element in list) {\r\n'
            '          final isSelf = element.isSelf ?? true;\r\n'
            '          final timestamp = element.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '          final shouldMarkRead = isSelf &&\r\n'
            '              element.isPeerRead != true &&\r\n'
            '              (wildcardPeers.contains(peerKey) ||\r\n'
            '                  timestamp <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '                  timestamp <= readAt);\r\n'
            '          if (shouldMarkRead) {\r\n'
            '            final msgID = element.msgID;\r\n'
            '            if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '              changedKeys.add(msgID);\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            changedKeys.add(ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(element));\r\n'
            '            convChanged = true;\r\n'
            '            final next = _cloneMessage(element);\r\n'
            '            next.isPeerRead = true;\r\n'
            '            updated.add(next);\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (convChanged) {\r\n'
            '          final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '            MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '              conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '              eventID: \'read_receipt:c2c:$peerID:$readAt:\'\r\n'
            '                  \'${wildcardPeers.contains(peerKey) ? \'all\' : \'through\'}\',\r\n'
            '              kind: MessageDeltaKind.readReceipt,\r\n'
            '              source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '              generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '              clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '              upserts: _reconciliationRecords(updated),\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          if (commit != null) {\r\n'
            '            for (final element in updated) {\r\n'
            '              if (element.isSelf == true && element.isPeerRead == true) {\r\n'
            '                final msgID = element.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '                if (msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '                  _messageReadReceiptMap[msgID] = V2TimMessageReceipt(\r\n'
            '                    userID: peerID,\r\n'
            '                    timestamp: readAt,\r\n'
            '                    msgID: msgID,\r\n'
            '                    isPeerRead: true,\r\n'
            '                  );\r\n'
            '                }\r\n'
            '              }\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            _chatUiStateStore.markMessagesChanged(storageKey, changedKeys);\r\n'
            '            changed = true;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in peerReadConvIds.entries) {\r\n'
            '      ConversationPeerReadCoordinator.scheduleNotify(\r\n'
            '        conversationID: entry.key,\r\n'
            '        peerReadAtSec: entry.value,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (changed) {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  _onReceiveMessageReadReceipts(List<V2TimMessageReceipt> receiptList) {\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      var changed = false;\r\n'
            '      final latestByID = <String, V2TimMessageReceipt>{};\r\n'
            '      for (final receipt in receiptList) {\r\n'
            '        final id = receipt.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        if (id.isNotEmpty) latestByID[id] = receipt;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final changedIDs = <String>{};\r\n'
            '      for (var receipt in latestByID.values) {\r\n'
            '        final msgID = receipt.msgID;\r\n'
            '        if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          // Some SDK versions report a fully-read receipt as\r\n'
            '          // unreadCount=0/readCount>0 while leaving isPeerRead=false.\r\n'
            '          // Normalize that combination so the chat message model and the\r\n'
            '          // conversation-list projection use the same read decision.\r\n'
            '          final fullyRead = receipt.isPeerRead == true ||\r\n'
            '              (receipt.unreadCount != null &&\r\n'
            '                  receipt.unreadCount == 0 &&\r\n'
            '                  (receipt.readCount ?? 0) > 0);\r\n'
            '          final next = V2TimMessageReceipt(\r\n'
            '            userID: receipt.userID,\r\n'
            '            timestamp: _receiptTimestamp(receipt.timestamp),\r\n'
            '            msgID: msgID,\r\n'
            '            isPeerRead: fullyRead,\r\n'
            '            readCount: receipt.readCount,\r\n'
            '            unreadCount: receipt.unreadCount,\r\n'
            '            groupID: receipt.groupID,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          final previous = _messageReadReceiptMap[msgID];\r\n'
            '          if (previous?.isPeerRead != next.isPeerRead ||\r\n'
            '              previous?.timestamp != next.timestamp ||\r\n'
            '              previous?.readCount != next.readCount ||\r\n'
            '              previous?.unreadCount != next.unreadCount) {\r\n'
            '            _messageReadReceiptMap[msgID] = next;\r\n'
            '            changedIDs.add(msgID);\r\n'
            '            changed = true;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          if (_isReceiptFullyRead(next)) {\r\n'
            '            final convId = _conversationIdForReadReceipt(next);\r\n'
            '            if (convId != null && convId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '              ConversationPeerReadCoordinator.scheduleNotify(\r\n'
            '                conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '                msgID: msgID,\r\n'
            '                peerReadAtSec: next.timestamp,\r\n'
            '              );\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (changed) {\r\n'
            '        for (final msgID in changedIDs) {\r\n'
            '          _markMessageRowsChangedByMsgID(msgID);\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } catch (e) {}\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isReceiptFullyRead(V2TimMessageReceipt receipt) {\r\n'
            '    if (receipt.isPeerRead == true) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final unread = receipt.unreadCount;\r\n'
            '    final read = receipt.readCount ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    return unread != null && unread == 0 && read > 0;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String? _conversationIdForReadReceipt(V2TimMessageReceipt receipt) {\r\n'
            '    final group = receipt.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (group.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return group.startsWith(\'group_\') ? group : \'group_$group\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = receipt.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final matches = _messageListMap.find(msgID);\r\n'
            '      if (matches.isNotEmpty) return matches.first.key;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final peer = _normalizeC2CKey(receipt.userID);\r\n'
            '    if (peer.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  _onSendMessageProgress(V2TimMessage message, int progress) {\r\n'
            '    final rawConvID = _messageConversationID(message) ??\r\n'
            '        TencentUtils.checkString(message.userID) ??\r\n'
            '        message.groupID;\r\n'
            '    if (rawConvID == null || rawConvID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convID = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(rawConvID);\r\n'
            '    if (convID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID;\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id;\r\n'
            '    if (isOutgoingMediaCancelled(id) || isOutgoingMediaCancelled(msgID)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final progressClamped = progress.clamp(0, 100);\r\n'
            '    if (progressClamped > 0 && progressClamped < 100) {\r\n'
            '      // SDKs can repeat an integer percentage or deliver an older callback.\r\n'
            '      // Keep the row stable until progress actually advances; terminal status\r\n'
            '      // must still be reconciled even when its percentage has not changed.\r\n'
            '      final knownProgress = max(\r\n'
            '        getMessageProgress(msgID ?? \'\'),\r\n'
            '        getMessageProgress(id ?? \'\'),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (progressClamped <= knownProgress &&\r\n'
            '          message.status != MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SEND_SUCC) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        _setUploadProgressSilently(msgID, progressClamped);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        _setUploadProgressSilently(id, progressClamped);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _markMessageRowChangedByIds(convID, msgID: msgID, clientId: id);\r\n'
            '    } else if (progressClamped >= 100) {\r\n'
            '      if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        _clearUploadProgressSilently(msgID);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        _clearUploadProgressSilently(id);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _markMessageRowChangedByIds(convID, msgID: msgID, clientId: id);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> onMessageDownloadProgressCallback(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessageDownloadProgress messageProgress, {\r\n'
            '    bool Function()? isCurrent,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (isCurrent?.call() == false) return;\r\n'
            '    final currentProgress = getMessageProgress(messageProgress.msgID);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (messageProgress.isError || messageProgress.errorCode != 0) {\r\n'
            '      V2TimMessage? message = await _findAndRetrieveMessage(\r\n'
            '        messageProgress.msgID,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (isCurrent?.call() == false) return;\r\n'
            '      _handleDownloadError(messageProgress, message);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (messageProgress.isFinish && currentProgress < 100) {\r\n'
            '      V2TimMessage? message = await _findAndRetrieveMessage(\r\n'
            '        messageProgress.msgID,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (isCurrent?.call() == false) return;\r\n'
            '      _handleFinishedDownload(messageProgress, message, isCurrent: isCurrent);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _updateProgressIfNeeded(messageProgress, currentProgress);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<V2TimMessage?> _findAndRetrieveMessage(String messageId) async {\r\n'
            '    final messages = await _messageService.findMessages(\r\n'
            '      messageIDList: [messageId],\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return messages == null || messages.isEmpty ? null : messages.first;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _handleFinishedDownload(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessageDownloadProgress messageProgress,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? message, {\r\n'
            '    bool Function()? isCurrent,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (message != null) {\r\n'
            '      bool isImageType =\r\n'
            '          message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE;\r\n'
            '      bool isVideoType =\r\n'
            '          message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_VIDEO;\r\n'
            '      const originalImageType = 0;\r\n'
            '      if (!isImageType && !isVideoType) {\r\n'
            '        _updateMessageLocationAndDownloadFile(messageProgress);\r\n'
            '      } else if ((isImageType && messageProgress.type == originalImageType) ||\r\n'
            '          (isVideoType && !messageProgress.isSnapshot)) {\r\n'
            '        Future.delayed(\r\n'
            '          const Duration(seconds: 1),\r\n'
            '          () {\r\n'
            '            if (isCurrent?.call() == false) return;\r\n'
            '            _updateMessageAndDownloadFile(message, messageProgress);\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      _updateMessageLocationAndDownloadFile(messageProgress);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _handleDownloadError(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessageDownloadProgress messageProgress,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? message,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    setMessageProgress(messageProgress.msgID, 0);\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowsChangedByMsgID(messageProgress.msgID);\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    downloadFile();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _updateMessageAndDownloadFile(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessageDownloadProgress messageProgress,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    updateAsyncMessage(\r\n'
            '      message,\r\n'
            '      TencentUtils.checkString(message.userID) ??\r\n'
            '          TencentUtils.checkString(message.groupID) ??\r\n'
            '          "",\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _updateMessageLocationAndDownloadFile(messageProgress);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _updateMessageLocationAndDownloadFile(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessageDownloadProgress messageProgress,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    setFileMessageLocation(messageProgress.msgID, messageProgress.path);\r\n'
            '    setMessageProgress(messageProgress.msgID, 100);\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowsChangedByMsgID(messageProgress.msgID);\r\n'
            '    _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    downloadFile();\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _updateProgressIfNeeded(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessageDownloadProgress messageProgress,\r\n'
            '    int currentProgress,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      if (messageProgress.totalSize != -1 && !messageProgress.isFinish) {\r\n'
            '        int progress = min(\r\n'
            '          99,\r\n'
            '          (messageProgress.currentSize / messageProgress.totalSize * 100)\r\n'
            '              .floor(),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (progress > 1 && progress > currentProgress) {\r\n'
            '          setMessageProgress(messageProgress.msgID, progress);\r\n'
            '          _markMessageRowsChangedByMsgID(messageProgress.msgID);\r\n'
            '          _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } catch (e) {\r\n'
            '      outputLogger.i("calculate error: ${messageProgress.toJson()}");\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '  void _scheduleActiveReadReport({\r\n'

            '    final lifecycleGeneration = _messageHistoryCoverageSessionGeneration;\r\n'

            '    if (normalizedConvID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (convType == ConvType.c2c) {\r\n'
            '      final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '      final last = _lastActiveReadReportAtMs[normalizedConvID] ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      final elapsed = now - last;\r\n'
            '      final delayMs = elapsed >= _activeReadReportMinIntervalMs\r\n'
            '          ? _activeReadReportDebounceMs\r\n'
            '          : _activeReadReportMinIntervalMs - elapsed;\r\n'
            '      _activeReadReportDebounceMap[normalizedConvID]?.cancel();\r\n'
            '      _activeReadReportDebounceMap[normalizedConvID] = Timer(\r\n'
            '        Duration(milliseconds: delayMs),\r\n'
            '        () async {\r\n'
            '          _activeReadReportDebounceMap.remove(normalizedConvID);\r\n'
            '          if (!_isMessageLifecycleCurrent(lifecycleGeneration) ||\r\n'
            '              !_isSameConversationID(normalizedConvID, currentSelectedConv)) {\r\n'
            '            ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '              \'active_read_report_skip\',\r\n'
            '              conv: normalizedConvID,\r\n'
            '              extras: const <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '                \'reason\': \'lifecycle_or_conversation_changed\',\r\n'
            '              },\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          if (_isSameConversationID(normalizedConvID, currentSelectedConv)) {\r\n'
            '            await markMessageAsRead(\r\n'
            '              convID: normalizedConvID,\r\n'
            '              convType: convType,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            if (_isMessageLifecycleCurrent(lifecycleGeneration) &&\r\n'
            '                _isSameConversationID(normalizedConvID, currentSelectedConv)) {\r\n'
            '              _lastActiveReadReportAtMs[normalizedConvID] =\r\n'
            '                  DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '        \'active_read_report_scheduled\',\r\n'
            '        conv: normalizedConvID,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'convType\': \'c2c\',\r\n'
            '          \'delayMs\': delayMs,\r\n'
            '          \'elapsedMs\': elapsed,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (kIsWeb) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    final last = _lastActiveReadReportAtMs[normalizedConvID] ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final elapsed = now - last;\r\n'
            '    final delayMs = elapsed >= _activeReadReportMinIntervalMs\r\n'
            '        ? _activeReadReportDebounceMs\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    _activeReadReportDebounceMap[normalizedConvID]?.cancel();\r\n'
            '    _activeReadReportDebounceMap[normalizedConvID] = Timer(\r\n'
            '      Duration(milliseconds: delayMs),\r\n'

            '        ? 0\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  String _commitSnapshotIdentity(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final key = messageDedupKey(message).trim();\r\n'
            '    if (key.isNotEmpty) return key;\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.isNotEmpty) return \'msg:$msgID\';\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _messageCommitStructureChanged(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> previous,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> next,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (previous.length != next.length) return true;\r\n'
            '    for (var index = 0; index < previous.length; index++) {\r\n'
            '      if (_commitSnapshotIdentity(previous[index]) !=\r\n'
            '          _commitSnapshotIdentity(next[index])) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Public accessor: true when the memory window was trimmed on the older\r\n'
            '  /// side and the user can scroll up to load more (haveMoreData must be true).\r\n'
            '  bool memoryWindowMissingOlder(String conversationID) =>\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C lastMessage verification: when onConversationChanged arrives with\r\n'
            '  /// a lastMessage that is not in the active C2C chat\'s visible list,\r\n'
            '  /// the onRecvNewMessage push was lost. Trigger a CLOUD_NEWER catch-up.\r\n'
            '  void verifyC2CLastMessage(List<V2TimConversation> conversations) {\r\n'
            '    final activeConv = currentSelectedConv;\r\n'
            '    if (activeConv.isEmpty) return;\r\n'
            '    for (final conv in conversations) {\r\n'
            '      final convIdRaw = (conv.conversationID ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '      if (!convIdRaw.toLowerCase().startsWith(\'c2c\')) continue;\r\n'
            '      final convID = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conv.conversationID ?? \'\');\r\n'
            '      if (!_isSameConversationID(convID, activeConv)) continue;\r\n'
            '      final lastMsg = conv.lastMessage;\r\n'
            '      if (lastMsg == null) continue;\r\n'
            '      final lastMsgID = (lastMsg.msgID ?? lastMsg.id ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '      if (lastMsgID.isEmpty) continue;\r\n'
            '      final list = _messageListMap[convID] ??\r\n'
            '          _messageListMap[_resolveMessageListStorageKey(convID)];\r\n'
            '      if (list == null || list.isEmpty) continue;\r\n'
            '      bool found = false;\r\n'
            '      for (final msg in list) {\r\n'
            '        final msgID = (msg.msgID ?? msg.id ?? \'\').trim();\r\n'
            '        if (msgID.isNotEmpty && msgID == lastMsgID) {\r\n'
            '          found = true;\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!found && !_gapCatchUpInFlight.contains(convID)) {\r\n'
            '        _gapCatchUpInFlight.add(convID);\r\n'
            '        unawaited(_c2cLastMessageCatchUp(convID, activeConv));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _c2cLastMessageCatchUp(String convID, String rawConvID) async {\r\n'
            '    await reconcileConversationCloud(\r\n'

            '    );\r\n'
            '    _gapCatchUpInFlight.remove(convID);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Clears the missing-older flag so haveMoreData reflects only the SDK\r\n'

            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult _messageCommitSnapshot({\r\n'

            '    MessageReconciliationWriterCommit<V2TimMessage>? writerCommit,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'

            '        final sharesWriterWindow = identical(writerValues, list) ||\r\n'

            '          (_messageCommitGenerationByConv[storageKey] ?? 0) + 1;\r\n'
            '      _messageCommitTokenByConv[storageKey] = ++_nextMessageCommitToken;\r\n'

            '    final projectionKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final unreadState = _inboundUnreadStateFor(projectionKey, create: false);\r\n'
            '    return MessageCommitResult(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '      token: _messageCommitTokenByConv[storageKey] ?? 0,\r\n'
            '      generation: _messageCommitGenerationByConv[storageKey] ?? 0,\r\n'
            '      listRevision: messageListRevisionFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '      projectionRevision: messageProjectionRevisionFor(conversationID),\r\n'

            '      lastIdentity: list.isEmpty ? null : _commitSnapshotIdentity(list.last),\r\n'

            '      memoryWindowMissingOlder: _memoryWindowMissingOlder(conversationID),\r\n'

            '      unreadBufferedCount: unreadState.bufferedMessageKeys.length,\r\n'
            '      unreadProjectionHeld: _deferredUntilUserBottomConversations.contains(\r\n'
            '        projectionKey,\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '      structureChanged: structureChanged,\r\n'
            '      contentChanged: contentChanged,\r\n'
            '      writerRevision: writerCommit?.revision,\r\n'
            '      writerGeneration: writerCommit?.generation,\r\n'
            '      writerClearEpoch: writerCommit?.clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      writerOwnerUserID: writerCommit?.ownerUserID,\r\n'
            '      writerAccountGeneration: writerCommit?.accountGeneration,\r\n'
            '      writerDomainGeneration: writerCommit?.domainGeneration,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool isMessageCommitCurrent(MessageCommitResult result) {\r\n'
            '    final key = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(result.conversationID);\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  MessageMutationType _messageMutationTypeForCommit({\r\n'
            '    required bool replace,\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult setMessageList(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messageList, {\r\n'
            '    bool needResetNewMessageCount = true,\r\n'
            '    bool isDeleteMsg = false,\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    /// true：整表替换，不与旧内存拼接（会话预览首屏 / 已合并全量列表写入用）。\r\n'
            '    bool replace = false,\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    /// false：跳过内存窗口裁剪（搜索定位拉史等）。\r\n'
            '    bool applyMemoryWindow = true,\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    /// False for an explicitly retained, durably recoverable working window.\r\n'
            '    bool preserveInFlightOutgoing = true,\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    /// true：强制保留最新端窗口（loadLatest / 回底补窗）。\r\n'
            '    bool memoryWindowPreferLatest = false,\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    /// true：显式分页收尾时允许按锚点收束读历史窗口。\r\n'
            '    bool forceMemoryWindowTrimWhileReading = false,\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    /// 覆盖全局挂起的窗口锚点。\r\n'
            '    String? memoryWindowAnchorMsgID,\r\n'

            '    MessageReconciliationWriterCommit<V2TimMessage>? writerCommit,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final canonical = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'

            '    final previous = _mergedAliasMessageList(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    if (writerCommit == null &&\r\n'
            '        _messageReconciliationWriter.hasActiveRequest(storageKey)) {\r\n'

            '        contentChanged: false,\r\n'
            '        recordCommit: false,\r\n'

            '      // Legacy callers remain source-compatible, but their snapshot must be\r\n'
            '      // admitted by the same identity/revision boundary as every other\r\n'
            '      // formal mutation. Seed from the current projection first because the\r\n'
            '      // Writer may be seeing this conversation for the first time.\r\n'
            '      final clearEpoch = messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey);\r\n'
            '      _seedMessageWriterFromProjection(\r\n'
            '        storageKey,\r\n'
            '        previous,\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      final compatibilityCommit =\r\n'
            '          _messageReconciliationWriter.applyCompatibilitySnapshot(\r\n'
            '        conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID:\r\n'
            '            \'compatibility:set_message_list:$storageKey:${++_nextRealtimeReconciliationEvent}\',\r\n'
            '        records: _reconciliationRecords(messageList),\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: clearEpoch,\r\n'
            '        replace: replace || isDeleteMsg,\r\n'
            '        // 删除操作已经通过 MessageDelta.explicitDeletes 提供了精确\r\n'

            '      );\r\n'

            '        return _messageCommitSnapshot(\r\n'
            '          conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '          storageKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '          list: previous,\r\n'
            '          structureChanged: false,\r\n'
            '          contentChanged: false,\r\n'
            '          recordCommit: false,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      writerCommit = compatibilityCommit;\r\n'
            '      messageList = _messageReconciliationWriter.valuesFor(storageKey);\r\n'
            '      // The Writer has already produced a complete authoritative snapshot;\r\n'
            '      // this method now only applies the existing memory-window/UI projection.\r\n'
            '      replace = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (replace) {\r\n'
            '      // Do this before the equivalent-window fast path as well. A replace can\r\n'
            '      // carry no content delta while still superseding a pending presentation\r\n'
            '      // transaction that has hidden rows in the projection.\r\n'

            '        previous.length == messageList.length) {\r\n'
            '      final previousSignature = _messageListContentSignature(previous);\r\n'
            '      final incomingSignature = _messageListContentSignature(messageList);\r\n'
            '      final commitSignature = \'$historyCommitSource|$incomingSignature\';\r\n'
            '      if (previousSignature == incomingSignature &&\r\n'
            '          _historyWindowCommitSignatureByConv[storageKey] == commitSignature) {\r\n'
            '        if (replace &&\r\n'
            '            _revealAllDeferredProjectionAcrossAliases(conversationID)) {\r\n'
            '          _markNeedsNotify(conversationID: conversationID);\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return _messageCommitSnapshot(\r\n'
            '          conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '          storageKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '          list: previous,\r\n'
            '          structureChanged: false,\r\n'
            '          contentChanged: false,\r\n'
            '          recordCommit: false,\r\n'
            '          writerCommit: writerCommit,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _historyWindowCommitSignatureByConv[storageKey] = commitSignature;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // The writer already sorts and reconciles identities. Reuse that work\r\n'
            '    // only for a proven new prefix with the entire previous suffix retained.\r\n'
            '    final realtimeAppendCount =\r\n'
            '        historyCommitSource.startsWith(\'message_delta:realtimeUpsert:\') &&\r\n'
            '                writerCommit.missingSeqRanges.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '                writerCommit.seqIdentityConflicts.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '                !isDeleteMsg\r\n'
            '            ? _canonicalRealtimeAppendCount(previous, messageList)\r\n'
            '            : 0;\r\n'
            '    String? canonicalSignature;\r\n'
            '    final equivalentCanonical = replace &&\r\n'
            '        !isDeleteMsg &&\r\n'
            '        previous.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        previous.length == messageList.length &&\r\n'
            '        messageList.length <= ChatMessageWindowPolicy.softMax &&\r\n'
            '        !_messageCommitStructureChanged(previous, messageList) &&\r\n'
            '        _messageListContentSignatureByConv[storageKey] ==\r\n'

            '        !_listHasCorrelatingDup(messageList);\r\n'
            '    final reuseCanonical = realtimeAppendCount > 0 || equivalentCanonical;\r\n'
            '    if (reuseCanonical) {\r\n'
            '      ChatMainThreadPerf.increment(realtimeAppendCount > 0\r\n'

            '          : \'message_noop_canonical_reused\');\r\n'

            '        incoming: messageList,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '          OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '        OutgoingVisibleProbe.log(\r\n'
            '          replace ? \'set_list_replace_retain\' : \'set_list_merge_retain\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'prevCount\': previous.length,\r\n'
            '            \'incomingCount\': messageList.length,\r\n'
            '            \'retainCount\': extras.length,\r\n'
            '            \'retainIds\':\r\n'
            '                extras.map((m) => \'${m.id ?? \'\'}/${m.msgID ?? \'\'}\').join(\',\'),\r\n'
            '            \'prevHasTracked\': OutgoingVisibleProbe.trackedInList(\r\n'
            '              previous,\r\n'
            '            ).toString(),\r\n'
            '            \'incomingHasTracked\': OutgoingVisibleProbe.trackedInList(\r\n'
            '              messageList,\r\n'
            '            ).toString(),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (extras.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        incomingForMerge = <V2TimMessage>[...messageList, ...extras];\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!reuseCanonical &&\r\n'
            '        replace &&\r\n'
            '        !isDeleteMsg &&\r\n'
            '        applyMemoryWindow &&\r\n'
            '        HistoryPaginationAnchor.shouldRejectC2cPeekRestamp(\r\n'
            '          existingCount: previous.length,\r\n'
            '          incomingCount: incomingForMerge.length,\r\n'
            '        )) {\r\n'
            '      if (OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '          OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(storageKey)) {\r\n'
            '        OutgoingVisibleProbe.log(\r\n'
            '          \'c2c_reject_peek_restamp\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'prevCount\': previous.length,\r\n'
            '            \'incomingCount\': incomingForMerge.length,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      incomingForMerge = mergeC2cOfficialOlderPage(\r\n'
            '        existing: previous,\r\n'
            '        fetched: incomingForMerge,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } else if (replace &&\r\n'
            '        previous.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        (OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(conversationID) ||\r\n'
            '            OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(storageKey))) {\r\n'
            '      OutgoingVisibleProbe.log(\r\n'
            '        \'set_list_replace_empty_prev\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'incomingCount\': messageList.length,\r\n'
            '          \'incomingHasTracked\': OutgoingVisibleProbe.trackedInList(\r\n'
            '            messageList,\r\n'
            '          ).toString(),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'

            '        if (identical(element, resolvedMessage)) {\r\n'
            '          return true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final sameId = resolvedId.isNotEmpty && element.id == resolvedId;\r\n'
            '        final sameMsgID = resolvedMsgID != null &&\r\n'
            '            resolvedMsgID.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            element.msgID == resolvedMsgID;\r\n'

            '        loadingMessage[storageConvID]!.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (chatConfig.isShowReadingStatus &&\r\n'
            '        groupType != GroupReceiptAllowType.community &&\r\n'
            '        sendMsgRes.data?.msgID != null) {\r\n'
            '      _messageReadReceiptMap[sendMsgRes.data!.msgID!] = V2TimMessageReceipt(\r\n'
            '        timestamp: 0,\r\n'

            '        readCount: 0,\r\n'

            '    _registerSoundLocalPath(resolvedMessage);\r\n'
            '    final stableIdentity =\r\n'
            '        readOutgoingStableId(previousForMerge)?.trim().isNotEmpty == true\r\n'
            '            ? readOutgoingStableId(previousForMerge)!.trim()\r\n'
            '            : readOutgoingStableId(resolvedMessage)?.trim().isNotEmpty == true\r\n'
            '                ? readOutgoingStableId(resolvedMessage)!.trim()\r\n'
            '                : id.trim();\r\n'
            '    final adoptionRecord = MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '      value: resolvedMessage,\r\n'
            '      msgID: resolvedMessage.msgID,\r\n'
            '      localID: resolvedMessage.id,\r\n'
            '      outgoingStableID: stableIdentity,\r\n'
            '      seq: resolvedMessage.seq,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final authoritativeSendCommit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: storageConvID,\r\n'
            '        eventID: \'send_adoption:$stableIdentity:${resolvedMessage.msgID ?? \'\'}\',\r\n'

            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sendPipeline,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageConvID),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageConvID),\r\n'
            '        upserts: [adoptionRecord],\r\n'

            '    if (authoritativeSendCommit == null) {\r\n'
            '      // A queued, stale, or rejected receipt cannot use the old row-local or\r\n'

            '      // the next formal publication.\r\n'
            '      // `send_done_row_local_fallback` is intentionally retired as a formal\r\n'
            '      // list path; keep the diagnostic term for compatibility with probes.\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _chatUiStateStore.bindMessageAlias(\r\n'
            '      storageConvID,\r\n'
            '      id,\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(resolvedMessage),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // temp id 上已测到的行高迁到正式 msgID，避免 send_done 后失缓存再估高抖动。\r\n'
            '    ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.rememberAlias(id, resolvedMessage.msgID);\r\n'
            '    final knownHeight = ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.heightFor(\r\n'
            '      resolvedMessage,\r\n'

            '      ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.remember(resolvedMessage, knownHeight);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowChanged(storageConvID, resolvedMessage, extraKey: id);\r\n'
            '    final insertedRow = targetIndex == -1;\r\n'
            '    final reordered = !isNewestFirstStorageOrderValid(currentHistoryMsgList);\r\n'
            '    final isRowLocalMediaReceipt = targetIndex != -1 &&\r\n'
            '        !collapsedDuplicate &&\r\n'
            '        stableIdentity.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _isRowLocalOutgoingMediaReceipt(previousForMerge, resolvedMessage);\r\n'
            '    final structuralChange = insertedRow || collapsedDuplicate || reordered;\r\n'
            '    if (structuralChange) {\r\n'
            '      _bumpMessageListRevisionFor(\r\n'
            '        storageConvID,\r\n'
            '        reason: insertedRow\r\n'
            '            ? \'send_done_insert_sort\'\r\n'
            '            : collapsedDuplicate\r\n'
            '                ? \'send_done_duplicate_collapse\'\r\n'
            '                : \'send_done_reorder\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _logOutgoingSendOrder(\r\n'
            '      event: \'send_done\',\r\n'
            '      convID: storageConvID,\r\n'
            '      message: resolvedMessage,\r\n'
            '      clientId: id,\r\n'
            '      mergePath: isRowLocalMediaReceipt\r\n'
            '          ? \'row_local_stable_identity\'\r\n'
            '          : targetIndex != -1\r\n'
            '              ? \'update_replace\'\r\n'
