            '      existingIndex: targetIndex,\r\n'
            '      reordered: reordered,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // 同位回执只由 ChatUiStateStore 通知该行；不发全局 notify，\r\n'
            '    // 也不请求贴底，避免用户正在上滑时被拉回底部。\r\n'
            '    if (!structuralChange) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 发送后 350ms suppress 窗口内推迟整表 notify，让 list-push 先播完。\r\n'
            '    if (targetIndex != -1 && shouldSuppressOutgoingPinScroll()) {\r\n'
            '      Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 380), () {\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool markOutgoingSendFailedByIdentity({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    String? clientId,\r\n'
            '    String? msgID,\r\n'
            '    String? localCustomData,\r\n'
            '    int? sendFailCode,\r\n'
            '    String reason = \'send_failed\',\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final storageConvID = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final cid = clientId?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final mid = msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (storageConvID.isEmpty || (cid.isEmpty && mid.isEmpty)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final list = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageConvID);\r\n'
            '    if (list.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final index = list.indexWhere((item) {\r\n'
            '      final stable = readOutgoingStableId(item)?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (cid.isNotEmpty && (item.id == cid || stable == cid)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (mid.isNotEmpty && (item.msgID == mid || stable == mid)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    if (index < 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final previous = list[index];\r\n'
            '    final failed = _cloneMessage(previous);\r\n'
            '    failed.status = MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SEND_FAIL;\r\n'
            '    if (localCustomData != null) {\r\n'
            '      failed.localCustomData = localCustomData;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (sendFailCode != null) {\r\n'
            '      ErrorMessageConverter.attachSendFailCode(failed, sendFailCode);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final stableIdentity = readOutgoingStableId(previous) ??\r\n'
            '        readOutgoingStableId(failed) ??\r\n'
            '        (cid.isNotEmpty ? cid : mid);\r\n'
            '    final safeReason = reason.trim().isEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? \'send_failed\'\r\n'
            '        : reason.trim().replaceAll(\':\', \'_\');\r\n'
            '    final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: storageConvID,\r\n'
            '        eventID: \'send_fail:$storageConvID:$safeReason:$stableIdentity:$mid\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.optimisticAdoption,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sendPipeline,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageConvID),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageConvID),\r\n'
            '        upserts: <MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>>[\r\n'
            '          MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '            value: failed,\r\n'
            '            msgID: failed.msgID,\r\n'
            '            localID: failed.id,\r\n'
            '            outgoingStableID: stableIdentity,\r\n'
            '            seq: failed.seq,\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        ],\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final failedKey = ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(failed);\r\n'
            '    for (final alias in <String>{cid, mid, stableIdentity}..remove(\'\')) {\r\n'
            '      if (alias != failedKey) {\r\n'
            '        _chatUiStateStore.bindMessageAlias(storageConvID, alias, failedKey);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowChanged(\r\n'
            '      storageConvID,\r\n'
            '      failed,\r\n'
            '      extraKey: cid.isNotEmpty ? cid : mid,\r\n'
            '      mutationType: MessageMutationType.statusOrProgress,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (_isSameConversationID(storageConvID, currentSelectedConv)) {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Marks an optimistic outgoing message as SEND_FAIL when the commit guard\r\n'
            '  /// rejected the send (e.g. conversation switched during async media prep).\r\n'
            '  /// Finds the message by temporary client [id], updates its status, and\r\n'
            '  /// stamps [localCustomData] with guard_dropped so the UI can show a retry.\r\n'
            '  void markOutgoingGuardDropped({\r\n'
            '    required String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    required String clientId,\r\n'
            '    String? localCustomData,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    markOutgoingSendFailedByIdentity(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: conversationID,\r\n'
            '      clientId: clientId,\r\n'
            '      localCustomData: localCustomData,\r\n'
            '      reason: \'guard_dropped\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void updateAsyncMessage(V2TimMessage message, String convID) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.id == null || message.id!.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      message.id =\r\n'
            '          message.msgID ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final storageKey = _resolveMessageListStorageKey(convID);\r\n'
            '    if (storageKey.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final current = _mergedAliasMessageList(storageKey);\r\n'
            '    final index = current.indexWhere((item) => item.msgID == msgID);\r\n'
            '    if (index < 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final previous = current[index];\r\n'
            '    final resolved = _cloneMessage(message);\r\n'
            '    final stableIdentity = readOutgoingStableId(previous) ??\r\n'
            '        readOutgoingStableId(resolved) ??\r\n'
            '        previous.id ??\r\n'
            '        resolved.id ??\r\n'
            '        msgID;\r\n'
            '    final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: storageKey,\r\n'
            '        eventID: \'async_message_edit:$storageKey:$msgID\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.edit,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(storageKey),\r\n'
            '        upserts: <MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>>[\r\n'
            '          MessageReconciliationRecord<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '            value: resolved,\r\n'
            '            msgID: resolved.msgID,\r\n'
            '            localID: resolved.id,\r\n'
            '            outgoingStableID: stableIdentity,\r\n'
            '            seq: resolved.seq,\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '        ],\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _chatUiStateStore.markMessagesChanged(storageKey, <String>{\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(previous),\r\n'
            '      ChatUiStateStore.messageKeyOf(resolved),\r\n'
            '      msgID,\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    _markMessageRowChanged(storageKey, resolved, extraKey: msgID);\r\n'
            '    if (_isSameConversationID(storageKey, currentSelectedConv)) {\r\n'
            '      _markNeedsNotify();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 群 dedup 用：与 [_normalizeConversationID] 同规则，但不依赖实例。\r\n'
            '  static String _normalizeGroupIdForDedup(String? value) {\r\n'
            '    final raw = value?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (raw.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var normalized = raw;\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.startsWith(\'GROUP\')) {\r\n'
            '      normalized = normalized.substring(5);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (normalized.startsWith(\'group_\')) {\r\n'
            '      normalized = normalized.substring(6);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return normalized.trim();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static String _groupShortTokenForDedup(String raw) {\r\n'
            '    final trimmed = raw.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final upper = trimmed.toUpperCase();\r\n'
            '    // 默认分配：`@TGS#_@TGS#short` → 取内层；自定义：`@TGS#_mc…` → 原样\r\n'
            '    if (upper.startsWith(\'@TGS#_@TGS#\')) {\r\n'
            '      return trimmed.substring(\'@TGS#_\'.length); // `@TGS#short`\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (upper.startsWith(\'@TGS#_\')) {\r\n'
            '      return trimmed;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return trimmed;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _groupIdsEquivalentForDedup(String? left, String? right) {\r\n'
            '    final a = _normalizeGroupIdForDedup(left);\r\n'
            '    final b = _normalizeGroupIdForDedup(right);\r\n'
            '    if (a.isEmpty && b.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (a.isEmpty || b.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (a == b) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final shortA = _groupShortTokenForDedup(a);\r\n'
            '    final shortB = _groupShortTokenForDedup(b);\r\n'
            '    if (shortA.isNotEmpty && shortA == shortB) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 群消息：含 groupID、归档 msgKey，或带 archiveHistory 的群归档行（C2C 归档不算）。\r\n'
            '  static bool _isGroupLikeMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final userID = message.userID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (userID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupID = message.groupID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (groupID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.contains(\'@TGS#\') && msgID.contains(\':\')) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 从 groupID 或归档 msgKey（@TGS#xxx:seq）解析 canonical 群 token。\r\n'
            '  static String _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final cached = _dedupMeta[message];\r\n'
            '    if (cached != null) return cached.groupId;\r\n'
            '    final fromGroup = _normalizeGroupIdForDedup(message.groupID);\r\n'
            '    String result;\r\n'
            '    if (fromGroup.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      result = _groupShortTokenForDedup(fromGroup);\r\n'
            '      _dedupMeta[message] =\r\n'
            '          _MessageDedupMeta(result, _messageSortSeqUncached(message));\r\n'
            '      return result;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      result = \'\';\r\n'
            '      _dedupMeta[message] =\r\n'
            '          _MessageDedupMeta(result, _messageSortSeqUncached(message));\r\n'
            '      return result;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(msgID)) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final colon = msgID.lastIndexOf(\':\');\r\n'
            '    if (colon > 0) {\r\n'
            '      final prefix = msgID.substring(0, colon);\r\n'
            '      final normalized = _normalizeGroupIdForDedup(prefix);\r\n'
            '      if (normalized.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        result = _groupShortTokenForDedup(normalized);\r\n'
            '        _dedupMeta[message] =\r\n'
            '            _MessageDedupMeta(result, _messageSortSeqUncached(message));\r\n'
            '        return result;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    result = _groupShortTokenForDedup(_normalizeGroupIdForDedup(msgID));\r\n'
            '    _dedupMeta[message] =\r\n'
            '        _MessageDedupMeta(result, _messageSortSeqUncached(message));\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int _messageSortSeq(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final cached = _dedupMeta[message];\r\n'
            '    if (cached != null) return cached.seq;\r\n'
            '    return _messageSortSeqUncached(message);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int _messageSortSeqUncached(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final fromField = int.tryParse(message.seq?.toString() ?? \'\') ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (fromField > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return fromField;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final colon = msgID.lastIndexOf(\':\');\r\n'
            '    if (colon <= 0 || colon + 1 >= msgID.length) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final suffix = msgID.substring(colon + 1);\r\n'
            '    if (!_isAllAsciiDigits(suffix)) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return int.tryParse(suffix) ?? 0;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Whether [message] carries a group-global monotonic [seq] that can be\r\n'
            '  /// trusted for chronological ordering.\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// Only GROUP messages have a conversation-wide monotonic seq. In C2C (1-to-1)\r\n'
            '  /// chats each side numbers its own messages independently, so seq is NOT\r\n'
            '  /// comparable across senders and must never drive ordering — timestamps are\r\n'
            '  /// the source of truth there.\r\n'
            '  static bool _hasGroupSeqOrdering(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (_messageSortSeq(message) <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _isGroupLikeMessage(message);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// A self message that is still being sent (no server [seq] yet) and carries\r\n'
            '  /// a local outgoing sequence. Such a row is the most recently tapped message\r\n'
            '  /// and must sort as the newest on a timestamp tie.\r\n'
            '  static bool _isLiveOutgoingPlaceholder(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return _messageSortSeq(message) <= 0 &&\r\n'
            '        message.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '        _readOutgoingLocalSeq(message) != null &&\r\n'
            '        message.status == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Messages without a server [seq] (local group tips, sending placeholders).\r\n'
            '  static bool _usesTimelineLocalOrdering(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (_messageSortSeq(message) > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final raw = message.localCustomData?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (raw.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\r\n'
            '        if (decoded is Map) {\r\n'
            '          if (decoded[\'localGroupTips\'] == true) {\r\n'
            '            return true;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          if (decoded.containsKey(\'timelineRank\')) {\r\n'
            '            return true;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return message.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '        _readOutgoingLocalSeq(message) != null &&\r\n'
            '        message.status == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int _messageTimelineSortRank(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final raw = message.localCustomData?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (raw.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return 50;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\r\n'
            '      if (decoded is Map) {\r\n'
            '        final rank = decoded[\'timelineRank\'];\r\n'
            '        if (rank is num) {\r\n'
            '          return rank.toInt();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    return 50;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int _messageSortTimestamp(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final timestamp = normalizeMessageEpochSeconds(message.timestamp);\r\n'
            '    if (timestamp > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return timestamp;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final localSentAt = normalizeMessageEpochSeconds(\r\n'
            '      _readOutgoingLocalSentAt(message),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (localSentAt > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return localSentAt;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return 0;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static int compareMessagesChronological(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    final sa = _messageSortSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final sb = _messageSortSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    final aLocalTimeline = _usesTimelineLocalOrdering(a);\r\n'
            '    final bLocalTimeline = _usesTimelineLocalOrdering(b);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // In GROUP chats the server seq is the source of truth: msgID/server\r\n'
            '    // timestamps can be non-monotonic while seq stays ordered (see logs). In\r\n'
            '    // C2C chats seq is per-sender and NOT chronological, so it must not be used\r\n'
            '    // here — fall through to timestamp ordering instead.\r\n'
            '    final batchA = readChatMediaBatchId(a);\r\n'
            '    final batchB = readChatMediaBatchId(b);\r\n'
            '    final batchIndexA = readChatMediaBatchIndex(a);\r\n'
            '    final batchIndexB = readChatMediaBatchIndex(b);\r\n'
            '    if (batchA != null &&\r\n'
            '        batchA == batchB &&\r\n'
            '        batchIndexA != null &&\r\n'
            '        batchIndexB != null &&\r\n'
            '        batchIndexA != batchIndexB) {\r\n'
            '      return batchIndexA.compareTo(batchIndexB);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final aGroupSeq = !aLocalTimeline && _hasGroupSeqOrdering(a);\r\n'
            '    final bGroupSeq = !bLocalTimeline && _hasGroupSeqOrdering(b);\r\n'
            '    if (aGroupSeq && bGroupSeq) {\r\n'
            '      if (sa != sb) {\r\n'
            '        return sa.compareTo(sb);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final ta = _messageSortTimestamp(a);\r\n'
            '    final tb = _messageSortTimestamp(b);\r\n'
            '    if (ta != tb) {\r\n'
            '      return ta.compareTo(tb);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Equal timestamps (same-second send): a live SENDING placeholder was just\r\n'
            '    // created locally and is therefore newer than any already-resolved message\r\n'
            '    // it ties with. Sends are serialized, so any resolved row in the list was\r\n'
            '    // dispatched before this placeholder was tapped. Without this, the\r\n'
            '    // placeholder (seq=0) loses the seq tie-break below and briefly renders\r\n'
            '    // *above* (older than) the previous message, then snaps back once its own\r\n'
            '    // server seq arrives — the visible "reorder then recover" flicker.\r\n'
            '    final aSendingPlaceholder = _isLiveOutgoingPlaceholder(a);\r\n'
            '    final bSendingPlaceholder = _isLiveOutgoingPlaceholder(b);\r\n'
            '    if (aSendingPlaceholder != bSendingPlaceholder) {\r\n'
            '      return aSendingPlaceholder ? 1 : -1;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 同一秒内本地发送与入站消息的兜底顺序：我方先发、对方后回，\r\n'
            '    // 升序里 self 在前。群聊某些本地发送/回执阶段可能暂时没有 server\r\n'
            '    // seq，此时不能让 msgID/hash 决定顺序，否则回复会短暂显示在自己消息上方。\r\n'
            '    if (ta == tb &&\r\n'
            '        ta > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        (_isC2cLikeMessage(a) || _isGroupLikeMessage(a)) &&\r\n'
            '        (_isC2cLikeMessage(b) || _isGroupLikeMessage(b)) &&\r\n'
            '        a.isSelf != b.isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      if (a.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '        return -1;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (b.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '        return 1;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final rankA = _messageTimelineSortRank(a);\r\n'
            '    final rankB = _messageTimelineSortRank(b);\r\n'
            '    if (rankA != rankB) {\r\n'
            '      return rankA.compareTo(rankB);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (aGroupSeq && bGroupSeq && sa != sb) {\r\n'
            '      return sa.compareTo(sb);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final la = _readOutgoingLocalSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final lb = _readOutgoingLocalSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    if (la != null && lb != null && la != lb) {\r\n'
            '      return la.compareTo(lb);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (la != null && lb == null) {\r\n'
            '      return 1;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (la == null && lb != null) {\r\n'
            '      return -1;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final ma = a.msgID ?? a.id ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final mb = b.msgID ?? b.id ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    return ma.compareTo(mb);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> sortMessagesChronologicallyAsc(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    return List<V2TimMessage>.from(messages)\r\n'
            '      ..sort(compareMessagesChronological);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 缓存 _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId 结果——控制台日志显示历史拉取后\r\n'
            '  /// 该函数被调用 160 万次。纯函数 + msgID 不变，适合 LRU 缓存。\r\n'
            '  static final LinkedHashMap<String, bool> _likelySdkMsgIdCache =\r\n'
            '      LinkedHashMap<String, bool>();\r\n'
            '  static const int _likelySdkMsgIdCacheCap = 8192;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 腾讯 SDK / 端上自消息 msgID（数字 TIM id 或 `userId-ts-random`；非归档 `@TGS#:seq`）。\r\n'
            '  static bool _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(String? msgID) {\r\n'
            '    final id = msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (id.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final cached = _likelySdkMsgIdCache[id];\r\n'
            '    if (cached != null) {\r\n'
            '      RegExpProbe.recordCacheHit(\'msgId.isLikelySdk\');\r\n'
            '      _likelySdkMsgIdCache.remove(id);\r\n'
            '      _likelySdkMsgIdCache[id] = cached;\r\n'
            '      return cached;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    RegExpProbe.recordCacheMiss(\'msgId.isLikelySdk\');\r\n'
            '    final result = RegExpProbe.measure(\'msgId.isLikelySdk\', () {\r\n'
            '      // These two checks intentionally mirror the old anchored regexes, but\r\n'
            '      // avoid invoking the RegExp interpreter for the high-volume identity\r\n'
            '      // comparator. The prefix check accepts malformed-but-prefixed SDK IDs\r\n'
            '      // exactly as `^\\d{6,}-` did.\r\n'
            '      if (_hasDigitDashPrefix(id)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 自消息常见：`q14gkm5swv-1785731054-174908238`\r\n'
            '      return _matchesUserIdDashShape(id) && !_isArchiveUnderscoreMsgId(id);\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    _likelySdkMsgIdCache[id] = result;\r\n'
            '    while (_likelySdkMsgIdCache.length > _likelySdkMsgIdCacheCap) {\r\n'
            '      _likelySdkMsgIdCache.remove(_likelySdkMsgIdCache.keys.first);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _hasDigitDashPrefix(String id) {\r\n'
            '    var index = 0;\r\n'
            '    while (index < id.length) {\r\n'
            '      final code = id.codeUnitAt(index);\r\n'
            '      if (code < 0x30 || code > 0x39) {\r\n'
            '        break;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      index++;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return index >= 6 && index < id.length && id.codeUnitAt(index) == 0x2d;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Fast structural equivalent of `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+-\\d+-\\d+$`.\r\n'
            '  static bool _matchesUserIdDashShape(String id) {\r\n'
            '    final last = id.lastIndexOf(\'-\');\r\n'
            '    if (last <= 0 || last == id.length - 1) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final middle = id.lastIndexOf(\'-\', last - 1);\r\n'
            '    if (middle <= 0 || middle == last - 1) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _isUserIdWireHead(id.substring(0, middle)) &&\r\n'
            '        _isAllAsciiDigits(id.substring(middle + 1, last)) &&\r\n'
            '        _isAllAsciiDigits(id.substring(last + 1));\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// `seq_random_ts` 归档 msgID：`^(\\d+)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)$`（结构匹配，对齐旧 hasMatch）。\r\n'
            '  static bool _isArchiveUnderscoreMsgId(String msgID) {\r\n'
            '    final last = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'_\');\r\n'
            '    if (last <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final mid = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'_\', last - 1);\r\n'
            '    if (mid <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 恰好两段 `_`，三段均非空数字（含 0），与 RegExp hasMatch 一致。\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.indexOf(\'_\') != mid) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final head = msgID.substring(0, mid);\r\n'
            '    final midPart = msgID.substring(mid + 1, last);\r\n'
            '    final tail = msgID.substring(last + 1);\r\n'
            '    return _isAllAsciiDigits(head) &&\r\n'
            '        _isAllAsciiDigits(midPart) &&\r\n'
            '        _isAllAsciiDigits(tail);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _isAllAsciiDigits(String s) {\r\n'
            '    if (s.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final c = s.codeUnitAt(i);\r\n'
            '      if (c < 0x30 || c > 0x39) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _isUserIdWireHead(String s) {\r\n'
            '    if (s.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final c = s.codeUnitAt(i);\r\n'
            '      final isDigit = c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39;\r\n'
            '      final isUpper = c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5a;\r\n'
            '      final isLower = c >= 0x61 && c <= 0x7a;\r\n'
            '      final isSep = c == 0x5f /* _ */ || c == 0x2d /* - */;\r\n'
            '      if (!isDigit && !isUpper && !isLower && !isSep) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// `^(\\d{6,})-(\\d+)-(\\d+)$` → (ts, random)\r\n'
            '  static ({int ts, int random})? _tryParseTimDigitDashWire(String msgID) {\r\n'
            '    final last = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'-\');\r\n'
            '    if (last <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final mid = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'-\', last - 1);\r\n'
            '    if (mid <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final head = msgID.substring(0, mid);\r\n'
            '    final midPart = msgID.substring(mid + 1, last);\r\n'
            '    final tail = msgID.substring(last + 1);\r\n'
            '    if (head.length < 6 ||\r\n'
            '        !_isAllAsciiDigits(head) ||\r\n'
            '        !_isAllAsciiDigits(midPart) ||\r\n'
            '        !_isAllAsciiDigits(tail)) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final ts = int.tryParse(midPart) ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final random = int.tryParse(tail) ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (ts <= 0 || random <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return (ts: ts, random: random);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// `^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)-(\\d+)-(\\d+)$` → (ts, random)\r\n'
            '  static ({int ts, int random})? _tryParseUserIdDashWire(String msgID) {\r\n'
            '    final last = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'-\');\r\n'
            '    if (last <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final mid = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'-\', last - 1);\r\n'
            '    if (mid <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final head = msgID.substring(0, mid);\r\n'
            '    final midPart = msgID.substring(mid + 1, last);\r\n'
            '    final tail = msgID.substring(last + 1);\r\n'
            '    if (!_isUserIdWireHead(head) ||\r\n'
            '        !_isAllAsciiDigits(midPart) ||\r\n'
            '        !_isAllAsciiDigits(tail)) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final ts = int.tryParse(midPart) ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final random = int.tryParse(tail) ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (ts <= 0 || random <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return (ts: ts, random: random);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// `^(\\d+)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)$` → (random, ts) 与旧 RegExp group2/group3 一致。\r\n'
            '  static ({int random, int ts})? _tryParseArchiveUnderscoreWire(String msgID) {\r\n'
            '    final last = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'_\');\r\n'
            '    if (last <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final mid = msgID.lastIndexOf(\'_\', last - 1);\r\n'
            '    if (mid <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final head = msgID.substring(0, mid);\r\n'
            '    final midPart = msgID.substring(mid + 1, last);\r\n'
            '    final tail = msgID.substring(last + 1);\r\n'
            '    if (!_isAllAsciiDigits(head) ||\r\n'
            '        !_isAllAsciiDigits(midPart) ||\r\n'
            '        !_isAllAsciiDigits(tail)) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final random = int.tryParse(midPart) ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final ts = int.tryParse(tail) ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (random <= 0 || ts <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return (random: random, ts: ts);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C 跨源稳定身份：sender + timestampSec + random。\r\n'
            '  static ({String sender, int timestampSec, int random})? _c2cWireIdentity(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isC2cConversationMessage(message) && !_isC2cLikeMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final sender = _normalizedC2cAccountId(\r\n'
            '      (message.sender?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '          ? message.sender\r\n'
            '          : message.userID,\r\n'
