            '            ts = sdk.ts;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          if (random <= 0 && sdk.random > 0) {\r\n'
            '            random = sdk.random;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        } else {\r\n'
            '          final archive = _tryParseArchiveUnderscoreWire(msgID);\r\n'
            '          if (archive != null) {\r\n'
            '            if (random <= 0 && archive.random > 0) {\r\n'
            '              random = archive.random;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            if (ts <= 0 && archive.ts > 0) {\r\n'
            '              ts = archive.ts;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (sender.isEmpty || ts <= 0 || random <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return (sender: sender, timestampSec: ts, random: random);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static ({String sender, int timestampSec, int random})?\r\n'
            '      parseC2cWireIdentityForTesting(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return _c2cWireIdentity(message);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 历史合并后用于幂等判断的身份签名（wire 优先，否则 messageDedupKey）。\r\n'
            '  static String historyIdentitySignature(List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>[];\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      final wire = _c2cWireIdentity(message);\r\n'
            '      if (wire != null) {\r\n'
            '        keys.add(\'c2cwi:${wire.sender}:${wire.timestampSec}:${wire.random}\');\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (_hasGroupSeqOrdering(message)) {\r\n'
            '        final seq = _messageSortSeq(message);\r\n'
            '        if (seq > 0) {\r\n'
            '          keys.add(\'gseq:${_normalizedGroupIdForMessage(message)}:$seq\');\r\n'
            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      keys.add(messageDedupKey(message));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    keys.sort();\r\n'
            '    return keys.join(\'|\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static String historyIdentitySignatureForTesting(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    return historyIdentitySignature(messages);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 胜出行吸收对侧本地媒体路径，并在方向分更高时采纳 isSelf。\r\n'
            '  static V2TimMessage _finalizePreferredDedupMessage(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage preferred,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage other,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    _absorbMediaLocalPaths(preferred, other);\r\n'
            '    // 归档↔SDK 不同 msgID：把已测行高粘到保留行，避免短历史 spacer 再估高。\r\n'
            '    ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.rememberAliasesBetween(preferred, other);\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(preferred) &&\r\n'
            '        _isC2cConversationMessage(other)) {\r\n'
            '      final preferredScore = _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(preferred);\r\n'
            '      final otherScore = _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(other);\r\n'
            '      if (otherScore > preferredScore) {\r\n'
            '        preferred.isSelf = other.isSelf;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return preferred;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static void _absorbMediaLocalPaths(V2TimMessage winner, V2TimMessage donor) {\r\n'
            '    if (winner.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE &&\r\n'
            '        donor.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE) {\r\n'
            '      final donorPath = donor.imageElem?.path?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final winnerPath = winner.imageElem?.path?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (donorPath.isNotEmpty && winnerPath.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        winner.imageElem ??= donor.imageElem;\r\n'
            '        winner.imageElem?.path = donorPath;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (winner.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND &&\r\n'
            '        donor.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_SOUND) {\r\n'
            '      final donorPath =\r\n'
            '          donor.soundElem?.path ?? donor.soundElem?.localUrl ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (donorPath.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        winner.soundElem ??= donor.soundElem;\r\n'
            '        winner.soundElem?.path = donor.soundElem?.path ?? donorPath;\r\n'
            '        winner.soundElem?.localUrl =\r\n'
            '            donor.soundElem?.localUrl ?? winner.soundElem?.localUrl;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (winner.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_VIDEO &&\r\n'
            '        donor.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_VIDEO) {\r\n'
            '      final donorPath = donor.videoElem?.localVideoUrl?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          donor.videoElem?.videoPath?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          \'\';\r\n'
            '      final winnerPath = winner.videoElem?.localVideoUrl?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          winner.videoElem?.videoPath?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (donorPath.isNotEmpty && winnerPath.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        winner.videoElem ??= donor.videoElem;\r\n'
            '        if ((winner.videoElem?.localVideoUrl?.trim().isEmpty ?? true) &&\r\n'
            '            (donor.videoElem?.localVideoUrl?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)) {\r\n'
            '          winner.videoElem?.localVideoUrl = donor.videoElem?.localVideoUrl;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if ((winner.videoElem?.videoPath?.trim().isEmpty ?? true) &&\r\n'
            '            (donor.videoElem?.videoPath?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)) {\r\n'
            '          winner.videoElem?.videoPath = donor.videoElem?.videoPath;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (winner.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_FILE &&\r\n'
            '        donor.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_FILE) {\r\n'
            '      final donorPath = donor.fileElem?.localUrl?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          donor.fileElem?.path?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          \'\';\r\n'
            '      final winnerPath = winner.fileElem?.localUrl?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          winner.fileElem?.path?.trim() ??\r\n'
            '          \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (donorPath.isNotEmpty && winnerPath.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        winner.fileElem ??= donor.fileElem;\r\n'
            '        winner.fileElem?.localUrl =\r\n'
            '            donor.fileElem?.localUrl ?? winner.fileElem?.localUrl;\r\n'
            '        winner.fileElem?.path = donor.fileElem?.path ?? winner.fileElem?.path;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static void _applyDedupPreference(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> result,\r\n'
            '    int index,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage candidate, {\r\n'
            '    String? candidateDedupKey,\r\n'
            '    Map<String, int>? dedupKeyToResultIndex,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final existing = result[index];\r\n'
            '    if (_preferMessageForDedup(candidate, existing)) {\r\n'
            '      result[index] = _finalizePreferredDedupMessage(candidate, existing);\r\n'
            '      if (candidateDedupKey != null && dedupKeyToResultIndex != null) {\r\n'
            '        dedupKeyToResultIndex[candidateDedupKey] = index;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      result[index] = _finalizePreferredDedupMessage(existing, candidate);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 同一 dedupKey 冲突时保留哪条（incoming 为 true 则替换 existing）。\r\n'
            '  static bool _preferMessageForDedup(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage incoming,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage existing,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final incomingArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(\r\n'
            '      incoming,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final existingArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(\r\n'
            '      existing,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 后端归档历史 SoT：先于「resolved outgoing」判断，避免 SDK isSelf 压过归档。\r\n'
            '    if (incomingArchive != existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '      final incomingSeq = _messageSortSeq(incoming);\r\n'
            '      final existingSeq = _messageSortSeq(existing);\r\n'
            '      final sameGroupSeq = !_isC2cConversationMessage(incoming) &&\r\n'
            '          !_isC2cConversationMessage(existing) &&\r\n'
            '          incomingSeq > 0 &&\r\n'
            '          incomingSeq == existingSeq;\r\n'
            '      final c2cPair = _isC2cConversationMessage(incoming) &&\r\n'
            '          _isC2cConversationMessage(existing);\r\n'
            '      if (sameGroupSeq ||\r\n'
            '          c2cPair ||\r\n'
            '          messagesCorrelateForDedup(incoming, existing)) {\r\n'
            '        return incomingArchive;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final existingResolved = _isResolvedOutgoingMessage(existing);\r\n'
            '    final incomingResolved = _isResolvedOutgoingMessage(incoming);\r\n'
            '    if (incomingResolved && !existingResolved) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!incomingResolved && existingResolved) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 群历史（含 Web SDK 缺 groupID）：同 seq 时后端归档优先。\r\n'
            '    final incomingSeqEarly = _messageSortSeq(incoming);\r\n'
            '    final existingSeqEarly = _messageSortSeq(existing);\r\n'
            '    if (!_isC2cConversationMessage(incoming) &&\r\n'
            '        !_isC2cConversationMessage(existing) &&\r\n'
            '        incomingSeqEarly > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        incomingSeqEarly == existingSeqEarly) {\r\n'
            '      if (incomingArchive && !existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!incomingArchive && existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 群消息：后端归档历史优先于 SDK 漫游副本。\r\n'
            '    if (_isGroupLikeMessage(incoming) &&\r\n'
            '        _isGroupLikeMessage(existing) &&\r\n'
            '        _messageSortSeq(incoming) > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        _messageSortSeq(incoming) == _messageSortSeq(existing)) {\r\n'
            '      if (incomingArchive && !existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!incomingArchive && existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // C2C：后端归档历史为 SoT；SDK 仅覆盖 client echo。\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(incoming) &&\r\n'
            '        _isC2cConversationMessage(existing)) {\r\n'
            '      final incomingSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(incoming.msgID);\r\n'
            '      final existingSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(existing.msgID);\r\n'
            '      if (incomingArchive && existingSdk) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (incomingSdk && existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (incomingArchive && !existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!incomingArchive && existingArchive) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (incomingSdk && _isC2cClientEchoMessage(existing)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (_isC2cClientEchoMessage(incoming) && existingSdk) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final incomingScore = _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(incoming);\r\n'
            '      final existingScore = _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(existing);\r\n'
            '      if (incomingScore != existingScore) {\r\n'
            '        return incomingScore > existingScore;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _isC2cConversationMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return _isC2cLikeMessage(message) &&\r\n'
            '        (message.userID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 无 C2C userID 即非单聊；群消息也有 sender，不能凭 sender 判 C2C。\r\n'
            '  static bool _isC2cLikeMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (_isGroupLikeMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return message.userID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _isC2cClientEchoMessage(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (_isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(message.msgID)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    return id.isNotEmpty;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 同秒同内容：TIM SDK 副本 vs 会话预览/client id echo（userID 可能不一致）。\r\n'
            '  static bool _c2cPreviewEchoCorrelate(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isC2cLikeMessage(a) || !_isC2cLikeMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final tsA = a.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final tsB = b.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (tsA <= 0 || tsA != tsB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fpA = _messageContentFingerprint(a);\r\n'
            '    final fpB = _messageContentFingerprint(b);\r\n'
            '    if (fpA == null || fpB == null || fpA != fpB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final aSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(a.msgID);\r\n'
            '    final bSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(b.msgID);\r\n'
            '    if (aSdk && bSdk) {\r\n'
            '      final aMsgID = a.msgID!.trim();\r\n'
            '      final bMsgID = b.msgID!.trim();\r\n'
            '      return aMsgID == bMsgID;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (aSdk || bSdk) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (a.isSelf != b.isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _isC2cClientEchoMessage(a) || _isC2cClientEchoMessage(b);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C 账号归一化（去 c2c_ 前缀、@ 后缀），与 app 侧 ChatIdFormat 语义对齐。\r\n'
            '  static String _normalizedC2cAccountId(String? raw) {\r\n'
            '    var id = raw?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (id.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (id.startsWith(\'c2c_\')) {\r\n'
            '      id = id.substring(4);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final at = id.indexOf(\'@\');\r\n'
            '    if (at > 0) {\r\n'
            '      id = id.substring(0, at);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return id.toLowerCase();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// sender 与 peer/userID 方向一致时得分更高（3=一致，1=镜像 dup）。\r\n'
            '  static int _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isC2cConversationMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final peer = _normalizedC2cAccountId(message.userID);\r\n'
            '    final sender = _normalizedC2cAccountId(message.sender);\r\n'
            '    if (peer.isEmpty || sender.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fromPeer = peer == sender;\r\n'
            '    final isSelf = message.isSelf == true;\r\n'
            '    if (fromPeer && !isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      return 3;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!fromPeer && isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      return 3;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return 1;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C 镜像 dup：sender 为 peer 却被标成 isSelf（Web 漫游常见）。\r\n'
            '  static bool _isC2cMirrorMislabeledSelf(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    return message.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '        _isC2cConversationMessage(message) &&\r\n'
            '        _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(message) < 3;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  V2TimMessage _normalizeInboundC2cDirection(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isC2cMirrorMislabeledSelf(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return message;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fixed = _cloneMessage(message);\r\n'
            '    fixed.isSelf = false;\r\n'
            '    return fixed;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _resolveMergedIsSelf(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    final scoreA = _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(a);\r\n'
            '    final scoreB = _c2cDirectionConsistencyScore(b);\r\n'
            '    if (scoreA > scoreB) {\r\n'
            '      return a.isSelf == true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (scoreB > scoreA) {\r\n'
            '      return b.isSelf == true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final peer = _normalizedC2cAccountId(a.userID ?? b.userID);\r\n'
            '    if (peer.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final senderA = _normalizedC2cAccountId(a.sender);\r\n'
            '      final senderB = _normalizedC2cAccountId(b.sender);\r\n'
            '      if (senderA == peer && senderB == peer) {\r\n'
            '        // 双方 sender 均为 peer：真实方向是 incoming（左收）。\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (senderA == peer && senderB != peer) {\r\n'
            '        return a.isSelf == true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (senderB == peer && senderA != peer) {\r\n'
            '        return b.isSelf == true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return a.isSelf == true && b.isSelf == true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static String? _messageContentFingerprint(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final text = message.textElem?.text?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (text != null && text.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return text;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C 跨源去重键：优先 wire identity（ts+random）；无 random 时降级文本指纹。\r\n'
            '  static String? _c2cCrossSourceDedupKey(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isC2cConversationMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final wire = _c2cWireIdentity(message);\r\n'
            '    if (wire != null) {\r\n'
            '      return \'c2cwi:${wire.sender}:${wire.timestampSec}:${wire.random}\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final userID = _normalizedC2cAccountId(message.userID);\r\n'
            '    final ts = message.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (userID.isEmpty || ts <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fingerprint = _messageContentFingerprint(message);\r\n'
            '    if (fingerprint == null || fingerprint.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return \'c2cx:$userID:$ts:${message.elemType}:$fingerprint\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _c2cCrossSourceCorrelate(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    final keyA = _c2cCrossSourceDedupKey(a);\r\n'
            '    final keyB = _c2cCrossSourceDedupKey(b);\r\n'
            '    if (keyA == null || keyB == null || keyA != keyB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // wire identity 已对齐：任意来源组合均视为同一条。\r\n'
            '    if (keyA.startsWith(\'c2cwi:\')) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final aArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(a);\r\n'
            '    final bArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(b);\r\n'
            '    final aSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(a.msgID);\r\n'
            '    final bSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(b.msgID);\r\n'
            '    if ((aArchive && bSdk) || (bArchive && aSdk)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 同会话同内容 isSelf 镜像（左收右发）：归档/TIM 或双 SDK echo。\r\n'
            '    if (a.isSelf != b.isSelf) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 群聊 archive↔SDK 跨源：同 seq 视为同一条（Web SDK 常缺 groupID/@TGS#）。\r\n'
            '  static String? _groupCrossSourceDedupKey(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isGroupLikeMessage(message) &&\r\n'
            '        !HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seq = _messageSortSeq(message);\r\n'
            '    if (seq <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(message.msgID) &&\r\n'
            '        !_isGroupLikeMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      // Web SDK 群消息偶发缺 groupID：用 seq-only 键与归档侧配对。\r\n'
            '      return \'gseqx:*:$seq\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final token = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(message);\r\n'
            '    return \'gseqx:${token.isEmpty ? \'*\' : token}:$seq\';\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _groupCrossSourceCorrelate(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(a) || _isC2cConversationMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqA = _messageSortSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final seqB = _messageSortSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    if (seqA <= 0 || seqB <= 0 || seqA != seqB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final aArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(a);\r\n'
            '    final bArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(b);\r\n'
            '    final aSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(a.msgID);\r\n'
            '    final bSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(b.msgID);\r\n'
            '    if ((aArchive && bSdk) || (bArchive && aSdk)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static String messageDedupKey(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    // Seq proves group ordering and gap continuity, not exact identity. Keep\r\n'
            '    // different server msgIDs distinct; archive↔SDK copies are correlated by\r\n'
            '    // the explicit cross-source rule above.\r\n'
            '    if (_hasGroupSeqOrdering(message)) {\r\n'
            '      final groupToken = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(message);\r\n'
            '      final seq = _messageSortSeq(message);\r\n'
            '      final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return \'gmsg:$groupToken:$seq:$msgID\';\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return \'gseq:$groupToken:$seq\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (msgID != null && msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'msg:$msgID\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim();\r\n'
            '    if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'id:$id\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return [\r\n'
            '      message.sender ?? message.userID ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '      message.timestamp ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '      message.seq ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '      message.elemType,\r\n'
            '      message.random,\r\n'
            '    ].join(\'|\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> dedupeMessages(List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'
            '    if (messages.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return const <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final dedupKeyToResultIndex = <String, int>{};\r\n'
            '    final correlationToResultIndex = <String, int>{};\r\n'
            '    final crossSourceToResultIndex = <String, int>{};\r\n'
            '    final groupCrossSourceToResultIndex = <String, int>{};\r\n'
            '    // Every positive rule in messagesCorrelateForDedup has an indexed route.\r\n'
            '    // Buckets select candidates only; the existing guards still decide identity.\r\n'
            '    // In particular, complete SDK rows do not search unrelated same-second rows.\r\n'
            '    final correlationBucketToResultIndexes = <String, Set<int>>{};\r\n'
            '    void indexCorrelationBuckets(V2TimMessage message, int resultIndex) {\r\n'
            '      for (final bucket in _dedupCorrelationBuckets(message)) {\r\n'
            '        correlationBucketToResultIndexes\r\n'
            '            .putIfAbsent(bucket, () => <int>{})\r\n'
            '            .add(resultIndex);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final result = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    void applyPreference(int index, V2TimMessage candidate, String key) {\r\n'
            '      _applyDedupPreference(\r\n'
            '        result,\r\n'
            '        index,\r\n'
            '        candidate,\r\n'
            '        candidateDedupKey: key,\r\n'
            '        dedupKeyToResultIndex: dedupKeyToResultIndex,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      // An ack can introduce a server ID, local sequence or media path that\r\n'
            '      // was absent on its placeholder. Index the winner after every adoption.\r\n'
            '      // Sets avoid adding the same row repeatedly when receipts keep it alive.\r\n'
            '      indexCorrelationBuckets(result[index], index);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      final key = messageDedupKey(message);\r\n'
            '      final corr = _outgoingCorrelationKey(message);\r\n'
            '      if (corr != null) {\r\n'
            '        final existingIdx = correlationToResultIndex[corr];\r\n'
            '        if (existingIdx != null &&\r\n'
            '            !_areDistinctSdkIdentities(result[existingIdx], message) &&\r\n'
            '            !_areDistinctGroupServerIdentities(result[existingIdx], message) &&\r\n'
            '            !_areDistinctGroupSequences(result[existingIdx], message)) {\r\n'
            '          applyPreference(existingIdx, message, key);\r\n'
            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final groupCrossKey = _groupCrossSourceDedupKey(message);\r\n'
            '      var groupCrossMatched = false;\r\n'
            '      if (groupCrossKey != null) {\r\n'
            '        final existingIdx = groupCrossSourceToResultIndex[groupCrossKey];\r\n'
            '        if (existingIdx != null) {\r\n'
            '          final existing = result[existingIdx];\r\n'
            '          if (_groupCrossSourceCorrelate(message, existing)) {\r\n'
            '            applyPreference(existingIdx, message, key);\r\n'
            '            groupCrossMatched = true;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (!groupCrossMatched && groupCrossKey.contains(\':*:\')) {\r\n'
            '          final seqSuffix = groupCrossKey.substring(\r\n'
            '            groupCrossKey.lastIndexOf(\':\'),\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          final sameSeq = correlationBucketToResultIndexes[\r\n'
            '                  \'group_seq:${_messageSortSeq(message)}\'] ??\r\n'
            '              const <int>{};\r\n'
            '          for (final i in sameSeq) {\r\n'
            '            final existingKey = _groupCrossSourceDedupKey(result[i]);\r\n'
            '            if (existingKey == null || !existingKey.endsWith(seqSuffix)) {\r\n'
            '              continue;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            if (_groupCrossSourceCorrelate(message, result[i])) {\r\n'
            '              applyPreference(i, message, key);\r\n'
            '              groupCrossSourceToResultIndex[groupCrossKey] = i;\r\n'
            '              if (existingKey != groupCrossKey) {\r\n'
            '                groupCrossSourceToResultIndex[existingKey] = i;\r\n'
            '              }\r\n'
            '              groupCrossMatched = true;\r\n'
            '              break;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (groupCrossMatched) {\r\n'
            '          continue;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final crossKey = _c2cCrossSourceDedupKey(message);\r\n'
            '      if (crossKey != null) {\r\n'
            '        final existingIdx = crossSourceToResultIndex[crossKey];\r\n'
            '        if (existingIdx != null) {\r\n'
            '          final existing = result[existingIdx];\r\n'
            '          if (!_areDistinctSdkIdentities(existing, message) &&\r\n'
            '              _c2cCrossSourceCorrelate(message, existing)) {\r\n'
            '            applyPreference(existingIdx, message, key);\r\n'
            '            continue;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      var correlateIdx = -1;\r\n'
            '      final candidateIndexes = <int>{};\r\n'
            '      for (final bucket in _dedupCorrelationBuckets(message, forLookup: true)) {\r\n'
            '        final indexes = correlationBucketToResultIndexes[bucket];\r\n'
            '        if (indexes != null) {\r\n'
            '          candidateIndexes.addAll(indexes);\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Missing metadata is covered by identity/local-sequence/path and the\r\n'
            '      // explicit preview partitions below. An empty candidate set proves that\r\n'
            '      // none of the correlation rules can match; it must never trigger a scan.\r\n'
            '      for (final i in candidateIndexes) {\r\n'
            '        if (messagesCorrelateForDedup(message, result[i])) {\r\n'
            '          correlateIdx = i;\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (correlateIdx >= 0) {\r\n'
            '        applyPreference(correlateIdx, message, key);\r\n'
            '        if (corr != null) {\r\n'
            '          correlationToResultIndex[corr] = correlateIdx;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (crossKey != null) {\r\n'
            '          crossSourceToResultIndex[crossKey] = correlateIdx;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if (groupCrossKey != null) {\r\n'
            '          groupCrossSourceToResultIndex[groupCrossKey] = correlateIdx;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final existingIdx = dedupKeyToResultIndex[key];\r\n'
            '      if (existingIdx != null) {\r\n'
            '        applyPreference(existingIdx, message, key);\r\n'
            '        if (corr != null) {\r\n'
            '          correlationToResultIndex[corr] = existingIdx;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final resultIndex = result.length;\r\n'
            '      result.add(message);\r\n'
            '      dedupKeyToResultIndex[key] = resultIndex;\r\n'
            '      indexCorrelationBuckets(message, resultIndex);\r\n'
            '      if (corr != null) {\r\n'
            '        correlationToResultIndex[corr] = resultIndex;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (crossKey != null) {\r\n'
            '        crossSourceToResultIndex[crossKey] = resultIndex;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (groupCrossKey != null) {\r\n'
            '        groupCrossSourceToResultIndex[groupCrossKey] = resultIndex;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static Iterable<String> _dedupCorrelationBuckets(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message, {\r\n'
            '    bool forLookup = false,\r\n'
            '  }) sync* {\r\n'
            '    // msgID/id aliases can match even without sender, timestamp or elemType.\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final localID = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.isNotEmpty) yield \'identity:$msgID\';\r\n'
            '    if (localID.isNotEmpty && localID != msgID) yield \'identity:$localID\';\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final elemType = message.elemType;\r\n'
            '    if (message.isSelf == true) {\r\n'
            '      final corr = _outgoingCorrelationKey(message);\r\n'
            '      if (corr != null) yield \'outgoing:$corr\';\r\n'
            '      final localSeq = _readOutgoingLocalSeq(message);\r\n'
            '      if (localSeq != null) yield \'outgoing_seq:$localSeq:$elemType\';\r\n'
            '      if (elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_IMAGE) {\r\n'
            '        final path = message.imageElem?.path?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        if (path.isNotEmpty) yield \'outgoing_path:$path\';\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // Correlation uses the raw timestamp for preview equality. Wire identity\r\n'
            '    // separately normalizes seconds/milliseconds and can parse missing fields.\r\n'
            '    final timestamp = message.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '      final crossKey = _c2cCrossSourceDedupKey(message);\r\n'
            '      if (crossKey != null) yield \'cross:$crossKey\';\r\n'
            '      final fingerprint = _messageContentFingerprint(message);\r\n'
            '      if (timestamp > 0 && fingerprint != null) {\r\n'
            '        final base = \'c2c_preview:$timestamp:$fingerprint\';\r\n'
            '        final sdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(msgID);\r\n'
            '        if (forLookup) {\r\n'
            '          // Two different SDK IDs cannot correlate through preview content.\r\n'
            '          yield \'$base:compat\';\r\n'
            '          if (!sdk) yield \'$base:sdk\';\r\n'
            '        } else {\r\n'
            '          yield \'$base:${sdk ? \'sdk\' : \'compat\'}\';\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final seq = _messageSortSeq(message);\r\n'
            '    // No elemType in this key: archive↔SDK seq correlation accepts differing\r\n'
            '    // payload shapes, including Web SDK rows that have lost their groupID.\r\n'
            '    if (seq > 0) yield \'group_seq:$seq\';\r\n'
            '    if (timestamp <= 0) return;\r\n'
            '    final base = \'group_preview:$timestamp:$elemType\';\r\n'
            '    if (forLookup) {\r\n'
            '      if (seq > 0) {\r\n'
            '        yield \'$base:seq:$seq\';\r\n'
            '        yield \'$base:seq:0\';\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        yield \'$base:all\';\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      // Preview/echo rules reject unequal positive seqs. A legacy row without\r\n'
            '      // seq may still match either side and searches just its timestamp/type.\r\n'
            '      yield \'$base:seq:${seq > 0 ? seq : 0}\';\r\n'
            '      yield \'$base:all\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> dedupeMessagesForTesting(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    return dedupeMessages(messages);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _groupPreviewStubCorrelate(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(a) || _isC2cConversationMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // preview stub 常缺 textElem（指纹为 null）。若不校验 elemType，\r\n'
            '    // 同秒「已发出文字」会与「图片 stub/SDK 头」误并，本地气泡从文字变成图片。\r\n'
            '    if (a.elemType != b.elemType) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final tsA = a.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final tsB = b.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (tsA <= 0 || tsA != tsB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqA = _messageSortSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final seqB = _messageSortSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    if (seqA > 0 && seqB > 0 && seqA != seqB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final randA = _outgoingRandomValue(a);\r\n'
            '    final randB = _outgoingRandomValue(b);\r\n'
            '    if (randA != null && randB != null && randA != randB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isClientPlaceholderMessage(a) && _isClientPlaceholderMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      final idA = a.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final idB = b.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (idA.isNotEmpty && idB.isNotEmpty && idA != idB) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final aSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(a.msgID);\r\n'
            '    final bSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(b.msgID);\r\n'
            '    final aStub = seqA <= 0 || !aSdk;\r\n'
            '    final bStub = seqB <= 0 || !bSdk;\r\n'
            '    if (!aStub && !bStub) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final senderA = a.sender?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final senderB = b.sender?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (senderA.isNotEmpty && senderB.isNotEmpty && senderA != senderB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fpA = _messageContentFingerprint(a);\r\n'
            '    final fpB = _messageContentFingerprint(b);\r\n'
            '    if (aStub && bStub) {\r\n'
            '      // 双 stub 必须内容指纹一致，避免同秒不同消息误并。\r\n'
            '      if (fpA == null || fpB == null || fpA != fpB) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // SDK 头 + 会话 preview stub：允许 preview 缺 textElem。\r\n'
            '    if (fpA != null && fpB != null && fpA != fpB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _sameSelfNonC2cEchoCorrelate(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (a.isSelf != true || b.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(a) || _isC2cConversationMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (a.elemType != b.elemType) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final tsA = a.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final tsB = b.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (tsA <= 0 || tsA != tsB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqA = _messageSortSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final seqB = _messageSortSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    // 连发相同文案会共享同一秒 timestamp；seq 不同就是不同消息，不能当 echo 合并。\r\n'
            '    if (seqA > 0 && seqB > 0 && seqA != seqB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final randA = _outgoingRandomValue(a);\r\n'
            '    final randB = _outgoingRandomValue(b);\r\n'
            '    if (randA != null && randB != null && randA != randB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isClientPlaceholderMessage(a) && _isClientPlaceholderMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      final idA = a.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final idB = b.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (idA.isNotEmpty && idB.isNotEmpty && idA != idB) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fpA = _messageContentFingerprint(a);\r\n'
            '    final fpB = _messageContentFingerprint(b);\r\n'
            '    if (fpA == null || fpB == null || fpA != fpB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final senderA = a.sender?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final senderB = b.sender?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (senderA.isNotEmpty && senderB.isNotEmpty && senderA != senderB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C 两条都已是腾讯 SDK msgID 且不相同：就是两条云端消息，禁止再按\r\n'
            '  /// random / 文案 / 同秒指纹并掉（连发 `1`/`2`/`3` 会误并整页）。\r\n'
            '  /// 群聊不走这条：同 seq 的 SDK/归档副本 msgID 本来就不同。\r\n'
            '  static bool _areDistinctSdkIdentities(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isC2cLikeMessage(a) || !_isC2cLikeMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final aId = a.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final bId = b.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (!_isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(aId) || !_isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(bId)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return aId != bId;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 群聊的正数 seq 是服务端会话内的唯一顺序标识。只要两条消息属于同一群且\r\n'
            '  /// seq 不同，就一定是两条不同消息，不能再按同秒、相同发送者或相同内容合并。\r\n'
            '  static bool _areDistinctGroupSequences(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_isGroupLikeMessage(a) || !_isGroupLikeMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqA = _messageSortSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final seqB = _messageSortSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    if (seqA <= 0 || seqB <= 0 || seqA == seqB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final groupA = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(a);\r\n'
            '    final groupB = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(b);\r\n'
            '    return groupA.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        groupB.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _groupIdsEquivalentForDedup(groupA, groupB);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _groupSeqScopesCompatible(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    final groupA = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(a);\r\n'
            '    final groupB = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(b);\r\n'
            '    if (groupA.isEmpty || groupB.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _groupIdsEquivalentForDedup(groupA, groupB);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Same Seq is a protocol conflict when both group rows carry different\r\n'
            '  /// server identities. Preserve both so diagnostics and later authority can\r\n'
            '  /// resolve it. The one allowed exception is a proven archive↔SDK copy.\r\n'
            '  static bool _areDistinctGroupServerIdentities(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage a,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage b,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (_isC2cConversationMessage(a) || _isC2cConversationMessage(b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqA = _messageSortSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final seqB = _messageSortSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    if (seqA <= 0 || seqA != seqB) return false;\r\n'
            '    final msgIDA = a.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final msgIDB = b.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgIDA.isEmpty || msgIDB.isEmpty || msgIDA == msgIDB) return false;\r\n'
            '    final aArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(a);\r\n'
            '    final bArchive = HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(b);\r\n'
            '    final aSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(msgIDA);\r\n'
            '    final bSdk = _isLikelyTencentSdkMsgId(msgIDB);\r\n'
            '    if ((aArchive && bSdk) || (bArchive && aSdk)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_groupSeqScopesCompatible(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (a.elemType == b.elemType && aSdk && bSdk) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fpA = _messageContentFingerprint(a);\r\n'
            '    final fpB = _messageContentFingerprint(b);\r\n'
            '    if (a.elemType == b.elemType && fpA != null && fpA == fpB) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool messagesCorrelateForDedup(V2TimMessage a, V2TimMessage b) {\r\n'
            '    if (_areDistinctSdkIdentities(a, b) ||\r\n'
            '        _areDistinctGroupSequences(a, b) ||\r\n'
            '        _areDistinctGroupServerIdentities(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final seqA = _messageSortSeq(a);\r\n'
            '    final seqB = _messageSortSeq(b);\r\n'
            '    if (seqA > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        seqA == seqB &&\r\n'
            '        !_isC2cConversationMessage(a) &&\r\n'
            '        !_isC2cConversationMessage(b) &&\r\n'
            '        _groupSeqScopesCompatible(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      if (a.elemType == b.elemType &&\r\n'
            '          (_isGroupLikeMessage(a) ||\r\n'
            '              _isGroupLikeMessage(b) ||\r\n'
            '              (a.isSelf == true && b.isSelf == true))) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_hasGroupSeqOrdering(a) &&\r\n'
            '        _hasGroupSeqOrdering(b) &&\r\n'
            '        a.elemType == b.elemType &&\r\n'
            '        _groupIdsEquivalentForDedup(\r\n'
            '          _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(a),\r\n'
            '          _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(b),\r\n'
            '        ) &&\r\n'
            '        seqA == seqB) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final aMsgID = a.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final bMsgID = b.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (aMsgID.isNotEmpty && bMsgID.isNotEmpty && aMsgID == bMsgID) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final aId = a.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final bId = b.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (aId.isNotEmpty && bId.isNotEmpty && aId == bId) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (aMsgID.isNotEmpty && bId.isNotEmpty && aMsgID == bId) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (aId.isNotEmpty && bMsgID.isNotEmpty && aId == bMsgID) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_c2cCrossSourceCorrelate(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_groupCrossSourceCorrelate(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_c2cPreviewEchoCorrelate(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_sameSelfNonC2cEchoCorrelate(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_groupPreviewStubCorrelate(a, b)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _outgoingMessagesCorrelate(a, b);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Merge fetched history with any messages upserted while loading.\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// 注意：会保留 [existing] 里的全部历史。首屏若要以会话预览窗口为准，\r\n'
            '  /// 请用 [mergePeekWindowWithLiveMemory] + [setMessageList] `replace: true`。\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> mergeHistoricalWithInMemory({\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage>? existing,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> fetched,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (existing == null || existing.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return sortMessagesNewestFirst(dedupeMessages(fetched));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return sortMessagesNewestFirst(\r\n'
            '      dedupeMessages(<V2TimMessage>[...existing, ...fetched]),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Merge an older SDK page into an already canonical window.  Pagination\r\n'
            '  /// normally overlaps the current oldest row, so running dedupe over the\r\n'
            '  /// whole window makes every upward swipe increasingly expensive.  Canonical\r\n'
            '  /// keys and group seq identities are stable enough to reject that overlap\r\n'
            '  /// using indexes; only the fetched page goes through full correlation.\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> mergeOlderPageIncrementally({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> existing,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> olderPage,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (existing.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return sortMessagesNewestFirst(dedupeMessages(olderPage));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (olderPage.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return List<V2TimMessage>.from(existing);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final result = List<V2TimMessage>.from(existing);\r\n'
            '    final keys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    final identities = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    final groupSeqCandidates = <String, List<V2TimMessage>>{};\r\n'
            '    for (final message in existing) {\r\n'
            '      keys.add(messageDedupKey(message));\r\n'
            '      final msgId = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final localId = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (msgId.isNotEmpty) identities.add(\'m:$msgId\');\r\n'
            '      if (localId.isNotEmpty) identities.add(\'i:$localId\');\r\n'
            '      final seq = _messageSortSeq(message);\r\n'
            '      final group = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(message);\r\n'
            '      if (seq > 0 && group.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        groupSeqCandidates\r\n'
            '            .putIfAbsent(\'$group:$seq\', () => <V2TimMessage>[])\r\n'
            '            .add(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // A page is small (normally 20-50 rows), so its local dedupe remains\r\n'
            '    // cheap and preserves all existing preference/correlation rules.\r\n'
            '    for (final message in dedupeMessages(olderPage)) {\r\n'
            '      final key = messageDedupKey(message);\r\n'
            '      final msgId = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final localId = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final seq = _messageSortSeq(message);\r\n'
            '      final group = _normalizedGroupIdForMessage(message);\r\n'
            '      final sameGroupSeq = seq > 0 && group.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '          ? (groupSeqCandidates[\'$group:$seq\'] ?? const <V2TimMessage>[])\r\n'
            '              .any((candidate) => messagesCorrelateForDedup(candidate, message))\r\n'
            '          : false;\r\n'
            '      final duplicate = keys.contains(key) ||\r\n'
            '          (msgId.isNotEmpty && identities.contains(\'m:$msgId\')) ||\r\n'
            '          (localId.isNotEmpty && identities.contains(\'i:$localId\')) ||\r\n'
            '          sameGroupSeq;\r\n'
            '      if (duplicate) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      result.add(message);\r\n'
            '      keys.add(key);\r\n'
            '      if (msgId.isNotEmpty) identities.add(\'m:$msgId\');\r\n'
            '      if (localId.isNotEmpty) identities.add(\'i:$localId\');\r\n'
            '      if (seq > 0 && group.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        groupSeqCandidates\r\n'
            '            .putIfAbsent(\'$group:$seq\', () => <V2TimMessage>[])\r\n'
            '            .add(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return sortMessagesNewestFirst(result);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// C2C 官方旧页：只按 msgID 并集。连发相同数字文案不能走 outgoing/指纹去重，\r\n'
            '  /// 否则 20 条云端页只会留下 2 条（`----` / `11111`）。\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> mergeC2cOfficialOlderPage({\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage>? existing,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> fetched,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final current = existing ?? const <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    final seenMsgID = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    final keyed = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    final placeholders = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    void ingest(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '      final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (msgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        if (seenMsgID.add(msgID)) {\r\n'
            '          keyed.add(message);\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      placeholders.add(message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    for (final message in current) {\r\n'
            '      ingest(message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final message in fetched) {\r\n'
            '      ingest(message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (placeholders.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return sortMessagesNewestFirst(keyed);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return sortMessagesNewestFirst(\r\n'
            '      dedupeMessages(<V2TimMessage>[...keyed, ...placeholders]),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 进聊合窗时须保留的本地群灰字（勿被 peek 窗口冲掉）。\r\n'
            '  /// 成员变动 tip（member_added/removed/left）已换轨 IM GroupTips，不再保留。\r\n'
            '  static bool _isPreservedLocalGroupTip(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    final raw = message.localCustomData?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (raw.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\r\n'
            '        if (decoded is Map && decoded[\'localGroupTips\'] == true) {\r\n'
            '          final action =\r\n'
            '              decoded[\'action\']?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '          if (action == \'member_added\' ||\r\n'
            '              action == \'member_removed\' ||\r\n'
            '              action == \'member_left\') {\r\n'
            '            return false;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          return true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgID.startsWith(\'local_gt_\') ||\r\n'
            '        msgID.startsWith(\'ce_\') ||\r\n'
            '        msgID.startsWith(\'local_\')) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final id = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    return id.startsWith(\'local_gt_\') ||\r\n'
            '        id.startsWith(\'ce_\') ||\r\n'
            '        id.startsWith(\'local_\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 整表 replace 或分页 merge 时，保留尚未出现在新窗里的在途/刚回执自己消息。\r\n'
            '  /// 已对上 id / msgID / stableId / dedup 的占位符不回插（避免 018 双气泡）。\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> collectUncorrelatedInFlightOutgoing({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> previous,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> incoming,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (previous.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return const <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final incomingObjects = Set<V2TimMessage>.identity();\r\n'
            '    final incomingIds = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    final incomingMsgIDs = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    final incomingStableIds = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? newestIncoming;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in incoming) {\r\n'
            '      incomingObjects.add(message);\r\n'
            '      final id = message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final msgID = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final stableId = readOutgoingStableId(message)?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (id.isNotEmpty) incomingIds.add(id);\r\n'
            '      if (msgID.isNotEmpty) incomingMsgIDs.add(msgID);\r\n'
            '      if (stableId.isNotEmpty) incomingStableIds.add(stableId);\r\n'
            '      if (newestIncoming == null ||\r\n'
            '          compareMessagesChronological(message, newestIncoming) > 0) {\r\n'
            '        newestIncoming = message;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    bool coveredByIncoming(V2TimMessage candidate) {\r\n'
            '      final candidateId = candidate.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final candidateMsgID = candidate.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      final candidateStable = readOutgoingStableId(candidate)?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      // These are the same independent identity checks as the old scan.\r\n'
            '      // Cross-field aliases must still pass the correlation guards below.\r\n'
            '      if ((candidateId.isNotEmpty && incomingIds.contains(candidateId)) ||\r\n'
            '          (candidateMsgID.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '              incomingMsgIDs.contains(candidateMsgID)) ||\r\n'
            '          (candidateStable.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '              incomingStableIds.contains(candidateStable))) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Anonymous malformed rows need not correlate even with themselves.\r\n'
            '      // Keep that compatibility behavior rather than inferring new identity.\r\n'
            '      if (incomingObjects.contains(candidate) &&\r\n'
            '          messagesCorrelateForDedup(candidate, candidate)) {\r\n'
            '        return true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Only eligible outgoing rows without an exact match need the legacy\r\n'
            '      // cross-source/placeholder correlation scan.\r\n'
            '      for (final row in incoming) {\r\n'
            '        if (messagesCorrelateForDedup(candidate, row)) {\r\n'
            '          return true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final extras = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    for (final message in previous) {\r\n'
            '      if (message.isSelf != true ||\r\n'
            '          !_shouldKeepUncorrelatedOutgoing(message, newestIncoming)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!coveredByIncoming(message)) {\r\n'
            '        extras.add(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return extras;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 未被新窗关联的自己消息：在途必留；已成功则留下「比窗新」或本会话刚发出的行。\r\n'
            '  ///\r\n'
            '  /// 发图 upload 回执时间戳常晚于紧跟着发出的文字。只按 chronological > newest\r\n'
            '  /// 会把这条 SEND_SUCC 文字当旧历史丢掉，对端却已收到。\r\n'
            '  static bool _shouldKeepUncorrelatedOutgoing(\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage message,\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? newestIncoming,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.status == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING ||\r\n'
            '        _isLiveOutgoingPlaceholder(message)) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (message.status != MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SEND_SUCC) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (newestIncoming != null &&\r\n'
            '        compareMessagesChronological(message, newestIncoming) > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_readOutgoingLocalSeq(message) == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (newestIncoming == null) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (compareMessagesChronological(message, newestIncoming) >= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    const maxLagSec = 120;\r\n'
            '    final newestTs = newestIncoming.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final messageTs = message.timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (newestTs > 0 && messageTs > 0 && newestTs - messageTs <= maxLagSec) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final sentAt = _readOutgoingLocalSentAt(message);\r\n'
            '    if (sentAt == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final nowSec = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000;\r\n'
            '    return nowSec >= sentAt && nowSec - sentAt <= maxLagSec;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 把 [collectUncorrelatedInFlightOutgoing] 的 extras 插回 newest 端并去重。\r\n'
            '  /// 用于分页 merge、内存窗 trim 之后，避免已回执自己消息被旧页/120 窗裁掉。\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> restoreUncorrelatedInFlightOutgoing({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> previous,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> incoming,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final extras = collectUncorrelatedInFlightOutgoing(\r\n'
            '      previous: previous,\r\n'
            '      incoming: incoming,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (extras.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return incoming;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return sortMessagesNewestFirst(\r\n'
            '      dedupeMessages(<V2TimMessage>[...extras, ...incoming]),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 以 peek 窗补齐实时/在途消息；不得驱逐后端归档历史（含窗外独有补洞）。\r\n'
            '  /// 历史冲突以后端归档为 SoT，由最终 [dedupeMessages] prefer 收敛。\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> mergePeekWindowWithLiveMemory({\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage>? existing,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> fetched,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final window = dedupeMessages(fetched);\r\n'
            '    if (existing == null || existing.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return sortMessagesNewestFirst(window);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (window.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return sortMessagesNewestFirst(dedupeMessages(existing));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? newestInWindow;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in window) {\r\n'
            '      if (newestInWindow == null ||\r\n'
            '          compareMessagesChronological(message, newestInWindow) > 0) {\r\n'
            '        newestInWindow = message;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final live = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    var retainedArchiveCount = 0;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in existing) {\r\n'
            '      // 后端归档（含校对补洞）：一律保留，禁止 SDK peek 窗整表冲掉后再靠校对灌回。\r\n'
            '      if (HistoryPaginationAnchor.isArchiveHistoryMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '        live.add(message);\r\n'
            '        retainedArchiveCount++;\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final coveredByWindow = window.any(\r\n'
            '        (windowMessage) => messagesCorrelateForDedup(message, windowMessage),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (coveredByWindow) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (_isPreservedLocalGroupTip(message)) {\r\n'
            '        live.add(message);\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final sending = message.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '          (message.status == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING ||\r\n'
            '              _isLiveOutgoingPlaceholder(message));\r\n'
            '      if (sending) {\r\n'
            '        live.add(message);\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (newestInWindow != null &&\r\n'
            '          compareMessagesChronological(message, newestInWindow) > 0) {\r\n'
            '        live.add(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final merged = restoreUncorrelatedInFlightOutgoing(\r\n'
            '      previous: existing,\r\n'
            '      incoming: sortMessagesNewestFirst(\r\n'
            '        dedupeMessages(<V2TimMessage>[...window, ...live]),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (OutgoingVisibleProbe.matches(OutgoingVisibleProbe.lastConvID) ||\r\n'
            '        existing.any(OutgoingVisibleProbe.matchesMessage) ||\r\n'
            '        fetched.any(OutgoingVisibleProbe.matchesMessage)) {\r\n'
            '      final droppedSelf = existing.where((message) {\r\n'
            '        if (message.isSelf != true) {\r\n'
            '          return false;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return !merged.any(\r\n'
            '          (kept) =>\r\n'
            '              ((message.id?.trim() ?? \'\').isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '                  kept.id?.trim() == message.id?.trim()) ||\r\n'
            '              ((message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\').isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '                  kept.msgID?.trim() == message.msgID?.trim()),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }).toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '      OutgoingVisibleProbe.log(\r\n'
            '        \'peek_merge_live\',\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'existingCount\': existing.length,\r\n'
            '          \'fetchedCount\': fetched.length,\r\n'
            '          \'liveKept\': live.length,\r\n'
            '          \'mergedCount\': merged.length,\r\n'
            '          \'droppedSelfCount\': droppedSelf.length,\r\n'
            '          \'droppedSelf\':\r\n'
            '              droppedSelf.map(OutgoingVisibleProbe.brief).join(\' || \'),\r\n'
            '          \'existingTracked\': OutgoingVisibleProbe.trackedInList(\r\n'
            '            existing,\r\n'
            '          ).toString(),\r\n'
            '          \'fetchedTracked\': OutgoingVisibleProbe.trackedInList(\r\n'
            '            fetched,\r\n'
            '          ).toString(),\r\n'
            '          \'mergedTracked\': OutgoingVisibleProbe.trackedInList(\r\n'
            '            merged,\r\n'
            '          ).toString(),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (retainedArchiveCount > 0) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'peek_merge_retained_archive\',\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'retainedArchiveCount\': retainedArchiveCount,\r\n'
            '          \'windowCount\': window.length,\r\n'
            '          \'mergedCount\': merged.length,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return merged;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> sortMessagesNewestFirst(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> messages,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final result = List<V2TimMessage>.from(messages);\r\n'
            '    // Writer snapshots and restored windows are usually already ordered.\r\n'
            '    // Keep returning an independent list; only skip the redundant sort.\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 1; i < result.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      if (compareMessagesChronological(result[i], result[i - 1]) > 0) {\r\n'
            '        result.sort((a, b) => compareMessagesChronological(b, a));\r\n'
            '        break;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> _mergePendingIncomingForDedup({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> pending,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> existing,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'

            '      dedupeMessages(<V2TimMessage>[...pending, ...existing]),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'

            '    required List<V2TimMessage> existing,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage> incoming,\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> filterHiddenProjectionForTesting({\r\n'
            '    required Iterable<V2TimMessage> authoritativeMessages,\r\n'
            '    required Set<String> hiddenKeys,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final messages = authoritativeMessages.toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? newestVisible;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      if (!hiddenKeys.contains(messageDedupKey(message)) &&\r\n'
            '          (newestVisible == null ||\r\n'
            '              compareMessagesChronological(message, newestVisible) > 0)) {\r\n'
            '        newestVisible = message;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'

            '    // the visible window. A later realtime/self message or history commit can\r\n'
            '    // overtake a queued reveal. Expose the intervening rows immediately,\r\n'
            '    // using the same group-seq / C2C ordering as the displayed list.\r\n'
            '    final boundary = newestVisible;\r\n'

            '            (boundary != null &&\r\n'
