            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Publishes a small realtime batch without rebuilding the entire history\r\n'
            '  /// window. Callers must use this only for strictly newer, non destructive\r\n'
            '  /// messages; all history/reorder/delete paths continue through setMessageList.\r\n'
            '  MessageCommitResult appendRealtimeMessages(\r\n'
            '    String conversationID,\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> incoming,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final key = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID).isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID)\r\n'
            '        : conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    final commit = commitMessageDelta(\r\n'
            '      MessageDelta<V2TimMessage>(\r\n'
            '        conversationKey: key,\r\n'
            '        eventID:\r\n'
            '            \'realtime:public:${++_nextRealtimeReconciliationEvent}:${incoming.map(messageDedupKey).join(\',\')}\',\r\n'
            '        kind: MessageDeltaKind.realtimeUpsert,\r\n'
            '        source: MessageDeltaSource.sdkRealtime,\r\n'
            '        generation: messageDeltaGenerationFor(key),\r\n'
            '        clearEpoch: messageDeltaClearEpochFor(key),\r\n'
            '        upserts: _reconciliationRecords(incoming),\r\n'
            '      ),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (commit != null) {\r\n'
            '      if (commit.contentChanged) {\r\n'
            '        _bumpMessageListRevisionFor(\r\n'
            '          key,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'public_realtime_writer_append\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        _markNeedsNotify(conversationID: key);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return commit;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final current = _mergedAliasMessageList(key);\r\n'
            '    return _messageCommitSnapshot(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: key,\r\n'
            '      storageKey: key,\r\n'
            '      list: current,\r\n'
            '      structureChanged: false,\r\n'
            '      contentChanged: false,\r\n'
            '      recordCommit: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Feed rows read an existing window without creating a chat projection,\r\n'
            '  /// sorting history, adding dividers, or allocating cache rows for cold chats.\r\n'
            '  V2TimMessage? getConversationPreviewMessage(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    final key = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final displayed = _messageListDisplayCache[key];\r\n'
            '    final raw = _messageListMap[key] ??\r\n'
            '        _messageListMap[conversationID] ??\r\n'
            '        _messageListMap[_normalizeConversationID(conversationID)];\r\n'
            '    if (displayed == null && (raw == null || raw.isEmpty)) return null;\r\n'
            '    // A custom list transform is authoritative. Until the chat has built that\r\n'
            '    // projection, retain the SDK conversation preview instead of guessing.\r\n'
            '    if (displayed == null && _lifeCycle?.messageListShouldMount != null) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final hidden = _inboundHiddenKeysByConv[_inboundStateKey(conversationID)];\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? newest;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in displayed ?? raw!) {\r\n'
            '      if (message.elemType == 0 ||\r\n'
            '          message.elemType == 11 ||\r\n'
            '          message.elemType == 101) continue;\r\n'
            '      if (displayed == null &&\r\n'
            '          ((hidden?.contains(messageDedupKey(message)) ?? false) ||\r\n'
            '              !(_lifeCycle?.messageShouldMount(message) ?? true))) continue;\r\n'
            '      if (newest == null || compareMessagesChronological(message, newest) > 0) {\r\n'
            '        newest = message;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return newest;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage>? getMessageList(String conversationID) {\r\n'
            '    // Every caller must share one display-cache row. During startup the\r\n'
            '    // conversation feed can pass both `c2c_<uid>` and the bare uid (and group\r\n'
            '    // callers can pass both `group_<id>` and the bare group id); looking up\r\n'
            '    // the cache with the raw argument creates duplicate projections and makes\r\n'
            '    // scrolling rebuild the same visible list repeatedly.\r\n'
            '    final displayKey = canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID).isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '        ? canonicalHistoryStorageKey(conversationID)\r\n'
            '        : conversationID.trim();\r\n'
            '    final cached = _messageListDisplayCache[displayKey];\r\n'
            '    if (cached != null) {\r\n'
            '      return cached;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convKey = _inboundStateKey(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    final hidden = _inboundHiddenKeysByConv[convKey];\r\n'
            '    final authoritative = _collectAuthoritativeMessages(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    // The Writer window is already newest-first. Hidden reveal rows may only\r\n'
            '    // defer a newest prefix; never leave a hole behind a newer visible row.\r\n'
            '    V2TimMessage? revealBoundary;\r\n'
            '    if (hidden?.isNotEmpty == true) {\r\n'
            '      for (final message in authoritative) {\r\n'
            '        if (!hidden!.contains(messageDedupKey(message))) {\r\n'
            '          revealBoundary = message;\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final visible = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    for (final message in authoritative.reversed) {\r\n'
            '      if (hidden?.contains(messageDedupKey(message)) == true &&\r\n'
            '          (revealBoundary == null ||\r\n'
            '              compareMessagesChronological(message, revealBoundary) > 0))\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      if (_lifeCycle?.messageShouldMount(message) ?? true) visible.add(message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final mounted = _lifeCycle?.messageListShouldMount(visible) ?? visible;\r\n'
            '    // Business transforms may reorder rows; ordinary SDK windows need neither\r\n'
            '    // a second sort nor a copied list for every projection rebuild.\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> chronological = mounted;\r\n'
            '    if (_lifeCycle?.messageListShouldMount != null ||\r\n'
            '        _lifeCycle?.messageShouldMount != null) {\r\n'
            '      for (var i = 1; i < mounted.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '        if (compareMessagesChronological(mounted[i - 1], mounted[i]) > 0) {\r\n'
            '          chronological = List<V2TimMessage>.from(mounted)\r\n'
            '            ..sort(compareMessagesChronological);\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final interval = chatConfig.timeDividerConfig?.timeInterval ?? 300;\r\n'
            '    final result = _ReversedMessageList(\r\n'
            '        attachTimeDividersForTesting(chronological, intervalSeconds: interval));\r\n'
            '    ChatMainThreadPerf.increment(\'message_display_projection_built\');\r\n'
            '    _messageListDisplayCache[displayKey] = result;\r\n'
            '    return result;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 无可见行高的消息不参与时间分割线锚点（否则会留下孤儿分割线）。\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static bool messageAnchorsTimeDivider(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.elemType == 11 || message.elemType == 101) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 与列表 item 一致：空群 tip 渲染为 SizedBox.shrink。\r\n'
            '    if (message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_GROUP_TIPS &&\r\n'
            '        message.groupTipsElem == null) {\r\n'

            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 按时间升序插入分割线，并去掉「后面没有真实消息」的孤儿分割线。\r\n'
            '  @visibleForTesting\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> attachTimeDividersForTesting(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> chronologicalAsc, {\r\n'
            '    int intervalSeconds = 300,\r\n'
            '  }) => attachTimeDividers(chronologicalAsc, intervalSeconds: intervalSeconds);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Shared divider layout for the SDK window and its business overlays.\r\n'
            '  static List<V2TimMessage> attachTimeDividers(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage> chronologicalAsc, {\r\n'
            '    int intervalSeconds = 300,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final listWithTimestamp = <V2TimMessage>[];\r\n'
            '    for (final item in chronologicalAsc) {\r\n'
            '      if (!messageAnchorsTimeDivider(item)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final lastAnchor = _lastTimeDividerAnchor(listWithTimestamp);\r\n'
            '      final crossesCalendarDay = lastAnchor?.timestamp != null &&\r\n'
            '          item.timestamp != null &&\r\n'
            '          _isDifferentCalendarDay(lastAnchor!.timestamp!, item.timestamp!);\r\n'
            '      final shouldInsertDivider = listWithTimestamp.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '          crossesCalendarDay ||\r\n'
            '          (lastAnchor?.timestamp != null &&\r\n'
            '              item.timestamp != null &&\r\n'
            '              item.timestamp! - lastAnchor!.timestamp! > intervalSeconds);\r\n'
            '      if (shouldInsertDivider) {\r\n'
            '        listWithTimestamp.add(_buildTimeDividerMessage(item.timestamp));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      listWithTimestamp.add(item);\r\n'

            '    return listWithTimestamp;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static bool _isDifferentCalendarDay(int firstTimestamp, int secondTimestamp) {\r\n'
            '    final first = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(firstTimestamp * 1000);\r\n'
            '    final second = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(secondTimestamp * 1000);\r\n'
            '    return first.year != second.year ||\r\n'
            '        first.month != second.month ||\r\n'
            '        first.day != second.day;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static V2TimMessage _buildTimeDividerMessage(int? timestamp) {\r\n'
            '    final ts = timestamp ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    final message = V2TimMessage.fromJson(<String, dynamic>{\r\n'

            '      \'message_msg_id\': \'time-divider-$ts\',\r\n'
            '      \'message_is_from_self\': false,\r\n'
            '      \'message_custom_str\': \'\',\r\n'
            '      \'message_risk_type_identified\': 0,\r\n'
            '      \'message_sender_group_member_info\': <String, dynamic>{},\r\n'
            '      \'message_group_at_user_array\': <String>[],\r\n'
            '      \'elem_type\': 11,\r\n'

            '    message.elemType = 11;\r\n'
            '    message.timestamp = ts;\r\n'
            '    message.msgID = \'time-divider-$ts\';\r\n'
            '    message.isSelf = false;\r\n'
            '    message.userID = \'\';\r\n'
            '    return message;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  static V2TimMessage? _lastTimeDividerAnchor(List<V2TimMessage> list) {\r\n'
            '    for (var i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 时间升序列表：去掉连续分割线，以及末尾无真实消息的分割线。\r\n'

            '        }\r\n'
            '        out.add(item);\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _resetHistoryOpenRevealGate({bool resetPainted = true}) {\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealReady = false;\r\n'

            '      _historyOpenRevealPainted = false;\r\n'

            '    _historyOpenRevealDeadlineMs = null;\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealWaitScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealStarveLogged = false;\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealMaxPostFrames = 2;\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealTimeoutMs = 120;\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealStableFrames = 0;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// prepare 后二次 begin 会抬 epoch；作废旧代际 ready / 采样并重跑稳定窗。\r\n'

            '    final epoch = ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.epochOf(_conversationId());\r\n'
            '    if (epoch == 0 || epoch == _layoutReadyEpochSeen) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final hadSigned =\r\n'
            '        _layoutReadyEpochSigned >= 0 && _layoutReadyEpochSigned != epoch;\r\n'
            '    final softResettle = !hadSigned &&\r\n'
            '        (_historyOpenRevealReady ||\r\n'
            '            _historyOpenRevealStableFrames > 0 ||\r\n'
            '            _historyOpenRevealHoldFrames > 0 ||\r\n'
            '            _historyOpenRevealMeasuredAtMs != null ||\r\n'
            '            _historyOpenRevealLongArmAtMs != null);\r\n'
            '    if (!hadSigned && !softResettle) {\r\n'
            '      _layoutReadyEpochSeen = epoch;\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '    ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'

            '        \'seen\': _layoutReadyEpochSeen,\r\n'

            '    _layoutReadyEpochSeen = epoch;\r\n'

            '    final shortCandidate =\r\n'
            '        ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled &&\r\n'

            '                _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 1 ||\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _historyOpenRevealWaitExpired() {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _revealCommitScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _commitHistoryOpenRevealReady({\r\n'
            '    required String source,\r\n'
            '    bool bridgeSignal = true,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (SchedulerBinding.instance.schedulerPhase ==\r\n'
            '        SchedulerPhase.persistentCallbacks) {\r\n'
            '      if (_revealCommitScheduled) return;\r\n'
            '      _revealCommitScheduled = true;\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '        _revealCommitScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '        setState(() {\r\n'
            '          _commitHistoryOpenRevealReady(\r\n'
            '            source: source,\r\n'
            '            bridgeSignal: bridgeSignal,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'

            '    final canReveal = ChatInitialWindowRevealPolicy.canReveal(\r\n'
            '      alreadyPainted: _historyOpenRevealPainted,\r\n'
            '      explicitPosition: _isOpeningPlaceholderSearchJump ||\r\n'
            '          widget.model.globalModel.hasLockedEntryUnreadFor(_conversationId()),\r\n'
            '      completeWindow: _isCompleteCachedOpenWindow(widget.model.globalModel) ||\r\n'
            '          (widget.messageList.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '              !_isInitialHistoryBootstrapping(widget.model.globalModel)),\r\n'
            '      // Any already available local message can be revealed after layout. The\r\n'
            '      // remaining history window is filled after the first frame and keeps its\r\n'
            '      // bottom anchor, so cloud completion does not hold the whole route.\r\n'
            '      hasMessages: widget.messageList.isNotEmpty,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (!canReveal) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final pipelineKey = ChatPipelineClock.normalizeKey(\r\n'
            '      rawConversationId: widget.conversation.conversationID,\r\n'
            '      userId: widget.conversation.userID,\r\n'
            '      groupId: widget.conversation.groupID,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final readyOffsetMs = ChatPipelineClock.instance.offsetMs(pipelineKey);\r\n'
            '    // ignore: avoid_print\r\n'
            '    if (ChatHistoryTrace.enabled) {\r\n'
            '      debugPrint(\r\n'
            '        \'[RevealTrace] reason=commit conv=$pipelineKey \'\r\n'
            '        \'source=$source \'\r\n'
            '        \'alreadyReady=$_historyOpenRevealReady \'\r\n'
            '        \'readyOffsetMs=$readyOffsetMs \'\r\n'
            '        \'bridgeSignal=$bridgeSignal \'\r\n'
            '        \'postFrames=$_historyOpenRevealPostFrameCount \'\r\n'
            '        \'msgCount=${widget.messageList.length}\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_historyOpenRevealReady) {\r\n'
            '      _historyOpenRevealPainted = true;\r\n'
            '      _scheduleOpeningPlaceholderDismiss(source: source);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final epoch = ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.epochOf(_conversationId());\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealReady = true;\r\n'
            '    // Jump while Opacity is still 0 so the first painted frame is already at\r\n'
            '    // the latest edge — otherwise smooth pin after reveal looks like content\r\n'
            '    // floating up from the bottom.\r\n'
            '    if (!_isOpeningPlaceholderSearchJump) {\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealPainted = true;\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealReadyAtMs = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    final isLongPath = source.startsWith(\'long_\');\r\n'
            '    ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '      \'history_open_reveal_ready\',\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'source\': source,\r\n'
            '        \'postFrames\': _historyOpenRevealPostFrameCount,\r\n'
            '        if (isLongPath) ...<String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'longStableFrames\': _historyOpenRevealLongStableFrames,\r\n'
            '          \'lastMaxExtent\': _historyOpenRevealLastMaxExtent,\r\n'
            '        } else ...<String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'stableFrames\': _historyOpenRevealStableFrames,\r\n'
            '          \'holdFrames\': _historyOpenRevealHoldFrames,\r\n'
            '          \'framesSinceMeasured\': _historyOpenRevealFramesSinceMeasured,\r\n'
            '          \'measured\': _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured,\r\n'
            '          \'latched\': _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '        \'openedWithCachedHistory\': _routeScroll.openedWithCachedHistory,\r\n'
            '        \'epoch\': epoch,\r\n'
            '        \'bridgeSignal\': bridgeSignal,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (bridgeSignal) {\r\n'
            '      _layoutReadyEpochSigned = epoch;\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryOpenLayoutReady.signal(_conversationId(), epoch: epoch);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _scheduleOpeningPlaceholderDismiss(source: \'history_open_reveal_$source\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _armHistoryOpenRevealWaitBudget({required bool shortHistory}) {\r\n'
            '    final pipelineKey = ChatPipelineClock.normalizeKey(\r\n'
            '      rawConversationId: widget.conversation.conversationID,\r\n'
            '      userId: widget.conversation.userID,\r\n'
            '      groupId: widget.conversation.groupID,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final armOffsetMs = ChatPipelineClock.instance.offsetMs(pipelineKey);\r\n'
            '    if (shortHistory) {\r\n'
            '      // 仅用于「测前」starve 诊断，绝不据此强制 reveal。\r\n'
            '      _historyOpenRevealMaxPostFrames = 45;\r\n'
            '      _historyOpenRevealTimeoutMs = 1500;\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      // 长历史：maxExtent 稳定 / 400ms 软超时，不再用 2 帧骗开整页。\r\n'
            '      _historyOpenRevealMaxPostFrames = 48;\r\n'
            '      _historyOpenRevealTimeoutMs = 400;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _historyOpenRevealDeadlineMs ??=\r\n'
            '        DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch + _historyOpenRevealTimeoutMs;\r\n'
            '    // ignore: avoid_print\r\n'
            '    if (ChatHistoryTrace.enabled) {\r\n'
            '      debugPrint(\r\n'
            '        \'[RevealTrace] reason=arm conv=$pipelineKey \'\r\n'
            '        \'shortHistory=$shortHistory \'\r\n'
            '        \'maxPostFrames=$_historyOpenRevealMaxPostFrames \'\r\n'
            '        \'timeoutMs=$_historyOpenRevealTimeoutMs \'\r\n'
            '        \'hardCapMs=1500 \'\r\n'
            '        \'armOffsetMs=$armOffsetMs \'\r\n'
            '        \'msgCount=${widget.messageList.length} \'\r\n'
            '        \'hasContentDimensions=${_singleScrollPositionOrNull()?.hasContentDimensions} \'\r\n'
            '        \'alreadyReady=$_historyOpenRevealReady\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // B1：post-frame 链中断保护 - 注册 100ms 周期的 watchdog 兜底定时器。\r\n'
            '    // 历史问题：链式 addPostFrameCallback 递归如果某次回调丢失，\r\n'

            '  bool get _shouldShowTopHistoryLoading {\r\n'

            '    // spinner competes with that action and makes the scroll feel blocked.\r\n'

            '  void _onInboundPresentationSupersede() {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Chunk layer cancelled this push to keep only the newest bubble. Snap open\r\n'

            '  void _abortViewportInsertSlideForSupersede() {\r\n'
            '    for (final controller in _shortInsertControllers.toList()) {\r\n'

            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushTicker?.stop();\r\n'
            '    _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'

            '      for (final message in _viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages.values) {\r\n'

            '    final convId = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position == null ||\r\n'

            '          \'towardHistory\': towardHistory,\r\n'
            '          \'towardLatest\': towardLatest,\r\n'
            '          \'scrollEnded\': scrollEnded,\r\n'

            '          \'pushActive\': _isLiveViewportPushActive(),\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isGeometryViewportTransitionActive(convId)) {\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (following) {\r\n'
            '      // 手指正在拖动时用户意图优先于收消息的自动上推：global 侧的 push 引用\r\n'

            '      final gestureOverridesPush =\r\n'

            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (_isLiveViewportPushActive() && !gestureOverridesPush) {\r\n'
            '        if (userIntent && distance > _followingLatestEpsilonPx) {\r\n'
            '          logBlocked(\'push_active\');\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!userIntent) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (distance <= BackToBottomCapsulePolicy.followExitThresholdPx) {\r\n'
            '        if (userIntent) {\r\n'
            '          logBlocked(\'within_follow_exit\');\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!towardHistory) {\r\n'
            '        logBlocked(\'not_toward_history\');\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      globalModel.setFollowingLatest(convId, false, notify: false);\r\n'
            '      widget.model.freezeVisibleHistoryWindowIfNeeded();\r\n'
            '      _logReadingHistoryIncoming(\'following_latest_leave\');\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '        action: \'leave\',\r\n'
            '        conv: convId,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'distance\': distance.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          \'towardHistory\': towardHistory,\r\n'
            '          \'dragActive\': dragActive,\r\n'
            '          \'pushActive\': _isLiveViewportPushActive(),\r\n'
            '          \'overrodePush\': gestureOverridesPush,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isLiveViewportPushActive()) {\r\n'
            '      logBlocked(\'push_active\');\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (position.outOfRange) {\r\n'
            '      if (scrollEnded) {\r\n'
            '        logBlocked(\'out_of_range\');\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final bufferedCount = globalModel.deferredIncomingBufferedCount(convId);\r\n'
            '    if (bufferedCount > 0) {\r\n'
            '      if (widget.model.haveMoreLatestData ||\r\n'
            '          globalModel.memoryWindowMissingNewer(convId) ||\r\n'
            '          widget.model.hasHistoryKnownTipMissing) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Keep a bounded batch ahead of an active drag/fling. A single row per\r\n'
            '      // layout-settle cycle cannot keep up with continuous finger movement:\r\n'
            '      // the reader repeatedly hits the temporary minimum scroll extent.\r\n'
            '      // Attachment is only preloading; unread progress still follows visible\r\n'
            '      // row bottoms. Idle readers retain the one-row staging policy.\r\n'
            '      if (globalModel.isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(convId)) {\r\n'
            '        // 点胶囊回底事务自己冲刷全部缓冲。\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'

            '      if (_paginationUi.isLoadingPrevious ||\r\n'

            '          logBlocked(\'still_away\');\r\n'

            '            final latestPosition = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'

            '            _syncFollowingLatestFromUserScroll(\r\n'
            '              userGesture: userGesture,\r\n'
            '              towardLatest: towardLatest,\r\n'
            '              scrollEnded: scrollEnded,\r\n'
            '              dragActive: dragActive,\r\n'
            '              anchorRetryFrames: anchorRetryFrames - 1,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '          });\r\n'

            '        }\r\n'

            '      }\r\n'
            '      _latchProgressiveNewestBoundary();\r\n'

            '          \'towardLatest\': towardLatest,\r\n'

            '    return false;\r\n'

            '\r\n'

            '  bool _shouldCompensateScrollForPagination() {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _captureIncomingScrollAnchor(TUIChatGlobalModel globalModel) {\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 渐进接缓冲的「跑道」：视口底边距列表底部小于该值时接下一条，让新行\r\n'
            '  /// 在用户滑到之前已经完成 layout；下限覆盖快速甩动时约两帧的位移。\r\n'
            '  double _bufferedRevealRunwayPx(ScrollPosition position) {\r\n'
            '    const minPx = HistoryMessageDartConstant.revealBufferedTowardLatestRunwayMinPx;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _latchProgressiveNewestBoundary({List<V2TimMessage?>? previousMessages}) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_hasLiveCenter &&\r\n'

            '          .firstOrNull;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// 标记一条缓冲等待布局，避免同一帧再接第二条；位置由真实行锚点补偿。\r\n'
            '  void _beginProgressiveRevealGrowth() {\r\n'
            '    _progressiveRevealGrowthPending = true;\r\n'
            '    final generation = ++_progressiveRevealGeneration;\r\n'

            '      generation,\r\n'
            '      _progressiveRevealGrowthMaxFrames,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleProgressiveRevealGrowthExpiry(int generation, int framesLeft) {\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _progressiveRevealGeneration ||\r\n'
            '          !_progressiveRevealGrowthPending) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'

            '        \'currentTop\': currentTop.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  void _clearPaginationRestoreAnchor() {\r\n'

            '  bool _wasPinnedNearTopForPagination({\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  ScrollPhysics? _buildHistoryScrollPhysics() {\r\n'
            '    if (widget.isAllowScroll == false) {\r\n'
            '      return const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = _chatGlobalModel ??\r\n'
            '        Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(context, listen: false);\r\n'
            '    // 全屏预览（尤其 opaque:false 下滑透出聊天）期间禁用列表滚动，\r\n'
            '    // 避免下滑关闭手势穿透把会话记录拖走。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.shouldLockChatScrollForMediaPreview) {\r\n'
            '      return const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 微信式长按菜单打开时，底层聊天列表不响应拖动；滚动只留给菜单自身\r\n'
            '    // 的长消息预览区域。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isMessageContextMenuOverlayOpen) {\r\n'
            '      return const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final configured = widget.mainHistoryListConfig?.physics;\r\n'
            '    return HistoryPaginationScrollPhysics(\r\n'
            '      parent: configured,\r\n'
            '      newestInsertAnchorCorrection: _correctNewestInsertFromVisibleAnchor,\r\n'
            '      shouldCompensate: _shouldCompensateScrollForPagination,\r\n'
            '      // Newer SDK pages insert at the minimum edge of the reverse list.\r\n'
            '      // Preserve the current rows before paint. Context-menu restoration\r\n'
            '      // still uses its separate identity anchor without this compensation.\r\n'
            '      // Search windows have a fixed sliver origin. Extent compensation here\r\n'
            '      // would apply a second movement on top of Flutter\'s native anchoring.\r\n'
            '      shouldPreserveNewestInsertExtent: _shouldPreserveNewestInsertExtent,\r\n'
            '      lastSeenMaxExtent: () => _lastPhysicsMaxExtentSeen,\r\n'
            '      onMaxExtentObserved: (value) => _lastPhysicsMaxExtentSeen = value,\r\n'
            '      newestInsertRoom: () {\r\n'
            '        if (_newestInsertRoom > 0 && _newestInsertRoomAtMs > 0) {\r\n'
            '          final ageMs =\r\n'
            '              DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - _newestInsertRoomAtMs;\r\n'
            '          if (ageMs > _newestInsertRoomTtlMs) {\r\n'
            '            ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '              action: \'newest_room_expire\',\r\n'
            '              conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '              extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '                \'dropped\': _newestInsertRoom.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '                \'ageMs\': ageMs,\r\n'
            '              },\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '            _newestInsertRoom = 0.0;\r\n'
            '            _newestInsertRoomAtMs = 0;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return _newestInsertRoom;\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      revealGrowthPending: () => _progressiveRevealGrowthPending,\r\n'
            '      onNewestInsertApplied: (applied) {\r\n'
            '        // 渐进接缓冲是一次性的：实测增长补偿完就关掉全额通道，避免把后续\r\n'
            '        // 无关的媒体撑高也算作这一条的高度。\r\n'
            '        if (_progressiveRevealGrowthPending && applied > 0.5) {\r\n'
            '          _clearProgressiveRevealGrowth(reason: \'applied\');\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        // 懒布局让整批插入的真实增长跨多帧到达。一次补偿就清零预算，会让\r\n'
            '        // 剩余增长在后续帧完全裸奔，净效果是视口被推到最新端。\r\n'
            '        _newestInsertRoom -= applied;\r\n'
            '        if (_newestInsertRoom <= 0.5) {\r\n'
            '          _newestInsertRoom = 0.0;\r\n'
            '          _newestInsertRoomAtMs = 0;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      pinnedNearTopTolerancePx: _loadPreviousTopNearPx,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldPreserveNewestInsertExtent() {\r\n'
            '    if (_progressiveRevealGrowthPending) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_newestInsertRoom > 0.5) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushActive ||\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_chatGlobalModel?.isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(_conversationId()) ??\r\n'
            '        false) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_chatGlobalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (widget.searchJumpAnchor != null ||\r\n'
            '        widget.initFindingMsg != null ||\r\n'
            '        _entryUnreadOrigin != null ||\r\n'
            '        _atJumpOrigin != null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_paginationUi.isLoadingLatest) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_deferUnreadCenterPartition) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  ScrollPosition? _singleScrollPositionOrNull() {\r\n'
            '    if (!_autoScrollController.hasClients) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_autoScrollController.positions.length == 1) {\r\n'
            '      return _autoScrollController.position;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    for (final position in _autoScrollController.positions) {\r\n'
            '      if (position.hasPixels && position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '        return position;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _autoScrollController.positions.isEmpty\r\n'

            '        : _autoScrollController.positions.first;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  ChatGeomSettleSnapshot? _captureGeomSettleSnapshot() {\r\n'

            '      pixels: position?.hasPixels == true ? position!.pixels : null,\r\n'

            '          ? position!.maxScrollExtent\r\n'

            '          ? position!.viewportDimension\r\n'

            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _geomJumpTo(double pixels, {required String reason}) {\r\n'
            '    _lastGeomJumpAttemptReason = reason;\r\n'
            '    _lastGeomJumpAttemptAtMs = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = _chatGlobalModel;\r\n'
            '    final menuTransactionActive = globalModel != null &&\r\n'
            '        (globalModel.isMessageContextMenuOverlayOpen ||\r\n'
            '            globalModel.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(_conversationId()));\r\n'
            '    final isMenuRestoreWrite = reason.contains(\'restoreContextMenuViewport\');\r\n'
            '    if (menuTransactionActive && !isMenuRestoreWrite) {\r\n'
            '      // Context-menu restore is the sole scroll writer while its transaction\r\n'
            '      // is active. Reject stale CVP/pin/spacer callbacks instead of letting a\r\n'
            '      // delayed producer seize the ScrollPosition after dismissal.\r\n'
            '      if (ChatHistoryTrace.enabled) {\r\n'
            '        debugPrint(\r\n'
            '          \'[MessageContextTrace] scroll_mutation_blocked \'\r\n'
            '          \'conv=${_conversationId()} reason=$reason\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_shouldCompensateScrollForPagination()) {\r\n'
            '      final nowMs = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '      if (nowMs - _lastPaginationScrollWriteLogMs >= 250) {\r\n'
            '        _lastPaginationScrollWriteLogMs = nowMs;\r\n'
            '        final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '        ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '          \'pagination_scroll_write\',\r\n'
            '          conversationID: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'reason\': reason,\r\n'
            '            \'beforePixels\': position?.hasPixels == true\r\n'
            '                ? position!.pixels.toStringAsFixed(1)\r\n'
            '                : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '            \'target\': pixels.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            \'axis\': position?.axisDirection.name,\r\n'
            '            \'userScrolling\': _userScrollGestureActive ||\r\n'
            '                (_chatGlobalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '      reason,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\'target\': pixels.toStringAsFixed(1)},\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // 「谁把视口推走了」的归因：offset_jump 只在跳变超阈值时记，且 physics\r\n'
            '    // 的绘制前补偿走另一条路，中间那些无归因的位移只能在写入点自报。\r\n'
            '    if (ChatJitterDiag.followingLatestEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      final writePosition = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '        action: \'geom_jump\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'reason\': reason,\r\n'
            '          \'before\': writePosition?.hasPixels == true\r\n'
            '              ? writePosition!.pixels.toStringAsFixed(1)\r\n'
            '              : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '          \'target\': pixels.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          \'minExtent\': writePosition?.hasContentDimensions == true\r\n'
            '              ? writePosition!.minScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(1)\r\n'
            '              : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '          \'maxExtent\': writePosition?.hasContentDimensions == true\r\n'
            '              ? writePosition!.maxScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(1)\r\n'
            '              : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _autoScrollController.jumpTo(pixels);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 非手势造成的 offset 突变探针：定位「谁把视口推走了」。\r\n'
            '  void _sampleOffsetJump(ScrollNotification notification) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatJitterDiag.followingLatestEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final metrics = notification.metrics;\r\n'
            '    if (!metrics.hasPixels || !metrics.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final dragging = notification is ScrollUpdateNotification &&\r\n'
            '        notification.dragDetails != null;\r\n'
            '    _sampleOffsetJumpGeometry(\r\n'
            '      pixels: metrics.pixels,\r\n'
            '      minExtent: metrics.minScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      maxExtent: metrics.maxScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      viewport: metrics.viewportDimension,\r\n'
            '      dragging: dragging,\r\n'
            '      source: \'scroll_update\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _sampleOffsetJumpGeometry({\r\n'
            '    required double pixels,\r\n'
            '    required double minExtent,\r\n'
            '    required double maxExtent,\r\n'
            '    required double viewport,\r\n'
            '    required bool dragging,\r\n'
            '    required String source,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatJitterDiag.followingLatestEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prevPixels = _lastOffsetSamplePixels;\r\n'
            '    final prevMinExtent = _lastOffsetSampleMinExtent;\r\n'
            '    final prevMaxExtent = _lastOffsetSampleMaxExtent;\r\n'
            '    // 基线必须无条件刷新：任何提前 return 都不能把上一次采样冻住，\r\n'
            '    // 否则 delta 会变成跨越数秒的累积值而不是单次跳变。\r\n'
            '    _lastOffsetSamplePixels = pixels;\r\n'
            '    _lastOffsetSampleMinExtent = minExtent;\r\n'
            '    _lastOffsetSampleMaxExtent = maxExtent;\r\n'
            '    if (prevPixels == null || prevMinExtent == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prevDistance = prevPixels - prevMinExtent;\r\n'
            '    final distance = pixels - minExtent;\r\n'
            '    final delta = distance - prevDistance;\r\n'
            '    if (delta.abs() <= _offsetJumpDiagThresholdPx) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (dragging) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 回底事务走 animateTo，不经过 _geomJumpTo，本来就要大幅移动。\r\n'
            '    if (_chatGlobalModel?.isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(_conversationId()) ??\r\n'
            '        false) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // CVP 推入新消息时的瞬时位移是设计中的中间态，list_push_start 另有记录。\r\n'
            '    if (_isLiveViewportPushActive()) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final nowMs = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '    final rawCount = _chatGlobalModel?.rawMessageCount(_conversationId());\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '      action: \'offset_jump\',\r\n'
            '      conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'source\': source,\r\n'
            '        \'prevPixels\': prevPixels.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'pixels\': pixels.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'prevMinExtent\': prevMinExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'minExtent\': minExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        if (prevMaxExtent != null)\r\n'
            '          \'prevMaxExtent\': prevMaxExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'maxExtent\': maxExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'viewport\': viewport.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'prevDistance\': prevDistance.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'distance\': distance.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'delta\': delta.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        if (rawCount != null) \'rawCount\': rawCount,\r\n'
            '        \'following\': _isFollowingLatest(),\r\n'
            '        \'userScrolling\': _chatGlobalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false,\r\n'
            '        if (_lastGeomJumpAttemptReason.isNotEmpty)\r\n'
            '          \'lastJumpAttempt\': _lastGeomJumpAttemptReason,\r\n'
            '        if (_lastGeomJumpAttemptAtMs > 0)\r\n'
            '          \'sinceJumpMs\': nowMs - _lastGeomJumpAttemptAtMs,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      throttleKey: \'offset_jump\',\r\n'
            '      minIntervalMs: 250,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 入站处理完后下一帧采样一次，捕获布局阶段（而非滚动事件）造成的位移。\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleOffsetJumpProbe() {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatJitterDiag.followingLatestEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '      if (position == null ||\r\n'
            '          !position.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '          !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _sampleOffsetJumpGeometry(\r\n'
            '        pixels: position.pixels,\r\n'
            '        minExtent: position.minScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '        maxExtent: position.maxScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '        viewport: position.viewportDimension,\r\n'
            '        dragging: false,\r\n'
            '        source: \'post_frame\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// center 划分点探针：未读数驱动的 unread/read 分界一移动，center 之前的\r\n'
            '  /// sliver 长度就变，框架会 correctPixels 把视口推走。\r\n'
            '  void _logCenterPartition({\r\n'
            '    required int rawTongue,\r\n'
            '    required bool locked,\r\n'
            '    required int unreadNew,\r\n'
            '    required bool tongueEnabled,\r\n'
            '    required int effectiveUnread,\r\n'
            '    required int loadedReal,\r\n'
            '    required int safeUnread,\r\n'
            '    required int layoutUnread,\r\n'
            '    required bool centerActive,\r\n'
            '    required bool isSearchJump,\r\n'
            '    required int unreadEndPoint,\r\n'
            '    required int unreadLen,\r\n'
            '    required int readLen,\r\n'
            '    required int msgLen,\r\n'

            '    // build 每帧都跑，只在划分点真的动了才记录。\r\n'
            '    if (layoutUnread == _lastCenterDiagLayoutUnread &&\r\n'
            '        unreadEndPoint == _lastCenterDiagUnreadEndPoint &&\r\n'

            '        centerActive == _lastCenterDiagCenterActive) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _lastCenterDiagLayoutUnread = layoutUnread;\r\n'
            '    _lastCenterDiagUnreadEndPoint = unreadEndPoint;\r\n'
            '    _lastCenterDiagUnreadLen = unreadLen;\r\n'
            '    _lastCenterDiagReadLen = readLen;\r\n'
            '    _lastCenterDiagCenterActive = centerActive;\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    final hasGeom = position != null &&\r\n'
            '        position.hasPixels &&\r\n'
            '        position.hasContentDimensions;\r\n'
            '    final received =\r\n'
            '        _chatGlobalModel?.receivedNewMessageCountFor(_conversationId());\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '      action: \'center_partition\',\r\n'
            '      conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'rawTongue\': rawTongue,\r\n'
            '        \'locked\': locked,\r\n'
            '        \'unreadNew\': unreadNew,\r\n'
            '        \'tongueEnabled\': tongueEnabled,\r\n'
            '        \'effectiveUnread\': effectiveUnread,\r\n'
            '        \'loadedReal\': loadedReal,\r\n'
            '        \'safeUnread\': safeUnread,\r\n'
            '        \'layoutUnread\': layoutUnread,\r\n'
            '        \'centerActive\': centerActive,\r\n'
            '        \'isSearchJump\': isSearchJump,\r\n'
            '        \'unreadEndPoint\': unreadEndPoint,\r\n'
            '        \'unreadLen\': unreadLen,\r\n'
            '        \'readLen\': readLen,\r\n'
            '        \'msgLen\': msgLen,\r\n'
            '        \'hasLiveCenter\': _hasLiveCenter,\r\n'
            '        \'deferPartition\': _deferUnreadCenterPartition,\r\n'
            '        \'following\': _isFollowingLatest(),\r\n'
            '        if (received != null) \'received\': received,\r\n'
            '        // build 跑在 layout 之前，这两个是上一帧的几何结果。\r\n'
            '        \'framePixels\': hasGeom ? position!.pixels.toStringAsFixed(1) : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '        \'frameMaxExtent\':\r\n'
            '            hasGeom ? position!.maxScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(1) : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '    int index, {\r\n'
            '    required String reason,\r\n'
            '    AutoScrollPosition preferPosition = AutoScrollPosition.middle,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '      reason,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'index\': index,\r\n'
            '        \'prefer\': preferPosition.toString(),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return _autoScrollController.scrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '      index,\r\n'
            '      preferPosition: preferPosition,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _assignShortHistorySpacer(double nextHeight, {required String reason}) {\r\n'
            '    var normalized = nextHeight <= 1 ? 0.0 : nextHeight;\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled &&\r\n'
            '        normalized > 0) {\r\n'
            '      ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '        \'short_history_spacer_blocked_top_align_disabled\',\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'reason\': reason,\r\n'
            '          \'blockedNext\': normalized.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      normalized = 0.0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prev = _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight;\r\n'
            '    final delta = (normalized - prev).abs();\r\n'
            '    if (_isPostRevealMicroSuppressWindow) {\r\n'
            '      final sinceReady = _msSinceHistoryOpenRevealReady();\r\n'
            '      final maxSuppressDelta = sinceReady < 200 ? 4.0 : 2.0;\r\n'
            '      if (delta <= maxSuppressDelta) {\r\n'
            '        ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '          \'spacer_micro_suppressed_post_reveal\',\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'prev\': prev.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            \'next\': normalized.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            \'delta\': (normalized - prev).toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            \'sinceReadyMs\': sinceReady,\r\n'
            '            \'maxDelta\': maxSuppressDelta,\r\n'
            '            \'reason\': reason,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '      reason,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'prev\': prev.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'next\': normalized.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'delta\': (normalized - prev).toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight = normalized;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _assignShortHistoryContentHeight(\r\n'
            '    double nextHeight, {\r\n'
            '    required String reason,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final normalized = nextHeight < 0 ? -1.0 : nextHeight;\r\n'
            '    final prev = _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight;\r\n'
            '    ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '      reason,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'prev\': prev.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'next\': normalized.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'delta\': (normalized - prev).toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight = normalized;\r\n'
            '    if (normalized < 0) {\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured = false;\r\n'
            '    } else if (reason == \'content_h_measure\' || reason == \'content_h_set\') {\r\n'
            '      final becameMeasured = !_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured;\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured = true;\r\n'
            '      if (becameMeasured) {\r\n'
            '        _onShortHistoryFirstMeasured();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else if (reason == \'content_h_prime_last_measured\') {\r\n'
            '      // 会话上次实测：视为已测 SSOT，禁止 _resolved* 用偏高估盖回（暖开 183→259）。\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _alignGlobalMessageIndexToViewportTop(\r\n'
            '    int targetGlobalIndex, {\r\n'
            '    Duration duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 220),\r\n'
            '    bool animate = true,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    return _jumpToFirstUnreadGlobalIndex(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  _FirstUnreadJumpFrameCheck? _checkFirstUnreadJumpFrame(\r\n'
            '    int targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final scrollIndex = -targetGlobalIndex;\r\n'
            '    final tagContext = _autoScrollController.tagMap[scrollIndex]?.context;\r\n'
            '    if (tagContext == null) {\r\n'
            '      return _FirstUnreadJumpFrameCheck.notReady(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final scrollable = Scrollable.maybeOf(tagContext);\r\n'
            '    if (scrollable == null) {\r\n'
            '      return _FirstUnreadJumpFrameCheck.notReady(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetRenderObject = tagContext.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '    final viewportRenderObject = scrollable.context.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '    if (targetRenderObject is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '        !targetRenderObject.attached ||\r\n'
            '        viewportRenderObject is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '        !viewportRenderObject.attached ||\r\n'
            '        !targetRenderObject.hasSize ||\r\n'
            '        !viewportRenderObject.hasSize ||\r\n'
            '        _renderObjectNeedsLayout(targetRenderObject) ||\r\n'
            '        _renderObjectNeedsLayout(viewportRenderObject)) {\r\n'
            '      return _FirstUnreadJumpFrameCheck.notReady(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final targetTop = targetRenderObject\r\n'
            '        .localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: viewportRenderObject)\r\n'
            '        .dy;\r\n'
            '    const tolerance = 12.0;\r\n'
            '    final targetPixels = RenderAbstractViewport.of(\r\n'
            '      targetRenderObject,\r\n'
            '    ).getOffsetToReveal(targetRenderObject, 0).offset;\r\n'
            '    return _FirstUnreadJumpFrameCheck(\r\n'
            '      targetGlobalIndex: targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '      isReady: true,\r\n'
            '      topDelta: targetTop,\r\n'
            '      tolerance: tolerance,\r\n'
            '      targetPixels: targetPixels,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _correctFirstUnreadJumpToTop(int targetGlobalIndex) async {\r\n'
            '    final check = _checkFirstUnreadJumpFrame(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    if (check == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!check.isReady) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '          -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '          preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.begin,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'scroll_to_index_begin\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (check.isTopAligned) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position == null ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '          -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '          preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.begin,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'scroll_to_index_begin\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetPixels = check.targetPixels?.clamp(\r\n'
            '      position.minScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      position.maxScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (targetPixels == null) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '          -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '          preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.begin,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'scroll_to_index_begin\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if ((position.pixels - targetPixels).abs() <= 0.5) {\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '          -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '          preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.begin,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'scroll_to_index_begin\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _geomJumpTo(targetPixels.toDouble(), reason: \'first_unread_jump_pixels\');\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _stabilizeFirstUnreadJumpTarget(int targetGlobalIndex) async {\r\n'
            '    var stableFrames = 0;\r\n'
            '    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {\r\n'
            '      _lockSearchJumpStabilization(milliseconds: 4000);\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.scheduleFrame();\r\n'
            '      await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame;\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final corrected = await _correctFirstUnreadJumpToTop(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (corrected) {\r\n'
            '        stableFrames++;\r\n'
            '        if (stableFrames >= 3) {\r\n'
            '          return true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        stableFrames = 0;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Verify consecutive rendered layouts, not 60ms wall-clock samples.\r\n'
            '      // Three stable frames remain required before removing the retained view.\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final finalCheck = _checkFirstUnreadJumpFrame(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    return finalCheck?.isTopAligned ?? false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _jumpToFirstUnreadGlobalIndex(int targetGlobalIndex) async {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || targetGlobalIndex < 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_scrollMetricsReady()) {\r\n'
            '      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 80));\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted || !_scrollMetricsReady()) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _lockSearchJumpStabilization(milliseconds: 4000);\r\n'
            '    _paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious += 2;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 12; attempt++) {\r\n'
            '        try {\r\n'
            '          await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '            -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '            preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.begin,\r\n'
            '            reason: \'scroll_to_index_begin\',\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        } catch (_) {}\r\n'
            '        await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame;\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '          return false;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final check = _checkFirstUnreadJumpFrame(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '        if (check?.isReady == true) {\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 50));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      return _stabilizeFirstUnreadJumpTarget(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    } finally {\r\n'
            '      Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 700), () {\r\n'
            '        if (mounted && _paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious >= 2) {\r\n'
            '          _paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious -= 2;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleUnreadTongueMetricsUpdate(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    int safeUnreadCount, {\r\n'
            '    bool force = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(context, listen: false);\r\n'
            '    final convId = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    if (force) {\r\n'
            '      _unreadTongueMetricsThrottleTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '      _unreadTongueMetricsThrottleTimer = null;\r\n'
            '      _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList = null;\r\n'
            '      _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount = 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (safeUnreadCount <= 0 || messageList.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _unreadTongueMetricsThrottleTimer?.cancel();\r\n'
            '      _unreadTongueMetricsThrottleTimer = null;\r\n'
            '      _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList = null;\r\n'
            '      _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount = 0;\r\n'
            '      if (globalModel.hasLockedEntryUnreadFor(convId)) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _lastUnreadTongueConversationID = null;\r\n'
            '      _lastUnreadTongueRemaining = null;\r\n'
            '      _lastUnreadTongueSafeCount = 0;\r\n'
            '      globalModel.clearUnreadTongueMetrics(convId, notify: true);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!force &&\r\n'
            '        (globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling || _userScrollGestureActive)) {\r\n'
            '      final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '      final waitMs = _scrollingUnreadTongueMetricsThrottleMs -\r\n'
            '          (now - _lastUnreadTongueMetricsRunAtMs);\r\n'
            '      if (waitMs > 0) {\r\n'
            '        _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList = messageList;\r\n'
            '        _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount = safeUnreadCount;\r\n'
            '        _unreadTongueMetricsThrottleTimer ??= Timer(\r\n'
            '          Duration(milliseconds: waitMs),\r\n'
            '          () {\r\n'
            '            _unreadTongueMetricsThrottleTimer = null;\r\n'
            '            if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '              return;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            final pendingList = _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList;\r\n'
            '            final pendingSafeCount = _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount;\r\n'
            '            _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList = null;\r\n'
            '            _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount = 0;\r\n'
            '            if (pendingList == null || pendingSafeCount <= 0) {\r\n'
            '              return;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            _enqueueUnreadTongueMetricsPostFrame(pendingList, pendingSafeCount);\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _enqueueUnreadTongueMetricsPostFrame(\r\n'
            '      messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _enqueueUnreadTongueMetricsPostFrame(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList = messageList;\r\n'
            '    _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount = safeUnreadCount;\r\n'
            '    if (_unreadTongueMetricsScheduled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _unreadTongueMetricsScheduled = true;\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      _unreadTongueMetricsScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final snapshot = _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList ?? messageList;\r\n'
            '      final count = _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount;\r\n'
            '      _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsList = null;\r\n'
            '      _pendingUnreadTongueMetricsSafeCount = 0;\r\n'
            '      _lastUnreadTongueMetricsRunAtMs = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\r\n'
            '      if (count <= 0 || snapshot.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _updateUnreadTongueMetrics(snapshot, count);\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _updateUnreadTongueMetrics(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || safeUnreadCount <= 0 || messageList.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 已点过入口未读并跳走：不再用入口未读数刷右下角「新消息」胶囊。\r\n'
            '    // 翻历史时的 live 计数仍要更新，否则数字会停住。\r\n'
            '    if (_firstUnreadAnchorJumped && _isFollowingLatest()) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position == null ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(context, listen: false);\r\n'
            '    final convId = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    final nearLatest = position.pixels <= position.minScrollExtent + 24;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (nearLatest &&\r\n'
            '        safeUnreadCount > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        !_firstUnreadAnchorJumped &&\r\n'
            '        globalModel.getMessageListPosition(convId) ==\r\n'
            '            HistoryMessagePosition.bottom) {\r\n'
            '      _commitUnreadTongueMetrics(\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '        remaining: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '        below: false,\r\n'
            '        safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (_hasLiveCenter) {\r\n'
            '      _commitUnreadTongueMetrics(\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '        remaining: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '        below: true,\r\n'
            '        safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final viewportHeight = position.viewportDimension;\r\n'
            '    var realUnreadOrdinal = 0;\r\n'
            '    var builtAnyUnread = false;\r\n'
            '    var allBuiltUnreadBelowViewport = true;\r\n'
            '    var allBuiltUnreadAboveViewport = true;\r\n'
            '    int? oldestVisibleUnreadOrdinal;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0;\r\n'
            '        i < messageList.length && realUnreadOrdinal < safeUnreadCount;\r\n'
            '        i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = messageList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (!_isUnreadAnchorMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final ordinalFromNewest = realUnreadOrdinal;\r\n'
            '      realUnreadOrdinal++;\r\n'
            '      final tagContext = _autoScrollController.tagMap[-i]?.context;\r\n'
            '      final renderObject = tagContext?.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '      if (tagContext == null ||\r\n'
            '          renderObject is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '          !renderObject.attached) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final viewport = RenderAbstractViewport.of(renderObject);\r\n'
            '      if (viewport is! RenderBox || !viewport.attached) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final leadingOffset =\r\n'
            '          renderObject.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: viewport).dy;\r\n'
            '      final trailingOffset = leadingOffset + renderObject.size.height;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      builtAnyUnread = true;\r\n'
            '      if (leadingOffset <= viewportHeight + 4) {\r\n'
            '        allBuiltUnreadBelowViewport = false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (trailingOffset >= -4) {\r\n'
            '        allBuiltUnreadAboveViewport = false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final isVisible =\r\n'
            '          trailingOffset >= -4 && leadingOffset <= viewportHeight + 4;\r\n'
            '      if (isVisible) {\r\n'
            '        if (oldestVisibleUnreadOrdinal == null ||\r\n'
            '            ordinalFromNewest > oldestVisibleUnreadOrdinal) {\r\n'
            '          oldestVisibleUnreadOrdinal = ordinalFromNewest;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (!builtAnyUnread) {\r\n'
            '      // Lazy slivers may have none of the unread rows mounted. Preserve a\r\n'
            '      // deterministic count instead of retaining stale metrics indefinitely.\r\n'
            '      _commitUnreadTongueMetrics(\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '        remaining: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '        below: !nearLatest,\r\n'
            '        safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (oldestVisibleUnreadOrdinal != null) {\r\n'
            '      // messageList is newest -> oldest. At the first unread anchor, the\r\n'
            '      // oldest visible unread ordinal is safeUnreadCount - 1, so the capsule\r\n'
            '      // shows the full unread count. When the user scrolls down toward the\r\n'
            '      // latest message, the ordinal becomes smaller and the count decreases.\r\n'
            '      _commitUnreadTongueMetrics(\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '        remaining: oldestVisibleUnreadOrdinal + 1,\r\n'
            '        below: true,\r\n'
            '        safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (allBuiltUnreadBelowViewport) {\r\n'
            '      _commitUnreadTongueMetrics(\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '        remaining: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '        below: true,\r\n'
            '        safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _visibleIncomingProgressScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '  bool _visibleIncomingProgressInFlight = false;\r\n'
            '  String? _visibleIncomingProgressSignature;\r\n'
            '  String? _visibleIncomingProgressConversation;\r\n'
            '  TUIChatSeparateViewModel? _visibleIncomingProgressModel;\r\n'
            '  bool Function()? _visibleIncomingProgressFence;\r\n'
            '  final Map<String, V2TimMessage> _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress = {};\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleVisibleIncomingProgress() {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || _visibleIncomingProgressScheduled) return;\r\n'
            '    _visibleIncomingProgressScheduled = true;\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      _visibleIncomingProgressScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\r\n'
            '      final model = widget.model;\r\n'
            '      final global = model.globalModel;\r\n'
            '      final conv = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '      if (_visibleIncomingProgressConversation != conv ||\r\n'
            '          !identical(_visibleIncomingProgressModel, model) ||\r\n'
            '          _visibleIncomingProgressFence?.call() != true) {\r\n'
            '        _visibleIncomingProgressConversation = conv;\r\n'
            '        _visibleIncomingProgressModel = model;\r\n'

            '        _visibleIncomingProgressSignature = null;\r\n'
            '        _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress.clear();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Loading a page is not a read. A measured visible row can settle an\r\n'
            '      // identity while reading history, independently of FOLLOW.\r\n'
            '      if (global.isGeometryViewportTransitionActive(conv) ||\r\n'
            '          (global.receivedNewMessageCountFor(conv) <= 0 &&\r\n'
            '              global.remainingLiveIncomingCountFor(conv) <= 0) ||\r\n'

            '          _isSearchJumpStabilizing ||\r\n'
            '          model.isLoadingChatHistory ||\r\n'
            '          _historyWindowTrimUi.isBusy ||\r\n'
            '          _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive ||\r\n'
            '          global.isMessageContextMenuOverlayOpen ||\r\n'
            '          global.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(conv) ||\r\n'
            '          global.shouldLockChatScrollForMediaPreview ||\r\n'
            '          global.hasPendingScrollRestore(conv) ||\r\n'
            '          global.isRestoringScrollAfterMediaPreview ||\r\n'
            '          global.isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(conv)) return;\r\n'
            '      final messages = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '      int? readingEdge;\r\n'
            '      for (var index = 0; index < messages.length; index++) {\r\n'
            '        final message = messages[index];\r\n'
            '        if (message == null || message.elemType == 11) continue;\r\n'
            '        final tag = _autoScrollController.tagMap[-index];\r\n'
            '        final rowContext = tag?.context;\r\n'
            '        if (rowContext == null ||\r\n'
            '            tag?.widget.key != ValueKey<String>(\r\n'
            '                _stableMessageListKey(message, index))) continue;\r\n'
            '        final row = rowContext.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '        final viewport = _viewportRenderBoxFor(rowContext);\r\n'
            '        if (row is! RenderBox || viewport == null || !row.attached ||\r\n'
            '            !row.hasSize || row.size.height <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '            _renderObjectNeedsLayout(row)) continue;\r\n'
            '        final top = row.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: viewport).dy;\r\n'
            '        final bottom = top + row.size.height;\r\n'
            '        // A long message is crossed once its bottom has entered the viewport.\r\n'
