            '      // A fast drag can cross several rows in one frame. Only rows behind this\r\n'
            '      // measured edge in the connected window qualify, never the prefetched\r\n'
            '      // newer rows still below it. Exact IDs keep arrival order independent.\r\n'
            '      for (final message in messages.skip(readingEdge).whereType<V2TimMessage>()) {\r\n'
            '        if (message.elemType == 11) continue;\r\n'
            '        final id = (message.msgID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '            ? message.msgID!.trim() : message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '        if (id.isNotEmpty) _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress[id] = message;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _drainVisibleIncomingProgress();\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _drainVisibleIncomingProgress() {\r\n'
            '    if (_visibleIncomingProgressInFlight ||\r\n'
            '        _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress.isEmpty || !mounted) return;\r\n'
            '    final model = widget.model;\r\n'
            '    final conv = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    final fence = _visibleIncomingProgressFence;\r\n'
            '    bool sameProofOwner() => mounted && identical(widget.model, model) &&\r\n'
            '        _conversationId() == conv &&\r\n'
            '        identical(_visibleIncomingProgressFence, fence) && fence?.call() == true;\r\n'
            '    bool current() => sameProofOwner() &&\r\n'
            '        ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent != false;\r\n'
            '    if (!current()) return;\r\n'
            '    _visibleIncomingProgressInFlight = true;\r\n'
            '    var failed = false;\r\n'
            '    unawaited(() async {\r\n'
            '      List<V2TimMessage> batch = const [];\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        while (current() && _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          batch = _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress.values.take(120).toList();\r\n'
            '          for (final message in batch) {\r\n'
            '            final id = (message.msgID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '                ? message.msgID!.trim() : message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '            _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress.remove(id);\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          final consumed = await model.globalModel.acknowledgeVisibleHistoryMessages(\r\n'
            '              conv, batch, isCurrent: current);\r\n'
            '          if (!consumed && sameProofOwner()) {\r\n'
            '            _visibleIncomingProgressSignature = null;\r\n'
            '            if (!current()) {\r\n'
            '              for (final message in batch) {\r\n'
            '                final id = (message.msgID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '                    ? message.msgID!.trim() : message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '                _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress[id] = message;\r\n'
            '              }\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          batch = const [];\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        failed = true;\r\n'
            '        if (sameProofOwner()) {\r\n'
            '          // Keep crossed identities for a later retry even if the viewport has\r\n'
            '          // since moved past them. Do not retry a failed write in a tight loop.\r\n'
            '          _visibleIncomingProgressSignature = null;\r\n'
            '          for (final message in batch) {\r\n'
            '            final id = (message.msgID?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)\r\n'
            '                ? message.msgID!.trim() : message.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '            _pendingVisibleIncomingProgress[id] = message;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } finally {\r\n'
            '        _visibleIncomingProgressInFlight = false;\r\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '          _scheduleVisibleLatestConfirmation();\r\n'
            '          _scheduleLiveCenterRelease();\r\n'
            '          if (_pendingVisibleIncomingProgress.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '              (!failed || !sameProofOwner())) {\r\n'
            '            if (current()) {\r\n'
            '              _drainVisibleIncomingProgress();\r\n'
            '            } else {\r\n'
            '              // A new visit may have queued its own proof while this write\r\n'
            '              // was finishing. Let a fresh sampler validate and wake it.\r\n'
            '              _scheduleVisibleIncomingProgress();\r\n'
            '              WidgetsBinding.instance.scheduleFrame();\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }());\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    final conv = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    if (global.remainingLiveIncomingCountFor(conv) <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '        ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == false ||\r\n'
            '        global.isMessageContextMenuOverlayOpen ||\r\n'

            '  /// didUpdateWidget 里、本帧 build 前调用：新行以 progress=0 进树，避免全高闪一帧。\r\n'

            '  void _silentAbsorbExtentDelta(double delta) {\r\n'
            '    final model = _chatGlobalModel;\r\n'

            '    if (delta.abs() < 0.5) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '    if (model?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'

            '      _finishContinuousViewportPush(reachedBottom: false);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final previousElapsed = _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushLastElapsed;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushLastElapsed = elapsed;\r\n'
            '    if (previousElapsed == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final elapsedMicros = (elapsed - previousElapsed).inMicroseconds.clamp(\r\n'
            '          0,\r\n'
            '          50000,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '    final pendingRows =\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushRemainingRowExtents.length +\r\n'
            '            _viewportInsert.queuedViewportInsertMessages.length;\r\n'
            '    // Once all measured rows have been integrated there is no viewport work\r\n'
            '    // left for the ticker.  Keeping the ticker alive here causes an idle chat\r\n'
            '    // page to schedule a frame on every vsync (and repeatedly flush layout,\r\n'
            '    // paint and semantics).  The integration callback will start it again\r\n'
            '    // when a new batch is queued.\r\n'
            '    if (pendingRows == 0 &&\r\n'
            '        !_viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushIntegrationScheduled) {\r\n'
            '      _finishContinuousViewportPush(reachedBottom: false);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final distance = max(0.0, position.pixels - position.minScrollExtent);\r\n'
            '    final travel = distance * _viewportInsert.motion.consumeFraction(\r\n'
            '      elapsed,\r\n'
            '      disableAnimations: MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final speed = elapsedMicros > 0 ? travel * 1000000 / elapsedMicros : 0.0;\r\n'
            '    final pixelsBefore = position.pixels;\r\n'
            '    final externalDrift =\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushLastCommandedPixels == null\r\n'
            '            ? 0.0\r\n'
            '            : pixelsBefore -\r\n'
            '                _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushLastCommandedPixels!;\r\n'
            '    final target = max(\r\n'
            '      position.minScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      position.pixels - travel,\r\n'
            '    ).toDouble();\r\n'
            '    if ((position.pixels - target).abs() > 0.1) {\r\n'
            '      _geomJumpTo(target, reason: \'cvp_tick\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final pixelsAfter =\r\n'
            '        _singleScrollPositionOrNull()?.pixels ?? position.pixels;\r\n'
            '    final actualTravel = pixelsBefore - pixelsAfter;\r\n'
            '    _consumeContinuousViewportPushTravel(actualTravel);\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushLastCommandedPixels = pixelsAfter;\r\n'
            '    final reachedBottom = (pixelsAfter - position.minScrollExtent).abs() <= 0.5;\r\n'
            '    final frame = ++_viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushDiagFrame;\r\n'
            '    // debugPrint 会在 UI isolate 上格式化并节流。120Hz 下逐帧记录会反过来制造\r\n'
            '    // 动画卡顿；仅保留起始帧、每 15 帧采样、异常漂移和结束帧。\r\n'
            '    final shouldLogTick = frame <= 3 ||\r\n'
            '        frame % 15 == 0 ||\r\n'
            '        externalDrift.abs() > 0.5 ||\r\n'
            '        reachedBottom;\r\n'
            '    if (shouldLogTick) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '        action: \'cvp_tick\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'cvpTx\': _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushDiagTransaction,\r\n'
            '          \'tick\': frame,\r\n'
            '          \'elapsedUs\': elapsedMicros,\r\n'
            '          \'pendingRows\': pendingRows,\r\n'
            '          \'speed\': speed.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          \'requestedTravel\': travel.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'pixelsBefore\': pixelsBefore.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'target\': target.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'pixelsAfter\': pixelsAfter.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'actualTravel\': actualTravel.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'externalDriftSinceLastTick\': externalDrift.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'min\': position.minScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'max\': position.maxScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'viewport\': position.viewportDimension.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '          \'queued\': _viewportInsert.queuedViewportInsertMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          \'integrationScheduled\':\r\n'
            '              _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushIntegrationScheduled,\r\n'
            '          \'outOfRange\': position.outOfRange,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (reachedBottom &&\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.queuedViewportInsertMessages.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !_viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushIntegrationScheduled) {\r\n'
            '      _finishContinuousViewportPush(reachedBottom: true);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _finishContinuousViewportPush({\r\n'
            '    required bool reachedBottom,\r\n'
            '    bool forcePinOnMiss = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushActive) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushTicker?.stop();\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushLastElapsed = null;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushLastCommandedPixels = null;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushActive = false;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = false;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushIntegrationScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushInitialLayoutUntilMsByKey.clear();\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushRemainingRowExtents.clear();\r\n'
            '    ++_viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushIntegrationGeneration;\r\n'
            '    _beginViewportInsertSettle();\r\n'
            '    _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '    if (_viewportInsert.queuedViewportInsertMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final pending = List<V2TimMessage>.from(\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.queuedViewportInsertMessages.values,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(pending);\r\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '        setState(() {});\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = _chatGlobalModel;\r\n'
            '    final shouldForcePinOnMiss = forcePinOnMiss &&\r\n'
            '        !reachedBottom &&\r\n'
            '        mounted &&\r\n'
            '        !(globalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false);\r\n'
            '    if (reachedBottom && globalModel != null) {\r\n'
            '      globalModel.setMessageListPosition(\r\n'
            '        _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        HistoryMessagePosition.bottom,\r\n'
            '        notify: false,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } else if (globalModel != null && !shouldForcePinOnMiss) {\r\n'
            '      final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '      if (position != null &&\r\n'
            '          position.hasPixels &&\r\n'
            '          position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '        final distance = position.pixels - position.minScrollExtent;\r\n'
            '        final nextPosition = position.viewportDimension > 0 &&\r\n'
            '                distance > position.viewportDimension\r\n'
            '            ? HistoryMessagePosition.awayTwoScreen\r\n'
            '            : HistoryMessagePosition.inTwoScreen;\r\n'
            '        globalModel.setMessageListPosition(\r\n'
            '          _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          nextPosition,\r\n'
            '          notify: false,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (nextPosition == HistoryMessagePosition.awayTwoScreen) {\r\n'
            '          // correctBy 是静默修正，不会产生 ScrollNotification。爆发冻结后补发一次\r\n'
            '          // 同位置通知，让 tongue 立即按“一屏外”状态显示回到底部入口。\r\n'
            '          WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '            if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '              return;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            final settledPosition = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '            if (settledPosition != null && settledPosition.hasPixels) {\r\n'
            '              _geomJumpTo(\r\n'
            '                settledPosition.pixels,\r\n'
            '                reason: \'jump__finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal\',\r\n'
            '              );\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          });\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _endInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '      action: \'continuous_viewport_push_end\',\r\n'
            '      conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'cvpTx\': _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushDiagTransaction,\r\n'
            '        \'ticks\': _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushDiagFrame,\r\n'
            '        \'reachedBottom\': reachedBottom,\r\n'
            '        \'forcePinOnMiss\': shouldForcePinOnMiss,\r\n'
            '        \'queued\': _viewportInsert.queuedViewportInsertMessages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'pixels\': _singleScrollPositionOrNull()?.pixels.toStringAsFixed(2),\r\n'
            '        \'min\': _singleScrollPositionOrNull()?.minScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(\r\n'
            '              2,\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '        \'max\': _singleScrollPositionOrNull()?.maxScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(\r\n'
            '              2,\r\n'
            '            ),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (shouldForcePinOnMiss) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '        action: \'cvp_measure_miss_force_pin\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'cvpTx\': _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushDiagTransaction,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(ignoreInsertWindows: true);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _startWechatViewportInsertSlide(List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'
            '    if (_viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive) {\r\n'
            '      _queueViewportInsertMessages(messages);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final controller = _viewportInsert.rowRevealController;\r\n'
            '    final beforePosition = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (messages.isEmpty ||\r\n'
            '        controller == null ||\r\n'
            '        beforePosition == null ||\r\n'
            '        !beforePosition.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '        !beforePosition.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(messages);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 发送会同时 requestPinToBottom(force)。先消费掉这次 pin，避免\r\n'
            '    // cancel 之后又被 _onPinToBottomRequested 重新 schedule，和上推动画抢滚。\r\n'
            '    final pinModel = _chatGlobalModel ??\r\n'
            '        (mounted\r\n'
            '            ? Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(context, listen: false)\r\n'
            '            : null);\r\n'
            '    if (pinModel != null) {\r\n'
            '      _lastHandledPinSeq = pinModel.pinToBottomRequestSeq;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 上推会短暂 jump 离底；先锁贴底语义，避免右侧「回到底部」闪一下。\r\n'
            '    _beginInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // Build 前零高：本帧不把旧消息顶走。\r\n'
            '    _armZeroHeightViewportInsert(messages);\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final oldPixels = beforePosition.pixels;\r\n'
            '    final oldMaxScrollExtent = beforePosition.maxScrollExtent;\r\n'
            '    final generation = ++_viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideGeneration;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = true;\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '      action: \'viewport_slide_schedule\',\r\n'
            '      conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'rows\': messages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'pixels\': oldPixels.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'minExtent\': beforePosition.minScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'maxExtent\': oldMaxScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'armedZeroHeight\': true,\r\n'
            '        \'hasOutgoing\': messages.any((m) => m.isSelf == true),\r\n'
            '        \'mode\': \'viewport_scroll\',\r\n'
            '        \'generation\': generation,\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) async {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideGeneration) {\r\n'
            '        // 被更新一轮覆盖时，由新一代持有锁；勿 end 掉新锁。\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      var position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '      if (position == null ||\r\n'
            '          !position.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '          !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = false;\r\n'
            '        _releaseArmedViewportInsertReveal();\r\n'
            '        _endInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      if (_chatGlobalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false) {\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = false;\r\n'
            '        _releaseArmedViewportInsertReveal();\r\n'
            '        _endInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final cachedExtent = _cachedInsertedExtent(messages);\r\n'
            '      final estimatedExtent = _estimatedInsertedExtent(messages);\r\n'
            '      var chosenExtent = (cachedExtent != null && cachedExtent > 0)\r\n'
            '          ? cachedExtent\r\n'
            '          : estimatedExtent;\r\n'
            '      if (chosenExtent <= 0.5) {\r\n'
            '        chosenExtent = _shortHistoryMessageEstimatedRowHeight;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final viewportHeight = position.viewportDimension;\r\n'
            '      // 能否补偿要看「展开后」的可滚空间。旧逻辑用展开前 maxScrollExtent：\r\n'
            '      // 当气泡高度 > 当前剩余可滚高度时会误判 no_scroll_room → grow，\r\n'
            '      // 整段可见历史会被 SizeTransition 一起顶走。\r\n'
            '      // 列表已可滚（oldMax > 0）时，expand 后 max 大约 +chosenExtent，应走 atomic。\r\n'
            '      // 仅短列表（内容未铺满视口、max≈0）才走零→满 grow。\r\n'
            '      final canCompensateJump = oldMaxScrollExtent > 0.5 &&\r\n'
            '          (oldPixels + chosenExtent) > position.minScrollExtent + 0.5;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      // 短列表无滚动空间：收/发都走零→满 grow，直接从底部顶起。\r\n'
            '      // 有空间时收/发统一走下方 atomic（expand 后同帧实测 jump + animateTo），\r\n'
            '      // 不再把发送单独拆成 grow，否则观感会分叉。\r\n'
            '      if (!canCompensateJump) {\r\n'
            '        final durationMs = _listPushDurationMs(\r\n'
            '          motionExtent: chosenExtent,\r\n'
            '          viewportHeight: viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '          outgoing: messages.every((message) => message.isSelf == true),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '          action: \'viewport_slide_start\',\r\n'
            '          conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'rows\': messages.length,\r\n'
            '            \'chosenExtent\': chosenExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            \'durationMs\': durationMs,\r\n'
            '            \'mode\': \'row_reveal_grow\',\r\n'
            '            \'reason\': \'no_scroll_room\',\r\n'
            '            \'hasOutgoing\': messages.any((m) => m.isSelf == true),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        controller.duration = Duration(milliseconds: durationMs);\r\n'
            '        try {\r\n'
            '          await controller.forward(from: 0);\r\n'
            '        } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        } finally {\r\n'
            '          if (mounted &&\r\n'
            '              generation == _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideGeneration) {\r\n'
            '            _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = false;\r\n'
            '            _beginViewportInsertSettle();\r\n'
            '            // 收尾仍保持一段 absorb 窗，避免 grow 结束后二次 layout 再 pin 顶历史。\r\n'
            '            _beginMediaSettleForMessages(messages, holdMs: 900);\r\n'
            '            _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '            if (_viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '              _releaseArmedViewportInsertReveal();\r\n'
            '            } else {\r\n'
            '              _acknowledgeInboundProjectionRevealIfNeeded();\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '            _drainQueuedViewportInsertMessages();\r\n'
            '            _endInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '            ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '              action: \'viewport_slide_end\',\r\n'
            '              conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '              extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '                \'mode\': \'row_reveal_grow\',\r\n'
            '                \'generation\': generation,\r\n'
            '              },\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      // 收/发统一：撑满后 flushLayout 用实测高度 jump，再 animateTo 从底部上推。\r\n'
            '      _expandArmedViewportInsertToFullHeight();\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        RendererBinding.instance.pipelineOwner.flushLayout();\r\n'
            '      } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '        // Layout pipeline may be unavailable in rare teardown races.\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '      if (position == null ||\r\n'
            '          !position.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '          !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = false;\r\n'
            '        _releaseArmedViewportInsertReveal();\r\n'
            '        _endInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final measuredExtent = max(\r\n'
            '        0.0,\r\n'
            '        position.maxScrollExtent - oldMaxScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      // 补偿只能使用真实 layout 高度。预估偏大时 jump 会把历史向下拉一帧，\r\n'
            '      // 随后的 animateTo 又向上推，正是录像里的方向反转。\r\n'
            '      final pushExtent =\r\n'
            '          measuredExtent > 0.5 ? measuredExtent : (cachedExtent ?? 0.0);\r\n'
            '      if (pushExtent <= 0.5) {\r\n'
            '        ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '          action: \'viewport_slide_no_measured_extent\',\r\n'
            '          conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'estimatedExtent\': estimatedExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            \'measuredExtent\': measuredExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = false;\r\n'
            '        _beginViewportInsertSettle();\r\n'
            '        _beginMediaSettleForMessages(messages, holdMs: 900);\r\n'
            '        if (_viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          _releaseArmedViewportInsertReveal();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _drainQueuedViewportInsertMessages();\r\n'
            '        _endInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 展开后若仍几乎跳不动（极端短列表误判），回退 grow，避免「闪全高」。\r\n'
            '      final predictedStart = oldPixels + pushExtent;\r\n'
            '      if (predictedStart > position.maxScrollExtent + 0.5 &&\r\n'
            '          (position.maxScrollExtent - position.minScrollExtent) < 0.5) {\r\n'
            '        ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '          action: \'viewport_slide_fallback_grow\',\r\n'
            '          conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'pushExtent\': pushExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            \'maxExtent\': position.maxScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        // 已 expand 到 1：直接收尾，不再二次动画顶历史。\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive = false;\r\n'
            '        _beginViewportInsertSettle();\r\n'
            '        _beginMediaSettleForMessages(messages, holdMs: 900);\r\n'
            '        _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '        if (_viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '          _releaseArmedViewportInsertReveal();\r\n'
            '        } else {\r\n'
            '          _acknowledgeInboundProjectionRevealIfNeeded();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _drainQueuedViewportInsertMessages();\r\n'
            '        _endInboundViewportPushPresentation();\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final start = (oldPixels + pushExtent).clamp(\r\n'
            '        position.minScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '        position.maxScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _geomJumpTo(\r\n'
            '        start.toDouble(),\r\n'
            '        reason: \'jump__releaseArmedViewportInsertReveal\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'

            '  void _onHeadMessageLaidOut(V2TimMessage message, Size size, Rect globalRect) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Returns true when newest-side inserts were absorbed into short spacer\r\n'

            '  bool _onMessageListMaybeInserted(\r\n'

            '        final oldKey = _stableMessageListKey(oldList[oldHead], oldHead);\r\n'
            '        final shifted = newList.asMap().entries.any((entry) =>\r\n'
            '            entry.key > oldHead &&\r\n'
            '            _stableMessageListKey(entry.value, entry.key) == oldKey);\r\n'

            '        !globalModel.isChunkedRevealActive(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      _abortViewportInsertSlideForSupersede();\r\n'

            '    final outgoingMediaInserted =\r\n'
            '        insertedMessages.where(_isOutgoingMediaMessage).toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    if (outgoingMediaInserted.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'

            '          },\r\n'

            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '        // 内容已放不进视口：本会话剩余生命周期改贴底，避免下一帧又造回大 spacer。\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentSuppressedByLiveInsert = true;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (absorbedShortHistoryInsert) {\r\n'
            '      // 吃 spacer 成功：禁止 list-push / pin，否则会把已顶部锚定的消息再往上推。\r\n'
            '      // 估高偏小时多行自消息可能仍溢出视口：下一帧实测后必要时退场并贴底。\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(insertedMessages);\r\n'
            '      final hasOutgoingSelf = insertedMessages.any((m) => m.isSelf == true);\r\n'
            '      if (hasOutgoingSelf) {\r\n'
            '        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '          if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          _breakShortHistoryIfOutgoingOverflowsViewport();\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (globalModel.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '        _scheduleContextMenuViewportRestore();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final fastForwardInsertedMessages = insertedMessages\r\n'
            '        .where(globalModel.consumeInboundFastForwardFlag)\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    final fastForwardKeys = fastForwardInsertedMessages\r\n'
            '        .map((message) => _stableMessageListKey(message, 0))\r\n'
            '        .toSet();\r\n'
            '    if (fastForwardInsertedMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      for (final message in fastForwardInsertedMessages) {\r\n'
            '        globalModel.finishMessageEnterAnimation(message);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Fast-forwarded rows intentionally skip animation. Commit them at the\r\n'
            '      // latest edge before the retained animated tail starts on the next tick.\r\n'
            '      if (!globalModel.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '          if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '            _pinScrollToBottomImmediate();\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final animatingMessages = insertedMessages\r\n'
            '        .where(\r\n'
            '          (message) =>\r\n'
            '              !fastForwardKeys.contains(_stableMessageListKey(message, 0)),\r\n'
            '        )\r\n'
            '        .where(globalModel.isMessageEnterAnimationPending)\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    final incomingInsertedMessages = insertedMessages\r\n'
            '        .where(\r\n'
            '          (message) =>\r\n'
            '              message.isSelf != true &&\r\n'
            '              !fastForwardKeys.contains(_stableMessageListKey(message, 0)),\r\n'
            '        )\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    final outgoingAnimatingMessages = animatingMessages\r\n'
            '        .where((message) => message.isSelf == true)\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    // Local sends share the viewport owner even when Android skips bubble\r\n'
            '    // effects. Completed/failed history rows must not replay a send.\r\n'
            '    final outgoingTextInserted = insertedMessages\r\n'
            '        .where((message) => message.isSelf == true &&\r\n'
            '            message.status == MessageStatus.V2TIM_MSG_STATUS_SENDING &&\r\n'
            '            !fastForwardKeys.contains(_stableMessageListKey(message, 0)))\r\n'
            '        .where(\r\n'
            '          (message) => message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_TEXT,\r\n'
            '        )\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    final outgoingNonTextAnimating = outgoingAnimatingMessages\r\n'
            '        .where(\r\n'
            '          (message) => message.elemType != MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_TEXT,\r\n'
            '        )\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    final incomingAnimatingMessages = animatingMessages\r\n'
            '        .where((message) => message.isSelf != true)\r\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '      action: \'list_insert_classified\',\r\n'
            '      conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'oldLen\': oldList.length,\r\n'
            '        \'newLen\': newList.length,\r\n'
            '        \'inserted\': insertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'incoming\': incomingInsertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'outgoingAnimating\': outgoingAnimatingMessages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'animating\': incomingAnimatingMessages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'growth\': growth,\r\n'
            '        \'insertedTipRows\': insertedTipRows,\r\n'
            '        \'untrackedGrowth\': growth - insertedMessages.length - insertedTipRows,\r\n'
            '        \'fastForward\': fastForwardInsertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '        \'queue\': globalModel.pendingInboundProjectionCount(_conversationId()),\r\n'
            '        \'waiting\': globalModel.isInboundProjectionRevealWaiting(\r\n'
            '          _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '        \'logicalPosition\':\r\n'
            '            globalModel.getMessageListPosition(_conversationId()).name,\r\n'
            '        \'pixels\': position?.hasPixels == true\r\n'
            '            ? position!.pixels.toStringAsFixed(1)\r\n'
            '            : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '        \'minExtent\': position?.hasContentDimensions == true\r\n'
            '            ? position!.minScrollExtent.toStringAsFixed(1)\r\n'
            '            : \'n/a\',\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (incomingInsertedMessages.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        outgoingAnimatingMessages.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages.isEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        !_viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive &&\r\n'
            '        !(_viewportInsert.rowRevealController?.isAnimating ?? false) &&\r\n'
            '        globalModel.isInboundProjectionRevealWaiting(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      globalModel.completeInboundProjectionReveal(_conversationId());\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (oldList.isEmpty && newList.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(incomingInsertedMessages);\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(outgoingAnimatingMessages);\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      // The scroll physics owns this one geometry transaction. Commit all\r\n'
            '      // buffered rows at full height now; row reveal/list-push would continue\r\n'
            '      // changing extent after the menu disappears and reintroduce a wobble.\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(incomingInsertedMessages);\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(outgoingAnimatingMessages);\r\n'
            '      _clearIncomingScrollAnchor(reason: \'context_menu_viewport_restore\');\r\n'
            '      _scheduleContextMenuViewportRestore();\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 自动 list-push 本身会暂时把 pixels 推离 minExtent；这不是用户在读历史。\r\n'
            '    // 若此时锁定阅读锚点，restore 会逐帧把 ticker 拉回旧 offset，形成来回抖动。\r\n'
            '    final inboundPushOwnsViewport =\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushActive ||\r\n'
            '            _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive ||\r\n'
            '            globalModel.isInboundPresentationBottomLocked(_conversationId());\r\n'
            '    if (inboundPushOwnsViewport) {\r\n'
            '      _clearIncomingScrollAnchor(reason: \'inbound_push_owns_viewport\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 上拉分页 prepend 必须优先于「读历史锚点锁」。否则会把 offset 拉回插入前，\r\n'
            '    // 与 HistoryPaginationScrollPhysics / 分页 restore 对打，表现为历史加载完朝新消息跳一下。\r\n'
            '    if (_paginationUi.isLoadingPrevious ||\r\n'
            '        _paginationUi.loadPreviousTask != null ||\r\n'
            '        _paginationUi.previousLoadInFlightAnchorKey != null ||\r\n'
            '        _shouldCompensateScrollForPagination()) {\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(incomingInsertedMessages);\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(outgoingAnimatingMessages);\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final frozenIncoming = !_isFollowingLatest();\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isAttachingBufferedTowardLatest) {\r\n'
            '      final attachingInserted = incomingInsertedMessages\r\n'
            '          .where(widget.model.isMessageInHistoryReadingWindow)\r\n'
            '          .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '      _armNewestInsertRoom(attachingInserted);\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _chatGlobalModel?.endAttachingBufferedTowardLatest();\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (frozenIncoming && incomingInsertedMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      final leakedIncoming = incomingInsertedMessages\r\n'
            '          .where((message) => !widget.model.isMessageInHistoryReadingWindow(message))\r\n'
            '          .toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logReadingHistoryIncoming(\r\n'
            '        action: leakedIncoming.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '            ? \'freeze_violation\'\r\n'
            '            : \'frozen_ignore_incoming\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'oldLen\': oldList.length,\r\n'
            '          \'newLen\': newList.length,\r\n'
            '          \'incoming\': incomingInsertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          \'leaked\': leakedIncoming.length,\r\n'
            '          \'userScrolling\': globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(incomingInsertedMessages);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final liveIncomingInsertedMessages = frozenIncoming\r\n'
            '        ? const <V2TimMessage>[]\r\n'
            '        : incomingInsertedMessages;\r\n'
            '    final wechatListPush = _useWechatListPushTranslate(globalModel);\r\n'
            '    // Receive and local send share one viewport owner, without a bubble tween.\r\n'
            '    var listPushMessages = <V2TimMessage>[\r\n'
            '      ...liveIncomingInsertedMessages,\r\n'
            '      if (wechatListPush) ...outgoingNonTextAnimating,\r\n'
            '      if (wechatListPush) ...outgoingTextInserted,\r\n'
            '    ];\r\n'
            '    // 同一帧多条必须整批进入同一个零高事务。以前只动画最新 1 条、其余直接\r\n'
            '    // 全高落位；快速收消息时这些 overflow 会先顶动历史，再由最新气泡上推。\r\n'
            '    // atomic 路径会按整批实测高度做一次补偿，因此不会让历史随批次跳动。\r\n'
            '    if (listPushMessages.length > 1) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logInboundFlow(\r\n'
            '        action: \'list_push_batch\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'animated\': listPushMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          \'queuedBehindActive\': _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (wechatListPush &&\r\n'
            '        (listPushMessages.isNotEmpty || outgoingMediaInserted.isNotEmpty)) {\r\n'
            '      final pushMessages = <String, V2TimMessage>{\r\n'
            '        for (final message in [...listPushMessages, ...outgoingMediaInserted])\r\n'
            '          _stableMessageListKey(message, 0): message,\r\n'
            '      }.values.toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '      final canReveal = _shouldRunRowReveal(forLiveListPush: true);\r\n'
            '      final following = _isFollowingLatest();\r\n'
            '      final chunked = globalModel.isChunkedRevealActive(_conversationId());\r\n'
            '      final bulk = _chatGlobalModel?.isBulkMessageSyncActive(_conversationId()) ??\r\n'
            '          false;\r\n'
            '      final insertPath = canReveal && following\r\n'
            '          ? \'list_push\'\r\n'
            '          : (!_isHistoryScrollProtected && following && !chunked && !bulk)\r\n'
            '              ? \'pin\'\r\n'
            '              : \'hold\';\r\n'
            '      String? holdReason;\r\n'
            '      if (insertPath == \'hold\') {\r\n'
            '        if (!following) {\r\n'
            '          holdReason = \'not_following\';\r\n'
            '        } else if (_isHistoryScrollProtected) {\r\n'
            '          holdReason = \'history_protected\';\r\n'
            '        } else if (chunked) {\r\n'
            '          holdReason = \'chunked\';\r\n'
            '        } else if (bulk) {\r\n'
            '          holdReason = \'bulk_sync\';\r\n'
            '        } else {\r\n'
            '          holdReason = \'reveal_blocked\';\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '        action: \'list_insert_decision\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'path\': insertPath,\r\n'
            '          \'canReveal\': canReveal,\r\n'
            '          \'following\': following,\r\n'
            '          \'historyProtected\': _isHistoryScrollProtected,\r\n'
            '          \'pushCount\': pushMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          if (holdReason != null) \'holdReason\': holdReason,\r\n'
            '          ...globalModel.stickToLatestDiagSnapshot(_conversationId()),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (canReveal && following) {\r\n'
            '        _startContinuousViewportInsertPush(pushMessages);\r\n'
            '      } else if (!_isHistoryScrollProtected &&\r\n'
            '          following &&\r\n'
            '          !globalModel.isChunkedRevealActive(_conversationId()) &&\r\n'
            '          !(_chatGlobalModel?.isBulkMessageSyncActive(_conversationId()) ??\r\n'
            '              false)) {\r\n'
            '        // 发送路径里 suppressOutgoingPinScroll 只挡 soft pin，不该吞掉落位；\r\n'
            '        // force-pin 会单独处理贴底。\r\n'
            '        _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(pushMessages);\r\n'
            '        if (!(_chatGlobalModel?.shouldSuppressOutgoingPinScroll() ?? false)) {\r\n'
            '          _schedulePinScrollToBottom();\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(pushMessages);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    } else if (liveIncomingInsertedMessages.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '        _shouldRunRowReveal() &&\r\n'
            '        _isFollowingLatest()) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '        action: \'list_insert_decision\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'path\': incomingAnimatingMessages.isNotEmpty\r\n'
            '              ? \'row_reveal\'\r\n'
            '              : \'pin\',\r\n'
            '          \'following\': true,\r\n'
            '          \'pushCount\': incomingInsertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          ...globalModel.stickToLatestDiagSnapshot(_conversationId()),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (incomingAnimatingMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        _startRowRevealTransaction(incomingAnimatingMessages);\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(incomingInsertedMessages);\r\n'
            '        _schedulePinScrollToBottom();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(outgoingAnimatingMessages);\r\n'
            '    } else if (!_isHistoryScrollProtected &&\r\n'
            '        !(_chatGlobalModel?.shouldSuppressOutgoingPinScroll() ?? false) &&\r\n'
            '        _isFollowingLatest() &&\r\n'
            '        !globalModel.isChunkedRevealActive(_conversationId()) &&\r\n'
            '        !(_chatGlobalModel?.isBulkMessageSyncActive(_conversationId()) ??\r\n'
            '            false)) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '        action: \'list_insert_decision\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'path\': \'pin\',\r\n'
            '          \'following\': true,\r\n'
            '          \'pushCount\': incomingInsertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          ...globalModel.stickToLatestDiagSnapshot(_conversationId()),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(incomingInsertedMessages);\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(outgoingAnimatingMessages);\r\n'
            '      _schedulePinScrollToBottom();\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '        action: \'list_insert_decision\',\r\n'
            '        conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'path\': \'hold\',\r\n'
            '          \'holdReason\': !_isFollowingLatest()\r\n'
            '              ? \'not_following\'\r\n'
            '              : (_isHistoryScrollProtected\r\n'
            '                  ? \'history_protected\'\r\n'
            '                  : \'other\'),\r\n'
            '          \'following\': _isFollowingLatest(),\r\n'
            '          \'historyProtected\': _isHistoryScrollProtected,\r\n'
            '          \'pushCount\': incomingInsertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          ...globalModel.stickToLatestDiagSnapshot(_conversationId()),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (!_isFollowingLatest() &&\r\n'
            '          !globalModel.isAttachingBufferedTowardLatest &&\r\n'
            '          liveIncomingInsertedMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '        ChatJitterDiag.logReadingHistoryIncoming(\r\n'
            '          action: \'freeze_violation\',\r\n'
            '          conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'pushCount\': liveIncomingInsertedMessages.length,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(liveIncomingInsertedMessages);\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(outgoingAnimatingMessages);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isReadingHistory() && !_shouldRunRowReveal()) {\r\n'
            '      _logReadingHistoryIncoming(\r\n'
            '        \'pin_blocked\',\r\n'
            '        globalModel: globalModel,\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'historyProtected\': _isHistoryScrollProtected,\r\n'
            '          \'suppressOutgoingPin\':\r\n'
            '              _chatGlobalModel?.shouldSuppressOutgoingPinScroll() ?? false,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _scheduleOffsetJumpProbe();\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldPinScrollToBottom(TUIChatGlobalModel globalModel) {\r\n'
            '    final reason = _pinScrollBlockReason(globalModel);\r\n'
            '    if (reason == null) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logFollowingLatest(\r\n'
            '      action: \'pin_refused\',\r\n'
            '      conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'reason\': reason,\r\n'
            '        ...globalModel.stickToLatestDiagSnapshot(_conversationId()),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '      throttleKey: \'pin_refused\',\r\n'
            '      minIntervalMs: 250,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String? _pinScrollBlockReason(TUIChatGlobalModel globalModel) {\r\n'
            '    if (_mayUseShortHistoryTopAlignment()) {\r\n'
            '      return \'short_history_top\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 用户正在手动滑动时不做滚底补偿（list-push 补偿阈值 80px 会把「上滑一点」\r\n'
            '    // 的用户拽回底部）。发送消息的 force-pin 不经过这里，不受影响。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling) {\r\n'
            '      return \'user_scrolling\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isSearchJumpStabilizing) {\r\n'
            '      return \'search_jump\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_paginationUi.isLoadingLatest) {\r\n'
            '      return \'loading_latest\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (widget.model.haveMoreLatestData) {\r\n'
            '      return \'have_more_latest\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.memoryWindowMissingNewer(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return \'memory_missing_newer\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.hasDurableHistoryDeferred(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return \'durable_deferred\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isWalletOverlayOpen) {\r\n'
            '      return \'wallet_overlay\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isMediaPickerOverlayOpen) {\r\n'
            '      return \'picker_overlay\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isMediaPreviewOverlayOpen) {\r\n'
            '      return \'preview_overlay\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isMessageContextMenuOverlayOpen) {\r\n'
            '      return \'context_menu\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return \'context_menu_restore\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isRestoringScrollAfterMediaPreview) {\r\n'
            '      return \'preview_restore\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convId = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.hasPendingScrollRestore(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      return \'pending_scroll_restore\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_isFollowingLatest()) {\r\n'
            '      return \'not_following\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // awayTwoScreen 是视口派生量，跟随最新端时不能用它挡 pin；离底保护由下面\r\n'
            '    // 的 24px 物理距离兜底。notShowLatest 代表窗口不含最新端，必须继续拦。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.getMessageListPosition(convId) ==\r\n'
            '        HistoryMessagePosition.notShowLatest) {\r\n'
            '      return \'logical_notShowLatest\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_deferUnreadCenterPartition) {\r\n'
            '      return \'unread_center_defer\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!globalModel.isInboundViewportPushActive(convId) &&\r\n'
            '        !globalModel.isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '      if (position != null &&\r\n'
            '          position.hasPixels &&\r\n'
            '          position.hasContentDimensions &&\r\n'
            '          position.pixels - position.minScrollExtent >\r\n'
            '              (globalModel.chatConfig.desktopStickToLatestEnabled\r\n'
            '                  ? 80.0\r\n'
            '                  : _followingLatestEpsilonPx)) {\r\n'
            '        return globalModel.chatConfig.desktopStickToLatestEnabled\r\n'
            '            ? \'physically_away_80\'\r\n'
            '            : \'physically_away_24\';\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 进页布局冻结窗：覆盖 hydrate + 首轮 loadLatest 常见耗时，避免 spacer/loading 抖。\r\n'
            '  bool get _isInitialRouteSettleWindow =>\r\n'
            '      DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - _createdAtMs < 2500;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _schedulePinScrollToBottomOnUnreadEntry({int attempt = 0}) {\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _pinScrollToBottomOnUnreadEntry(attempt: attempt);\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _pinScrollToBottomOnUnreadEntry({int attempt = 0}) {\r\n'
            '    const maxAttempts = 12;\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(context, listen: false);\r\n'
            '    final convId = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.unreadCountForTongue <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '        globalModel.getMessageListPosition(convId) !=\r\n'
            '            HistoryMessagePosition.bottom ||\r\n'
            '        _firstUnreadAnchorJumped) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position == null ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        _schedulePinScrollToBottomOnUnreadEntry(attempt: attempt + 1);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    const pinThreshold = 80.0;\r\n'
            '    final target = position.minScrollExtent;\r\n'
            '    if ((position.pixels - target).abs() > 0.5) {\r\n'
            '      _geomJumpTo(target, reason: \'pin_unread_entry\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    globalModel.setMessageListPosition(\r\n'
            '      convId,\r\n'
            '      HistoryMessagePosition.bottom,\r\n'
            '      notify: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final frozenUnread = globalModel.unreadCountForTongue;\r\n'
            '    if (frozenUnread > 0) {\r\n'
            '      globalModel.setUnreadTongueMetrics(\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '        remaining: frozenUnread,\r\n'
            '        below: false,\r\n'
            '        notify: true,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (attempt < maxAttempts - 1 && position.pixels > target + pinThreshold) {\r\n'
            '      _schedulePinScrollToBottomOnUnreadEntry(attempt: attempt + 1);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _schedulePinScrollToBottom({int attempt = 0}) {\r\n'
            '    if (_isHistoryScrollProtected) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (attempt == 0) {\r\n'
            '      scheduleMicrotask(() {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _pinScrollToBottomImmediate();\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _pinScrollToBottomIfNeeded(attempt: attempt);\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _cancelForcePinScroll() {\r\n'
            '    _forcePinGeneration++;\r\n'
            '    _forcePinIgnoreInsertWindows = false;\r\n'
            '    _immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin = false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom({\r\n'
            '    int attempt = 0,\r\n'
            '    int? generation,\r\n'
            '    bool ignoreInsertWindows = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (_unreadWindowJumpInFlight) {\r\n'
            '      _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final gen = generation ?? ++_forcePinGeneration;\r\n'
            '    if (generation == null) {\r\n'
            '      _forcePinIgnoreInsertWindows = ignoreInsertWindows;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 上拉历史保护窗口内不要直接放弃：延后重试，保证发送/点输入框仍能回底。\r\n'
            '    // An explicit send supersedes the passive 520ms history cooldown. Keep\r\n'
            '    // waiting for a real pagination transaction; gestures are checked below.\r\n'
            '    final waitForHistory = _immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin\r\n'
            '        ? (_paginationUi.isLoadingPrevious ||\r\n'
            '            _paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious > 0)\r\n'
            '        : _isHistoryScrollProtected;\r\n'
            '    if (waitForHistory) {\r\n'
            '      final maxAttempts = _immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin\r\n'
            '          ? 32\r\n'
            '          : (_isInitialRouteSettleWindow ? 4 : 8);\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 48), () {\r\n'
            '          if (!mounted || gen != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '            attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '            generation: gen,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isRouteBackGestureInProgress() ||\r\n'
            '        (_chatGlobalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false)) {\r\n'
            '      _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (attempt == 0 && !_immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin) {\r\n'
            '      scheduleMicrotask(() {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted || gen != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _forcePinScrollToBottomIfNeeded(attempt: attempt, generation: gen);\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted || gen != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _forcePinScrollToBottomIfNeeded(attempt: attempt, generation: gen);\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    if (_immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin) {\r\n'
            '      WidgetsBinding.instance.ensureVisualUpdate();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _forcePinScrollToBottomIfNeeded({\r\n'
            '    int attempt = 0,\r\n'
            '    required int generation,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (generation != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_unreadWindowJumpInFlight) {\r\n'
            '      _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 进入本方法即 force-pin 意图（软贴底走 _pinScrollToBottomIfNeeded）。\r\n'
            '    // 短历史顶部对齐期间必须先退场再贴底，否则发送多行后最新气泡不可见。\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched ||\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentSuppressedByLiveInsert = true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_forcePinIgnoreInsertWindows &&\r\n'
            '        !_immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin &&\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive) {\r\n'
            '      // list-push 拥有本轮上推：结束后再视需要补一次贴底，勿直接丢弃 force-pin。\r\n'
            '      final maxAttempts = _isInitialRouteSettleWindow ? 4 : 8;\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 48), () {\r\n'
            '          if (!mounted || generation != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '            attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '            generation: generation,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_forcePinIgnoreInsertWindows &&\r\n'
            '        !_immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin &&\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.hasAnyMediaSettling()) {\r\n'
            '      // 图片/视频首帧 layout、decode 期间勿 force-pin，与 silentAbsorb 对打会抖。\r\n'
            '      // 出站媒体稳定窗最长 1200ms；24 * 64ms = 1536ms，必须覆盖完整\r\n'
            '      // 稳定窗。旧值 6/16 次会在 384/1024ms 提前耗尽，pin seq 又已消费，\r\n'
            '      // 导致相册返回后新图片留在视口外，必须手动滑动才能看到。\r\n'
            '      const maxAttempts = 24;\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 64), () {\r\n'
            '          if (!mounted || generation != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '            attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '            generation: generation,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_forcePinIgnoreInsertWindows &&\r\n'
            '        !_immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin &&\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.continuousViewportPushActive) {\r\n'
            '      final maxAttempts = _isInitialRouteSettleWindow ? 4 : 8;\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 48), () {\r\n'
            '          if (!mounted || generation != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '            return;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '            attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '            generation: generation,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isRouteBackGestureInProgress() ||\r\n'
            '        (_chatGlobalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false)) {\r\n'
            '      _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_forcePinIgnoreInsertWindows &&\r\n'
            '        !_immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin &&\r\n'
            '        _isViewportInsertSettling()) {\r\n'
            '      final delayMs = _viewportInsertSettleRemainingMs();\r\n'
            '      Future<void>.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: max(delayMs, 16)), () {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted || generation != _forcePinGeneration) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '          attempt: attempt,\r\n'
            '          generation: generation,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final maxAttempts = _isInitialRouteSettleWindow ? 4 : 8;\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(context, listen: false);\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling) {\r\n'
            '      _cancelForcePinScroll();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isWalletOverlayOpen ||\r\n'
            '        (!_forcePinIgnoreInsertWindows &&\r\n'
            '            globalModel.isMediaPickerOverlayOpen) ||\r\n'
            '        globalModel.isMediaPreviewOverlayOpen ||\r\n'
            '        globalModel.isMessageContextMenuOverlayOpen ||\r\n'
            '        globalModel.isRestoringScrollAfterMediaPreview) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convId = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.hasPendingScrollRestore(convId)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position == null) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '          attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '          generation: generation,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!position.hasPixels || !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '          attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '          generation: generation,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final target = position.minScrollExtent;\r\n'
            '    final awayFromBottom = (position.pixels - target).abs() > 0.5;\r\n'
            '    // Already near bottom during outgoing suppress: stop chasing frames.\r\n'
            '    if (!awayFromBottom && globalModel.shouldSuppressOutgoingPinScroll()) {\r\n'
            '      _immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin = false;\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (awayFromBottom) {\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logScroll(\r\n'
            '        reason: \'force_pin_bottom_a$attempt\',\r\n'
            '        pixels: position.pixels,\r\n'
            '        minExtent: target,\r\n'
            '        maxExtent: position.maxScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _scrollToBottomTarget(\r\n'
            '        target,\r\n'
            '        globalModel,\r\n'
            '        immediate: _immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    globalModel.setMessageListPosition(\r\n'
            '      convId,\r\n'
            '      HistoryMessagePosition.bottom,\r\n'
            '      notify: false,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // Only keep chasing bottom while layout is still drifting. Unconditional\r\n'
            '    // 8-frame retries after list-push often re-nudge settled content.\r\n'
            '    if (attempt < maxAttempts - 1 && awayFromBottom) {\r\n'
            '      _scheduleForcePinScrollToBottom(\r\n'
            '        attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '        generation: generation,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      _immediateOutgoingImageBatchPin = false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _pinScrollToBottomIfNeeded({int attempt = 0}) {\r\n'
            '    if (_viewportInsert.viewportInsertSlideActive) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isRouteBackGestureInProgress() ||\r\n'
            '        (_chatGlobalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling ?? false)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isViewportInsertSettling()) {\r\n'
            '      final delayMs = _viewportInsertSettleRemainingMs();\r\n'
            '      Future<void>.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: max(delayMs, 16)), () {\r\n'
            '        if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '          return;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _schedulePinScrollToBottom(attempt: attempt);\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final maxAttempts = _isInitialRouteSettleWindow ? 3 : 8;\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(context, listen: false);\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isBulkMessageSyncActive(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isUserScrollToBottomInProgress(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_shouldPinScrollToBottom(globalModel)) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (KeyboardViewportTransitionCoordinator.active?.isAnimating == true) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position == null) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        _schedulePinScrollToBottom(attempt: attempt + 1);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!position.hasPixels || !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < maxAttempts) {\r\n'
            '        _schedulePinScrollToBottom(attempt: attempt + 1);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    const bottomEpsilon = 24.0;\r\n'
            '    final nearBottom =\r\n'
            '        position.pixels <= position.minScrollExtent + bottomEpsilon;\r\n'
            '    final contentFitsViewport =\r\n'
            '        position.maxScrollExtent <= position.minScrollExtent + bottomEpsilon;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (nearBottom || contentFitsViewport) {\r\n'
            '      final target = position.minScrollExtent;\r\n'
            '      if ((position.pixels - target).abs() > 0.5) {\r\n'
            '        _scrollToBottomTarget(target, globalModel);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      globalModel.setMessageListPosition(\r\n'
            '        _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        HistoryMessagePosition.bottom,\r\n'
            '        notify: false,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (attempt < maxAttempts - 1 && (nearBottom || contentFitsViewport)) {\r\n'
            '      _schedulePinScrollToBottom(attempt: attempt + 1);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scrollToBottomTarget(\r\n'
            '    double target,\r\n'
            '    TUIChatGlobalModel globalModel, {\r\n'
            '    bool immediate = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    // 用户手指优先：异步媒体布局、发送回调或旧的 post-frame pin 可能在\r\n'
            '    // 手势已经开始后才到达。此时再 jump/animate 会抢夺 ScrollPosition，\r\n'
            '    // 表现为列表卡住、拖动方向反转或松手后又被拉回底部。调用方大多有\r\n'
            '    // 自己的保护，但这里是所有贴底路径的最后一道闸门。\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isChatListUserScrolling || _userScrollGestureActive) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (globalModel.isMessageContextMenuOverlayOpen ||\r\n'
            '        globalModel.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(_conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Open / just-revealed: always jump. Smooth follow is for live inbound only.\r\n'
            '    if (immediate ||\r\n'
            '        !_historyOpenRevealPainted ||\r\n'
            '        _isInitialRouteSettleWindow ||\r\n'
            '        _isPostRevealMicroSuppressWindow) {\r\n'
            '      _geomJumpTo(target, reason: \'scroll_to_bottom_instant_open\');\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final useSmooth = globalModel.chatConfig.inboundScrollFollowEnabled &&\r\n'
            '        globalModel.chatConfig.inboundScrollFollowMode ==\r\n'
            '            InboundScrollFollowMode.smooth;\r\n'
            '    if (useSmooth) {\r\n'
            '      unawaited(\r\n'
            '        _autoScrollController.animateTo(\r\n'
            '          target,\r\n'
            '          duration: Duration(\r\n'
            '            milliseconds: globalModel.chatConfig.inboundScrollFollowDurationMs,\r\n'
            '          ),\r\n'
            '          curve: Curves.easeInOut,\r\n'
            '        ),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _geomJumpTo(target, reason: \'scroll_to_bottom_target\');\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _startRowRevealTransaction(List<V2TimMessage> messages) {\r\n'
            '    final controller = _viewportInsert.rowRevealController;\r\n'
            '    if (controller == null || messages.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _finishIncomingMessagesWithoutRowReveal(messages);\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (controller.isAnimating ||\r\n'
            '        _viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      _finishActiveRowRevealImmediately();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final generation = ++_viewportInsert.rowRevealGeneration;\r\n'
            '    _viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages.clear();\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messages) {\r\n'
            '      _viewportInsert.activeRowRevealMessages[_stableMessageListKey(\r\n'
            '        message,\r\n'
            '        0,\r\n'
            '      )] = message;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = _chatGlobalModel ??\r\n'

            '  Future<void> _restoreRouteScroll(\r\n'

            '      final position = offsetPosition;\r\n'

            '        final target = offset.clamp(\r\n'
            '          position.minScrollExtent,\r\n'

            '      // 预览路由 maintainState，列表位姿应保持；只重试 offset jump，否则就地解锁。\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.routeRestoreAttempt++;\r\n'

            '    _routeScroll.routeRestoreScheduled = false;\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  _PaginationViewportAnchor? _capturePaginationViewportAnchor(\r\n'
            '    _PreviousLoadAnchor anchor,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    final globalIndex = _globalIndexForPreviousLoadAnchor(anchor);\r\n'
            '    if (globalIndex == null) {\r\n'
