            '    final scrollable =\r\n'
            '        tagContext == null ? null : Scrollable.maybeOf(tagContext);\r\n'
            '    final target = tagContext?.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '    final viewport = scrollable?.context.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '    if (target is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '        viewport is! RenderBox ||\r\n'

            '        !viewport.attached ||\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  /// Captures a mounted row near the current viewport when the pagination\r\n'
            '  /// boundary itself is outside the sliver cache. This keeps the user\'s\r\n'
            '  /// visible content stable even when the boundary row was just evicted.\r\n'
            '  _PaginationViewportAnchor? _captureVisiblePaginationViewportAnchor({\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?>? messages,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final messageList = messages ?? _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    _PaginationViewportAnchor? best;\r\n'
            '    var bestDistance = double.infinity;\r\n'
            '    for (final entry in _autoScrollController.tagMap.entries) {\r\n'
            '      final globalIndex = -entry.key;\r\n'
            '      if (globalIndex < 0 || globalIndex >= messageList.length) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final tagContext = entry.value.context;\r\n'
            '      final target = tagContext?.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '      final viewport =\r\n'
            '          tagContext == null ? null : _viewportRenderBoxFor(tagContext);\r\n'
            '      if (target is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '          viewport is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '          !target.attached ||\r\n'
            '          !viewport.attached ||\r\n'
            '          !target.hasSize ||\r\n'
            '          !viewport.hasSize ||\r\n'
            '          _renderObjectNeedsLayout(target) ||\r\n'
            '          _renderObjectNeedsLayout(viewport)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final top = target.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: viewport).dy;\r\n'
            '      final bottom = top + target.size.height;\r\n'
            '      if (bottom < -1 || top > viewport.size.height + 1) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final distance = (top - viewport.size.height / 3).abs();\r\n'
            '      if (distance >= bestDistance) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final message = messageList[globalIndex];\r\n'
            '      if (message == null ||\r\n'
            '          message.elemType == 11 ||\r\n'
            '          ((message.msgID?.trim().isEmpty ?? true) &&\r\n'
            '              (int.tryParse(message.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') ?? 0) <= 0)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (entry.value.widget.key !=\r\n'
            '          ValueKey<String>(_stableMessageListKey(message, globalIndex)))\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      bestDistance = distance;\r\n'
            '      best = _PaginationViewportAnchor(\r\n'
            '        msgID: message.msgID?.trim(),\r\n'
            '        seq: int.tryParse(message.seq?.trim() ?? \'\'),\r\n'
            '        viewportTop: top,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (best != null) {\r\n'
            '      ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '        \'load_previous_viewport_anchor_capture_fallback\',\r\n'
            '        conversationID: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'msgID\': best.msgID,\r\n'
            '          \'seq\': best.seq,\r\n'
            '          \'viewportTop\': best.viewportTop,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return best;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'

            '  /// 向下滑加载更新消息：沿当前 SDK 窗口的最新边界继续分页。\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isSearchJumpHistoryMode(TUIChatGlobalModel globalModel) {\r\n'
            '    // Entry-unread navigation installs the same bounded, two-sided history\r\n'

            '          // 列表已增长：放开同一次贴顶消费位，便于继续上滑/回弹拉下一页。\r\n'

            '            \'haveMoreData\': widget.model.haveMoreData,\r\n'

            '            \'releasedTopReach\': !_paginationUi.previousLoadConsumedThisTopReach,\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '          \'history_pagination\',\r\n'
            '          conv: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'stage\': \'ui_load_done\',\r\n'
            '            \'loaded\': loaded,\r\n'
            '            \'effectiveLoaded\': effectiveLoaded,\r\n'
            '            \'listLenBefore\': listLenBefore,\r\n'
            '            \'listLenAfter\': listLenAfter,\r\n'

            '            \'delta\': listLenAfter - listLenBefore,\r\n'

            '        ChatResourceSample.onRawMessageCount(_rawMessageCount());\r\n'
            '        // Register the window trim callback before the viewport restore callback\r\n'
            '        // so the anchor is measured against the final post-trim list.\r\n'
            '        _finishPreviousLoadPagination(\r\n'
            '          anchorMsgID: anchor.msgID,\r\n'

            '          _scheduleScrollPaginationCompensationEnd(\r\n'
            '            generation: compensationGeneration,\r\n'

            '            anchorMaxExtent: anchorMaxExtent,\r\n'
            '            viewportAnchor: viewportAnchor,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        } else if (effectiveLoaded) {\r\n'
            '          // The user kept dragging after this request started. Telegram-style\r\n'
            '          // behavior is to leave the current gesture position authoritative;\r\n'
            '          // restoring the pre-request offset here creates the observed\r\n'
            '          // 0 -> oldOffset jump when ScrollEnd arrives later.\r\n'
            '          _cancelPaginationRestoreForUserScroll(\r\n'
            '            reason: \'gesture_continued_during_request\',\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '          ChatHistoryTrace.log(\r\n'
            '            \'load_previous_restore_skipped_user_scroll\',\r\n'
            '            conversationID: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '            extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '              \'listLenBefore\': listLenBefore,\r\n'
            '              \'listLenAfter\': listLenAfter,\r\n'
            '              \'anchorPixels\': anchorPixels,\r\n'
            '            },\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        Future<void>.delayed(\r\n'
            '          const Duration(milliseconds: _loadPreviousScrollUnlockMs),\r\n'
            '          () {\r\n'
            '            if (ownsLoad() && !windowIsCurrent()) {\r\n'
            '              _invalidatePreviousPagination();\r\n'
            '              _syncTopHistoryLoadingVisible();\r\n'
            '            } else if (ownsLoad()) {\r\n'
            '              if (_paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious >= 2) {\r\n'
            '                _paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious -= 2;\r\n'
            '              } else if (_paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious > 0) {\r\n'
            '                _paginationUi.ignoreScrollLoadPrevious = 0;\r\n'
            '              }\r\n'
            '              _previousLoadWindowIsCurrent = null;\r\n'
            '            }\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _messageMatchesTarget(V2TimMessage? current, V2TimMessage target) {\r\n'
            '    if (current == null || current.elemType == 11 || current.elemType == 101) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetMsgID = target.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final currentMsgID = current.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (targetMsgID.isNotEmpty && currentMsgID.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return currentMsgID == targetMsgID;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetId = target.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final currentId = current.id?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (targetId.isNotEmpty && currentId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return currentId == targetId;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetSeq = target.seq?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final currentSeq = current.seq?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (targetSeq.isNotEmpty && currentSeq.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return currentSeq == targetSeq;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if ((targetMsgID.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            currentMsgID.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            currentMsgID != targetMsgID) ||\r\n'
            '        (targetId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            currentId.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            currentId != targetId) ||\r\n'
            '        (targetSeq.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            currentSeq.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '            currentSeq != targetSeq)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetSender = target.sender?.trim() ?? target.userID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    final currentSender =\r\n'
            '        current.sender?.trim() ?? current.userID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (current.timestamp != null &&\r\n'
            '        target.timestamp != null &&\r\n'
            '        current.timestamp == target.timestamp) {\r\n'
            '      return targetSender.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '          currentSender.isNotEmpty &&\r\n'
            '          targetSender == currentSender &&\r\n'
            '          target.elemType != null &&\r\n'
            '          current.elemType != null &&\r\n'
            '          target.elemType == current.elemType;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int? _globalIndexForTargetMessage(V2TimMessage target) {\r\n'
            '    final messageList = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    int? matchedIndex;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < messageList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      if (_messageMatchesTarget(messageList[i], target)) {\r\n'
            '        if (matchedIndex != null) {\r\n'
            '          return null;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        matchedIndex = i;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return matchedIndex;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int? _globalIndexForAnchor(MessageAnchor target) {\r\n'
            '    final messageList = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    int? matchedIndex;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < messageList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      if (target.matches(messageList[i])) {\r\n'
            '        if (matchedIndex != null) {\r\n'
            '          return null;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        matchedIndex = i;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return matchedIndex;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int? _globalIndexForSeq(String targetSeq) {\r\n'
            '    final messageList = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    final want = int.tryParse(targetSeq.trim());\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < messageList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = messageList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (message == null ||\r\n'
            '          message.elemType == 11 ||\r\n'
            '          message.elemType == 101) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final raw = message.seq?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '      if (raw == targetSeq.trim()) {\r\n'
            '        return i;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (want != null) {\r\n'
            '        final current = int.tryParse(raw);\r\n'
            '        if (current != null && current == want) {\r\n'
            '          return i;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  V2TimMessage? _messageForAnchor(MessageAnchor target) {\r\n'
            '    final messageList = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messageList) {\r\n'
            '      if (target.matches(message)) {\r\n'
            '        return message;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _scrollMetricsReady() {\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    return position != null &&\r\n'
            '        position.hasPixels &&\r\n'
            '        position.hasContentDimensions &&\r\n'
            '        position.maxScrollExtent.isFinite &&\r\n'
            '        position.minScrollExtent.isFinite;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _isInitialFindingTarget(V2TimMessage target) {\r\n'
            '    final initial = widget.initFindingMsg;\r\n'
            '    return initial != null && _messageMatchesTarget(initial, target);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleScrollToFindingMsgDelayed({\r\n'
            '    Duration delay = const Duration(milliseconds: 120),\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    Future<void>.delayed(delay, () {\r\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '        _scheduleScrollToFindingMsg();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int? _resolveSearchJumpGlobalIndex(_SearchJumpTarget target) {\r\n'
            '    return target.resolveIndex();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  _SearchJumpFrameCheck? _checkSearchJumpTargetFrame(_SearchJumpTarget target) {\r\n'
            '    final targetGlobalIndex = _resolveSearchJumpGlobalIndex(target);\r\n'
            '    if (targetGlobalIndex == null) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final tagContext =\r\n'
            '        _autoScrollController.tagMap[-targetGlobalIndex]?.context;\r\n'
            '    final rendered = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    // A retained tag can occupy the same numeric index during replacement.\r\n'
            '    // Geometry is evidence only after its stable message key also matches.\r\n'
            '    if (tagContext == null ||\r\n'
            '        targetGlobalIndex < 0 ||\r\n'
            '        targetGlobalIndex >= rendered.length ||\r\n'
            '        tagContext.widget.key !=\r\n'
            '            ValueKey(_stableMessageListKey(\r\n'
            '                rendered[targetGlobalIndex], targetGlobalIndex))) {\r\n'
            '      return _SearchJumpFrameCheck.notReady(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final scrollable = Scrollable.maybeOf(tagContext);\r\n'
            '    if (scrollable == null) {\r\n'
            '      return _SearchJumpFrameCheck.notReady(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetRenderObject = tagContext.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '    final viewportRenderObject = scrollable.context.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '    if (targetRenderObject is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '        viewportRenderObject is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '        !targetRenderObject.attached ||\r\n'
            '        !viewportRenderObject.attached ||\r\n'
            '        !targetRenderObject.hasSize ||\r\n'
            '        !viewportRenderObject.hasSize ||\r\n'
            '        _renderObjectNeedsLayout(targetRenderObject) ||\r\n'
            '        _renderObjectNeedsLayout(viewportRenderObject)) {\r\n'
            '      return _SearchJumpFrameCheck.notReady(targetGlobalIndex);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final targetTop = targetRenderObject\r\n'
            '        .localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: viewportRenderObject)\r\n'
            '        .dy;\r\n'
            '    final targetCenter = targetTop + targetRenderObject.size.height / 2;\r\n'
            '    final viewportCenter = viewportRenderObject.size.height / 2;\r\n'
            '    final centerDelta = targetCenter - viewportCenter;\r\n'
            '    const tolerance = 2.0;\r\n'
            '    final strictCenter = _entryUnreadOrigin != null ||\r\n'
            '        _atJumpOrigin != null ||\r\n'
            '        widget.searchJumpAnchor != null ||\r\n'
            '        widget.initFindingMsg != null;\r\n'
            '    return _SearchJumpFrameCheck(\r\n'
            '      targetGlobalIndex: targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '      isReady: true,\r\n'
            '      centerDelta: !strictCenter &&\r\n'
            '              searchJumpAtReachablePosition(\r\n'
            '                targetTop: targetTop,\r\n'
            '                targetHeight: targetRenderObject.size.height,\r\n'
            '                viewportHeight: viewportRenderObject.size.height,\r\n'
            '                metrics: scrollable.position,\r\n'
            '                tolerance: tolerance,\r\n'
            '              )\r\n'
            '          ? 0\r\n'
            '          : centerDelta,\r\n'
            '      tolerance: tolerance,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _correctSearchJumpTargetToCenter(\r\n'
            '    _SearchJumpTarget target,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    final check = _checkSearchJumpTargetFrame(target);\r\n'
            '    if (check == null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final targetGlobalIndex = check.targetGlobalIndex;\r\n'
            '    if (!check.isReady) {\r\n'
            '      await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '        -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '        preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.middle,\r\n'
            '        reason: \'scroll_to_index_middle\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (check.isCentered) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position == null ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasPixels ||\r\n'
            '        !position.hasContentDimensions) {\r\n'
            '      await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '        -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '        preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.middle,\r\n'
            '        reason: \'scroll_to_index_middle\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final centeredPixels = searchJumpCenterOffset(\r\n'
            '      centerDelta: check.centerDelta,\r\n'
            '      metrics: position,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _geomJumpTo(centeredPixels, reason: \'search_jump_measured_center\');\r\n'
            '    return false;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _stabilizeCenteredSearchJumpTarget(\r\n'
            '    _SearchJumpTarget target, {\r\n'
            '    required int generation,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    var stableFrames = 0;\r\n'
            '    // The unread handoff retains the old viewport until geometry is verified.\r\n'
            '    // Consecutive layout frames are enough; do not add fixed sleeps while the\r\n'
            '    // user is waiting behind the loader.\r\n'
            '    final unreadHandoff = _unreadWindowJumpInFlight;\r\n'
            '    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 14; attempt++) {\r\n'
            '      _lockSearchJumpStabilization(milliseconds: 2600);\r\n'
            '      await waitForSearchJumpLayout();\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          !_ownsSearchJumpRequest ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _searchJumpGeneration) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '      final centered = await _correctSearchJumpTargetToCenter(target);\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          !_ownsSearchJumpRequest ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _searchJumpGeneration) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (centered) {\r\n'
            '        stableFrames++;\r\n'
            '        if (stableFrames >= (unreadHandoff ? 3 : 4)) {\r\n'
            '          return true;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        stableFrames = 0;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!unreadHandoff) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 70));\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          !_ownsSearchJumpRequest ||\r\n'
            '          generation != _searchJumpGeneration) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final finalCheck = _checkSearchJumpTargetFrame(target);\r\n'
            '    return finalCheck != null && finalCheck.isReady && finalCheck.isCentered;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _centerOnGlobalIndex(\r\n'
            '    int targetGlobalIndex, {\r\n'
            '    int attempt = 0,\r\n'
            '    _SearchJumpTarget? target,\r\n'
            '    int? generation,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '        !_ownsSearchJumpRequest ||\r\n'
            '        (generation != null && generation != _searchJumpGeneration)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _lockSearchJumpStabilization(milliseconds: 2600);\r\n'
            '    if (!_scrollMetricsReady()) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < 12) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 80));\r\n'
            '        return _centerOnGlobalIndex(\r\n'
            '          targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '          attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '          target: target,\r\n'
            '          generation: generation,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 只使用 scroll_to_index 自带的安全定位，避免在图片/视频/长文本还没\r\n'
            '    // layout 完成时手动 getOffsetToReveal / jumpTo 触发 debugNeedsLayout 红屏。\r\n'
            '    try {\r\n'
            '      await waitForSearchJumpLayout();\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          !_ownsSearchJumpRequest ||\r\n'
            '          (generation != null && generation != _searchJumpGeneration)) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final resolvedTargetGlobalIndex = target == null\r\n'
            '          ? targetGlobalIndex\r\n'
            '          : _resolveSearchJumpGlobalIndex(target);\r\n'
            '      if (resolvedTargetGlobalIndex == null) return false;\r\n'
            '      final materialized = await materializeSearchJumpTarget(\r\n'
            '        controller: _autoScrollController,\r\n'
            '        resolveIndex: () => target == null\r\n'
            '            ? resolvedTargetGlobalIndex\r\n'
            '            : _resolveSearchJumpGlobalIndex(target),\r\n'
            '        isActive: () =>\r\n'
            '            mounted &&\r\n'
            '            _ownsSearchJumpRequest &&\r\n'
            '            (generation == null || generation == _searchJumpGeneration),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (!materialized) return false;\r\n'
            '      // Materialization can span multiple frames and list revisions. Never\r\n'
            '      // scroll to a stale numeric index belonging to a different message.\r\n'
            '      final currentIndex = target == null\r\n'
            '          ? resolvedTargetGlobalIndex\r\n'
            '          : _resolveSearchJumpGlobalIndex(target);\r\n'
            '      if (currentIndex == null) return false;\r\n'
            '      if (_unreadWindowJumpInFlight && target != null) {\r\n'
            '        // The target is materialized and the previous viewport is retained.\r\n'
            '        // Align measured geometry directly instead of animating unseen rows\r\n'
            '        // for 250ms. The same strict center verification still runs below.\r\n'
            '        await _correctSearchJumpTargetToCenter(target);\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        await _geomScrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '          -currentIndex,\r\n'
            '          preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.middle,\r\n'
            '          reason: \'scroll_to_index_middle\',\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final stabilized = target == null\r\n'
            '          ? true\r\n'
            '          : await _stabilizeCenteredSearchJumpTarget(\r\n'
            '              target,\r\n'
            '              generation: generation ?? _searchJumpGeneration,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '      _lockSearchJumpStabilization(milliseconds: 1600);\r\n'
            '      return stabilized;\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < 8) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));\r\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '          return _centerOnGlobalIndex(\r\n'
            '            targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '            attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '            target: target,\r\n'
            '            generation: generation,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleScrollToFindingMsg() {\r\n'
            '    if ((findingMsg == null && findingAnchor == null) ||\r\n'
            '        _scrollToFindInFlight ||\r\n'
            '        _pendingScrollToFind) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _pendingScrollToFind = true;\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      _pendingScrollToFind = false;\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final anchor = findingAnchor;\r\n'
            '      if (anchor != null) {\r\n'
            '        _onScrollToAnchor(anchor);\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (findingMsg != null) {\r\n'
            '        _onScrollToIndex(findingMsg!);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.ensureVisualUpdate();\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  initFinding() async {\r\n'

            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _captureFirstUnreadAnchor(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    int unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (unreadMessageCount <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '        _unreadAnchorMessageCount(messageList) < unreadMessageCount ||\r\n'
            '        (_firstUnreadAnchor != null &&\r\n'
            '            _firstUnreadAnchor!.conversationID == _conversationId())) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _firstUnreadAnchor = _unreadAnchorFromCount(\r\n'
            '      messageList,\r\n'
            '      unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<_UnreadMessageAnchor?> _ensureFirstUnreadAnchor(\r\n'
            '    int unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '  ) async {\r\n'
            '    final existing = _firstUnreadAnchor;\r\n'
            '    if (existing != null && existing.conversationID == _conversationId()) {\r\n'
            '      return existing;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 大未读禁止按条数追翻；仅小未读 count_fallback 可用。\r\n'
            '    if (unreadMessageCount > FirstUnreadJump.maxCountFallbackUnread) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final maxRounds = (unreadMessageCount / 80).ceil() + 6;\r\n'
            '    for (var round = 0; round < maxRounds && mounted; round++) {\r\n'
            '      final messageList = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '      _captureFirstUnreadAnchor(messageList, unreadMessageCount);\r\n'
            '      final captured = _firstUnreadAnchor;\r\n'
            '      if (captured != null) {\r\n'
            '        return captured;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final previousAnchor = _anchorForPreviousLoad(messageList);\r\n'
            '      final loadedCount = _unreadAnchorMessageCount(messageList);\r\n'
            '      final remaining = unreadMessageCount - loadedCount;\r\n'
            '      final requestCount = remaining.clamp(1, 80).toInt();\r\n'
            '      var loadedMore = false;\r\n'
            '      if (previousAnchor != null) {\r\n'
            '        loadedMore = await widget.onLoadMore(\r\n'
            '          previousAnchor.msgID,\r\n'
            '          LoadDirection.previous,\r\n'
            '          requestCount,\r\n'
            '          previousAnchor.seq,\r\n'
            '          previousAnchor.message,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        loadedMore = await widget.model.loadChatRecord(\r\n'
            '          count: requestCount,\r\n'
            '          direction: LoadDirection.previous,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));\r\n'
            '      if (!loadedMore &&\r\n'
            '          _unreadAnchorMessageCount(_currentVisibleMessageList()) <\r\n'
            '              unreadMessageCount) {\r\n'
            '        final beforeCount = _unreadAnchorMessageCount(messageList);\r\n'
            '        await widget.model.loadChatRecord(\r\n'
            '          count: requestCount,\r\n'
            '          direction: LoadDirection.previous,\r\n'
            '          lastMsgID: previousAnchor?.msgID,\r\n'
            '          lastMsgSeq: previousAnchor?.seq ?? -1,\r\n'
            '          lastMsg: previousAnchor?.message,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));\r\n'
            '        final afterCount = _unreadAnchorMessageCount(\r\n'
            '          _currentVisibleMessageList(),\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        if (afterCount <= beforeCount) {\r\n'
            '          break;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _firstUnreadAnchor;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int? _latestUnreadGlobalIndex(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    int unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (unreadMessageCount <= 0 || messageList.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return null;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var realCount = 0;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < messageList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = messageList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (!_isRealChatMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      realCount++;\r\n'
            '      if (realCount <= unreadMessageCount) {\r\n'
            '        return i;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      break;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return null;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int _realMessageCount(List<V2TimMessage?> messageList) {\r\n'
            '    var count = 0;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messageList) {\r\n'
            '      if (_isRealChatMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '        count++;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return count;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleInitialUnreadAnchor(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    int unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (unreadMessageCount <= 0 || messageList.isEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final convId = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    if (_initialUnreadAnchorConversationID == convId &&\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorCount == unreadMessageCount) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_initialUnreadAnchorScheduled || _initialUnreadAnchorInFlight) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_realMessageCount(messageList) < unreadMessageCount) {\r\n'
            '      if (_initialUnreadAnchorAttempts < 30 && !_initialUnreadAnchorScheduled) {\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorAttempts++;\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorScheduled = true;\r\n'
            '        Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120), () {\r\n'
            '          _initialUnreadAnchorScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '          if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '            _scheduleInitialUnreadAnchor(\r\n'

            '          }\r\n'

            '      _initialUnreadAnchorScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorInFlight = false;\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      try {\r\n'
            '        await _scrollToFirstUnread(\r\n'
            '          unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '          preferTop: true,\r\n'
            '          animate: false,\r\n'
            '          stabilize: false,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '      } finally {\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorInFlight = false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _scrollToLatestUnread(\r\n'
            '    int unreadMessageCount, {\r\n'
            '    int attempt = 0,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'

            '            contextMenuModel.isContextMenuViewportRestoreActive(\r\n'

            '          }\r\n'

            '        _completedEntryUnreadCount = 0;\r\n'
            '        final globalModel = Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(\r\n'

            '          listen: false,\r\n'

            '          conversationID: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          remaining: unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '          below: false,\r\n'
            '          notify: true,\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        globalModel.setMessageListPosition(\r\n'
            '          _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '          HistoryMessagePosition.bottom,\r\n'
            '          notify: false,\r\n'

            '    } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < 30) {\r\n'
            '        Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120), () {\r\n'
            '          if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '            _scrollToLatestUnread(unreadMessageCount, attempt: attempt + 1);\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<void> _scrollToFirstUnread(\r\n'
            '    int unreadMessageCount, {\r\n'
            '    bool preferTop = false,\r\n'
            '    bool animate = true,\r\n'
            '    bool stabilize = true,\r\n'
            '    int attempt = 0,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted || unreadMessageCount <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final messageList = _visibleMessageList(widget.messageList);\r\n'
            '    final targetGlobalIndex = _firstUnreadGlobalIndex(\r\n'
            '      messageList,\r\n'
            '      unreadMessageCount,\r\n'

            '    if (targetGlobalIndex == null) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < 30) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));\r\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '          await _scrollToFirstUnread(\r\n'
            '            unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '            preferTop: preferTop,\r\n'
            '            animate: animate,\r\n'
            '            stabilize: stabilize,\r\n'
            '            attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'

            '    if (_singleScrollPositionOrNull() == null) {\r\n'
            '      if (attempt < 30) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 80));\r\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '          await _scrollToFirstUnread(\r\n'
            '            unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '            preferTop: preferTop,\r\n'
            '            animate: animate,\r\n'

            '              return _autoScrollController\r\n'
            '                  .scrollToIndex(\r\n'
            '                    -targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '                    preferPosition: AutoScrollPosition.middle,\r\n'
            '                  )\r\n'
            '                  .then((_) => true)\r\n'
            '                  .catchError((_) => false);\r\n'
            '            }();\r\n'
            '      if (!aligned) {\r\n'
            '        if (attempt < 30) {\r\n'
            '          await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));\r\n'
            '          if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '            await _scrollToFirstUnread(\r\n'
            '              unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '              preferTop: preferTop,\r\n'
            '              animate: animate,\r\n'
            '              stabilize: stabilize,\r\n'

            '      // 首次布局中图片/视频/长文本高度会在下一帧继续变化，补两次顶对齐，\r\n'
            '      // 确保点击“xx条新消息”后稳定停在最早一条未读消息。\r\n'
            '      if (stabilize && attempt < 2) {\r\n'
            '        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));\r\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\r\n'
            '          await _scrollToFirstUnread(\r\n'
            '            unreadMessageCount,\r\n'
            '            preferTop: preferTop,\r\n'
            '            animate: animate,\r\n'
            '            stabilize: stabilize,\r\n'
            '            attempt: attempt + 1,\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      } else {\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorConversationID = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorCount = unreadMessageCount;\r\n'
            '        _initialUnreadAnchorAttempts = 0;\r\n'
            '        _completedEntryUnreadCount = 0;\r\n'
            '        final globalModel = Provider.of<TUIChatGlobalModel>(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _scrollToFirstUnreadFromTongue(int requestedUnreadCount) async {\r\n'

            '    try {\r\n'

            '      if (!current()) return false;\r\n'
            '      final didScroll = await _jumpToFirstUnreadAroundWindow(fallbackCount);\r\n'

            '        convId,\r\n'

            '        notify: false,\r\n'

            '      // 跳到首条未读后：清掉入口未读胶囊计数，避免右下角变成「xxx条新消息」。\r\n'
            '      globalModel.releaseEntryUnreadReminder(convId);\r\n'
            '      globalModel.markEntryUnreadTongueDismissed(\r\n'
            '        conversationID: convId,\r\n'
            '        unreadCount: fallbackCount,\r\n'
            '        notify: false,\r\n'

            '      globalModel.clearUnreadTongueMetrics(convId, notify: true);\r\n'
            '      globalModel.setSearchJumpStatus(convId, SearchJumpStatus.success,\r\n'
            '          requestID: _searchJumpRequest, notify: true);\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\r\n'
            '      if (current()) _showCantFindFirstUnread();\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'

            '      if (current() && globalModel.isSearchJumpPending(convId)) {\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _jumpToFirstUnreadAroundWindow(int fallbackCount) async {\r\n'

            '    final conversationID = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    bool current() =>\r\n'

            '        conversationID == _conversationId() &&\r\n'

            '        _ownsSearchJumpRequest;\r\n'

            '                  lastMsgSeq: -1),\r\n'

            '      );\r\n'

            '      final anchor =\r\n'
            '          MessageAnchor.fromConversationMessage(widget.conversation, target);\r\n'
            '      final loaded = await widget.model\r\n'
            '          .loadListForSpecificMessage(\r\n'
            '              anchor: anchor, targetMessage: target, searchJumpRequest: request)\r\n'
            '          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));\r\n'
            '      if (!current() || !loaded) return false;\r\n'

            '    }\r\n'
            '    final lockedSeq =\r\n'
            '        widget.model.globalModel.lockedFirstUnreadSeqFor(conversationID);\r\n'
            '    // Entry unread is frozen before mark-read. A fresh read cursor cannot\r\n'
            '    // improve an already locked anchor, and adds a network round trip.\r\n'
            '    final conversation = lockedSeq > 0\r\n'
            '        ? widget.conversation\r\n'
            '        : await _conversationWithFreshReadCursor();\r\n'
            '    if (!current()) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final isGroup = conversation.type != 1;\r\n'
            '    final last =\r\n'
            '        widget.model.entryUnreadLastMessage ?? conversation.lastMessage;\r\n'
            '    final lastSeq = int.tryParse(last?.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') ??\r\n'
            '        _newestMessageSeqForUnreadJump();\r\n'
            '    final target = FirstUnreadJump.resolve(\r\n'
            '      unreadCount: fallbackCount,\r\n'
            '      isGroup: isGroup,\r\n'
            '      groupReadSequence: conversation.groupReadSequence,\r\n'
            '      c2cReadTimestamp: conversation.c2cReadTimestamp,\r\n'
            '      lastMessageSeq: lastSeq,\r\n'
            '      lastMessageTimestamp: last?.timestamp,\r\n'
            '      lockedFirstUnreadSeq: lockedSeq > 0 ? lockedSeq : null,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _logFirstUnreadJump(\'entry_unread_jump_begin\', <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '      \'unread\': fallbackCount,\r\n'
            '      \'isGroup\': isGroup,\r\n'

            '      \'seq\': target?.seq,\r\n'
            '      \'readTs\': target?.timestampSec,\r\n'
            '      \'groupReadSeq\': conversation.groupReadSequence,\r\n'
            '      \'c2cReadTs\': conversation.c2cReadTimestamp,\r\n'
            '      \'lastSeq\': lastSeq,\r\n'
            '      \'lockedSeq\': lockedSeq,\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    if (target == null) {\r\n'
            '      _logFirstUnreadJump(\'entry_unread_jump_no_target\', <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'unread\': fallbackCount,\r\n'

            '        \'lastSeq\': lastSeq,\r\n'
            '        \'lockedSeq\': lockedSeq,\r\n'
            '      });\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    int? targetGlobalIndex;\r\n'
            '    if ((target.strategy == \'group_read_seq\' ||\r\n'
            '            target.strategy == \'seq_from_unread\' ||\r\n'
            '            target.strategy == \'locked_seq\') &&\r\n'
            '        target.seq != null) {\r\n'
            '      final readSeq = target.groupReadCursorSeq ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      // Install the same around-message window as history search, including\r\n'
            '      // when the latest page happens to contain this seq. This establishes\r\n'
            '      // paging/positioning state before computing the target\'s visible index.\r\n'
            '      final loaded = await widget.model\r\n'
            '          .loadListForSpecificMessage(\r\n'
            '            seq: target.seq!,\r\n'
            '            searchJumpRequest: request,\r\n'
            '          )\r\n'
            '          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));\r\n'
            '      if (!current()) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (!loaded) {\r\n'
            '        _logFirstUnreadJump(\'entry_unread_jump_load_fail\', <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'seq\': target.seq,\r\n'
            '          \'strategy\': target.strategy,\r\n'
            '        });\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 整窗替换后等两帧，再按 seq 重定位（勿沿用替换前的最新页 index）。\r\n'
            '      await waitForSearchJumpLayout();\r\n'
            '      if (!current()) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      await waitForSearchJumpLayout();\r\n'
            '      if (!current()) {\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      targetGlobalIndex = _globalIndexForSeq(target.seq!.toString());\r\n'
            '      final oldestAfterLoad = _oldestLoadedSeqInWindow();\r\n'

            '        targetGlobalIndex = _globalIndexForFirstUnreadAfterSeq(readSeq);\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // Closest is only OK within a small seq neighborhood of the target.\r\n'
            '      final closest = _globalIndexForClosestSeq(\r\n'

            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (targetGlobalIndex == null && closest != null) {\r\n'
            '        final closestSeq = int.tryParse(\r\n'
            '              _currentVisibleMessageList()[closest]?.seq?.trim() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '            ) ??\r\n'
            '            0;\r\n'
            '        if (closestSeq > 0 && (closestSeq - target.seq!).abs() <= 20) {\r\n'
            '          targetGlobalIndex = closest;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _logFirstUnreadJump(\r\n'
            '        \'entry_unread_jump_after_replace\',\r\n'
            '        <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'seq\': target.seq,\r\n'
            '          \'index\': targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '          \'listLen\': _currentVisibleMessageList().length,\r\n'
            '          \'oldestSeq\': oldestAfterLoad,\r\n'
            '          \'newestSeq\': _newestLoadedSeqInWindow(),\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (targetGlobalIndex == null) {\r\n'
            '        _logFirstUnreadJump(\r\n'
            '          \'entry_unread_jump_index_missing\',\r\n'
            '          <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'seq\': target.seq,\r\n'
            '            \'listLen\': _currentVisibleMessageList().length,\r\n'
            '            \'oldestSeq\': _oldestLoadedSeqInWindow(),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return false;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final landedSeq = int.tryParse(\r\n'
            '            _currentVisibleMessageList()[targetGlobalIndex]?.seq?.trim() ?? \'\',\r\n'
            '          ) ??\r\n'
            '          0;\r\n'
            '      if (landedSeq > 0 && (landedSeq - target.seq!).abs() > 50) {\r\n'
            '        _logFirstUnreadJump(\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  int? _oldestLoadedSeqInWindow() {\r\n'
            '    final list = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    int? oldest;\r\n'
            '    for (final msg in list) {\r\n'
            '      if (!_isUnreadAnchorMessage(msg)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final seq = int.tryParse(msg?.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      if (seq <= 0) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (oldest == null || seq < oldest) {\r\n'
            '        oldest = seq;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return oldest;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int? _newestLoadedSeqInWindow() {\r\n'
            '    final list = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    int? newest;\r\n'
            '    for (final msg in list) {\r\n'
            '      if (!_isUnreadAnchorMessage(msg)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final seq = int.tryParse(msg?.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      if (seq <= 0) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (newest == null || seq > newest) {\r\n'
            '        newest = seq;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'

            '\r\n'
            '  int? _globalIndexForClosestSeq(\r\n'
            '    int targetSeq, {\r\n'
            '    bool preferAtOrAfter = false,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final messageList = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    int? bestIndex;\r\n'
            '    var bestDelta = 1 << 30;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < messageList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = messageList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (!_isUnreadAnchorMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final seq = int.tryParse(message?.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      if (seq <= 0) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      if (preferAtOrAfter && seq < targetSeq) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final delta = (seq - targetSeq).abs();\r\n'
            '      if (delta < bestDelta) {\r\n'
            '        bestDelta = delta;\r\n'
            '        bestIndex = i;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (bestIndex != null) {\r\n'
            '      return bestIndex;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // Fallback: any closest seq (including older).\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < messageList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = messageList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (!_isUnreadAnchorMessage(message)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final seq = int.tryParse(message?.seq?.trim() ?? \'\') ?? 0;\r\n'
            '      if (seq <= 0) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final delta = (seq - targetSeq).abs();\r\n'
            '      if (delta < bestDelta) {\r\n'
            '        bestDelta = delta;\r\n'
            '        bestIndex = i;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return bestIndex;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  Future<bool> _finishFirstUnreadJump(\r\n'
            '    int targetGlobalIndex, {\r\n'
            '    String? preferSeq,\r\n'
            '  }) async {\r\n'
            '    final request = _searchJumpRequest;\r\n'
            '    final conversationID = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    bool current() =>\r\n'
            '        mounted &&\r\n'
            '        _conversationId() == conversationID &&\r\n'
            '        request == _searchJumpRequest &&\r\n'
            '        _ownsSearchJumpRequest;\r\n'
            '    if (!current()) return false;\r\n'
            '    final list = _currentVisibleMessageList();\r\n'
            '    String? anchorMsgID;\r\n'
            '    String? anchorSeq;\r\n'
            '    if (targetGlobalIndex >= 0 && targetGlobalIndex < list.length) {\r\n'
            '      final msg = list[targetGlobalIndex];\r\n'
            '      anchorMsgID = msg?.msgID;\r\n'
            '      anchorSeq = msg?.seq?.trim();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    anchorSeq ??= preferSeq?.trim();\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (targetGlobalIndex < 0 ||\r\n'
            '        targetGlobalIndex >= list.length ||\r\n'
            '        list[targetGlobalIndex] == null) return false;\r\n'
            '    final targetAnchor = MessageAnchor.fromConversationMessage(\r\n'
            '        widget.conversation, list[targetGlobalIndex]!);\r\n'
            '    setState(() {\r\n'
            '      _entryUnreadOrigin = targetAnchor;\r\n'
            '      _deferUnreadCenterPartition = false;\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    await waitForSearchJumpLayout();\r\n'
            '    if (!current()) return false;\r\n'
            '    final generation = ++_searchJumpGeneration;\r\n'
            '    final didScroll = await _centerOnGlobalIndex(targetGlobalIndex,\r\n'
            '        target: _SearchJumpTarget(\r\n'
            '            resolveIndex: () => _globalIndexForAnchor(targetAnchor)),\r\n'
            '        generation: generation);\r\n'
            '    if (!current()) return false;\r\n'
            '    if (didScroll) {\r\n'
            '      final matched = _messageForAnchor(targetAnchor);\r\n'
            '      final jumpId =\r\n'
            '          matched == null ? targetAnchor.stableKey : _messageIdentity(matched);\r\n'
            '      if (jumpId.isNotEmpty) widget.model.jumpMsgID = jumpId;\r\n'
            '      _releaseSearchJumpMemoryWindowSuppress(\r\n'
            '        anchorMsgID: anchorMsgID,\r\n'
            '        anchorSeq: anchorSeq,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      _logFirstUnreadJump(\'entry_unread_jump_success\', <String, Object?>{\r\n'
