            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      insertedHeight +=\r\n'
            '          ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.estimateRowHeight(message) ??\r\n'
            '              (message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_GROUP_TIPS\r\n'
            '                  ? _shortHistoryGroupTipsEstimatedRowHeight\r\n'
            '                  : _shortHistoryMessageEstimatedRowHeight);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (insertedTipRows > 0) {\r\n'
            '      insertedHeight +=\r\n'
            '          insertedTipRows * _shortHistoryTimeDividerEstimatedRowHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (insertedHeight <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final next = _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight - insertedHeight;\r\n'
            '    // 仅「装不下」才失败：spacer 吃到 0 仍算成功（刚好铺满），不要提前上推。\r\n'
            '    if (next < 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    _assignShortHistorySpacer(\r\n'
            '      next <= 1 ? 0.0 : next,\r\n'
            '      reason: \'spacer_absorb_insert\',\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched = true;\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight >= 0) {\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistoryContentHeight(\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight + insertedHeight,\r\n'
            '        reason: \'content_h_absorb_insert_add\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    } else {\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistoryContentHeight(\r\n'
            '        insertedHeight,\r\n'
            '        reason: \'content_h_absorb_insert\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return true;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// reveal 后暖开归档/云补导致的中间插入或缩窗：用 Δcontent 对冲 spacer，钉住 tip。\r\n'
            '  _AsyncSpacerAbsorbResult _absorbAsyncHistoryListChangeIntoShortSpacer({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> oldList,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> newList,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched &&\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return _AsyncSpacerAbsorbResult.skipped;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final oldKeys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < oldList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = oldList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (message == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      oldKeys.add(_asyncHistoryIdentityKey(message, i));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final newKeys = <String>{};\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < newList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = newList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (message == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      newKeys.add(_asyncHistoryIdentityKey(message, i));\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var addedHeight = 0.0;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < newList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = newList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (message == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final key = _asyncHistoryIdentityKey(message, i);\r\n'
            '      if (oldKeys.contains(key)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      addedHeight += _estimateShortHistoryRowHeight(message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    var removedHeight = 0.0;\r\n'
            '    for (var i = 0; i < oldList.length; i++) {\r\n'
            '      final message = oldList[i];\r\n'
            '      if (message == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      final key = _asyncHistoryIdentityKey(message, i);\r\n'
            '      if (newKeys.contains(key)) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      removedHeight += _estimateShortHistoryRowHeight(message);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final deltaContent = addedHeight - removedHeight;\r\n'
            '    if (deltaContent.abs() < 0.5) {\r\n'
            '      return _AsyncSpacerAbsorbResult.skipped;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prevSpacer = _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight;\r\n'
            '    final nextSpacer = prevSpacer - deltaContent;\r\n'
            '    if (nextSpacer < 0) {\r\n'
            '      return _AsyncSpacerAbsorbResult.overflow;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final reason = deltaContent > 0\r\n'
            '        ? \'short_spacer_absorb_async_grow\'\r\n'
            '        : \'short_spacer_absorb_async_shrink\';\r\n'
            '    _assignShortHistorySpacer(\r\n'
            '      nextSpacer <= 1 ? 0.0 : nextSpacer,\r\n'
            '      reason: reason,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched = true;\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight >= 0) {\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistoryContentHeight(\r\n'
            '        (_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight + deltaContent)\r\n'
            '            .clamp(0.0, double.infinity)\r\n'
            '            .toDouble(),\r\n'
            '        reason: \'${reason}_content_h\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '      reason,\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'oldLen\': oldList.length,\r\n'
            '        \'newLen\': newList.length,\r\n'
            '        \'addedH\': addedHeight.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'removedH\': removedHeight.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'deltaContent\': deltaContent.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'prevSpacer\': prevSpacer.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'nextSpacer\':\r\n'
            '            _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    return _AsyncSpacerAbsorbResult.ok;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _asyncHistoryIdentityKey(V2TimMessage message, int index) {\r\n'
            '    final msgId = message.msgID?.trim() ?? \'\';\r\n'
            '    if (msgId.isNotEmpty) {\r\n'
            '      return \'msgid_$msgId\';\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _stableMessageListKey(message, index);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _estimateShortHistoryRowHeight(V2TimMessage message) {\r\n'
            '    if (message.elemType == 11) {\r\n'
            '      return _shortHistoryTimeDividerEstimatedRowHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final cachedHeight = ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.heightFor(message);\r\n'
            '    if (cachedHeight != null && cachedHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return cachedHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.estimateRowHeight(message) ??\r\n'
            '        (message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_GROUP_TIPS\r\n'
            '            ? _shortHistoryGroupTipsEstimatedRowHeight\r\n'
            '            : _shortHistoryMessageEstimatedRowHeight);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _updateShortHistoryBaselineViewport(double viewportHeight) {\r\n'
            '    if (viewportHeight > 0 && !_isKeyboardInsetActive(context)) {\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryBaselineViewportHeight = viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _tryLatchShortHistoryAlignment({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    required int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    required double viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '    required BuildContext context,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched ||\r\n'
            '          _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '        _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isShortHistoryTopAlignmentBlocked(safeUnreadCount)) {\r\n'
            '      _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_contentExceedsShortHistoryViewport(\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      // 键盘动画中视口会瞬时变矮：清 latch 后再 re-prime 会造成 211↔379 大跳。\r\n'
            '      if (_isKeyboardInsetActive(context) ||\r\n'
            '          _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_shouldAlignShortHistoryToTop(\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched = true;\r\n'
            '      _updateShortHistoryBaselineViewport(viewportHeight);\r\n'
            '    } else if (!_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched) {\r\n'
            '      _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _contentExceedsShortHistoryViewport({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    required double viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '    required BuildContext context,\r\n'
            '    double? measuredContentHeight,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (viewportHeight <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final verticalPadding = _resolvedHistoryListVerticalPadding(context);\r\n'
            '    var contentHeight = measuredContentHeight ?? -1.0;\r\n'
            '    if (contentHeight < 0) {\r\n'
            '      final tilesHeight = _visibleHistoryTilesHeight(\r\n'
            '        expectedMessageCount: _shortHistoryTileCount(messageList),\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '      if (tilesHeight >= 0) {\r\n'
            '        contentHeight = tilesHeight;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (contentHeight < 0) {\r\n'
            '      contentHeight = _resolvedShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return contentHeight > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        contentHeight + verticalPadding + _shortHistoryAlignmentHysteresis >=\r\n'
            '            viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldKeepShortHistoryTopAlignment({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    required int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    required double viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '    required BuildContext context,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isShortHistoryTopAlignmentBlocked(safeUnreadCount)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentSuppressedByLiveInsert) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 已 latch：键盘开关过程中始终保持顶部对齐（只重算 spacer，不释放）。\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 键盘弹出后用当前（变矮的）视口判定/算 spacer；\r\n'
            '    // 无键盘时可用 baseline，避免输入栏微抖导致反复 latch。\r\n'
            '    final resolvedViewport = _isKeyboardInsetActive(context)\r\n'
            '        ? viewportHeight\r\n'
            '        : (_routeScroll.shortHistoryBaselineViewportHeight > 0\r\n'
            '            ? _routeScroll.shortHistoryBaselineViewportHeight\r\n'
            '            : viewportHeight);\r\n'
            '    if (_contentExceedsShortHistoryViewport(\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: resolvedViewport,\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _shouldAlignShortHistoryToTop(\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: resolvedViewport,\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _resolvedShortHistoryViewportForDecision(BuildContext context) {\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    if (position != null &&\r\n'
            '        position.hasContentDimensions &&\r\n'
            '        position.viewportDimension > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return position.viewportDimension;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryBaselineViewportHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return _routeScroll.shortHistoryBaselineViewportHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return _shortHistoryAvailableViewportHeight(context);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _releaseShortHistoryAlignmentAndPinBottom() {\r\n'
            '    final wasShort = _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched ||\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 0 ||\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight >= 0;\r\n'
            '    _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '    if (wasShort && mounted && !_isHistoryScrollProtected) {\r\n'
            '      // 进页 settle 内只清 latch，禁止强制 pin，避免估高校正触发贴底跳动。\r\n'
            '      if (_isInitialRouteSettleWindow) {\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _schedulePinScrollToBottom();\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _shortHistoryAvailableViewportHeight(BuildContext context) {\r\n'
            '    final coordinator = KeyboardViewportTransitionCoordinator.active;\r\n'
            '    var viewport = coordinator?.lastViewHeight ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    var padTop = coordinator?.lastPaddingTop ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    var padBottom = coordinator?.lastPaddingBottom ?? 0;\r\n'
            '    if (viewport <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      final view = View.maybeOf(context);\r\n'
            '      if (view != null) {\r\n'
            '        final dpr = view.devicePixelRatio == 0 ? 1.0 : view.devicePixelRatio;\r\n'
            '        viewport = view.physicalSize.height / dpr;\r\n'
            '        padTop = view.padding.top / dpr;\r\n'
            '        padBottom = view.padding.bottom / dpr;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 聊天区域约为全屏去掉顶栏、输入栏与安全区后的高度。\r\n'
            '    return (viewport - padTop - padBottom) * 0.62;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _shouldAlignShortHistoryToTop({\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    required int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    required double viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '    required BuildContext context,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentSuppressedByLiveInsert) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_isShortHistoryTopAlignmentBlocked(safeUnreadCount)) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_shortHistoryRealMessageCount(messageList) == 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (viewportHeight <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final verticalPadding = _resolvedHistoryListVerticalPadding(context);\r\n'
            '    final contentHeight = _resolvedShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '    if (contentHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return contentHeight +\r\n'
            '              verticalPadding +\r\n'
            '              _shortHistoryAlignmentHysteresis <\r\n'
            '          viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final estimate = _estimateShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '    return estimate > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        estimate + verticalPadding + _shortHistoryAlignmentHysteresis <\r\n'
            '            viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  bool _mayUseShortHistoryTopAlignment() {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (findingMsg != null ||\r\n'
            '        findingAnchor != null ||\r\n'
            '        widget.initFindingMsg != null ||\r\n'
            '        widget.searchJumpAnchor != null ||\r\n'
            '        _atJumpOrigin != null) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_shortHistoryRealMessageCount(widget.messageList) == 0) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!mounted) {\r\n'
            '      return _estimateShortHistoryContentHeight(widget.messageList) > 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentSuppressedByLiveInsert) {\r\n'
            '      return false;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched ||\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      return true;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final available = _resolvedShortHistoryViewportForDecision(context);\r\n'
            '    return _shouldAlignShortHistoryToTop(\r\n'
            '      messageList: widget.messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: 0,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: available,\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _resolvedHistoryListVerticalPadding(BuildContext context) {\r\n'
            '    final padding = widget.mainHistoryListConfig?.padding;\r\n'
            '    if (padding == null) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final direction = Directionality.maybeOf(context) ?? TextDirection.ltr;\r\n'
            '    return padding.resolve(direction).vertical;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _visibleHistoryTilesHeight({required int expectedMessageCount}) {\r\n'
            '    var total = 0.0;\r\n'
            '    var measured = 0;\r\n'
            '    for (final tag in _autoScrollController.tagMap.values) {\r\n'
            '      final tagContext = tag.context;\r\n'
            '      final renderObject = tagContext?.findRenderObject();\r\n'
            '      if (renderObject is! RenderBox ||\r\n'
            '          !renderObject.attached ||\r\n'
            '          !renderObject.hasSize) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      total += renderObject.size.height;\r\n'
            '      measured++;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // 短列表会完整构建所有消息行；只有全部行都拿到布局尺寸时才采用\r\n'
            '    // 实测总高，避免可见 tag 尚未齐全时用部分高度生成过大的 spacer。\r\n'
            '    return measured < expectedMessageCount ? -1 : total;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  int _shortHistoryRealMessageCount(List<V2TimMessage?> messageList) {\r\n'
            '    return messageList\r\n'
            '        .where((message) => message != null && message.elemType != 11)\r\n'
            '        .length;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 短历史测高期望的 tile 数（含时间分割线），与 AutoScrollTag 一一对应。\r\n'
            '  int _shortHistoryTileCount(List<V2TimMessage?> messageList) {\r\n'
            '    return messageList.where((message) => message != null).length;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  List<V2TimMessage> _nonNullHistoryMessages(List<V2TimMessage?> messageList) {\r\n'
            '    if (messageList is List<V2TimMessage>) return messageList;\r\n'
            '    return messageList.whereType<V2TimMessage>().toList(growable: false);\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  String _historyIdentitySignatureForList(List<V2TimMessage?> messageList) {\r\n'
            '    return TUIChatGlobalModel.historyIdentitySignature(\r\n'
            '      _nonNullHistoryMessages(messageList),\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _estimateShortHistoryContentHeight(List<V2TimMessage?> messageList) {\r\n'
            '    final screenWidth = mounted\r\n'
            '        ? MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width\r\n'
            '        : ChatMessageHeightCache.defaultScreenWidth;\r\n'
            '    var total = 0.0;\r\n'
            '    var counted = 0;\r\n'
            '    for (final message in messageList) {\r\n'
            '      if (message == null) {\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 时间分割线必须计入：空会话首条会「先气泡、后闪时间」，contentH 偏小再回弹。\r\n'
            '      if (message.elemType == 11) {\r\n'
            '        counted++;\r\n'
            '        total += _shortHistoryTimeDividerEstimatedRowHeight;\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      counted++;\r\n'
            '      final cachedHeight = ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.heightFor(message);\r\n'
            '      if (cachedHeight != null && cachedHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '        total += cachedHeight;\r\n'
            '        continue;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 缓存未命中时用类型感知估高（文本 TextPainter / 图视频占位），避免一律 56。\r\n'
            '      final estimated = ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.estimateRowHeight(\r\n'
            '            message,\r\n'
            '            screenWidth: screenWidth,\r\n'
            '          ) ??\r\n'
            '          (message.elemType == MessageElemType.V2TIM_ELEM_TYPE_GROUP_TIPS\r\n'
            '              ? _shortHistoryGroupTipsEstimatedRowHeight\r\n'
            '              : _shortHistoryMessageEstimatedRowHeight);\r\n'
            '      total += estimated;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return counted == 0 ? -1 : total;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _resolvedShortHistoryContentHeight(List<V2TimMessage?> messageList) {\r\n'
            '    final estimate = _estimateShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight >= 0) {\r\n'
            '      // 实测落地后 display 必须以 stored 为 SSOT，禁止 estimate 软覆盖\r\n'
            '      //（日志里 spacer 201↔127 即 estimate=549 盖住 measured=475）。\r\n'
            '      if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured) {\r\n'
            '        if (estimate > _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight + 8) {\r\n'
            '          ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '            \'estimate_resolve_blocked_after_measure\',\r\n'
            '            extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '              \'estimate\': estimate.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '              \'contentH\':\r\n'
            '                  _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '            },\r\n'
            '          );\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        return _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      // 仅估高阶段：首帧若只量到气泡、时间分割线尚未入 tagMap，stored 会偏小；\r\n'
            '      // 用含 divider 的估高兜住，避免 spacer 先过大再回弹。\r\n'
            '      if (estimate > _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight + 8) {\r\n'
            '        return estimate;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return estimate;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _setShortHistoryContentHeight(double nextHeight) {\r\n'
            '    final normalized = nextHeight < 0 ? -1.0 : nextHeight;\r\n'
            '    if ((_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight - normalized).abs() <= 0.5) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prev = _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight;\r\n'
            '    setState(() {\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistoryContentHeight(normalized, reason: \'content_h_set\');\r\n'
            '    });\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logLayoutPulse(\r\n'
            '      reason: \'short_history_content_h\',\r\n'
            '      contentH: normalized,\r\n'
            '      spacer: _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight,\r\n'
            '      latched: _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '      \'content_h_change\',\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'prev\': prev.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'next\': normalized.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'delta\': (normalized - prev).toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _setShortHistoryBottomSpacer(double nextHeight) {\r\n'
            '    final normalized = nextHeight <= 1 ? 0.0 : nextHeight;\r\n'
            '    if ((_routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight - normalized).abs() <= 1) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final prev = _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight;\r\n'
            '    _assignShortHistorySpacer(normalized, reason: \'spacer_set\');\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.logLayoutPulse(\r\n'
            '      reason: \'short_history_spacer\',\r\n'
            '      spacer: normalized,\r\n'
            '      contentH: _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight,\r\n'
            '      scrollPixels: position?.hasPixels == true ? position!.pixels : null,\r\n'
            '      maxExtent: position?.hasContentDimensions == true\r\n'
            '          ? position!.maxScrollExtent\r\n'
            '          : null,\r\n'
            '      latched: _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    ChatJitterDiag.log(\r\n'
            '      \'spacer_change\',\r\n'
            '      extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '        \'prev\': prev.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'next\': normalized.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '        \'delta\': (normalized - prev).toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '      },\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _shortHistorySpacerForViewport(\r\n'
            '    BuildContext context,\r\n'
            '    double viewportHeight, {\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    required int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!_shouldKeepShortHistoryTopAlignment(\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final contentHeight = _resolvedShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '    if (contentHeight < 0) {\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final verticalPadding = _resolvedHistoryListVerticalPadding(context);\r\n'
            '    var target = viewportHeight - contentHeight - verticalPadding;\r\n'
            '    if (target < 0) {\r\n'
            '      target = 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return target;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  double _displayShortHistoryBottomSpacer(\r\n'
            '    BuildContext context, {\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    required int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    required double viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched ||\r\n'
            '          _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '        _clearShortHistoryAlignmentLatch();\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      return 0;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final keyboardActive = _isKeyboardInsetActive(context);\r\n'
            '    final keyboardJustDismissed =\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryKeyboardJustDismissed;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _primeShortHistorySpacerFromEstimate(\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if (viewportHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      _tryLatchShortHistoryAlignment(\r\n'
            '        messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '        safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '        viewportHeight: viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '        context: context,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // B2：latch 后 estimate 不得覆盖已有 contentH（尤其实测后）。\r\n'
            '    final estimate = _estimateShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched &&\r\n'
            '        estimate > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight >= 0 &&\r\n'
            '        estimate > _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight + 8) {\r\n'
            '      ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '        \'estimate_blocked_after_measure\',\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '          \'estimate\': estimate.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          \'contentH\': _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          \'measured\': _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured,\r\n'
            '        },\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    // 已 latch：始终用「视口 − 内容」算 spacer（含键盘动画帧）。\r\n'
            '    // 不再用 delta 累积——收起后 delta/拦截一旦不同步，spacer 会停在键盘矮值，\r\n'
            '    // 表现为顶部大空白、消息沉在中下部，且要等下一轮才慢慢纠正。\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched && viewportHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      final contentHeight = _resolvedShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '      if (contentHeight >= 0) {\r\n'
            '        final verticalPadding = _resolvedHistoryListVerticalPadding(context);\r\n'
            '        var target = viewportHeight - contentHeight - verticalPadding;\r\n'
            '        if (target < 0) {\r\n'
            '          target = 0;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        final normalized = target <= 1 ? 0.0 : target;\r\n'
            '        final prevVp = _routeScroll.shortHistoryLastTrackedViewportHeight;\r\n'
            '        final viewportGrew = prevVp > 0 && viewportHeight > prevVp + 1;\r\n'
            '        final viewportShrunk = prevVp > 0 && viewportHeight + 1 < prevVp;\r\n'
            '        // 估高误差抬高 spacer（视口没变）仍拦截；视口变大/键盘收起/变矮必须跟。\r\n'
            '        final wouldGrow =\r\n'
            '            normalized > _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight + 1;\r\n'
            '        if (wouldGrow &&\r\n'
            '            !keyboardActive &&\r\n'
            '            !keyboardJustDismissed &&\r\n'
            '            !viewportGrew &&\r\n'
            '            !viewportShrunk &&\r\n'
            '            _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 1) {\r\n'
            '          if (viewportHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '            _routeScroll.shortHistoryLastTrackedViewportHeight = viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '          return _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight;\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        if ((normalized - _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight).abs() >\r\n'
            '            1) {\r\n'
            '          _assignShortHistorySpacer(normalized, reason: \'spacer_set\');\r\n'
            '          if (keyboardJustDismissed || viewportGrew) {\r\n'
            '            ChatJitterDiag.logLayoutPulse(\r\n'
            '              reason: keyboardJustDismissed\r\n'
            '                  ? \'short_history_spacer_keyboard_dismiss\'\r\n'
            '                  : \'short_history_spacer_viewport_grow\',\r\n'
            '              spacer: normalized,\r\n'
            '              contentH: contentHeight,\r\n'
            '              latched: true,\r\n'
            '            );\r\n'
            '          }\r\n'
            '        }\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryLastTrackedViewportHeight = viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '        return _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    final spacer = _shortHistorySpacerForViewport(\r\n'
            '      context,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if ((spacer - _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight).abs() > 1) {\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistorySpacer(spacer, reason: \'spacer_display_sync\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (viewportHeight > 0) {\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryLastTrackedViewportHeight = viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched ||\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight > 1) {\r\n'
            '      return _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    return spacer;\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// 首帧用估高预填 contentH/spacer，避免暖窗短列表先贴底、测高后再跳到顶部。\r\n'
            '  void _primeShortHistorySpacerFromEstimate({\r\n'
            '    required BuildContext context,\r\n'
            '    required List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    required int safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    required double viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    if (!ChatListRouteScrollRestore.shortHistoryTopAlignmentEnabled) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (viewportHeight <= 0 ||\r\n'
            '        _isShortHistoryTopAlignmentBlocked(safeUnreadCount) ||\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentSuppressedByLiveInsert) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final signature = _historyIdentitySignatureForList(messageList);\r\n'
            '    final lastMeasured =\r\n'
            '        ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.measuredContentHeightFor(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      identitySignature: signature,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final estimate = lastMeasured != null && lastMeasured > 0\r\n'
            '        ? lastMeasured\r\n'
            '        : _estimateShortHistoryContentHeight(messageList);\r\n'
            '    if (lastMeasured != null && lastMeasured > 0) {\r\n'
            '      ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '        \'content_h_prime_last_measured\',\r\n'
            '        extras: <String, Object?>{\'contentH\': lastMeasured.toStringAsFixed(1)},\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // B2：仅 contentH 未就绪且未实测时允许 estimate 写入；禁止抬高覆盖。\r\n'
            '    if (estimate > 0 &&\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight < 0 &&\r\n'
            '        !_routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeightMeasured) {\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistoryContentHeight(\r\n'
            '        estimate,\r\n'
            '        reason: lastMeasured != null && lastMeasured > 0\r\n'
            '            ? \'content_h_prime_last_measured\'\r\n'
            '            : \'content_h_prime_estimate\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (!_shouldAlignShortHistoryToTop(\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight: viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '      context: context,\r\n'
            '    )) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final target = _shortHistorySpacerForViewport(\r\n'
            '      context,\r\n'
            '      viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '      messageList: messageList,\r\n'
            '      safeUnreadCount: safeUnreadCount,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    // 已 latch：键盘收起后用公式恢复 spacer，禁止再走「从 0 re-prime」\r\n'
            '    //（日志里 spacer_prime 211→379 就是这条路径抖起来的）。\r\n'
            '    if (target > 1 &&\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight <= 1 &&\r\n'
            '        _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched) {\r\n'
            '      if (_blockShortSpacerReprimeAfterReveal) {\r\n'
            '        ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '          \'short_spacer_reprime_blocked_after_reveal\',\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'cause\': \'spacer_prime_relatch\',\r\n'
            '            \'target\': target.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistorySpacer(target, reason: \'spacer_prime_relatch\');\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryLastTrackedViewportHeight = viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (target > 1 && _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight <= 1) {\r\n'
            '      if (_blockShortSpacerReprimeAfterReveal) {\r\n'
            '        ChatGeomSettleTrace.noteReason(\r\n'
            '          \'short_spacer_reprime_blocked_after_reveal\',\r\n'
            '          extras: <String, Object?>{\r\n'
            '            \'cause\': \'spacer_prime\',\r\n'
            '            \'target\': target.toStringAsFixed(1),\r\n'
            '          },\r\n'
            '        );\r\n'
            '        return;\r\n'
            '      }\r\n'
            '      _assignShortHistorySpacer(target, reason: \'spacer_prime\');\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryAlignmentLatched = true;\r\n'
            '      _updateShortHistoryBaselineViewport(viewportHeight);\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortHistoryLastTrackedViewportHeight = viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '      ChatJitterDiag.logLayoutPulse(\r\n'
            '        reason: \'short_history_spacer_prime\',\r\n'
            '        spacer: target,\r\n'
            '        contentH: _routeScroll.shortHistoryContentHeight,\r\n'
            '        latched: true,\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _persistShortHistoryMeasuredContentHeight(\r\n'
            '    List<V2TimMessage?> messageList,\r\n'
            '    double contentHeight,\r\n'
            '  ) {\r\n'
            '    if (contentHeight <= 0) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    ChatMessageHeightCache.instance.rememberMeasuredContentHeight(\r\n'
            '      conversationID: _conversationId(),\r\n'
            '      identitySignature: _historyIdentitySignatureForList(messageList),\r\n'
            '      contentHeight: contentHeight,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  /// Apply measured spacer; when Δ large and scroll room exists, compensate\r\n'
            '  /// pixels so content does not visibly jump. At maxExtent≈0 compensation is\r\n'
            '  /// a no-op — warm/cold reveal deferral + lastMeasured prime cover that case.\r\n'
            '  void _applyShortHistorySpacerMeasureTarget({\r\n'
            '    required double target,\r\n'
            '    required double viewportHeight,\r\n'
            '  }) {\r\n'
            '    final normalized = target <= 1 ? 0.0 : target;\r\n'
            '    final prev = _routeScroll.shortHistoryBottomSpacerHeight;\r\n'
            '    final delta = normalized - prev;\r\n'
            '    final absDelta = delta.abs();\r\n'
            '    final globalModel = _chatGlobalModel;\r\n'
            '    final userScrolling = globalModel?.isChatListUserScrolling == true ||\r\n'
            '        _pageUi.userScrolling.value;\r\n'
            '    final position = _singleScrollPositionOrNull();\r\n'
            '    final canLockAnchor = !userScrolling &&\r\n'
            '        !_isHistoryScrollProtected &&\r\n'
            '        absDelta > _shortHistorySpacerRebuildTolerancePx &&\r\n'
            '        position != null &&\r\n'
            '        position.hasPixels &&\r\n'
            '        position.hasContentDimensions &&\r\n'
            '        position.maxScrollExtent > 1;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    _assignShortHistorySpacer(normalized, reason: \'spacer_measure_target\');\r\n'
            '    _routeScroll.shortHistoryLastTrackedViewportHeight = viewportHeight;\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '    if (!canLockAnchor || position == null) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    // reverse 列表底 spacer 变高且贴底时消息上移；有滚动余量时把 pixels 往同向推回。\r\n'
            '    final nextPixels = (position.pixels + delta).clamp(\r\n'
            '      position.minScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '      position.maxScrollExtent,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    if ((nextPixels - position.pixels).abs() > 0.5) {\r\n'
            '      _geomJumpTo(nextPixels, reason: \'spacer_measure_lock_anchor\');\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '  }\r\n'
            '\r\n'
            '  void _scheduleShortViewportHistoryFill(_PreviousLoadAnchor? anchor) {\r\n'
            '    // 缓存暖开时也可能只恢复到几条消息。只要模型明确还有历史且列表仍\r\n'
            '    // 不可滚动，就继续静默补页；否则用户无法通过滚动触发上一页。\r\n'
            '    // C-fix：首屏 reveal 未完成时，禁止此自动补页入口触发 schedule_previous。\r\n'
            '    // 否则首屏 widget 树刚进 vsync（maxScrollExtent<1）就会立即再拉 SDK，\r\n'
            '    // 阻塞 first_paint。允许时机：reveal 已完成 OR 已有过 reveal 过的会话重开。\r\n'
            '    final viewportFillKey = ChatPipelineClock.normalizeKey(\r\n'
            '      rawConversationId: widget.conversation.conversationID,\r\n'
            '      userId: widget.conversation.userID,\r\n'
            '      groupId: widget.conversation.groupID,\r\n'
            '    );\r\n'
            '    final precheckOffsetMs =\r\n'
            '        ChatPipelineClock.instance.offsetMs(viewportFillKey);\r\n'
            '    // ignore: avoid_print\r\n'
            '    if (ChatHistoryTrace.enabled) {\r\n'
            '      debugPrint(\r\n'
            '        \'[RevealTrace] reason=viewport_fill_entry conv=$viewportFillKey \'\r\n'
            '        \'revealPainted=$_historyOpenRevealPainted \'\r\n'
            '        \'hasContentDimensions=${_singleScrollPositionOrNull()?.hasContentDimensions} \'\r\n'
            '        \'maxScrollExtent=${_singleScrollPositionOrNull()?.maxScrollExtent} \'\r\n'
            '        \'haveMoreData=${widget.model.haveMoreData} \'\r\n'
            '        \'shortFillScheduled=${_routeScroll.shortViewportHistoryFillScheduled} \'\r\n'
            '        \'loadingPrevious=${_paginationUi.isLoadingPrevious} \'\r\n'
            '        \'taskInFlight=${_paginationUi.loadPreviousTask != null} \'\r\n'
            '        \'tickOffsetMs=$precheckOffsetMs \'\r\n'
            '        \'msgCount=${widget.messageList.length}\',\r\n'
            '      );\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    if (_routeScroll.shortViewportHistoryFillScheduled ||\r\n'
            '        anchor == null ||\r\n'
            '        !_canAttemptPreviousHistoryPagination() ||\r\n'
            '        _paginationUi.isLoadingPrevious ||\r\n'
            '        _paginationUi.loadPreviousTask != null ||\r\n'
            '        _isHistoryScrollProtected ||\r\n'
            '        _isSearchJumpStabilizing) {\r\n'
            '      return;\r\n'
            '    }\r\n'
            '    final scheduledModel = widget.model;\r\n'
            '    final scheduledConversation = _conversationId();\r\n'
            '    final scheduledWindowIsCurrent =\r\n'
            '        scheduledModel.captureHistoryWindowPublicationFence();\r\n'
            '    _routeScroll.shortViewportHistoryFillScheduled = true;\r\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\r\n'
            '      _routeScroll.shortViewportHistoryFillScheduled = false;\r\n'
            '      // C-fix 续：post-frame 再次校验 reveal 状态；reveal 未完成直接 return。\r\n'
            '      if (!mounted ||\r\n'
            '          !identical(widget.model, scheduledModel) ||\r\n'
            '          _conversationId() != scheduledConversation ||\r\n'
            '          !scheduledWindowIsCurrent() ||\r\n'
            '          !_historyOpenRevealPainted ||\r\n'
            '          !_canAttemptPreviousHistoryPagination() ||\r\n'
            '          _paginationUi.isLoadingPrevious ||\r\n'
            '          _paginationUi.loadPreviousTask != null ||\r\n'
            '          _isHistoryScrollProtected ||\r\n'
            '          _isSearchJumpStabilizing) {\r\n'
            '        final postOffsetMs =\r\n'
            '            ChatPipelineClock.instance.offsetMs(viewportFillKey);\r\n'
            '        // ignore: avoid_print\r\n'
